verses.textZh: 扫罗死后，大卫杀退了亚玛力人回来，就在洗革拉住了两天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗死后，大卫杀退了亚玛力人回来，就在洗革拉住了两天。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗死后，大卫击杀亚玛力人回来，在洗革拉住了两天。
verses.textEnNiv: After the death of Saul, David returned from striking down the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.
verses.textEnEsv: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from striking down the Amalekites, David remained two days in Ziklag.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,
verses.textEnNlt: After the death of Saul, David returned from his victory over the Amalekites and spent two days in Ziklag.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, that David stayed two days in Ziklag.
verses.textEn: After the death of Saul, David returned from striking down the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.

verses.textZh: 第三天，忽然有一个人从扫罗的营回来，衣服撕裂，头上蒙灰。这人一来到大卫面前，就俯伏在地上叩拜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天，忽然有一个人从扫罗的营回来，衣服撕裂，头上蒙灰。这人一来到大卫面前，就俯伏在地上叩拜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三天，有一人从扫罗的营里出来，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，到大卫面前伏地叩拜。
verses.textEnNiv: On the third day a man arrived from Saul’s camp with his clothes torn and dust on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him honor.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the third day, behold, a man came from Saul’s camp, with his clothes torn and dirt on his head. And when he came to David, he fell to the ground and paid homage.
verses.textEnNkjv: on the third day, behold, it happened that a man came from Saul’s camp with his clothes torn and dust on his head. So it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the ground and prostrated himself.
verses.textEnNlt: On the third day a man arrived from Saul’s army camp. He had torn his clothes and put dirt on his head to show that he was in mourning. He fell to the ground before David in deep respect.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the third day, behold, a man came from Saul’s camp with his clothes torn and dust on his head. And it happened when he came to David, he fell to the ground and prostrated himself.
verses.textEn: On the third day a man arrived from Saul’s camp with his clothes torn and dust on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him honor.

verses.textZh: 大卫问他："你从哪里来？"他对他说："我是从以色列的营中逃出来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问他："你从哪里来？"他对他说："我是从以色列的营中逃出来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问他说：「你从哪里来？」他说：「我从以色列的营里逃来。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Where have you come from?" David asked him. He answered, "I have escaped from the Israelite camp."
verses.textEnEsv: David said to him, "Where do you come from?" And he said to him, "I have escaped from the camp of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to him, "Where have you come from?" So he said to him, "I have escaped from the camp of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where have you come from?" David asked. "I escaped from the Israelite camp," the man replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to him, "From where do you come?" And he said to him, "I have escaped from the camp of Israel."
verses.textEn: "Where have you come from?" David asked him. He answered, "I have escaped from the Israelite camp."

verses.textZh: 大卫又问他："情况怎么样？请你告诉我！"他回答："众人都逃离战场，他们中间不但有许多人倒地阵亡，连扫罗和他的儿子约拿单也死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又问他："情况怎么样？请你告诉我！"他回答："众人都逃离战场，他们中间不但有许多人倒地阵亡，连扫罗和他的儿子约拿单也死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又问他说：「事情怎样？请你告诉我。」他回答说：「百姓从阵上逃跑，也有许多人仆倒死亡；扫罗和他儿子约拿单也死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "What happened?" David asked. "Tell me." "The men fled from the battle," he replied. "Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are dead."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to him, "How did it go? Tell me." And he answered, "The people fled from the battle, and also many of the people have fallen and are dead, and Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to him, "How did the matter go? Please tell me." And he answered, "The people have fled from the battle, many of the people are fallen and dead, and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also."
verses.textEnNlt: "What happened?" David demanded. "Tell me how the battle went." The man replied, "Our entire army fled from the battle. Many of the men are dead, and Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead."
verses.textEnNasb: David said to him, "How did things go? Please tell me." And he said, "The people have fled from the battle, and many of the people also have fallen and are dead; and Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead."
verses.textEn: "What happened?" David asked. "Tell me." "The men fled from the battle," he replied. "Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are dead."

verses.textZh: 于是，大卫问那向他报信的年轻人："你怎么知道扫罗和他的儿子死了呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，大卫问那向他报信的年轻人："你怎么知道扫罗和他的儿子死了呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问报信的少年人说：「你怎么知道扫罗和他儿子约拿单死了呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to the young man who brought him the report, "How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to the young man who told him, "How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to the young man who told him, "How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?"
verses.textEnNlt: "How do you know Saul and Jonathan are dead?" David demanded of the young man.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to the young man who told him, "How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?"
verses.textEn: Then David said to the young man who brought him the report, "How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?"

verses.textZh: 那个向大卫报信的年轻人回答："我刚巧在基利波山，看见扫罗靠在自己的矛枪上，又见有战车和马兵紧紧地追赶他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那个向大卫报信的年轻人回答："我刚巧在基利波山，看见扫罗靠在自己的矛枪上，又见有战车和马兵紧紧地追赶他。
verses.textZhCuv: 报信的少年人说：「我偶然到基利波山，看见扫罗伏在自己枪上，有战车、马兵紧紧地追他。
verses.textEnNiv: "I happened to be on Mount Gilboa," the young man said, "and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and their drivers in hot pursuit.
verses.textEnEsv: And the young man who told him said, "By chance I happened to be on Mount Gilboa, and there was Saul leaning on his spear, and behold, the chariots and the horsemen were close upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the young man who told him said, "As I happened by chance tobe on Mount Gilboa, there was Saul, leaning on his spear; and indeed the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
verses.textEnNlt: The man answered, "I happened to be on Mount Gilboa, and there was Saul leaning on his spear with the enemy chariots and charioteers closing in on him.
verses.textEnNasb: The young man who told him said, "By chance I happened to be on Mount Gilboa, and behold, Saul was leaning on his spear. And behold, the chariots and the horsemen had overtaken him.
verses.textEn: "I happened to be on Mount Gilboa," the young man said, "and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and their drivers in hot pursuit.

verses.textZh: 他回头看到我，就呼唤我。我说：‘我在这里。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回头看到我，就呼唤我。我说：‘我在这里。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他回头看见我，就呼叫我。我说：『我在这里。』
verses.textEnNiv: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I said, ‘What can I do?’
verses.textEnEsv: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called to me. And I answered, ‘Here I am.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. And I answered, ‘Here I am.’
verses.textEnNlt: When he turned and saw me, he cried out for me to come to him. ‘How can I help?’ I asked him.
verses.textEnNasb: When he looked behind himself, he saw me, and called to me. And I said, ‘Here I am.’
verses.textEn: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I said, ‘What can I do?’

verses.textZh: 他问我：‘你是谁？’我回答他：‘我是亚玛力人。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他问我：‘你是谁？’我回答他：‘我是亚玛力人。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他问我说：『你是什么人？』我说：『我是亚玛力人。』
verses.textEnNiv: "He asked me, ‘Who are you?’ " ‘An Amalekite,’ I answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, ‘Who are you?’ So I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
verses.textEnNlt: "He responded, ‘Who are you?’ "‘I am an Amalekite,’ I told him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, ‘Who are you?’ And I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
verses.textEn: "He asked me, ‘Who are you?’ " ‘An Amalekite,’ I answered.

verses.textZh: 于是他对我说：‘请你站到我身边来，把我杀死，因为痛苦抓住我，我却还死不了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他对我说：‘请你站到我身边来，把我杀死，因为痛苦抓住我，我却还死不了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：『请你来，将我杀死；因为痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Then he said to me, ‘Stand here by me and kill me! I’m in the throes of death, but I’m still alive.’
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, ‘Stand beside me and kill me, for anguish has seized me, and yet my life still lingers.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to me again, ‘Please stand over me and kill me, for anguish has come upon me, but my life still remains in me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then he begged me, ‘Come over here and put me out of my misery, for I am in terrible pain and want to die.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, ‘Please stand next to me and finish me off, for agony has seized me because my life still lingers in me.’
verses.textEn: "Then he said to me, ‘Stand here by me and kill me! I’m in the throes of death, but I’m still alive.’

verses.textZh: 我就站到他身边去，把他杀了，因为我知道他一倒下，就不能再活了。我摘下他头上的王冠，取下他臂上的手镯，带到这里来奉给我主。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就站到他身边去，把他杀了，因为我知道他一倒下，就不能再活了。我摘下他头上的王冠，取下他臂上的手镯，带到这里来奉给我主。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我准知他仆倒必不能活，就去将他杀死，把他头上的冠冕、臂上的镯子拿到我主这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "So I stood beside him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band on his arm and have brought them here to my lord."
verses.textEnEsv: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. And I took the crown that was on his head and the armlet that was on his arm, and I have brought them here to my lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I stood over him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. And I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord."
verses.textEnNlt: "So I killed him," the Amalekite told David, "for I knew he couldn’t live. Then I took his crown and his armband, and I have brought them here to you, my lord."
verses.textEnNasb: So I stood next to him and finished him off, because I knew that he could not live after he had fallen. And I took the crown which was on his head and the band which was on his arm, and I have brought them here to my lord."
verses.textEn: "So I stood beside him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band on his arm and have brought them here to my lord."

verses.textZh: 大卫就抓住自己的衣服，把它们全都撕裂。所有与他在一起的人也都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就抓住自己的衣服，把它们全都撕裂。所有与他在一起的人也都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就撕裂衣服，跟随他的人也是如此，
verses.textEnNiv: Then David and all the men with him took hold of their clothes and tore them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them, and so did all the men who were with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore David took hold of his own clothes and tore them, and sodid all the men who were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: David and his men tore their clothes in sorrow when they heard the news.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them, and so also did all the men who were with him.
verses.textEn: Then David and all the men with him took hold of their clothes and tore them.

verses.textZh: 他们为了扫罗、他的儿子约拿单、耶和华的子民和以色列家的缘故悲哀、哭泣、禁食直到晚上，因为他们已经倒毙在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们为了扫罗、他的儿子约拿单、耶和华的子民和以色列家的缘故悲哀、哭泣、禁食直到晚上，因为他们已经倒毙在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 而且悲哀哭号，禁食到晚上，是因扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并耶和华的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。
verses.textEnNiv: They mourned and wept and fasted till evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the army of the Lord and for the nation of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: And they mourned and wept and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son and for the people of the Lord and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they mourned and wept and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, for the people of the Lord and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: They mourned and wept and fasted all day for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the Lord ’s army and the nation of Israel, because they had died by the sword that day.
verses.textEnNasb: And they mourned and wept and fasted until evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the people of the Lord and the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
verses.textEn: They mourned and wept and fasted till evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the army of the Lord and for the nation of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

verses.textZh: 大卫问那向他报信的年轻人："你是哪里的人？"他回答："我是个寄居这地的亚玛力人的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问那向他报信的年轻人："你是哪里的人？"他回答："我是个寄居这地的亚玛力人的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问报信的少年人说：「你是哪里的人？」他说：「我是亚玛力客人的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to the young man who brought him the report, "Where are you from?" "I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite," he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to the young man who told him, "Where do you come from?" And he answered, "I am the son of a sojourner, an Amalekite."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to the young man who told him, "Where are you from?" And he answered, "I am the son of an alien, an Amalekite."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said to the young man who had brought the news, "Where are you from?" And he replied, "I am a foreigner, an Amalekite, who lives in your land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to the young man who informed him, "Where are you from?" And he answered, "I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite."
verses.textEn: David said to the young man who brought him the report, "Where are you from?" "I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite," he answered.

verses.textZh: 大卫对他说："你伸手毁灭耶和华的受膏者，怎么还不惧怕呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对他说："你伸手毁灭耶和华的受膏者，怎么还不惧怕呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「你伸手杀害耶和华的受膏者，怎么不畏惧呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: David asked him, "Why weren’t you afraid to lift your hand to destroy the Lord ’s anointed?"
verses.textEnEsv: David said to him, "How is it you were not afraid to put out your hand to destroy the Lord ’s anointed?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to him, "How was it you were not afraid to put forth your hand to destroy the Lord’s anointed?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why were you not afraid to kill the Lord ’s anointed one?" David asked.
verses.textEnNasb: And David said to him, "How is it you were not afraid to reach out with your hand to destroy the Lord’s anointed?"
verses.textEn: David asked him, "Why weren’t you afraid to lift your hand to destroy the Lord ’s anointed?"

verses.textZh: 于是大卫叫了一个年轻人来，说："你上前去，砍倒他。"那年轻人击杀他，他就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫叫了一个年轻人来，说："你上前去，砍倒他。"那年轻人击杀他，他就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫叫了一个少年人来，说：「你去杀他吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then David called one of his men and said, "Go, strike him down!" So he struck him down, and he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David called one of the young men and said, "Go, execute him." And he struck him down so that he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David called one of the young men and said, "Go near, and execute him!" And he struck him so that he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said to one of his men, "Kill him!" So the man thrust his sword into the Amalekite and killed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David called one of the young men and said, "Come forward, put him to death." So he struck him and he died.
verses.textEn: Then David called one of his men and said, "Go, strike him down!" So he struck him down, and he died.

verses.textZh: 大卫对他说："你流人血的罪要归到自己的头上，因为你亲口作证指控自己说：‘我杀了耶和华的受膏者。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对他说："你流人血的罪要归到自己的头上，因为你亲口作证指控自己说：‘我杀了耶和华的受膏者。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对他说：「你流人血的罪归到自己的头上，因为你亲口作见证说：『我杀了耶和华的受膏者。』」少年人就把他杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: For David had said to him, "Your blood be on your own head. Your own mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I killed the Lord ’s anointed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to him, "Your blood be on your head, for your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have killed the Lord ’s anointed.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to him, "Your blood is on your own head, for your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have killed the Lord’s anointed.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "You have condemned yourself," David said, "for you yourself confessed that you killed the Lord ’s anointed one."
verses.textEnNasb: And David said to him, " Your blood is on your head, because your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have finished off the Lord’s anointed.’ "
verses.textEn: For David had said to him, "Your blood be on your own head. Your own mouth testified against you when you said, ‘I killed the Lord ’s anointed.’ "

verses.textZh: 大卫为扫罗和他的儿子约拿单作了这首哀歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫为扫罗和他的儿子约拿单作了这首哀歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫作哀歌，吊扫罗和他儿子约拿单，
verses.textEnNiv: David took up this lament concerning Saul and his son Jonathan,
verses.textEnEsv: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and Jonathan his son,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son,
verses.textEnNlt: Then David composed a funeral song for Saul and Jonathan,
verses.textEnNasb: Then David sang this song of mourning over Saul and his son Jonathan,
verses.textEn: David took up this lament concerning Saul and his son Jonathan,

verses.textZh: 他又吩咐要把这首"弓歌"教导犹大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又吩咐要把这首"弓歌"教导犹大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 且吩咐将这歌教导犹大人。这歌名叫「弓歌」，写在雅煞珥书上。
verses.textEnNiv: and he ordered that the people of Judah be taught this lament of the bow (it is written in the Book of Jashar):
verses.textEnEsv: and he said it should be taught to the people of Judah; behold, it is written in the Book of Jashar. He said:
verses.textEnNkjv: and he told them to teach the children of Judah theSongof the Bow; indeed itis written in the Book of Jasher:
verses.textEnNlt: and he commanded that it be taught to the people of Judah. It is known as the Song of the Bow, and it is recorded in The Book of Jashar.
verses.textEnNasb: and he told them to teach the sons of Judah the mourning song of the bow; behold, it is written in the Book of Jashar.
verses.textEn: and he ordered that the people of Judah be taught this lament of the bow (it is written in the Book of Jashar):

verses.textZh: "以色列啊！尊荣的人都在高处被杀， 勇士怎么都已仆倒！
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列啊！尊荣的人都在高处被杀， 勇士怎么都已仆倒！
verses.textZhCuv: 歌中说：以色列啊， 你尊荣者在山上被杀！ 大英雄何竟死亡！
verses.textEnNiv: "A gazelle lies slain on your heights, Israel. How the mighty have fallen!
verses.textEnEsv: "Your glory, O Israel, is slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
verses.textEnNkjv: "The beauty of Israel is slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
verses.textEnNlt: Your pride and joy, O Israel, lies dead on the hills! Oh, how the mighty heroes have fallen!
verses.textEnNasb: " Your beauty, Israel, is slaughtered on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
verses.textEn: "A gazelle lies slain on your heights, Israel. How the mighty have fallen!

verses.textZh: 你们不要在迦特报道， 不要在亚实基伦的街上宣扬， 免得非利士的女子欢喜， 免得未受割礼之人的女子快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要在迦特报道， 不要在亚实基伦的街上宣扬， 免得非利士的女子欢喜， 免得未受割礼之人的女子快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要在迦特报告； 不要在亚实基伦街上传扬； 免得非利士的女子欢乐； 免得未受割礼之人的女子矜夸。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines be glad, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised exult.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell it not in Gath, Proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon— Lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, Lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t announce the news in Gath, don’t proclaim it in the streets of Ashkelon, or the daughters of the Philistines will rejoice and the pagans will laugh in triumph.
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell it not in Gath, Proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, Or the daughters of the Philistines will rejoice, The daughters of the uncircumcised will celebrate.
verses.textEn: "Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines be glad, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised rejoice.

verses.textZh: 基利波的群山啊！ 愿雨露都不降在你们上面， 愿你们的田地不产供物。 因为勇士的盾牌在那里玷污， 扫罗的盾牌没有用油抹亮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基利波的群山啊！ 愿雨露都不降在你们上面， 愿你们的田地不产供物。 因为勇士的盾牌在那里玷污， 扫罗的盾牌没有用油抹亮。
verses.textZhCuv: 基利波山哪，愿你那里没有雨露！ 愿你田地无土产可作供物！ 因为英雄的盾牌在那里被污丢弃； 扫罗的盾牌仿佛未曾抹油。
verses.textEnNiv: "Mountains of Gilboa, may you have neither dew nor rain, may no showers fall on your terraced fields. For there the shield of the mighty was despised, the shield of Saul—no longer rubbed with oil.
verses.textEnEsv: "You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain upon you, nor fields of offerings! For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul, not anointed with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O mountains of Gilboa, Lettherebe no dew nor rain upon you, Nor fields of offerings. For the shield of the mighty is cast away there! The shield of Saul, not anointed with oil.
verses.textEnNlt: O mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain upon you, nor fruitful fields producing offerings of grain. For there the shield of the mighty heroes was defiled; the shield of Saul will no longer be anointed with oil.
verses.textEnNasb: "Mountains of Gilboa, May there be no dew nor rain on you, or fields of offerings! For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, The shield of Saul, not anointed with oil.
verses.textEn: "Mountains of Gilboa, may you have neither dew nor rain, may no showers fall on your terraced fields. For there the shield of the mighty was despised, the shield of Saul—no longer rubbed with oil.

verses.textZh: 不见被杀者的血、 勇士的脂油， 约拿单的弓不缩回， 扫罗的剑也不空空返回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不见被杀者的血、 勇士的脂油， 约拿单的弓不缩回， 扫罗的剑也不空空返回。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单的弓箭非流敌人的血不退缩； 扫罗的刀剑非剖勇士的油不收回。
verses.textEnNiv: "From the blood of the slain, from the flesh of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, the sword of Saul did not return unsatisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: "From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the blood of the slain, From the fat of the mighty, The bow of Jonathan did not turn back, And the sword of Saul did not return empty.
verses.textEnNlt: The bow of Jonathan was powerful, and the sword of Saul did its mighty work. They shed the blood of their enemies and pierced the bodies of mighty heroes.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the blood of those slaughtered, from the fat of the mighty, The bow of Jonathan did not turn back, And the sword of Saul did not return unstained.
verses.textEn: "From the blood of the slain, from the flesh of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, the sword of Saul did not return unsatisfied.

verses.textZh: 扫罗和约拿单， 生时相亲相爱， 死时也不分离。 他们比鹰还快速， 比狮子更勇猛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗和约拿单， 生时相亲相爱， 死时也不分离。 他们比鹰还快速， 比狮子更勇猛。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗和约拿单－ 活时相悦相爱，死时也不分离 －他们比鹰更快，比狮子还强。
verses.textEnNiv: Saul and Jonathan— in life they were loved and admired, and in death they were not parted. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
verses.textEnEsv: "Saul and Jonathan, beloved and lovely! In life and in death they were not divided; they were swifter than eagles; they were stronger than lions.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Saul and Jonathan were beloved and pleasant in their lives, And in their death they were not divided; They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than lions.
verses.textEnNlt: How beloved and gracious were Saul and Jonathan! They were together in life and in death. They were swifter than eagles, stronger than lions.
verses.textEnNasb: "Saul and Jonathan, beloved and delightful in life, And in their deaths they were not separated; They were swifter than eagles, They were mightier than lions.
verses.textEn: Saul and Jonathan— in life they were loved and admired, and in death they were not parted. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

verses.textZh: 以色列的女子啊！你们要为扫罗哭泣， 他曾给你们穿上朱红色豪华的衣服， 又给你们的外衣加上金饰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的女子啊！你们要为扫罗哭泣， 他曾给你们穿上朱红色豪华的衣服， 又给你们的外衣加上金饰。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的女子啊，当为扫罗哭号！ 他曾使你们穿朱红色的美衣， 使你们衣服有黄金的妆饰。
verses.textEnNiv: "Daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and finery, who adorned your garments with ornaments of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: "You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you luxuriously in scarlet, who put ornaments of gold on your apparel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, Who clothed you in scarlet, with luxury; Who put ornaments of gold on your apparel.
verses.textEnNlt: O women of Israel, weep for Saul, for he dressed you in luxurious scarlet clothing, in garments decorated with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: "Daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, Who clothed you in scarlet, with jewelry, Who put gold jewelry on your apparel.
verses.textEn: "Daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and finery, who adorned your garments with ornaments of gold.

verses.textZh: 勇士怎么会在战阵上倒毙， 约拿单在高处被刺死！
verses.textZhCnvs: 勇士怎么会在战阵上倒毙， 约拿单在高处被刺死！
verses.textZhCuv: 英雄何竟在阵上仆倒！ 约拿单何竟在山上被杀！
verses.textEnNiv: "How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
verses.textEnEsv: "How the mighty have fallen in the midst of the battle! "Jonathan lies slain on your high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: "How the mighty have fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan was slain in your high places.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, how the mighty heroes have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies dead on the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: "How the mighty have fallen in the midst of the battle! Jonathan is slaughtered on your high places.
verses.textEn: "How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.

verses.textZh: 我的兄弟约拿单啊！我为你悲痛， 你是我最好的朋友， 你对我的爱情奇妙，远超过妇女的爱情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的兄弟约拿单啊！我为你悲痛， 你是我最好的朋友， 你对我的爱情奇妙，远超过妇女的爱情。
verses.textZhCuv: 我兄约拿单哪，我为你悲伤！ 我甚喜悦你！ 你向我发的爱情奇妙非常， 过于妇女的爱情。
verses.textEnNiv: I grieve for you, Jonathan my brother; you were very dear to me. Your love for me was wonderful, more wonderful than that of women.
verses.textEnEsv: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan; very pleasant have you been to me; your love to me was extraordinary, surpassing the love of women.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan; You have been very pleasant to me; Your love to me was wonderful, Surpassing the love of women.
verses.textEnNlt: How I weep for you, my brother Jonathan! Oh, how much I loved you! And your love for me was deep, deeper than the love of women!
verses.textEnNasb: "I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan; You have been a close friend to me. Your love for me was more wonderful Than the love of women.
verses.textEn: I grieve for you, Jonathan my brother; you were very dear to me. Your love for me was wonderful, more wonderful than that of women.

verses.textZh: 勇士怎么会倒毙！ 争战的武器怎么会毁灭！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 勇士怎么会倒毙！ 争战的武器怎么会毁灭！"
verses.textZhCuv: 英雄何竟仆倒！ 战具何竟灭没！
verses.textEnNiv: "How the mighty have fallen! The weapons of war have perished!"
verses.textEnEsv: "How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war perished!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "How the mighty have fallen, And the weapons of war perished!"
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, how the mighty heroes have fallen! Stripped of their weapons, they lie dead.
verses.textEnNasb: "How the mighty have fallen, And the weapons of war have perished!"
verses.textEn: "How the mighty have fallen! The weapons of war have perished!"

verses.textZh: 这事以后，大卫求问耶和华说："我可以上犹大的一座城去吗？"耶和华回答："你上去吧。"大卫又问："我应该上到哪里去呢？"他回答："上希伯仑去！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，大卫求问耶和华说："我可以上犹大的一座城去吗？"耶和华回答："你上去吧。"大卫又问："我应该上到哪里去呢？"他回答："上希伯仑去！"
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，大卫问耶和华说：「我上犹大的一个城去可以吗？」耶和华说：「可以。」大卫说：「我上哪一个城去呢？」耶和华说：「上希伯仑去。」
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, David inquired of the Lord . "Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?" he asked. The Lord said, "Go up." David asked, "Where shall I go?" "To Hebron," the Lord answered.
verses.textEnEsv: After this David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up." David said, "To which shall I go up?" And he said, "To Hebron."
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened after this that David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go up to any of the cities of Judah?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up." David said, "Where shall I go up?" And He said, "To Hebron."
verses.textEnNlt: After this, David asked the Lord , "Should I move back to one of the towns of Judah?" "Yes," the Lord replied. Then David asked, "Which town should I go to?" "To Hebron," the Lord answered.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about afterward that David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go up to one of the cities of Judah?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up." So David said, "Where shall I go up?" And He said, "To Hebron."
verses.textEn: In the course of time, David inquired of the Lord . "Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?" he asked. The Lord said, "Go up." David asked, "Where shall I go?" "To Hebron," the Lord answered.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫带着他的两个妻子，一个是耶斯列人亚希暖，一个是作过迦密人拿八妻子的亚比该，上到那里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫带着他的两个妻子，一个是耶斯列人亚希暖，一个是作过迦密人拿八妻子的亚比该，上到那里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫和他的两个妻－一个是耶斯列人亚希暖，一个是作过迦密人拿八妻的亚比该－都上那里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
verses.textEnEsv: So David went up there, and his two wives also, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David went up there, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.textEnNlt: David’s two wives were Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal from Carmel. So David and his wives
verses.textEnNasb: So David went up there, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.textEn: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

verses.textZh: 大卫也把与他在一起的人，和他们各人的家眷都带上去。他们就在希伯仑的城镇里住下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫也把与他在一起的人，和他们各人的家眷都带上去。他们就在希伯仑的城镇里住下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫也将跟随他的人和他们各人的眷属一同带上去，住在希伯仑的城邑中。
verses.textEnNiv: David also took the men who were with him, each with his family, and they settled in Hebron and its towns.
verses.textEnEsv: And David brought up his men who were with him, everyone with his household, and they lived in the towns of Hebron.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David brought up the men who were with him, every man with his household. So they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
verses.textEnNlt: and his men and their families all moved to Judah, and they settled in the villages near Hebron.
verses.textEnNasb: And David brought up his men who were with him, each with his household; and they settled in the cities of Hebron.
verses.textEn: David also took the men who were with him, each with his family, and they settled in Hebron and its towns.

verses.textZh: 于是犹大人来到希伯仑，在那里膏立了大卫作王，统治犹大家。 有人报告大卫说："埋葬扫罗的是基列．雅比人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是犹大人来到希伯仑，在那里膏立了大卫作王，统治犹大家。 有人报告大卫说："埋葬扫罗的是基列．雅比人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人来到希伯仑，在那里膏大卫作犹大家的王。 有人告诉大卫说：「葬埋扫罗的是基列‧雅比人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the tribe of Judah. When David was told that it was the men from Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul,
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. When they told David, "It was the men of Jabesh-gilead who buried Saul,"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, "The men of Jabesh Gilead weretheones who buried Saul."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the men of Judah came to David and anointed him king over the people of Judah. When David heard that the men of Jabesh-gilead had buried Saul,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, "It was the men of Jabesh-gilead who buried Saul."
verses.textEn: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the tribe of Judah. When David was told that it was the men from Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul,

verses.textZh: 大卫就差派使者到基列．雅比人那里去，对他们说："愿耶和华赐福给你们，因为你们厚待了你们的主扫罗，把他埋葬了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就差派使者到基列．雅比人那里去，对他们说："愿耶和华赐福给你们，因为你们厚待了你们的主扫罗，把他埋葬了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就差人去见基列‧雅比人，对他们说：「你们厚待你们的主－扫罗，将他葬埋。愿耶和华赐福与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: he sent messengers to them to say to them, "The Lord bless you for showing this kindness to Saul your master by burying him.
verses.textEnEsv: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to them, "May you be blessed by the Lord , because you showed this loyalty to Saul your lord and buried him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, "You are blessed of the Lord, for you have shown this kindness to your lord, to Saul, and have buried him.
verses.textEnNlt: he sent them this message: "May the Lord bless you for being so loyal to your master Saul and giving him a decent burial.
verses.textEnNasb: So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said to them, "May you be blessed of the Lord because you have shown this kindness to Saul your lord, and have buried him.
verses.textEn: he sent messengers to them to say to them, "The Lord bless you for showing this kindness to Saul your master by burying him.

verses.textZh: 你们既作了这事，现在就愿耶和华以慈爱和诚实待你们，我也要善待你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既作了这事，现在就愿耶和华以慈爱和诚实待你们，我也要善待你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既行了这事，愿耶和华以慈爱诚实待你们，我也要为此厚待你们。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord now show you kindness and faithfulness, and I too will show you the same favor because you have done this.
verses.textEnEsv: Now may the Lord show steadfast love and faithfulness to you. And I will do good to you because you have done this thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now may the Lord show kindness and truth to you. I also will repay you this kindness, because you have done this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord be loyal to you in return and reward you with his unfailing love! And I, too, will reward you for what you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: And now may the Lord show kindness and truth to you; and I also will show this goodness to you, because you have done this thing.
verses.textEn: May the Lord now show you kindness and faithfulness, and I too will show you the same favor because you have done this.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要坚强，要作勇敢的人，因为你们的主扫罗已经死了；犹大家已经膏立了我作他们的王了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要坚强，要作勇敢的人，因为你们的主扫罗已经死了；犹大家已经膏立了我作他们的王了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们的主－扫罗死了，犹大家已经膏我作他们的王，所以你们要刚强奋勇。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, be strong and brave, for Saul your master is dead, and the people of Judah have anointed me king over them."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant, for Saul your lord is dead, and the house of Judah has anointed me king over them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, let your hands be strengthened, and be valiant; for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah has anointed me king over them."
verses.textEnNlt: Now that Saul is dead, I ask you to be my strong and loyal subjects like the people of Judah, who have anointed me as their new king."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, let your hands be strong and be valiant, since Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah has anointed me king over them."
verses.textEn: Now then, be strong and brave, for Saul your master is dead, and the people of Judah have anointed me king over them."

verses.textZh: 当时，扫罗的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥已经领着扫罗的儿子伊施波设，把他带过河到玛哈念去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，扫罗的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥已经领着扫罗的儿子伊施波设，把他带过河到玛哈念去，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥，曾将扫罗的儿子伊施波设带过河，到玛哈念，
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, had taken Ish-Bosheth son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
verses.textEnEsv: But Abner the son of Ner, commander of Saul’s army, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim,
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abner the son of Ner, commander of Saul’s army, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim;
verses.textEnNlt: But Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, had already gone to Mahanaim with Saul’s son Ishbosheth.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abner the son of Ner, commander of Saul’s army, had taken Ish-bosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, had taken Ish-Bosheth son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

verses.textZh: 并且立了他作王，统治基列、亚书利、耶斯列、以法莲、便雅悯和以色列众人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且立了他作王，统治基列、亚书利、耶斯列、以法莲、便雅悯和以色列众人。
verses.textZhCuv: 立他作王，治理基列、亚书利、耶斯列、以法莲、便雅悯，和以色列众人。
verses.textEnNiv: He made him king over Gilead, Ashuri and Jezreel, and also over Ephraim, Benjamin and all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: and he made him king over Gilead and the Ashurites and Jezreel and Ephraim and Benjamin and all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: There he proclaimed Ishbosheth king over Gilead, Jezreel, Ephraim, Benjamin, the land of the Ashurites, and all the rest of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, even over all Israel.
verses.textEn: He made him king over Gilead, Ashuri and Jezreel, and also over Ephraim, Benjamin and all Israel.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设作以色列王的时候，已经四十岁；他作王共两年。犹大家却追随大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设作以色列王的时候，已经四十岁；他作王共两年。犹大家却追随大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设登基的时候年四十岁，作以色列王二年；惟独犹大家归从大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: Ish-Bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. The tribe of Judah, however, remained loyal to David.
verses.textEnEsv: Ish-bosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. Only the house of Judah followed David.
verses.textEnNlt: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he became king, and he ruled from Mahanaim for two years. Meanwhile, the people of Judah remained loyal to David.
verses.textEnNasb: Ish-bosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he was king for two years. The house of Judah, however, followed David.
verses.textEn: Ish-Bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. The tribe of Judah, however, remained loyal to David.

verses.textZh: 大卫在希伯仑作王统治犹大家的时候共有七年零六个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在希伯仑作王统治犹大家的时候共有七年零六个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在希伯仑作犹大家的王，共七年零六个月。
verses.textEnNiv: The length of time David was king in Hebron over Judah was seven years and six months.
verses.textEnEsv: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
verses.textEnNlt: David made Hebron his capital, and he ruled as king of Judah for seven and a half years.
verses.textEnNasb: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
verses.textEn: The length of time David was king in Hebron over Judah was seven years and six months.

verses.textZh: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥带着扫罗的儿子伊施波设的仆从，离开玛哈念，到基遍去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥带着扫罗的儿子伊施波设的仆从，离开玛哈念，到基遍去。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥和扫罗的儿子伊施波设的仆人从玛哈念出来，往基遍去。
verses.textEnNiv: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Abner led Ishbosheth’s troops from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abner the son of Ner, went from Mahanaim to Gibeon with the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul.
verses.textEn: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押和大卫的臣仆也出来，在基遍的水池旁边与他们会面。大家都坐下，一队在水池这边，一队在水池那边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押和大卫的臣仆也出来，在基遍的水池旁边与他们会面。大家都坐下，一队在水池这边，一队在水池那边。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押和大卫的仆人也出来，在基遍池旁与他们相遇；一班坐在池这边，一班坐在池那边。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab son of Zeruiah and David’s men went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat down on one side of the pool and one group on the other side.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah and the servants of David went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. And they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out and met them by the pool of Gibeon. So they sat down, one on one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.
verses.textEnNlt: About the same time, Joab son of Zeruiah led David’s troops out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. The two groups sat down there, facing each other from opposite sides of the pool.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joab the son of Zeruiah and the servants of David went out and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, Abner’s men on the one side of the pool and Joab’s men on the other side of the pool.
verses.textEn: Joab son of Zeruiah and David’s men went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat down on one side of the pool and one group on the other side.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥对约押说："让年轻人起来，在我们面前比比武。"约押说："好！叫他们起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥对约押说："让年轻人起来，在我们面前比比武。"约押说："好！叫他们起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥对约押说：「让少年人起来，在我们面前戏耍吧！」约押说：「可以。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let’s have some of the young men get up and fight hand to hand in front of us." "All right, let them do it," Joab said.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abner said to Joab, "Let the young men arise and compete before us." And Joab said, "Let them arise."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let the young men now arise and compete before us." And Joab said, "Let them arise."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abner suggested to Joab, "Let’s have a few of our warriors fight hand to hand here in front of us." "All right," Joab agreed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abner said to Joab, "Now have the young men arise and hold a martial skills match in our presence." And Joab said, "Have them arise!"
verses.textEn: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let’s have some of the young men get up and fight hand to hand in front of us." "All right, let them do it," Joab said.

verses.textZh: 他们就起来，按着人数走过去：属便雅悯，就是属扫罗的儿子伊施波设的，有十二人；属大卫臣仆的也有十二人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就起来，按着人数走过去：属便雅悯，就是属扫罗的儿子伊施波设的，有十二人；属大卫臣仆的也有十二人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就按着定数起来：属扫罗儿子伊施波设的便雅悯人过去十二名，大卫的仆人也过去十二名，
verses.textEnNiv: So they stood up and were counted off—twelve men for Benjamin and Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they arose and passed over by number, twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they arose and went over by number, twelve from Benjamin, followers of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve from the servants of David.
verses.textEnNlt: So twelve men were chosen to fight from each side—twelve men of Benjamin representing Ishbosheth son of Saul, and twelve representing David.
verses.textEnNasb: So they got up and went over by count, twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve from the servants of David.
verses.textEn: So they stood up and were counted off—twelve men for Benjamin and Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.

verses.textZh: 他们各人都紧紧抓住对手的头，用刀刺进对手的肋旁，于是他们全都倒毙。所以在基遍那地方就叫作希利甲．哈素林。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人都紧紧抓住对手的头，用刀刺进对手的肋旁，于是他们全都倒毙。所以在基遍那地方就叫作希利甲．哈素林。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼此揪头，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫做希利甲‧哈素林，就在基遍。
verses.textEnNiv: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his dagger into his opponent’s side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.
verses.textEnEsv: And each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his opponent’s side, so they fell down together. Therefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is at Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And each one grasped his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his opponent’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place was called the Field of Sharp Swords, which is in Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: Each one grabbed his opponent by the hair and thrust his sword into the other’s side so that all of them died. So this place at Gibeon has been known ever since as the Field of Swords.
verses.textEnNasb: And each one of them seized his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his opponent’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
verses.textEn: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his dagger into his opponent’s side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

verses.textZh: 那天的战事非常激烈，结果押尼珥和以色列人败在大卫的臣仆面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天的战事非常激烈，结果押尼珥和以色列人败在大卫的臣仆面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日的战事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人败在大卫的仆人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The battle that day was very fierce, and Abner and the Israelites were defeated by David’s men.
verses.textEnEsv: And the battle was very fierce that day. And Abner and the men of Israel were beaten before the servants of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: So there was a very fierce battle that day, and Abner and the men of Israel were beaten before the servants of David.
verses.textEnNlt: A fierce battle followed that day, and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated by the forces of David.
verses.textEnNasb: That day the battle was very severe, and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated by the servants of David.
verses.textEn: The battle that day was very fierce, and Abner and the Israelites were defeated by David’s men.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的三个儿子约押、亚比筛和亚撒黑都在那里。亚撒黑的腿轻快如野地的羚羊一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的三个儿子约押、亚比筛和亚撒黑都在那里。亚撒黑的腿轻快如野地的羚羊一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里有洗鲁雅的三个儿子：约押、亚比筛、亚撒黑。亚撒黑脚快如野鹿一般；
verses.textEnNiv: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Now Asahel was as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle.
verses.textEnEsv: And the three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Now Asahel was as swift of foot as a wild gazelle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab and Abishai and Asahel. And Asahel was as fleet of foot as a wild gazelle.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel—the three sons of Zeruiah—were among David’s forces that day. Asahel could run like a gazelle,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, Abishai, and Asahel; and Asahel was as swift-footed as one of the gazelles that is in the field.
verses.textEn: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Now Asahel was as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle.

verses.textZh: 亚撒黑追赶押尼珥，紧紧地跟着他，不偏左，也不偏右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒黑追赶押尼珥，紧紧地跟着他，不偏左，也不偏右。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒黑追赶押尼珥，直追赶他不偏左右。
verses.textEnNiv: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Asahel pursued Abner, and as he went, he turned neither to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Asahel pursued Abner, and in going he did not turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.
verses.textEnNlt: and he began chasing Abner. He pursued him relentlessly, not stopping for anything.
verses.textEnNasb: Asahel pursued Abner and did not turn to the right or to the left from following Abner.
verses.textEn: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥往后瞧着，说："你是亚撒黑吗？"他回答："我正是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥往后瞧着，说："你是亚撒黑吗？"他回答："我正是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥回头说：「你是亚撒黑吗？」回答说：「是。」
verses.textEnNiv: Abner looked behind him and asked, "Is that you, Asahel?" "It is," he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abner looked behind him and said, "Is it you, Asahel?" And he answered, "It is I."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abner looked behind him and said, "Are you Asahel?" He answered, "I am."
verses.textEnNlt: When Abner looked back and saw him coming, he called out, "Is that you, Asahel?" "Yes, it is," he replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abner looked behind himself and said, "Is that you, Asahel?" And he said, "It is I!"
verses.textEn: Abner looked behind him and asked, "Is that you, Asahel?" "It is," he answered.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥对他说："你或转左或转右，抓住一个年轻人，夺去他的武器吧！"可是亚撒黑不愿意离开不追赶他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥对他说："你或转左或转右，抓住一个年轻人，夺去他的武器吧！"可是亚撒黑不愿意离开不追赶他。
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥对他说：「你或转向左转向右，拿住一个少年人，剥去他的战衣。」亚撒黑却不肯转开不追赶他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abner said to him, "Turn aside to the right or to the left; take on one of the young men and strip him of his weapons." But Asahel would not stop chasing him.
verses.textEnEsv: Abner said to him, "Turn aside to your right hand or to your left, and seize one of the young men and take his spoil." But Asahel would not turn aside from following him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abner said to him, "Turn aside to your right hand or to your left, and lay hold on one of the young men and take his armor for yourself." But Asahel would not turn aside from following him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go fight someone else!" Abner warned. "Take on one of the younger men, and strip him of his weapons." But Asahel kept right on chasing Abner.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abner said to him, "Turn aside for your own good to your right or to your left, and take hold of one of the young men for yourself, and take for yourself his equipment." But Asahel was unwilling to turn aside from following him.
verses.textEn: Then Abner said to him, "Turn aside to the right or to the left; take on one of the young men and strip him of his weapons." But Asahel would not stop chasing him.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥再一次对亚撒黑说："你离开，别追赶我！我为甚么要把你砍倒在地上呢？以后怎么还有脸见你的哥哥约押呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥再一次对亚撒黑说："你离开，别追赶我！我为甚么要把你砍倒在地上呢？以后怎么还有脸见你的哥哥约押呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥又对亚撒黑说：「你转开不追赶我吧！我何必杀你呢？若杀你，有什么脸见你哥哥约押呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Again Abner warned Asahel, "Stop chasing me! Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Abner said again to Asahel, "Turn aside from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I lift up my face to your brother Joab?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abner said again to Asahel, "Turn aside from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I face your brother Joab?"
verses.textEnNlt: Again Abner shouted to him, "Get away from here! I don’t want to kill you. How could I ever face your brother Joab again?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abner repeated again to Asahel, "Turn aside for your own good from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I show my face to your brother Joab?"
verses.textEn: Again Abner warned Asahel, "Stop chasing me! Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?"

verses.textZh: 亚撒黑不肯离开，所以押尼珥就用枪的尾端刺入了他的肚子，枪从他的背后穿出。亚撒黑仆倒在那里，当场死了。所有来到亚撒黑倒毙的地方的人，都站住不动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒黑不肯离开，所以押尼珥就用枪的尾端刺入了他的肚子，枪从他的背后穿出。亚撒黑仆倒在那里，当场死了。所有来到亚撒黑倒毙的地方的人，都站住不动。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒黑仍不肯转开。故此，押尼珥就用枪𨱔刺入他的肚腹，甚至枪从背后透出，亚撒黑就在那里仆倒而死。众人赶到亚撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。
verses.textEnNiv: But Asahel refused to give up the pursuit; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into Asahel’s stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He fell there and died on the spot. And every man stopped when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.
verses.textEnEsv: But he refused to turn aside. Therefore Abner struck him in the stomach with the butt of his spear, so that the spear came out at his back. And he fell there and died where he was. And all who came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died, stood still.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, he refused to turn aside. Therefore Abner struck him in the stomach with the blunt end of the spear, so that the spear came out of his back; and he fell down there and died on the spot. So it was that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died, stood still.
verses.textEnNlt: But Asahel refused to turn back, so Abner thrust the butt end of his spear through Asahel’s stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He stumbled to the ground and died there. And everyone who came by that spot stopped and stood still when they saw Asahel lying there.
verses.textEnNasb: However, he refused to turn aside; so Abner struck him in the belly with the butt end of the spear, so that the spear came out at his back. And he fell there and died on the spot. And it happened that all who came thereafter to the place where Asahel had fallen and died, stood still.
verses.textEn: But Asahel refused to give up the pursuit; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into Asahel’s stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He fell there and died on the spot. And every man stopped when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.

verses.textZh: 约押和亚比筛却继续追赶押尼珥。日落的时候，他们来到亚玛山，就在通往基遍旷野的路旁，基亚的对面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押和亚比筛却继续追赶押尼珥。日落的时候，他们来到亚玛山，就在通往基遍旷野的路旁，基亚的对面。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押和亚比筛追赶押尼珥，日落的时候，到了通基遍旷野的路旁，基亚对面的亚玛山。
verses.textEnNiv: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and as the sun was setting, they came to the hill of Ammah, near Giah on the way to the wasteland of Gibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. And as the sun was going down they came to the hill of Ammah, which lies before Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joab and Abishai also pursued Abner. And the sun was going down when they came to the hill of Ammah, which is before Giah by the road to the Wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joab and Abishai found out what had happened, they set out after Abner. The sun was just going down as they arrived at the hill of Ammah near Giah, along the road to the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and when the sun was going down, they came to the hill of Ammah, which is opposite Giah by way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.textEn: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and as the sun was setting, they came to the hill of Ammah, near Giah on the way to the wasteland of Gibeon.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人集结在押尼珥后面，站在一座山头上，列成一个队伍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人集结在押尼珥后面，站在一座山头上，列成一个队伍。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人聚集，跟随押尼珥站在一个山顶上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the men of Benjamin rallied behind Abner. They formed themselves into a group and took their stand on top of a hill.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Benjamin gathered themselves together behind Abner and became one group and took their stand on the top of a hill.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the children of Benjamin gathered together behind Abner and became a unit, and took their stand on top of a hill.
verses.textEnNlt: Abner’s troops from the tribe of Benjamin regrouped there at the top of the hill to take a stand.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Benjamin gathered together behind Abner and became one troop, and they stood on the top of a hill.
verses.textEn: Then the men of Benjamin rallied behind Abner. They formed themselves into a group and took their stand on top of a hill.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥对约押喊叫，说："刀剑要不停地杀人吗？你不知道结局是痛苦的吗？你要等到甚么时候才吩咐人民转去，不追赶自己的兄弟呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥对约押喊叫，说："刀剑要不停地杀人吗？你不知道结局是痛苦的吗？你要等到甚么时候才吩咐人民转去，不追赶自己的兄弟呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥呼叫约押说：「刀剑岂可永远杀人吗？你岂不知终久必有苦楚吗？你要等何时才叫百姓回去、不追赶弟兄呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Abner called out to Joab, "Must the sword devour forever? Don’t you realize that this will end in bitterness? How long before you order your men to stop pursuing their fellow Israelites?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abner called to Joab, "Shall the sword devour forever? Do you not know that the end will be bitter? How long will it be before you tell your people to turn from the pursuit of their brothers?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abner called to Joab and said, "Shall the sword devour forever? Do you not know that it will be bitter in the latter end? How long will it be then until you tell the people to return from pursuing their brethren?"
verses.textEnNlt: Abner shouted down to Joab, "Must we always be killing each other? Don’t you realize that bitterness is the only result? When will you call off your men from chasing their Israelite brothers?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abner called to Joab and said, "Should the sword devour forever? Do you not realize that it will be bitter in the end? So how long will you refrain from telling the people to turn back from pursuing their kinsmen?"
verses.textEn: Abner called out to Joab, "Must the sword devour forever? Don’t you realize that this will end in bitterness? How long before you order your men to stop pursuing their fellow Israelites?"

verses.textZh: 约押说："我指着永活的神起誓，如果你没有说过比武的话，大家必在早晨的时候离去，不再追赶自己的兄弟。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押说："我指着永活的神起誓，如果你没有说过比武的话，大家必在早晨的时候离去，不再追赶自己的兄弟。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约押说：「我指着永生的神起誓：你若不说戏耍的那句话，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追赶弟兄了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joab answered, "As surely as God lives, if you had not spoken, the men would have continued pursuing them until morning."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab said, "As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely the men would not have given up the pursuit of their brothers until the morning."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab said, "As God lives, unless you had spoken, surely then by morning all the people would have given up pursuing their brethren."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joab said, "God only knows what would have happened if you hadn’t spoken, for we would have chased you all night if necessary."
verses.textEnNasb: Joab said, "As God lives, if you had not spoken, then the people of Judah certainly would have withdrawn in the morning, each from pursuing his brother."
verses.textEn: Joab answered, "As surely as God lives, if you had not spoken, the men would have continued pursuing them until morning."

verses.textZh: 于是约押吹响号角，众人就站住，不再追赶以色列人，也不再打仗了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约押吹响号角，众人就站住，不再追赶以色列人，也不再打仗了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约押吹角，众民就站住，不再追赶以色列人，也不再打仗了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the troops came to a halt; they no longer pursued Israel, nor did they fight anymore.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the men stopped and pursued Israel no more, nor did they fight anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab blew a trumpet; and all the people stood still and did not pursue Israel anymore, nor did they fight anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joab blew the ram’s horn, and his men stopped chasing the troops of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the people halted and no longer pursued Israel, nor did they continue to fight anymore.
verses.textEn: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the troops came to a halt; they no longer pursued Israel, nor did they fight anymore.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥和属他的人，整夜走过亚拉巴，渡过约旦河，又走过毕伦，才回到玛哈念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥和属他的人，整夜走过亚拉巴，渡过约旦河，又走过毕伦，才回到玛哈念。
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥和跟随他的人整夜经过亚拉巴，过约旦河，走过毕伦，到了玛哈念。
verses.textEnNiv: All that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, continued through the morning hours and came to Mahanaim.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, and marching the whole morning, they came to Mahanaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abner and his men went on all that night through the plain, crossed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron; and they came to Mahanaim.
verses.textEnNlt: All that night Abner and his men retreated through the Jordan Valley. They crossed the Jordan River, traveling all through the morning, and didn’t stop until they arrived at Mahanaim.
verses.textEnNasb: Abner and his men then went through the Arabah all that night; so they crossed the Jordan, walked all morning, and came to Mahanaim.
verses.textEn: All that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, continued through the morning hours and came to Mahanaim.

verses.textZh: 约押追赶押尼珥回来，集合所有人的时候，发现在大卫的臣仆中，除了亚撒黑以外，还少了十九个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押追赶押尼珥回来，集合所有人的时候，发现在大卫的臣仆中，除了亚撒黑以外，还少了十九个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押追赶押尼珥回来，聚集众民，见大卫的仆人中缺少了十九个人和亚撒黑。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joab stopped pursuing Abner and assembled the whole army. Besides Asahel, nineteen of David’s men were found missing.
verses.textEnEsv: Joab returned from the pursuit of Abner. And when he had gathered all the people together, there were missing from David’s servants nineteen men besides Asahel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab returned from pursuing Abner. And when he had gathered all the people together, there were missing of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Joab and his men also returned home. When Joab counted his casualties, he discovered that only 19 men were missing in addition to Asahel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab returned from pursuing Abner; but he gathered all the people together, and nineteen of David’s servants were missing, besides Asahel.
verses.textEn: Then Joab stopped pursuing Abner and assembled the whole army. Besides Asahel, nineteen of David’s men were found missing.

verses.textZh: 但大卫的臣仆击杀便雅悯人和跟随押尼珥的人，共有三百六十人死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但大卫的臣仆击杀便雅悯人和跟随押尼珥的人，共有三百六十人死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但大卫的仆人杀了便雅悯人和跟随押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。
verses.textEnNiv: But David’s men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.
verses.textEnEsv: But the servants of David had struck down of Benjamin 360 of Abner’s men.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the servants of David had struck down, of Benjamin and Abner’s men, three hundred and sixty men who died.
verses.textEnNlt: But 360 of Abner’s men had been killed, all from the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the servants of David had struck and killed many of Benjamin and Abner’s men; 360 men were dead.
verses.textEn: But David’s men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.

verses.textZh: 他们把亚撒黑抬回去，埋葬在伯利恒他父亲的坟墓里。约押和属他的人走了一整夜，天亮的时候才回到希伯仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把亚撒黑抬回去，埋葬在伯利恒他父亲的坟墓里。约押和属他的人走了一整夜，天亮的时候才回到希伯仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人将亚撒黑送到伯利恒，葬在他父亲的坟墓里。约押和跟随他的人走了一夜，天亮的时候到了希伯仑。
verses.textEnNiv: They took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb at Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and arrived at Hebron by daybreak.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was at Bethlehem. And Joab and his men marched all night, and the day broke upon them at Hebron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took up Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb, which wasin Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at daybreak.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab and his men took Asahel’s body to Bethlehem and buried him there in his father’s tomb. Then they traveled all night and reached Hebron at daybreak.
verses.textEnNasb: And they carried Asahel away and buried him in his father’s tomb, which was in Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men traveled all night until the day dawned at Hebron.
verses.textEn: They took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb at Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and arrived at Hebron by daybreak.

verses.textZh: 扫罗家和大卫家之间的战争相持很久。大卫家逐渐兴盛，扫罗家却日趋衰微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗家和大卫家之间的战争相持很久。大卫家逐渐兴盛，扫罗家却日趋衰微。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗家和大卫家争战许久。大卫家日见强盛；扫罗家日见衰弱。
verses.textEnNiv: The war between the house of Saul and the house of David lasted a long time. David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of David. And David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul became weaker and weaker.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of David. But David grew stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
verses.textEnNlt: That was the beginning of a long war between those who were loyal to Saul and those loyal to David. As time passed David became stronger and stronger, while Saul’s dynasty became weaker and weaker.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a long war between the house of Saul and the house of David; and David became steadily stronger, while the house of Saul became steadily weaker.
verses.textEn: The war between the house of Saul and the house of David lasted a long time. David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.

verses.textZh: 大卫在希伯仑生了几个儿子：他的长子暗嫩，是耶斯列人亚希暖所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在希伯仑生了几个儿子：他的长子暗嫩，是耶斯列人亚希暖所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在希伯仑得了几个儿子：长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖所生的；
verses.textEnNiv: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;
verses.textEnEsv: And sons were born to David at Hebron: his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam of Jezreel;
verses.textEnNkjv: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
verses.textEnNlt: These are the sons who were born to David in Hebron: The oldest was Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam from Jezreel.
verses.textEnNasb: Sons were born to David in Hebron: his firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
verses.textEn: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;

verses.textZh: 次子基利押，是作过迦密人拿八的妻子亚比该所生的。三子押沙龙，是基述王达买的女儿玛迦所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次子基利押，是作过迦密人拿八的妻子亚比该所生的。三子押沙龙，是基述王达买的女儿玛迦所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 次子基利押 是作过迦密人拿八的妻亚比该所生的；三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦所生的；
verses.textEnNiv: his second, Kileab the son of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
verses.textEnEsv: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
verses.textEnNkjv: his second, Chileab, by Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite; the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur;
verses.textEnNlt: The second was Daniel, whose mother was Abigail, the widow of Nabal from Carmel. The third was Absalom, whose mother was Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur.
verses.textEnNasb: and his second, Chileab, by Abigail the widow of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur;
verses.textEn: his second, Kileab the son of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom the son of Maakah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

verses.textZh: 四子亚多尼雅，是哈及所生的。五子示法提雅，是亚比他所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四子亚多尼雅，是哈及所生的。五子示法提雅，是亚比他所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 四子亚多尼雅是哈及所生的；五子示法提雅是亚比她所生的；
verses.textEnNiv: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.textEnEsv: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.textEnNkjv: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.textEnNlt: The fourth was Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith. The fifth was Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital.
verses.textEnNasb: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.textEn: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

verses.textZh: 六子以特念，是大卫妻子以格拉所生的。这些儿子都是大卫在希伯仑所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六子以特念，是大卫妻子以格拉所生的。这些儿子都是大卫在希伯仑所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉所生的。大卫这六个儿子都是在希伯仑生的。
verses.textEnNiv: and the sixth, Ithream the son of David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.
verses.textEnEsv: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the sixth, Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.
verses.textEnNlt: The sixth was Ithream, whose mother was Eglah, David’s wife. These sons were all born to David in Hebron.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sixth, Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These sons were born to David in Hebron.
verses.textEn: and the sixth, Ithream the son of David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.

verses.textZh: 当扫罗家和大卫家交战的时候，押尼珥使自己在扫罗家的权势日渐强大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当扫罗家和大卫家交战的时候，押尼珥使自己在扫罗家的权势日渐强大。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗家和大卫家争战的时候，押尼珥在扫罗家大有权势。
verses.textEnNiv: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had been strengthening his own position in the house of Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: While there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner was making himself strong in the house of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was so, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner was strengthening hishold on the house of Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: As the war between the house of Saul and the house of David went on, Abner became a powerful leader among those loyal to Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened that while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner was strengthening himself in the house of Saul.
verses.textEn: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had been strengthening his own position in the house of Saul.

verses.textZh: 扫罗有一个妃子，名叫利斯巴，是爱亚的女儿。伊施波设对押尼珥说："你为甚么亲近我父亲的妃子呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗有一个妃子，名叫利斯巴，是爱亚的女儿。伊施波设对押尼珥说："你为甚么亲近我父亲的妃子呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗有一妃嫔，名叫利斯巴，是爱亚的女儿。一日，伊施波设对押尼珥说：「你为什么与我父的妃嫔同房呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ish-Bosheth said to Abner, "Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?"
verses.textEnEsv: Now Saul had a concubine whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. And Ish-bosheth said to Abner, "Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. So Ishbosheth said to Abner, "Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?"
verses.textEnNlt: One day Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, accused Abner of sleeping with one of his father’s concubines, a woman named Rizpah, daughter of Aiah.
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul had a concubine whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, "Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?"
verses.textEn: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ish-Bosheth said to Abner, "Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?"

verses.textZh: 押尼珥因伊施波设的话非常忿怒，说："我是犹大的狗头吗？今天我厚待你的父亲扫罗家、他的兄弟和他的朋友，没有把你交在大卫的手中；可是，今天你竟为了这女人的事来找我的错！910我若不按着耶和华向大卫所起誓应许的去行：废去扫罗家的王国，建立大卫的王位，使他统治以色列和犹大，从但直到别是巴，愿神降罚押尼珥，重重地降罚他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥因伊施波设的话非常忿怒，说："我是犹大的狗头吗？今天我厚待你的父亲扫罗家、他的兄弟和他的朋友，没有把你交在大卫的手中；可是，今天你竟为了这女人的事来找我的错！910我若不按着耶和华向大卫所起誓应许的去行：废去扫罗家的王国，建立大卫的王位，使他统治以色列和犹大，从但直到别是巴，愿神降罚押尼珥，重重地降罚他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥因伊施波设的话就甚发怒，说：「我岂是犹大的狗头呢？我恩待你父扫罗的家和他的弟兄、朋友，不将你交在大卫手里，今日你竟为这妇人责备我吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said. So he answered, "Am I a dog’s head—on Judah’s side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven’t handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abner was very angry over the words of Ish-bosheth and said, "Am I a dog’s head of Judah? To this day I keep showing steadfast love to the house of Saul your father, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not given you into the hand of David. And yet you charge me today with a fault concerning a woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abner became very angry at the words of Ishbosheth, and said, "Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show loyalty to the house of Saul your father, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman?
verses.textEnNlt: Abner was furious. "Am I some Judean dog to be kicked around like this?" he shouted. "After all I have done for your father, Saul, and his family and friends by not handing you over to David, is this my reward—that you find fault with me about this woman?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abner became very angry over Ish-bosheth’s question and said, "Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to the house of Saul your father, to his brothers and to his friends, and have not let you fall into the hands of David; yet today you call me to account for wrongdoing with that woman?
verses.textEn: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said. So he answered, "Am I a dog’s head—on Judah’s side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven’t handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!

verses.textZh: 伊施波设因为惧怕押尼珥，就连一句话也不敢回答他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伊施波设因为惧怕押尼珥，就连一句话也不敢回答他。
verses.textZhCuv: 伊施波设惧怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。
verses.textEnNiv: May God deal with Abner, be it ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the Lord promised him on oath
verses.textEnEsv: God do so to Abner and more also, if I do not accomplish for David what the Lord has sworn to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: May God do so to Abner, and more also, if I do not do for David as the Lord has sworn to him—
verses.textEnNlt: May God strike me and even kill me if I don’t do everything I can to help David get what the Lord has promised him!
verses.textEnNasb: May God do so to me, and more so, if as the Lord has sworn to David, I do not accomplish this for him:
verses.textEn: May God deal with Abner, be it ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the Lord promised him on oath

verses.textZh: 押尼珥差派使者代表他去见大卫，说："这地是属谁的呢？"又说："你与我立约，我就必帮助你，使全以色列都归顺你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥差派使者代表他去见大卫，说："这地是属谁的呢？"又说："你与我立约，我就必帮助你，使全以色列都归顺你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥打发人去见大卫，替他说：「这国归谁呢？」又说：「你与我立约，我必帮助你，使以色列人都归服你。」
verses.textEnNiv: and transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David’s throne over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beersheba."
verses.textEnEsv: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan to Beersheba."
verses.textEnNkjv: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul, and set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan to Beersheba."
verses.textEnNlt: I’m going to take Saul’s kingdom and give it to David. I will establish the throne of David over Israel as well as Judah, all the way from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south."
verses.textEnNasb: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to establish the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba!"
verses.textEn: and transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David’s throne over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beersheba."

verses.textZh: 大卫说："好！我与你立约。不过，我要求你一件事：你来见我面的时候，首先要把扫罗的女儿米甲带来，否则你必不得见我的面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："好！我与你立约。不过，我要求你一件事：你来见我面的时候，首先要把扫罗的女儿米甲带来，否则你必不得见我的面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「好！我与你立约。但有一件，你来见我面的时候，若不将扫罗的女儿米甲带来，必不得见我的面。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ish-bosheth could not answer Abner another word, because he feared him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he could not answer Abner another word, because he feared him.
verses.textEnNlt: Ishbosheth didn’t dare say another word because he was afraid of what Abner might do.
verses.textEnNasb: And Ish-bosheth could no longer say a word in response to Abner, because he was afraid of him.
verses.textEn: Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.

verses.textZh: 后来，大卫差派使者去见扫罗的儿子伊施波设，说："请你把我的妻子米甲还给我，她是我从前用一百个非利士人的包皮聘下的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，大卫差派使者去见扫罗的儿子伊施波设，说："请你把我的妻子米甲还给我，她是我从前用一百个非利士人的包皮聘下的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就打发人去见扫罗的儿子伊施波设，说：「你要将我的妻米甲归还我；她是我从前用一百非利士人的阳皮所聘定的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, "Whose land is it? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you bring all Israel over to you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, "To whom does the land belong? Make your covenant with me, and behold, my hand shall be with you to bring over all Israel to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to David, saying, "Whose is the land?" saying also, "Make your covenant with me, and indeed my hand shallbe with you to bring all Israel to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abner sent messengers to David, saying, "Doesn’t the entire land belong to you? Make a solemn pact with me, and I will help turn over all of Israel to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abner sent messengers to David at his place, saying, "Whose is the land? Make your covenant with me, and behold, my hand shall be with you to bring all Israel over to you."
verses.textEn: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, "Whose land is it? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you bring all Israel over to you."

verses.textZh: 于是伊施波设派人去，把米甲从拉亿的儿子她丈夫帕铁那里接回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是伊施波设派人去，把米甲从拉亿的儿子她丈夫帕铁那里接回来。
