verses.textEnNiv: "Good," said David. "I will make an agreement with you. But I demand one thing of you: Do not come into my presence unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see me."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Good; I will make a covenant with you. But one thing I require of you; that is, you shall not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said, "Good, I will make a covenant with you. But one thing I require of you: you shall not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," David replied, "but I will not negotiate with you unless you bring back my wife Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Good! I will make a covenant with you, only I require one thing of you, namely, that you shall not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see me."
verses.textEn: "Good," said David. "I will make an agreement with you. But I demand one thing of you: Do not come into my presence unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see me."

verses.textZh: 米甲的丈夫与她一起去，跟在她后面，一边走、一边哭，一直跟到巴户琳。押尼珥对他说："你去吧！回去吧！"他只好回去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米甲的丈夫与她一起去，跟在她后面，一边走、一边哭，一直跟到巴户琳。押尼珥对他说："你去吧！回去吧！"他只好回去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 米甲的丈夫跟着她，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴户琳。押尼珥说：「你回去吧！」帕铁就回去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth, Saul’s son, saying, "Give me my wife Michal, for whom I paid the bridal price of a hundred foreskins of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred foreskins of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: David then sent this message to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son: "Give me back my wife Michal, for I bought her with the lives of 100 Philistines."
verses.textEnNasb: So David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth, Saul’s son, saying, "Give me my wife Michal, to whom I was betrothed for a hundred foreskins of the Philistines."
verses.textEn: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins."

verses.textZh: 押尼珥与以色列的长老商议说："从前你们希望大卫作你们的王。

verses.textEnNiv: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ish-bosheth sent and took her from her husband Paltiel the son of Laish.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, from Paltiel the son of Laish.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ishbosheth took Michal away from her husband, Palti son of Laish.
verses.textEnNasb: Ish-bosheth sent men and had her taken from her husband, from Paltiel the son of Laish.
verses.textEn: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.

verses.textZh: 现在可以实现了！因为耶和华曾经论到大卫说：‘我要借着我的仆人大卫的手，把我的子民以色列从非利士人和他们所有敌人的手中拯救出来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在可以实现了！因为耶和华曾经论到大卫说：‘我要借着我的仆人大卫的手，把我的子民以色列从非利士人和他们所有敌人的手中拯救出来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们可以照心愿而行。因为耶和华曾论到大卫说：『我必藉我仆人大卫的手，救我民以色列脱离非利士人和众仇敌的手。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Her husband, however, went with her, weeping behind her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go back home!" So he went back.
verses.textEnEsv: But her husband went with her, weeping after her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go, return." And he returned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then her husband went along with her to Bahurim, weeping behind her. So Abner said to him, "Go, return!" And he returned.
verses.textEnNlt: Palti followed along behind her as far as Bahurim, weeping as he went. Then Abner told him, "Go back home!" So Palti returned.
verses.textEnNasb: And her husband went with her, weeping as he went, following her as far as Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go, return." So he returned.
verses.textEn: Her husband, however, went with her, weeping behind her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go back home!" So he went back.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥也把这话说给便雅悯人听，然后又去希伯仑，把以色列人和便雅悯全都同意的一切事说给大卫听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥也把这话说给便雅悯人听，然后又去希伯仑，把以色列人和便雅悯全都同意的一切事说给大卫听。
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥也用这话说给便雅悯人听，又到希伯仑，将以色列人和便雅悯全家一切所喜悦的事说给大卫听。
verses.textEnNiv: Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, "For some time you have wanted to make David your king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abner conferred with the elders of Israel, saying, "For some time past you have been seeking David as king over you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abner had communicated with the elders of Israel, saying, "In time past you were seeking for David tobe king over you.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Abner had consulted with the elders of Israel. "For some time now," he told them, "you have wanted to make David your king.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abner had a consultation with the elders of Israel, saying, "In times past you were seeking for David to be king over you.
verses.textEn: Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, "For some time you have wanted to make David your king.

verses.textZh: 押尼珥带着二十个人，来到希伯仑见大卫的时候，大卫就为押尼珥和与他同来的人摆设筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押尼珥带着二十个人，来到希伯仑见大卫的时候，大卫就为押尼珥和与他同来的人摆设筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥带着二十个人来到希伯仑见大卫，大卫就为押尼珥和他带来的人设摆筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: Now do it! For the Lord promised David, ‘By my servant David I will rescue my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Now then bring it about, for the Lord has promised David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines, and from the hand of all their enemies.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now then, do it! For the Lord has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of My servant David, I will save My people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and the hand of all their enemies.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Now is the time! For the Lord has said, ‘I have chosen David to save my people Israel from the hands of the Philistines and from all their other enemies.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, do it! For the Lord has spoken regarding David, saying, ‘By the hand of My servant David I will save My people Israel from the hand of the Philistines, and from the hands of all their enemies.’ "
verses.textEn: Now do it! For the Lord promised David, ‘By my servant David I will rescue my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.’ "

verses.textZh: 后来，押尼珥对大卫说："让我去把以色列众人召集到我主我王这里来，好叫他们与你立约，这样你就可以照着自己的心愿统治所有的人。"于是大卫打发押尼珥回去，他就平平安安地走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，押尼珥对大卫说："让我去把以色列众人召集到我主我王这里来，好叫他们与你立约，这样你就可以照着自己的心愿统治所有的人。"于是大卫打发押尼珥回去，他就平平安安地走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 押尼珥对大卫说：「我要起身去招聚以色列众人来见我主我王，与你立约，你就可以照着心愿作王。」于是大卫送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites in person. Then he went to Hebron to tell David everything that Israel and the whole tribe of Benjamin wanted to do.
verses.textEnEsv: Abner also spoke to Benjamin. And then Abner went to tell David at Hebron all that Israel and the whole house of Benjamin thought good to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abner also spoke in the hearing of Benjamin. Then Abner also went to speak in the hearing of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and the whole house of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: Abner also spoke with the men of Benjamin. Then he went to Hebron to tell David that all the people of Israel and Benjamin had agreed to support him.
verses.textEnNasb: Abner also spoke to Benjamin; and in addition Abner went to speak to David in Hebron everything that seemed good to Israel and to the entire house of Benjamin.
verses.textEn: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites in person. Then he went to Hebron to tell David everything that Israel and the whole tribe of Benjamin wanted to do.

verses.textZh: 那时，大卫的臣仆和约押攻击敌人回来，带回许多的战利品。当时，押尼珥不在希伯仑大卫那里，因为大卫已经打发他离去，他也平平安安地走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，大卫的臣仆和约押攻击敌人回来，带回许多的战利品。当时，押尼珥不在希伯仑大卫那里，因为大卫已经打发他离去，他也平平安安地走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押和大卫的仆人攻击敌军，带回许多的掠物。那时押尼珥不在希伯仑大卫那里，因大卫已经送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Abner, who had twenty men with him, came to David at Hebron, David prepared a feast for him and his men.
verses.textEnEsv: When Abner came with twenty men to David at Hebron, David made a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abner and twenty men with him came to David at Hebron. And David made a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abner and twenty of his men came to Hebron, David entertained them with a great feast.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abner and twenty men with him came to David at Hebron. And David held a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.
verses.textEn: When Abner, who had twenty men with him, came to David at Hebron, David prepared a feast for him and his men.

verses.textZh: 约押和跟随他的全军一到达，就有人告诉约押，尼珥的儿子押尼珥曾经来见过王。王打发他离去，他已经平平安安地走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押和跟随他的全军一到达，就有人告诉约押，尼珥的儿子押尼珥曾经来见过王。王打发他离去，他已经平平安安地走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押和跟随他的全军到了，就有人告诉约押说：「尼珥的儿子押尼珥来见王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abner said to David, "Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abner said to David, "I will arise and go and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abner said to David, "I will arise and go, and gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abner said to David, "Let me go and call an assembly of all Israel to support my lord the king. They will make a covenant with you to make you their king, and you will rule over everything your heart desires." So David sent Abner safely on his way.
verses.textEnNasb: Abner said to David, "Let me set out and go and gather all Israel to my lord the king, so that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may be king over all that your soul desires." So David let Abner go, and he went in peace.
verses.textEn: Then Abner said to David, "Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.

verses.textZh: 约押进去见王，说："你作了甚么事？押尼珥来见你，你为甚么把他送走？现在他已经走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押进去见王，说："你作了甚么事？押尼珥来见你，你为甚么把他送走？现在他已经走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押去见王说：「你这是做什么呢？押尼珥来见你，你为何送他去，他就踪影不见了呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Just then David’s men and Joab returned from a raid and brought with them a great deal of plunder. But Abner was no longer with David in Hebron, because David had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
verses.textEnEsv: Just then the servants of David arrived with Joab from a raid, bringing much spoil with them. But Abner was not with David at Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that moment the servants of David and Joab came from a raid and brought much spoil with them. But Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
verses.textEnNlt: But just after David had sent Abner away in safety, Joab and some of David’s troops returned from a raid, bringing much plunder with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, the servants of David and Joab came from a raid and brought a large amount of plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, since he had let him go, and he had gone in peace.
verses.textEn: Just then David’s men and Joab returned from a raid and brought with them a great deal of plunder. But Abner was no longer with David in Hebron, because David had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

verses.textEnEsv: When Joab and all the army that was with him came, it was told Joab, "Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has let him go, and he has gone in peace."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Joab and all the troops that were with him had come, they told Joab, saying, "Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he sent him away, and he has gone in peace."
verses.textEnNlt: When Joab arrived, he was told that Abner had just been there visiting the king and had been sent away in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: When Joab and all the army that was with him arrived, they informed Joab, saying, "Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has let him go on his way, and he has gone in peace."
verses.textEn: When Joab and all the soldiers with him arrived, he was told that Abner son of Ner had come to the king and that the king had sent him away and that he had gone in peace.

verses.textZh: 约押从大卫那里出来，就差派使者去追赶押尼珥，使者从西拉的水井那里把他带回来。可是，大卫一点都不知道。

verses.textZhCuv: 约押从大卫那里出来，就打发人去追赶押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，将他带回来，大卫却不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joab went to the king and said, "What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you let him go? Now he is gone!
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joab went to the king and said, "What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, so that he is gone?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joab came to the king and said, "What have you done? Look, Abner came to you; why is it that you sent him away, and he has already gone?
verses.textEnNlt: Joab rushed to the king and demanded, "What have you done? What do you mean by letting Abner get away?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab came to the king and said, "What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you; why then have you let him go, so that he is already gone?
verses.textEn: So Joab went to the king and said, "What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you let him go? Now he is gone!

verses.textZh: 押尼珥回到了希伯仑，约押就拉他到城门的瓮洞里与他密谈。约押就在那里刺透他的肚子，他就死了。这样，他替自己的兄弟亚撒黑报了血仇。

verses.textZhCnvs: 事后大卫听到了，就说："关于尼珥的儿子押尼珥的血案，我和我的国家，在耶和华面前永远是无辜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫听见了，就说：「流尼珥的儿子押尼珥的血，这罪在耶和华面前必永不归我和我的国。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab then left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern at Sirah. But David did not know it.
verses.textEnEsv: When Joab came out from David’s presence, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern of Sirah. But David did not know about it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Joab had gone from David’s presence, he sent messengers after Abner, who brought him back from the well of Sirah. But David did not know it.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab then left David and sent messengers to catch up with Abner, asking him to return. They found him at the well of Sirah and brought him back, though David knew nothing about it.
verses.textEnNasb: When Joab left David’s presence, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David did not know about it.
verses.textEn: Joab then left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the cistern at Sirah. But David did not know it.

verses.textZh: 愿这流人血的罪归到约押的头上和他父亲的全家！又愿约押家不断有患血漏病的、长痲风的、拿拐杖的、倒毙在剑下的和缺乏粮食的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿这流人血的罪归到约押的头上和他父亲的全家！又愿约押家不断有患血漏病的、长痲风的、拿拐杖的、倒毙在剑下的和缺乏粮食的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿流他血的罪归到约押头上和他父的全家；又愿约押家不断有患漏症的，长大麻风的，架拐而行的，被刀杀死的，缺乏饮食的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into an inner chamber, as if to speak with him privately. And there, to avenge the blood of his brother Asahel, Joab stabbed him in the stomach, and he died.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the midst of the gate to speak with him privately, and there he struck him in the stomach, so that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him privately, and there stabbed him in the stomach, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abner arrived back at Hebron, Joab took him aside at the gateway as if to speak with him privately. But then he stabbed Abner in the stomach and killed him in revenge for killing his brother Asahel.
verses.textEnNasb: So when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him privately, and there he struck him in the belly, so that he died on account of the blood of his brother Asahel.
verses.textEn: Now when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into an inner chamber, as if to speak with him privately. And there, to avenge the blood of his brother Asahel, Joab stabbed him in the stomach, and he died.

verses.textZh: 因押尼珥在基遍的战场上，杀死了他们的兄弟亚撒黑，约押和他的兄弟亚比筛就杀了押尼珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因押尼珥在基遍的战场上，杀死了他们的兄弟亚撒黑，约押和他的兄弟亚比筛就杀了押尼珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押和他兄弟亚比筛杀了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍争战的时候杀了他们的兄弟亚撒黑。
verses.textEnNiv: Later, when David heard about this, he said, "I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the Lord concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward, when David heard of it, he said, "I and my kingdom are forever guiltless before the Lord for the blood of Abner the son of Ner.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, "My kingdom and I are guiltless before the Lord forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard about it, he declared, "I vow by the Lord that I and my kingdom are forever innocent of this crime against Abner son of Ner.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward, when David heard about this, he said, "I and my kingdom are innocent before the Lord forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.
verses.textEn: Later, when David heard about this, he said, "I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the Lord concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.

verses.textZh: 大卫对约押和与他在一起的众人说："你们要撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥面前哀哭！"大卫王也走在棺木后面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对约押和与他在一起的众人说："你们要撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥面前哀哭！"大卫王也走在棺木后面。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫吩咐约押和跟随他的众人说：「你们当撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥棺前哀哭。」大卫王也跟在棺后。
verses.textEnNiv: May his blood fall on the head of Joab and on his whole family! May Joab’s family never be without someone who has a running sore or leprosy or who leans on a crutch or who falls by the sword or who lacks food."
verses.textEnEsv: May it fall upon the head of Joab and upon all his father’s house, and may the house of Joab never be without one who has a discharge or who is leprous or who holds a spindle or who falls by the sword or who lacks bread!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let it rest on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house; and let there never fail to be in the house of Joab one who has a discharge or is a leper, who leans on a staff or falls by the sword, or who lacks bread."
verses.textEnNlt: Joab and his family are the guilty ones. May the family of Joab be cursed in every generation with a man who has open sores or leprosy or who walks on crutches or dies by the sword or begs for food!"
verses.textEnNasb: May it turn upon the head of Joab and on all his father’s house; and may there not be eliminated from the house of Joab someone who suffers a discharge, or has leprosy, or holds the spindle, or falls by the sword, or lacks bread."
verses.textEn: May his blood fall on the head of Joab and on his whole family! May Joab’s family never be without someone who has a running sore or leprosy or who leans on a crutch or who falls by the sword or who lacks food."

verses.textZh: 他们把押尼珥埋葬在希伯仑。王在押尼珥的墓旁放声大哭，众人也都哭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把押尼珥埋葬在希伯仑。王在押尼珥的墓旁放声大哭，众人也都哭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将押尼珥葬在希伯仑。王在押尼珥的墓旁放声而哭，众民也都哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)
verses.textEnEsv: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had put their brother Asahel to death in the battle at Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joab and his brother Abishai killed Abner because Abner had killed their brother Asahel at the battle of Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joab and his brother Abishai killed Abner because he had put their brother Asahel to death in the battle at Gibeon.
verses.textEn: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)

verses.textZh: 王又为押尼珥作了哀歌，说： "难道押尼珥死去，要像愚妄的人死去一样吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又为押尼珥作了哀歌，说： "难道押尼珥死去，要像愚妄的人死去一样吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 王为押尼珥举哀，说： 押尼珥何竟像愚顽人死呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to Joab and all the people with him, "Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and walk in mourning in front of Abner." King David himself walked behind the bier.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, "Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and mourn before Abner." And King David followed the bier.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, "Tear your clothes, gird yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn for Abner." And King David followed the coffin.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said to Joab and all those who were with him, "Tear your clothes and put on burlap. Mourn for Abner." And King David himself walked behind the procession to the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, "Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth, and mourn before Abner." And King David walked behind the bier.
verses.textEn: Then David said to Joab and all the people with him, "Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and walk in mourning in front of Abner." King David himself walked behind the bier.

verses.textZh: 你的手没有被绳索绑住， 你的脚也没有被铜炼锁住， 你倒毙，好象人在暴徒面前倒毙一样！" 于是，众民又为押尼珥哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的手没有被绳索绑住， 你的脚也没有被铜炼锁住， 你倒毙，好象人在暴徒面前倒毙一样！" 于是，众民又为押尼珥哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你手未曾捆绑，脚未曾锁住。 你死，如人死在罪孽之辈手下一样。 于是众民又为押尼珥哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb. All the people wept also.
verses.textEnEsv: They buried Abner at Hebron. And the king lifted up his voice and wept at the grave of Abner, and all the people wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at the grave of Abner, and all the people wept.
verses.textEnNlt: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king and all the people wept at his graveside.
verses.textEnNasb: And they buried Abner in Hebron; and the king raised his voice and wept at the grave of Abner, and all the people wept.
verses.textEn: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb. All the people wept also.

verses.textZh: 还在白天的时候，众人都来劝大卫吃点饭；大卫起誓说："我若在日落以前吃饭或吃甚么东西，愿神降罚我，重重地降罚我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 还在白天的时候，众人都来劝大卫吃点饭；大卫起誓说："我若在日落以前吃饭或吃甚么东西，愿神降罚我，重重地降罚我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 日头未落的时候，众民来劝大卫吃饭，但大卫起誓说：「我若在日头未落以前吃饭，或吃别物，愿神重重地降罚与我！」
verses.textEnNiv: The king sang this lament for Abner: "Should Abner have died as the lawless die?
verses.textEnEsv: And the king lamented for Abner, saying, "Should Abner die as a fool dies?
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king sang alament over Abner and said: "Should Abner die as a fool dies?
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king sang this funeral song for Abner: "Should Abner have died as fools die?
verses.textEnNasb: And the king sang a song of mourning for Abner and said, "Should Abner die as a fool dies?
verses.textEn: The king sang this lament for Abner: "Should Abner have died as the lawless die?

verses.textZh: 众人看见了，就都喜悦。王所作的一切，他们都很喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人看见了，就都喜悦。王所作的一切，他们都很喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 众民知道了就都喜悦。凡王所行的，众民无不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. You fell as one falls before the wicked." And all the people wept over him again.
verses.textEnEsv: Your hands were not bound; your feet were not fettered; as one falls before the wicked you have fallen." And all the people wept again over him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your hands were not bound Nor your feet put into fetters; As a man falls before wicked men, so you fell." Then all the people wept over him again.
verses.textEnNlt: Your hands were not bound; your feet were not chained. No, you were murdered— the victim of a wicked plot." All the people wept again for Abner.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your hands were not bound, nor your feet put in bronze shackles; As one falls before the wicked, you have fallen." And all the people wept over him again.
verses.textEn: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. You fell as one falls before the wicked." And all the people wept over him again.

verses.textZh: 那一天众人和全以色列都知道，杀死尼珥的儿子押尼珥，并不是出于王的意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天众人和全以色列都知道，杀死尼珥的儿子押尼珥，并不是出于王的意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，以色列众民才知道杀尼珥的儿子押尼珥并非出于王意。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they all came and urged David to eat something while it was still day; but David took an oath, saying, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people came to persuade David to eat bread while it was yet day. But David swore, saying, "God do so to me and more also, if I taste bread or anything else till the sun goes down!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when all the people came to persuade David to eat food while it was still day, David took an oath, saying, "God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else till the sun goes down!"
verses.textEnNlt: David had refused to eat anything on the day of the funeral, and now everyone begged him to eat. But David had made a vow, saying, "May God strike me and even kill me if I eat anything before sundown."
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people came to provide food for David in his distress while it was still day; but David vowed, saying, "May God do so to me, and more so, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun goes down."
verses.textEn: Then they all came and urged David to eat something while it was still day; but David took an oath, saying, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!"

verses.textZh: 王对他的臣仆说："你们不知道今天在以色列中，有一位将领和伟人倒毙了吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对他的臣仆说："你们不知道今天在以色列中，有一位将领和伟人倒毙了吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 王对臣仆说：「你们岂不知今日以色列人中死了一个作元帅的大丈夫吗？
verses.textEnNiv: All the people took note and were pleased; indeed, everything the king did pleased them.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as everything that the king did pleased all the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the people took note ofit, and it pleased them, since whatever the king did pleased all the people.
verses.textEnNlt: This pleased the people very much. In fact, everything the king did pleased them!
verses.textEnNasb: Now all the people took note of David’s vow, and it pleased them, just as everything that the king did pleased all the people.
verses.textEn: All the people took note and were pleased; indeed, everything the king did pleased them.

verses.textZh: 今天我虽然受膏为王，但我还是幼弱的。洗鲁雅的两个儿子太强了，非我所能应付。愿耶和华照着恶人所行的恶，报应恶人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 今天我虽然受膏为王，但我还是幼弱的。洗鲁雅的两个儿子太强了，非我所能应付。愿耶和华照着恶人所行的恶，报应恶人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽然受膏为王，今日还是软弱；这洗鲁雅的两个儿子比我刚强。愿耶和华照着恶人所行的恶报应他。」
verses.textEnNiv: So on that day all the people there and all Israel knew that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it had not been the king’s will to put to death Abner the son of Ner.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it had not been the king’s intent to kill Abner the son of Ner.
verses.textEnNlt: So everyone in Judah and all Israel understood that David was not responsible for Abner’s murder.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the people and all Israel understood on that day that it had not been the desire of the king to put Abner the son of Ner to death.
verses.textEn: So on that day all the people there and all Israel knew that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.

verses.textZh: 王对臣仆说：“你们岂不知今日以色列人中死了一个作元帅的大人物吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king said to his men, "Do you not realize that a commander and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to his servants, "Do you not know that a prince and a great man has fallen this day in Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to his servants, "Do you not know that a prince and a great man has fallen this day in Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: Then King David said to his officials, "Don’t you realize that a great commander has fallen today in Israel?
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to his servants, "Do you not know that a leader and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?
verses.textEn: Then the king said to his men, "Do you not realize that a commander and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?
verses.textZhCn: 王对臣仆说：“你们岂不知今日以色列人中死了一个作元帅的大人物吗？

verses.textZh: 我虽然是受膏的王，今日还是软弱；洗鲁雅的这两个儿子比我刚强。愿耶和华照着行恶之人的恶报应他。”
verses.textEnNiv: And today, though I am the anointed king, I am weak, and these sons of Zeruiah are too strong for me. May the Lord repay the evildoer according to his evil deeds!"
verses.textEnEsv: And I was gentle today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah, are more severe than I. The Lord repay the evildoer according to his wickedness!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I am weak today, though anointed king; and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are too harsh for me. The Lord shall repay the evildoer according to his wickedness."
verses.textEnNlt: And even though I am the anointed king, these two sons of Zeruiah—Joab and Abishai—are too strong for me to control. So may the Lord repay these evil men for their evil deeds."
verses.textEnNasb: And I am weak today, though anointed king; and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are too difficult for me. May the Lord repay the evildoer in proportion to his evil."
verses.textEn: And today, though I am the anointed king, I am weak, and these sons of Zeruiah are too strong for me. May the Lord repay the evildoer according to his evil deeds!"
verses.textZhCn: 我虽然是受膏的王，今日还是软弱；洗鲁雅的这两个儿子比我刚强。愿耶和华照着行恶之人的恶报应他。”

verses.textZh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设听见押尼珥在希伯仑死了，就怕得手都发软，以色列众人也都惊惶失措。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设听见押尼珥在希伯仑死了，就怕得手都发软，以色列众人也都惊惶失措。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设听见押尼珥死在希伯仑，手就发软；以色列众人也都惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: When Ish-Bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel became alarmed.
verses.textEnEsv: When Ish-bosheth, Saul’s son, heard that Abner had died at Hebron, his courage failed, and all Israel was dismayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul’s son heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost heart, and all Israel was troubled.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, heard about Abner’s death at Hebron, he lost all courage, and all Israel became paralyzed with fear.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Ish-bosheth, Saul’s son, heard that Abner had died in Hebron, his courage failed, and all Israel was horrified.
verses.textEn: When Ish-Bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel became alarmed.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设有两个统率突击队的将领，一个名叫巴拿，一个名叫利甲，他们是便雅悯支派比录人临门的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设有两个统率突击队的将领，一个名叫巴拿，一个名叫利甲，他们是便雅悯支派比录人临门的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设有两个军长，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅悯支派、比录人临门的儿子。比录也属便雅悯。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding bands. One was named Baanah and the other Rekab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin—Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,
verses.textEnEsv: Now Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands; the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon a man of Benjamin from Beeroth ( for Beeroth also is counted part of Benjamin;
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Saul’s son had two men whowere captains of troops. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin. (For Beeroth also was part of Benjamin,
verses.textEnNlt: Now there were two brothers, Baanah and Recab, who were captains of Ishbosheth’s raiding parties. They were sons of Rimmon, a member of the tribe of Benjamin who lived in Beeroth. The town of Beeroth is now part of Benjamin’s territory
verses.textEnNasb: And Saul’s son had two men who were commanders of troops: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the sons of Benjamin (for Beeroth is also considered part of Benjamin,
verses.textEn: Now Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding bands. One was named Baanah and the other Rekab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin—Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,

verses.textZh: 扫罗的儿子约拿单有一个儿子，双腿都跛了。扫罗和约拿单死亡的消息从耶斯列传到的时候，他才五岁。他的乳母抱着他逃跑。乳母在慌忙中逃跑，孩子掉了下来，腿就瘸了。他的名字叫米非波设。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的儿子约拿单有一个儿子，双腿都跛了。扫罗和约拿单死亡的消息从耶斯列传到的时候，他才五岁。他的乳母抱着他逃跑。乳母在慌忙中逃跑，孩子掉了下来，腿就瘸了。他的名字叫米非波设。
verses.textZhCuv: 比录人早先逃到基他音，在那里寄居，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: because the people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim and have resided there as foreigners to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have been sojourners there to this day).
verses.textEnNkjv: because the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have been sojourners there until this day.)
verses.textEnNlt: because the original people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim, where they still live as foreigners.
verses.textEnNasb: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have lived there as strangers until this day).
verses.textEn: because the people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim and have resided there as foreigners to this day.

verses.textZh: 比录人临门的儿子利甲和巴拿出去，约在正午炎热的时候，来到了伊施波设的家。伊施波设正在睡午觉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比录人临门的儿子利甲和巴拿出去，约在正午炎热的时候，来到了伊施波设的家。伊施波设正在睡午觉。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的儿子约拿单有一个儿子名叫米非波设，是瘸腿的。扫罗和约拿单死亡的消息从耶斯列传到的时候，他才五岁。他乳母抱着他逃跑；因为跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。
verses.textEnNiv: (Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in both feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled, but as she hurried to leave, he fell and became disabled. His name was Mephibosheth.)
verses.textEnEsv: Jonathan, the son of Saul, had a son who was crippled in his feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, and his nurse took him up and fled, and as she fled in her haste, he fell and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son whowas lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel; and his nurse took him up and fled. And it happened, as she made haste to flee, that he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.
verses.textEnNlt: (Saul’s son Jonathan had a son named Mephibosheth, who was crippled as a child. He was five years old when the report came from Jezreel that Saul and Jonathan had been killed in battle. When the child’s nurse heard the news, she picked him up and fled. But as she hurried away, she dropped him, and he became crippled.)
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was disabled in both feet. He was five years old when the news of Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, and his nurse picked him up and fled. But it happened that in her hurry to flee, he fell and could no longer walk. And his name was Mephibosheth.
verses.textEn: (Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in both feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled, but as she hurried to leave, he fell and became disabled. His name was Mephibosheth.)

verses.textZh: 他们进了屋里，假装要拿麦子，就刺透伊施波设的肚腹，然后利甲和他的兄弟巴拿都逃脱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进了屋里，假装要拿麦子，就刺透伊施波设的肚腹，然后利甲和他的兄弟巴拿都逃脱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，比录人临门的两个儿子利甲和巴拿出去，约在午热的时候到了伊施波设的家；伊施波设正睡午觉。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Rekab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out for the house of Ish-Bosheth, and they arrived there in the heat of the day while he was taking his noonday rest.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, set out, and about the heat of the day they came to the house of Ish-bosheth as he was taking his noonday rest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, set out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who was lying on his bed at noon.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Recab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon from Beeroth, went to Ishbosheth’s house around noon as he was taking his midday rest.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, departed and came to the house of Ish-bosheth in the heat of the day, while he was taking his midday rest.
verses.textEn: Now Rekab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out for the house of Ish-Bosheth, and they arrived there in the heat of the day while he was taking his noonday rest.

verses.textZh: 他们进屋子的时候，伊施波设正在自己的卧室里躺在床上，他们刺透他，把他杀死，然后割下他的头，拿着头颅在亚拉巴的路上走了一夜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进屋子的时候，伊施波设正在自己的卧室里躺在床上，他们刺透他，把他杀死，然后割下他的头，拿着头颅在亚拉巴的路上走了一夜，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进了房子，假作要取麦子，就刺透伊施波设的肚腹，逃跑了。
verses.textEnNiv: They went into the inner part of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rekab and his brother Baanah slipped away.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came into the midst of the house as if to get wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they came there, all the way into the house, asthough to get wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
verses.textEnNlt: The doorkeeper, who had been sifting wheat, became drowsy and fell asleep. So Recab and Baanah slipped past her.
verses.textEnNasb: And they came to the interior of the house as if to get wheat, and they struck him in the belly; and Rechab and his brother Baanah escaped.
verses.textEn: They went into the inner part of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rekab and his brother Baanah slipped away.

verses.textZh: 把伊施波设的头带到希伯仑去见大卫，对王说："你的仇敌扫罗过去常常寻索你的命。看哪！这是他儿子伊施波设的头。今天耶和华在扫罗和他后裔的身上为我主我王报了仇了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 把伊施波设的头带到希伯仑去见大卫，对王说："你的仇敌扫罗过去常常寻索你的命。看哪！这是他儿子伊施波设的头。今天耶和华在扫罗和他后裔的身上为我主我王报了仇了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进房子的时候，伊施波设正在卧房里躺在床上，他们将他杀死，割了他的首级，拿着首级在亚拉巴走了一夜，
verses.textEnNiv: They had gone into the house while he was lying on the bed in his bedroom. After they stabbed and killed him, they cut off his head. Taking it with them, they traveled all night by way of the Arabah.
verses.textEnEsv: When they came into the house, as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him and put him to death and beheaded him. They took his head and went by the way of the Arabah all night,
verses.textEnNkjv: For when they came into the house, he was lying on his bed in his bedroom; then they struck him and killed him, beheaded him and took his head, and were all night escaping through the plain.
verses.textEnNlt: They went into the house and found Ishbosheth sleeping on his bed. They struck and killed him and cut off his head. Then, taking his head with them, they fled across the Jordan Valley through the night.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they had come into the house, as he was lying on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him and killed him, and they beheaded him. And they took his head and traveled by way of the Arabah all night.
verses.textEn: They had gone into the house while he was lying on the bed in his bedroom. After they stabbed and killed him, they cut off his head. Taking it with them, they traveled all night by way of the Arabah.

verses.textZh: 大卫回答比录人临门的儿子利甲和他的兄弟巴拿，说："我指着那曾救赎我的命脱离一切患难的永活的耶和华起誓：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回答比录人临门的儿子利甲和他的兄弟巴拿，说："我指着那曾救赎我的命脱离一切患难的永活的耶和华起誓：
verses.textZhCuv: 将伊施波设的首级拿到希伯仑见大卫王，说：「王的仇敌扫罗曾寻索王的性命。看哪，这是他儿子伊施波设的首级；耶和华今日为我主我王在扫罗和他后裔的身上报了仇。」
verses.textEnNiv: They brought the head of Ish-Bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, "Here is the head of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, your enemy, who tried to kill you. This day the Lord has avenged my lord the king against Saul and his offspring."
verses.textEnEsv: and brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David at Hebron. And they said to the king, "Here is the head of Ish-bosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life. The Lord has avenged my lord the king this day on Saul and on his offspring."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth to David at Hebron, and said to the king, "Here is the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul your enemy, who sought your life; and the Lord has avenged my lord the king this day of Saul and his descendants."
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived at Hebron, they presented Ishbosheth’s head to David. "Look!" they exclaimed to the king. "Here is the head of Ishbosheth, the son of your enemy Saul who tried to kill you. Today the Lord has given my lord the king revenge on Saul and his entire family!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David at Hebron, and said to the king, "Behold, the head of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life; so the Lord has given my lord the king vengeance this day on Saul and his descendants."
verses.textEn: They brought the head of Ish-Bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, "Here is the head of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, your enemy, who tried to kill you. This day the Lord has avenged my lord the king against Saul and his offspring."

verses.textZh: 从前有人向我报信说：‘看哪！扫罗死了。’他自以为是报好消息，我却抓住他，把他杀在洗革拉，这就是我给他作报好消息的酬报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前有人向我报信说：‘看哪！扫罗死了。’他自以为是报好消息，我却抓住他，把他杀在洗革拉，这就是我给他作报好消息的酬报。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对比录人临门的儿子利甲和他兄弟巴拿说：「我指着救我性命脱离一切苦难、永生的耶和华起誓：
verses.textEnNiv: David answered Rekab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, "As surely as the Lord lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,
verses.textEnEsv: But David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, "As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my life out of every adversity,
verses.textEnNkjv: But David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, "As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my life from all adversity,
verses.textEnNlt: But David said to Recab and Baanah, "The Lord , who saves me from all my enemies, is my witness.
verses.textEnNasb: But David replied to Rechab and his brother Baanah, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, "As the Lord lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
verses.textEn: David answered Rekab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, "As surely as the Lord lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,

verses.textZh: 何况恶人在义人的家里，把义人杀在床上。现在我怎能不从你们手中追讨流他血的罪，把你们从这世上除灭呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况恶人在义人的家里，把义人杀在床上。现在我怎能不从你们手中追讨流他血的罪，把你们从这世上除灭呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前有人报告我说，扫罗死了，他自以为报好消息；我就拿住他，将他杀在洗革拉，这就作了他报消息的赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: when someone told me, ‘Saul is dead,’ and thought he was bringing good news, I seized him and put him to death in Ziklag. That was the reward I gave him for his news!
verses.textEnEsv: when one told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ and thought he was bringing good news, I seized him and killed him at Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.
verses.textEnNkjv: when someone told me, saying, ‘Look, Saul is dead,’ thinking to have brought good news, I arrested him and had him executed in Ziklag—the one who thought I would give him a reward for his news.
verses.textEnNlt: Someone once told me, ‘Saul is dead,’ thinking he was bringing me good news. But I seized him and killed him at Ziklag. That’s the reward I gave him for his news!
verses.textEnNasb: when the one who informed me, saying, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ also viewed himself as the bearer of good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.
verses.textEn: when someone told me, ‘Saul is dead,’ and thought he was bringing good news, I seized him and put him to death in Ziklag. That was the reward I gave him for his news!

verses.textZh: 于是，大卫吩咐年轻人把他们杀了，并且砍断他们的手脚，把身体挂在希伯仑的水池旁边；却把伊施波设的头拿去，埋葬在希伯仑押尼珥的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，大卫吩咐年轻人把他们杀了，并且砍断他们的手脚，把身体挂在希伯仑的水池旁边；却把伊施波设的头拿去，埋葬在希伯仑押尼珥的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 何况恶人将义人杀在他的床上，我岂不向你们讨流他血的罪、从世上除灭你们呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: How much more—when wicked men have killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed—should I not now demand his blood from your hand and rid the earth of you!"
verses.textEnEsv: How much more, when wicked men have killed a righteous man in his own house on his bed, shall I not now require his blood at your hand and destroy you from the earth?"
verses.textEnNkjv: How much more, when wicked men have killed a righteous person in his own house on his bed? Therefore, shall I not now require his blood at your hand and remove you from the earth?"
verses.textEnNlt: How much more should I reward evil men who have killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed? Shouldn’t I hold you responsible for his blood and rid the earth of you?"
verses.textEnNasb: How much more, when wicked men have killed a righteous man in his own house on his bed, shall I not now require his blood from your hands and eliminate you both from the earth?"
verses.textEn: How much more—when wicked men have killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed—should I not now demand his blood from your hand and rid the earth of you!"

verses.textZh: 于是大卫吩咐少年人将他们杀了，砍断他们的手脚，挂在希伯仑的池旁，却将伊施波设的首级葬在希伯仑、押尼珥的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫吩咐少年人将他们杀了，砍断他们的手脚，挂在希伯仑的池旁，却将伊施波设的首级葬在希伯仑、押尼珥的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫吩咐少年人将他们杀了，砍断他们的手脚，挂在希伯仑的池旁，却将伊施波设的首级葬在希伯仑、押尼珥的坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: So David gave an order to his men, and they killed them. They cut off their hands and feet and hung the bodies by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-Bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb at Hebron.
verses.textEnEsv: And David commanded his young men, and they killed them and cut off their hands and feet and hanged them beside the pool at Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in the tomb of Abner at Hebron.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David commanded his young men, and they executed them, cut off their hands and feet, and hanged them by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in the tomb of Abner in Hebron.
verses.textEnNlt: So David ordered his young men to kill them, and they did. They cut off their hands and feet and hung their bodies beside the pool in Hebron. Then they took Ishbosheth’s head and buried it in Abner’s tomb in Hebron.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David commanded the young men, and they killed them and cut off their hands and feet, and hung them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in the grave of Abner in Hebron.
verses.textEn: So David gave an order to his men, and they killed them. They cut off their hands and feet and hung the bodies by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-Bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb at Hebron.

verses.textZh: 以色列众支派都到希伯仑来见大卫，说："看哪！我们都是你的骨肉至亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众支派都到希伯仑来见大卫，说："看哪！我们都是你的骨肉至亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众支派来到希伯仑见大卫，说：「我们原是你的骨肉。
verses.textEnNiv: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, "Behold, we are your bone and flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, "Indeed we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the tribes of Israel went to David at Hebron and told him, "We are your own flesh and blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, "Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.textEn: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.

verses.textZh: 从前扫罗作我们的王的时候，领导以色列人行动的是你。耶和华也曾对你说：‘你要牧养我的子民以色列，要作以色列的领袖。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前扫罗作我们的王的时候，领导以色列人行动的是你。耶和华也曾对你说：‘你要牧养我的子民以色列，要作以色列的领袖。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前扫罗作我们王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华也曾应许你说：『你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
verses.textEnNiv: In the past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the Lord said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. And the Lord said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over Israel.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, in time past, when Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them in; and the Lord said to you, ‘You shall shepherd My people Israel, and be ruler over Israel.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In the past, when Saul was our king, you were the one who really led the forces of Israel. And the Lord told you, ‘You will be the shepherd of my people Israel. You will be Israel’s leader.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Previously, when Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel out and in. And the Lord said to you, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be a leader over Israel.’ "
verses.textEn: In the past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the Lord said to you, ‘You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列的众长老都到希伯仑来见王。大卫王在希伯仑耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏立大卫作以色列的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的众长老都到希伯仑来见王。大卫王在希伯仑耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏立大卫作以色列的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯仑见大卫王，大卫在希伯仑耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, the king made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord. And they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So there at Hebron, King David made a covenant before the Lord with all the elders of Israel. And they anointed him king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them before the Lord in Hebron; then they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.textEn: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, the king made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel.

verses.textZh: 大卫登基的时候是三十岁，在位共四十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫登基的时候是三十岁，在位共四十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫登基的时候年三十岁，在位四十年；
verses.textEnNiv: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in all.
verses.textEnNasb: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned for forty years.
verses.textEn: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.

verses.textZh: 他在希伯仑作犹大的王七年零六个月；在耶路撒冷作全以色列和犹大的王三十三年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在希伯仑作犹大的王七年零六个月；在耶路撒冷作全以色列和犹大的王三十三年。
verses.textZhCuv: 在希伯仑作犹大王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和犹大王三十三年。
verses.textEnNiv: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.
verses.textEnEsv: At Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and at Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: He had reigned over Judah from Hebron for seven years and six months, and from Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah for thirty-three years.
verses.textEnNasb: At Hebron he reigned over Judah for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned for thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.textEn: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.

verses.textZh: 王和随从他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住在那地的耶布斯人。耶布斯人对大卫说："你不能进这里来，这些瞎眼的、跛脚的就能把你抵挡住。"他们心里想："大卫决不能进那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和随从他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住在那地的耶布斯人。耶布斯人对大卫说："你不能进这里来，这些瞎眼的、跛脚的就能把你抵挡住。"他们心里想："大卫决不能进那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和跟随他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人对大卫说：「你若不赶出瞎子、瘸子，必不能进这地方」；心里想大卫决不能进去。
verses.textEnNiv: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem to attack the Jebusites, who lived there. The Jebusites said to David, "You will not get in here; even the blind and the lame can ward you off." They thought, "David cannot get in here."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who said to David, "You will not come in here, but the blind and the lame will ward you off"—thinking, "David cannot come in here."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, "You shall not come in here; but the blind and the lame will repel you," thinking, "David cannot come in here."
verses.textEnNlt: David then led his men to Jerusalem to fight against the Jebusites, the original inhabitants of the land who were living there. The Jebusites taunted David, saying, "You’ll never get in here! Even the blind and lame could keep you out!" For the Jebusites thought they were safe.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land; and they said to David, "You shall not come in here, but even those who are blind and those who limp will turn you away," thinking, "David cannot enter here."
verses.textEn: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem to attack the Jebusites, who lived there. The Jebusites said to David, "You will not get in here; even the blind and the lame can ward you off." They thought, "David cannot get in here."

verses.textZh: 大卫却攻取了锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫却攻取了锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, David took the stronghold of Zion, that is, the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion (that is, the City of David).
verses.textEnNlt: But David captured the fortress of Zion, which is now called the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, David captured the stronghold of Zion, that is, the city of David.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.

verses.textZh: 那一天大卫说："攻打耶布斯人的，要把大卫心中恨恶的‘瞎子’和‘瘸子’丢进水沟里。"因此有句俗语说："瞎眼的或瘸腿的，都不能进殿里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天大卫说："攻打耶布斯人的，要把大卫心中恨恶的‘瞎子’和‘瘸子’丢进水沟里。"因此有句俗语说："瞎眼的或瘸腿的，都不能进殿里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，大卫说：「谁攻打耶布斯人，当上水沟攻打我心里所恨恶的瘸子、瞎子。」从此有俗语说：「在那里有瞎子、瘸子，他不能进屋去。」
verses.textEnNiv: On that day David had said, "Anyone who conquers the Jebusites will have to use the water shaft to reach those ‘lame and blind’ who are David’s enemies. " That is why they say, "The ‘blind and lame’ will not enter the palace."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said on that day, "Whoever would strike the Jebusites, let him get up the water shaft to attack ‘the lame and the blind,’ who are hated by David’s soul." Therefore it is said, "The blind and the lame shall not come into the house."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David said on that day, "Whoever climbs up by way of the water shaft and defeats the Jebusites (the lame and the blind, whoare hated by David’s soul), heshallbechiefandcaptain." Therefore they say, "The blind and the lame shall not come into the house."
verses.textEnNlt: On the day of the attack, David said to his troops, "I hate those ‘lame’ and ‘blind’ Jebusites. Whoever attacks them should strike by going into the city through the water tunnel. " That is the origin of the saying, "The blind and the lame may not enter the house."
verses.textEnNasb: And David said on that day, "Whoever strikes the Jebusites is to reach those who limp and those who are blind, who are hated by David’s soul, through the water tunnel." For that reason they say, "People who are blind and people who limp shall not come into the house."
verses.textEn: On that day David had said, "Anyone who conquers the Jebusites will have to use the water shaft to reach those ‘lame and blind’ who are David’s enemies. " That is why they say, "The ‘blind and lame’ will not enter the palace."

verses.textZh: 后来大卫住在保障里，称保障为"大卫的城"。大卫又从米罗向里面周围筑墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来大卫住在保障里，称保障为"大卫的城"。大卫又从米罗向里面周围筑墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫住在保障里，给保障起名叫大卫城。大卫又从米罗以里，周围筑墙。
verses.textEnNiv: David then took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built up the area around it, from the terraces inward.
verses.textEnEsv: And David lived in the stronghold and called it the city of David. And David built the city all around from the Millo inward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David dwelt in the stronghold, and called it the City of David. And David built all around from the Millo and inward.
verses.textEnNlt: So David made the fortress his home, and he called it the City of David. He extended the city, starting at the supporting terraces and working inward.
verses.textEnNasb: So David lived in the stronghold, and called it the city of David. And David built all around from the Millo and inward.
verses.textEn: David then took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built up the area around it, from the terraces inward.

verses.textZh: 大卫渐渐强大，因为耶和华万军的神与他同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫渐渐强大，因为耶和华万军的神与他同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫日见强盛，因为耶和华－万军之神与他同在。
verses.textEnNiv: And he became more and more powerful, because the Lord God Almighty was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord , the God of hosts, was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David went on and became great, and the Lord God of hosts was with him.
verses.textEnNlt: And David became more and more powerful, because the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies was with him.
verses.textEnNasb: David became greater and greater, for the Lord God of armies was with him.
verses.textEn: And he became more and more powerful, because the Lord God Almighty was with him.

verses.textZh: 推罗王希兰差派使者来见大卫，又送来香柏木、木匠和石匠，他们就给大卫建造宫殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 推罗王希兰差派使者来见大卫，又送来香柏木、木匠和石匠，他们就给大卫建造宫殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和木匠、石匠给大卫建造宫殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs and carpenters and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, also carpenters and masons who built David a house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters and masons. And they built David a house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar timber and carpenters and stonemasons, and they built David a palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, carpenters, and stonemasons; and they built a house for David.
verses.textEn: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs and carpenters and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.

verses.textZh: 大卫就知道耶和华已经立他作以色列的王，又因自己的子民以色列的缘故，使他的国兴盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就知道耶和华已经立他作以色列的王，又因自己的子民以色列的缘故，使他的国兴盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列使他的国兴旺。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And David knew that the Lord had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel, and that He had exalted His kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And David realized that the Lord had confirmed him as king over Israel and had blessed his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And David realized that the Lord had appointed him as king over Israel, and that He had exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.textEn: Then David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.

verses.textZh: 大卫离开希伯仑后，在耶路撒冷又娶了多位妃嫔，并且生了很多儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫离开希伯仑后，在耶路撒冷又娶了多位妃嫔，并且生了很多儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫离开希伯仑之后，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, after he came from Hebron, and more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron. Also more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.textEnNlt: After moving from Hebron to Jerusalem, David married more concubines and wives, and they had more sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, after he came from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.textEn: After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.

verses.textZh: 以下这些就是他在耶路撒冷所生的孩子的名字：沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这些就是他在耶路撒冷所生的孩子的名字：沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of David’s sons who were born in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.textEn: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

verses.textZh: 益辖、以利书亚、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textZhCnvs: 益辖、以利书亚、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textZhCuv: 益辖、以利书亚、尼斐、雅非亚、
verses.textEnNiv: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnEsv: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNlt: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEnNasb: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.textEn: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

verses.textZh: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列。
verses.textEnNiv: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnEsv: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNkjv: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNlt: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEnNasb: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.textEn: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.

verses.textZh: 非利士人听见有人膏立了大卫作王统治以色列人，就全体上来搜寻大卫。大卫听见了，就下到保障去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人听见有人膏立了大卫作王统治以色列人，就全体上来搜寻大卫。大卫听见了，就下到保障去。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人听见人膏大卫作以色列王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫；大卫听见，就下到保障。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. But David heard of it and went down to the stronghold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David. And David heard ofit and went down to the stronghold.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king of Israel, they mobilized all their forces to capture him. But David was told they were coming, so he went into the stronghold.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek out David; and when David heard about it, he went down to the stronghold.
verses.textEn: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

verses.textZh: 非利士人来到，散布在利乏音谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人来到，散布在利乏音谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Philistines also went and deployed themselves in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines arrived and spread out across the valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines came and overran the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEn: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;

verses.textZh: 大卫求问耶和华说："我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你会把他们交在我手里吗？"耶和华对大卫说："你可以上去，我必把非利士人交在你手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫求问耶和华说："我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你会把他们交在我手里吗？"耶和华对大卫说："你可以上去，我必把非利士人交在你手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫求问耶和华说：「我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？」耶和华说：「你可以上去，我必将非利士人交在你手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: so David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?" The Lord answered him, "Go, for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hands."
verses.textEnEsv: And David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you give them into my hand?" And the Lord said to David, "Go up, for I will certainly give the Philistines into your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?" And the Lord said to David, "Go up, for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into your hand."
verses.textEnNlt: So David asked the Lord , "Should I go out to fight the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The Lord replied to David, "Yes, go ahead. I will certainly hand them over to you."
verses.textEnNasb: So David inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You hand them over to me?" And the Lord said to David, "Go up, for I will certainly hand the Philistines over to you."
verses.textEn: so David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hands?" The Lord answered him, "Go, for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hands."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫来到巴力．毘拉心，在那里击败了非利士人，说："耶和华在我面前冲破我的敌人，好象洪水冲破堤岸一般。"因此他给那地方起名叫巴力．毘拉心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫来到巴力．毘拉心，在那里击败了非利士人，说："耶和华在我面前冲破我的敌人，好象洪水冲破堤岸一般。"因此他给那地方起名叫巴力．毘拉心。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫来到巴力‧毗拉心，在那里击杀非利士人，说：「耶和华在我面前冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般。」因此称那地方为巴力‧毗拉心。
verses.textEnNiv: So David went to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, the Lord has broken out against my enemies before me." So that place was called Baal Perazim.
verses.textEnEsv: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them there. And he said, "The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like a breaking flood." Therefore the name of that place is called Baal-perazim.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David went to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there; and he said, "The Lord has broken through my enemies before me, like a breakthrough of water." Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
verses.textEnNlt: So David went to Baal-perazim and defeated the Philistines there. "The Lord did it!" David exclaimed. "He burst through my enemies like a raging flood!" So he named that place Baal-perazim (which means "the Lord who bursts through").
verses.textEnNasb: Then David came to Baal-perazim and defeated them there; and he said, "The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like the breakthrough of waters." Therefore he named that place Baal-perazim.
verses.textEn: So David went to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, the Lord has broken out against my enemies before me." So that place was called Baal Perazim.

verses.textZh: 非利士人把他们的神像遗弃在那里，大卫和跟随他的人就把它们拿走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人把他们的神像遗弃在那里，大卫和跟随他的人就把它们拿走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人将偶像撇在那里，大卫和跟随他的人拿去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them off.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines left their idols there, and David and his men carried them away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they left their images there, and David and his men carried them away.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines had abandoned their idols there, so David and his men confiscated them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Philistines abandoned their idols there, so David and his men carried them away.
verses.textEn: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them off.

verses.textZh: 非利士人又上来，散布在利乏音谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人又上来，散布在利乏音谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人又上来，布散在利乏音谷。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
verses.textEnEsv: And the Philistines came up yet again and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines went up once again and deployed themselves in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNlt: But after a while the Philistines returned and again spread out across the valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Philistines came up once again and overran the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEn: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;

verses.textZh: 大卫又求问耶和华，耶和华说："你不要直接上去，要绕到他们后面，从桑林对面攻打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又求问耶和华，耶和华说："你不要直接上去，要绕到他们后面，从桑林对面攻打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫求问耶和华；耶和华说：「不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。
verses.textEnNiv: so David inquired of the Lord , and he answered, "Do not go straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.
verses.textEnEsv: And when David inquired of the Lord , he said, "You shall not go up; go around to their rear, and come against them opposite the balsam trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore David inquired of the Lord, and He said, "You shall not go up; circle around behind them, and come upon them in front of the mulberry trees.
verses.textEnNlt: And again David asked the Lord what to do. "Do not attack them straight on," the Lord replied. "Instead, circle around behind and attack them near the poplar trees.
verses.textEnNasb: So David inquired of the Lord, but He said, "You shall not go directly up; circle around behind them and come at them in front of the baka-shrubs.
verses.textEn: so David inquired of the Lord , and he answered, "Do not go straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the poplar trees.

verses.textZh: 你一听到桑林树梢上有脚步的声音，就要赶快行动，因为那时耶和华已经在你前面出去击杀非利士人的军队了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一听到桑林树梢上有脚步的声音，就要赶快行动，因为那时耶和华已经在你前面出去击杀非利士人的军队了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要急速前去，因为那时耶和华已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move quickly, because that will mean the Lord has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."
verses.textEnEsv: And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then rouse yourself, for then the Lord has gone out before you to strike down the army of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then you shall advance quickly. For then the Lord will go out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: When you hear a sound like marching feet in the tops of the poplar trees, be on the alert! That will be the signal that the Lord is moving ahead of you to strike down the Philistine army."
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the baka-shrubs, then you shall act promptly, for then the Lord will have gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines."
verses.textEn: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the poplar trees, move quickly, because that will mean the Lord has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫照着耶和华所吩咐他的去作，击杀非利士人，从迦巴直到基色。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫照着耶和华所吩咐他的去作，击杀非利士人，从迦巴直到基色。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就遵着耶和华所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，从迦巴直到基色。
verses.textEnNiv: So David did as the Lord commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
verses.textEnEsv: And David did as the Lord commanded him, and struck down the Philistines from Geba to Gezer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David did so, as the Lord commanded him; and he drove back the Philistines from Geba as far as Gezer.
verses.textEnNlt: So David did what the Lord commanded, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David did so, just as the Lord had commanded him; he struck and killed the Philistines from Geba as far as Gezer.
verses.textEn: So David did as the Lord commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

verses.textZh: 大卫又聚集以色列中所有拣选出来的三万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又聚集以色列中所有拣选出来的三万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又聚集以色列中所有挑选的人三万。
verses.textEnNiv: David again brought together all the able young men of Israel—thirty thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: David again gathered all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again David gathered all the choice men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David again gathered all the elite troops in Israel, 30,000 in all.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David again gathered all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.textEn: David again brought together all the able young men of Israel—thirty thousand.

verses.textZh: 大卫和与他在一起的众人起程前去，要从巴拉．犹大把神的约柜运来，这约柜的名称是以坐在二基路伯之上万军之耶和华的名字而起的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和与他在一起的众人起程前去，要从巴拉．犹大把神的约柜运来，这约柜的名称是以坐在二基路伯之上万军之耶和华的名字而起的。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫起身，率领跟随他的众人前往，要从巴拉‧犹大将神的约柜运来；这约柜就是坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华留名的约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: He and all his men went to Baalah in Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name, the name of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim on the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: And David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale-judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the name of the Lord of hosts who sits enthroned on the cherubim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, whose name is called by the Name, the Lord of Hosts, who dwells between the cherubim.
verses.textEnNlt: He led them to Baalah of Judah to bring back the Ark of God, which bears the name of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, who is enthroned between the cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: And David departed from Baale-judah, with all the people who were with him, to bring up from there the ark of God which is called by the Name, the very name of the Lord of armies who is enthroned above the cherubim.
verses.textEn: He and all his men went to Baalah in Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name, the name of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim on the ark.

verses.textZh: 他们把神的约柜从山冈上亚比拿达的家里抬出来，安放在一辆新车上；亚比拿达的两个儿子，乌撒和亚希约赶着这辆新车，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把神的约柜从山冈上亚比拿达的家里抬出来，安放在一辆新车上；亚比拿达的两个儿子，乌撒和亚希约赶着这辆新车，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将神的约柜从冈上亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上；亚比拿达的两个儿子乌撒和亚希约赶这新车。
verses.textEnNiv: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart
verses.textEnEsv: And they carried the ark of God on a new cart and brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. And Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were driving the new cart,
verses.textEnNkjv: So they set the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
verses.textEnNlt: They placed the Ark of God on a new cart and brought it from Abinadab’s house, which was on a hill. Uzzah and Ahio, Abinadab’s sons, were guiding the cart
verses.textEnNasb: They had mounted the ark of God on a new cart and moved it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were leading the new cart.
verses.textEn: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart

verses.textZh: 车上有神的约柜 。亚希约走在约柜的前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 车上有神的约柜 。亚希约走在约柜的前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将神的约柜从冈上亚比拿达家里抬出来的时候，亚希约在柜前行走。
verses.textEnNiv: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.
verses.textEnEsv: with the ark of God, and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill, accompanying the ark of God; and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.textEnNlt: that carried the Ark of God. Ahio walked in front of the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: So they brought it with the ark of God from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill; and Ahio was walking ahead of the ark.
verses.textEn: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.

verses.textZh: 大卫和以色列全家在耶和华面前用各种松木制造的乐器，就是用琴、瑟、鼓、钹、锣，作乐跳舞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫和以色列全家在耶和华面前用各种松木制造的乐器，就是用琴、瑟、鼓、钹、锣，作乐跳舞。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫和以色列的全家在耶和华面前，用松木制造的各样乐器和琴、瑟、鼓、钹、锣，作乐跳舞。
verses.textEnNiv: David and all Israel were celebrating with all their might before the Lord , with castanets, harps, lyres, timbrels, sistrums and cymbals.
verses.textEnEsv: And David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the Lord , with songs and lyres and harps and tambourines and castanets and cymbals.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David and all the house of Israel played music before the Lord on all kinds of instrumentsof fir wood, on harps, on stringed instruments, on tambourines, on sistrums, and on cymbals.
verses.textEnNlt: David and all the people of Israel were celebrating before the Lord , singing songs and playing all kinds of musical instruments—lyres, harps, tambourines, castanets, and cymbals.
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile, David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the Lord with all kinds of instruments made of juniper wood, and with lyres, harps, tambourines, castanets, and cymbals.
verses.textEn: David and all Israel were celebrating with all their might before the Lord , with castanets, harps, lyres, timbrels, sistrums and cymbals.

verses.textZh: 他们到了拿艮的打禾场的时候，因为牛几乎绊倒，乌撒就伸手扶住神的约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了拿艮的打禾场的时候，因为牛几乎绊倒，乌撒就伸手扶住神的约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了拿艮的禾场，因为牛失前蹄 ，乌撒就伸手扶住神的约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to the threshing floor of Nakon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen stumbled.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah put out his hand to the ark of God and took hold of it, for the oxen stumbled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they came to Nachon’s threshing floor, Uzzah put out his hand to the ark of God and took hold of it, for the oxen stumbled.
