verses.textEnNlt: But when they arrived at the threshing floor of Nacon, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out his hand and steadied the Ark of God.
verses.textEnNasb: But when they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached out toward the ark of God and took hold of it, because the oxen nearly overturned it.
verses.textEn: When they came to the threshing floor of Nakon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen stumbled.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的怒气向乌撒发作；神因这错误的举动，就当场击杀他，他就死在神的约柜旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的怒气向乌撒发作；神因这错误的举动，就当场击杀他，他就死在神的约柜旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 神耶和华向乌撒发怒，因这错误击杀他，他就死在神的约柜旁。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s anger burned against Uzzah because of his irreverent act; therefore God struck him down, and he died there beside the ark of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzzah, and God struck him down there because of his error, and he died there beside the ark of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was aroused against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by the ark of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord ’s anger was aroused against Uzzah, and God struck him dead because of this. So Uzzah died right there beside the Ark of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And the anger of the Lord burned against Uzzah, and God struck him down there for his irreverence; and he died there by the ark of God.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s anger burned against Uzzah because of his irreverent act; therefore God struck him down, and he died there beside the ark of God.

verses.textZh: 大卫因为耶和华击杀了乌撒，就很生气，因此称那地方为毘列斯．乌撒，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫因为耶和华击杀了乌撒，就很生气，因此称那地方为毘列斯．乌撒，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫因耶和华击杀 乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯‧乌撒，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.
verses.textEnEsv: And David was angry because the Lord had broken out against Uzzah. And that place is called Perez-uzzah to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David became angry because of the Lord’s outbreak against Uzzah; and he called the name of the place Perez Uzzah to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: David was angry because the Lord ’s anger had burst out against Uzzah. He named that place Perez-uzzah (which means "to burst out against Uzzah"), as it is still called today.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David became angry because of the Lord’s outburst against Uzzah; and that place has been called Perez-uzzah to this day.
verses.textEn: Then David was angry because the Lord ’s wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.

verses.textZh: 那一天，大卫惧怕耶和华，说："耶和华的约柜怎可以到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，大卫惧怕耶和华，说："耶和华的约柜怎可以到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，大卫惧怕耶和华，说：「耶和华的约柜怎可运到我这里来？」
verses.textEnNiv: David was afraid of the Lord that day and said, "How can the ark of the Lord ever come to me?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David was afraid of the Lord that day, and he said, "How can the ark of the Lord come to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: David was afraid of the Lord that day; and he said, "How can the ark of the Lord come to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: David was now afraid of the Lord , and he asked, "How can I ever bring the Ark of the Lord back into my care?"
verses.textEnNasb: So David was afraid of the Lord that day; and he said, "How can the ark of the Lord come to me?"
verses.textEn: David was afraid of the Lord that day and said, "How can the ark of the Lord ever come to me?"

verses.textZh: 于是大卫不肯把耶和华的约柜运进大卫的城到他那里去，却转运到迦特人俄别．以东的家里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫不肯把耶和华的约柜运进大卫的城到他那里去，却转运到迦特人俄别．以东的家里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫不肯将耶和华的约柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别‧以东的家中。
verses.textEnNiv: He was not willing to take the ark of the Lord to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
verses.textEnEsv: So David was not willing to take the ark of the Lord into the city of David. But David took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David would not move the ark of the Lord with him into the City of David; but David took it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
verses.textEnNlt: So David decided not to move the Ark of the Lord into the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-edom of Gath.
verses.textEnNasb: And David was unwilling to move the ark of the Lord into the city of David with him; but David took it aside to the house of Obed-edom, the Gittite.
verses.textEn: He was not willing to take the ark of the Lord to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的约柜在迦特人俄别．以东的家停留了三个月，耶和华赐福给俄别．以东和他的全家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的约柜在迦特人俄别．以东的家停留了三个月，耶和华赐福给俄别．以东和他的全家。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的约柜在迦特人俄别‧以东家中三个月；耶和华赐福给俄别‧以东和他的全家。
verses.textEnNiv: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite for three months, and the Lord blessed him and his entire household.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-edom and all his household.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite three months. And the Lord blessed Obed-Edom and all his household.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ark of the Lord remained there in Obed-edom’s house for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-edom and his entire household.
verses.textEnNasb: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-edom and all his household.
verses.textEn: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite for three months, and the Lord blessed him and his entire household.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉大卫王："耶和华因为神的约柜的缘故，赐福给俄别．以东的家和一切属他的。"大卫就去，欢欢喜喜把神的约柜从俄别．以东的家中抬上大卫的城里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉大卫王："耶和华因为神的约柜的缘故，赐福给俄别．以东的家和一切属他的。"大卫就去，欢欢喜喜把神的约柜从俄别．以东的家中抬上大卫的城里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉大卫王说：「耶和华因为约柜赐福给俄别‧以东的家和一切属他的。」大卫就去，欢欢喜喜地将神的约柜从俄别‧以东家中抬到大卫的城里。
verses.textEnNiv: Now King David was told, "The Lord has blessed the household of Obed-Edom and everything he has, because of the ark of God." So David went to bring up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with rejoicing.
verses.textEnEsv: And it was told King David, "The Lord has blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God." So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom to the city of David with rejoicing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was told King David, saying, "The Lord has blessed the house of Obed-Edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God." So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with gladness.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King David was told, "The Lord has blessed Obed-edom’s household and everything he has because of the Ark of God." So David went there and brought the Ark of God from the house of Obed-edom to the City of David with a great celebration.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was reported to King David, saying, "The Lord has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, on account of the ark of God." So David went and brought the ark of God up from the house of Obed-edom to the city of David with joy.
verses.textEn: Now King David was told, "The Lord has blessed the household of Obed-Edom and everything he has, because of the ark of God." So David went to bring up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with rejoicing.

verses.textZh: 那些抬耶和华的约柜的人走了六步，大卫就献一头公牛和一只肥畜为祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些抬耶和华的约柜的人走了六步，大卫就献一头公牛和一只肥畜为祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 抬耶和华约柜的人走了六步，大卫就献牛与肥羊为祭。
verses.textEnNiv: When those who were carrying the ark of the Lord had taken six steps, he sacrificed a bull and a fattened calf.
verses.textEnEsv: And when those who bore the ark of the Lord had gone six steps, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened animal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when those bearing the ark of the Lord had gone six paces, that he sacrificed oxen and fatted sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: After the men who were carrying the Ark of the Lord had gone six steps, David sacrificed a bull and a fattened calf.
verses.textEnNasb: And so it was, that when those carrying the ark of the Lord marched six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened steer.
verses.textEn: When those who were carrying the ark of the Lord had taken six steps, he sacrificed a bull and a fattened calf.

verses.textZh: 大卫束着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前极力跳舞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫束着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前极力跳舞。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫穿着细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前极力跳舞。
verses.textEnNiv: Wearing a linen ephod, David was dancing before the Lord with all his might,
verses.textEnEsv: And David danced before the Lord with all his might. And David was wearing a linen ephod.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David danced before the Lord with all his might; and David was wearing a linen ephod.
verses.textEnNlt: And David danced before the Lord with all his might, wearing a priestly garment.
verses.textEnNasb: And David was dancing before the Lord with all his strength, and David was wearing a linen ephod.
verses.textEn: Wearing a linen ephod, David was dancing before the Lord with all his might,

verses.textZh: 这样，大卫和以色列全家，以欢呼和角声，把耶和华的约柜抬了上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，大卫和以色列全家，以欢呼和角声，把耶和华的约柜抬了上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，大卫和以色列的全家欢呼吹角，将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
verses.textEnNiv: while he and all Israel were bringing up the ark of the Lord with shouts and the sound of trumpets.
verses.textEnEsv: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting and with the sound of the horn.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and all the people of Israel brought up the Ark of the Lord with shouts of joy and the blowing of rams’ horns.
verses.textEnNasb: So David and all the house of Israel were bringing up the ark of the Lord with joyful shouting and the sound of the trumpet.
verses.textEn: while he and all Israel were bringing up the ark of the Lord with shouts and the sound of trumpets.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的约柜运进大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户往外观看，看见大卫王在耶和华面前跳跃舞蹈，心里就鄙视他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的约柜运进大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户往外观看，看见大卫王在耶和华面前跳跃舞蹈，心里就鄙视他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王在耶和华面前踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。
verses.textEnNiv: As the ark of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord , she despised him in her heart.
verses.textEnEsv: As the ark of the Lord came into the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out of the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord , and she despised him in her heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as the ark of the Lord came into the City of David, Michal, Saul’s daughter, looked through a window and saw King David leaping and whirling before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.textEnNlt: But as the Ark of the Lord entered the City of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looked down from her window. When she saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord , she was filled with contempt for him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened, as the ark of the Lord was coming into the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked down through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord; and she was contemptuous of him in her heart.
verses.textEn: As the ark of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord , she despised him in her heart.

verses.textZh: 他们把耶和华的约柜抬进去，安放在帐棚里它自己的地方，就是安放在大卫给它支搭的帐棚里，大卫就在耶和华面前献上燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把耶和华的约柜抬进去，安放在帐棚里它自己的地方，就是安放在大卫给它支搭的帐棚里，大卫就在耶和华面前献上燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人将耶和华的约柜请进去，安放在所预备的地方，就是在大卫所搭的帐幕里。大卫在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: They brought the ark of the Lord and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought in the ark of the Lord and set it in its place, inside the tent that David had pitched for it. And David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So they brought the ark of the Lord, and set it in its place in the midst of the tabernacle that David had erected for it. Then David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They brought the Ark of the Lord and set it in its place inside the special tent David had prepared for it. And David sacrificed burnt offerings and peace offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now they brought in the ark of the Lord and set it in its place inside the tent which David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.
verses.textEn: They brought the ark of the Lord and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉万军之耶和华的名给人民祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉万军之耶和华的名给人民祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉万军之耶和华的名给民祝福，
verses.textEnNiv: After he had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts
verses.textEnNkjv: And when David had finished offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: When he had finished his sacrifices, David blessed the people in the name of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: After he had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 又分给众人，就是分给以色列全体群众，无论男女，每人一个饼、一个枣饼、一个葡萄干饼；然后众人就各归各家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又分给众人，就是分给以色列全体群众，无论男女，每人一个饼、一个枣饼、一个葡萄干饼；然后众人就各归各家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且分给以色列众人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块肉，一个葡萄饼；众人就各回各家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each person in the whole crowd of Israelites, both men and women. And all the people went to their homes.
verses.textEnEsv: and distributed among all the people, the whole multitude of Israel, both men and women, a cake of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins to each one. Then all the people departed, each to his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he distributed among all the people, among the whole multitude of Israel, both the women and the men, to everyone a loaf of bread, a piece ofmeat, and a cake of raisins. So all the people departed, everyone to his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he gave to every Israelite man and woman in the crowd a loaf of bread, a cake of dates, and a cake of raisins. Then all the people returned to their homes.
verses.textEnNasb: Further, he distributed to all the people, to all the multitude of Israel, both to men and women, a cake of bread, one of dates, and one of raisins to each one. Then all the people left, each to his house.
verses.textEn: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each person in the whole crowd of Israelites, both men and women. And all the people went to their homes.

verses.textZh: 大卫回去要给自己的家人祝福。扫罗的女儿米甲出来迎见大卫，说："以色列王今天多么荣耀啊！他今天竟在众臣仆的婢女眼前，赤身露体，就像一个卑贱的人无耻地露体一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫回去要给自己的家人祝福。扫罗的女儿米甲出来迎见大卫，说："以色列王今天多么荣耀啊！他今天竟在众臣仆的婢女眼前，赤身露体，就像一个卑贱的人无耻地露体一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫回家要给眷属祝福；扫罗的女儿米甲出来迎接他，说：「以色列王今日在臣仆的婢女眼前露体，如同一个轻贱人无耻露体一样，有好大的荣耀啊！」
verses.textEnNiv: When David returned home to bless his household, Michal daughter of Saul came out to meet him and said, "How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today, going around half-naked in full view of the slave girls of his servants as any vulgar fellow would!"
verses.textEnEsv: And David returned to bless his household. But Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David and said, "How the king of Israel honored himself today, uncovering himself today before the eyes of his servants’ female servants, as one of the vulgar fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, "How glorious was the king of Israel today, uncovering himself today in the eyes of the maids of his servants, as one of the base fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!"
verses.textEnNlt: When David returned home to bless his own family, Michal, the daughter of Saul, came out to meet him. She said in disgust, "How distinguished the king of Israel looked today, shamelessly exposing himself to the servant girls like any vulgar person might do!"
verses.textEnNasb: But when David returned to bless his own household, Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David and said, "How the king of Israel dignified himself today! For he exposed himself today in the sight of his servants’ female slaves, as one of the rabble shamelessly exposes himself!"
verses.textEn: When David returned home to bless his household, Michal daughter of Saul came out to meet him and said, "How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today, going around half-naked in full view of the slave girls of his servants as any vulgar fellow would!"

verses.textZh: 大卫对米甲说："我是在耶和华面前跳舞 ；耶和华拣选了我，使我高过你父亲和他的全家，立我作耶和华的子民以色列的领袖，所以我要在耶和华面前跳舞作乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对米甲说："我是在耶和华面前跳舞 ；耶和华拣选了我，使我高过你父亲和他的全家，立我作耶和华的子民以色列的领袖，所以我要在耶和华面前跳舞作乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对米甲说：「这是在耶和华面前；耶和华已拣选我，废了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和华民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和华面前跳舞。
verses.textEnNiv: David said to Michal, "It was before the Lord , who chose me rather than your father or anyone from his house when he appointed me ruler over the Lord ’s people Israel—I will celebrate before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Michal, "It was before the Lord , who chose me above your father and above all his house, to appoint me as prince over Israel, the people of the Lord —and I will celebrate before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Michal, "Itwas before the Lord, who chose me instead of your father and all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the Lord, over Israel. Therefore I will play music before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: David retorted to Michal, "I was dancing before the Lord , who chose me above your father and all his family! He appointed me as the leader of Israel, the people of the Lord , so I celebrate before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But David said to Michal, "I was before the Lord, who preferred me to your father and to all his house, to appoint me as ruler over the people of the Lord, over Israel. So I will celebrate before the Lord!
verses.textEn: David said to Michal, "It was before the Lord , who chose me rather than your father or anyone from his house when he appointed me ruler over the Lord ’s people Israel—I will celebrate before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我还要比今天这样更卑贱，我要自视卑微 。至于你所说的那些婢女，她们倒要尊重我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还要比今天这样更卑贱，我要自视卑微 。至于你所说的那些婢女，她们倒要尊重我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必更加卑微，自己看为轻贱。你所说的那些婢女，她们倒要尊敬我。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes. But by these slave girls you spoke of, I will be held in honor."
verses.textEnEsv: I will make myself yet more contemptible than this, and I will be abased in your eyes. But by the female servants of whom you have spoken, by them I shall be held in honor."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will be even more undignified than this, and will be humble in my own sight. But as for the maidservants of whom you have spoken, by them I will be held in honor."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, and I am willing to look even more foolish than this, even to be humiliated in my own eyes! But those servant girls you mentioned will indeed think I am distinguished!"
verses.textEnNasb: And I might demean myself even more than this and be lowly in my own sight, but with the female slaves of whom you have spoken, with them I am to be held in honor!"
verses.textEn: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes. But by these slave girls you spoke of, I will be held in honor."

verses.textZh: 扫罗的女儿米甲，一直到她死的日子，都没有生育。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的女儿米甲，一直到她死的日子，都没有生育。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的女儿米甲，直到死日，没有生养儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
verses.textEnEsv: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
verses.textEnNlt: So Michal, the daughter of Saul, remained childless throughout her entire life.
verses.textEnNasb: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
verses.textEn: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.

verses.textZh: 那时，王住在自己的宫中，耶和华使他安享太平，不受周围仇敌的侵扰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，王住在自己的宫中，耶和华使他安享太平，不受周围仇敌的侵扰。
verses.textZhCuv: 王住在自己宫中，耶和华使他安靖，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。
verses.textEnNiv: After the king was settled in his palace and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies around him,
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the king lived in his house and the Lord had given him rest from all his surrounding enemies,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass when the king was dwelling in his house, and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies all around,
verses.textEnNlt: When King David was settled in his palace and the Lord had given him rest from all the surrounding enemies,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when the king lived in his house, and the Lord had given him rest on every side from all his enemies,
verses.textEn: After the king was settled in his palace and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies around him,

verses.textZh: 王对拿单先知说："你看！我自己住在香柏木的宫里，耶和华的约柜却停在帐幕内。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对拿单先知说："你看！我自己住在香柏木的宫里，耶和华的约柜却停在帐幕内。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，王对先知拿单说：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，神的约柜反在幔子里。」
verses.textEnNiv: he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent."
verses.textEnEsv: the king said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwells in a tent."
verses.textEnNkjv: that the king said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of God dwells inside tent curtains."
verses.textEnNlt: the king summoned Nathan the prophet. "Look," David said, "I am living in a beautiful cedar palace, but the Ark of God is out there in a tent!"
verses.textEnNasb: that the king said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I live in a house of cedar, but the ark of God remains within the tent."
verses.textEn: he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent."

verses.textZh: 拿单对王说："你可以照着你心所想的一切去作，因为耶和华与你同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿单对王说："你可以照着你心所想的一切去作，因为耶和华与你同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单对王说：「你可以照你的心意而行，因为耶和华与你同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: Nathan replied to the king, "Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the Lord is with you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Nathan said to the king, "Go, do all that is in your heart, for the Lord is with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nathan said to the king, "Go, do all that is in your heart, for the Lordis with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Nathan replied to the king, "Go ahead and do whatever you have in mind, for the Lord is with you."
verses.textEnNasb: Nathan said to the king, "Go, do all that is in your mind, for the Lord is with you."
verses.textEn: Nathan replied to the king, "Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the Lord is with you."

verses.textZh: 那天晚上，耶和华的话临到拿单说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天晚上，耶和华的话临到拿单说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，耶和华的话临到拿单说：
verses.textEnNiv: But that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying:
verses.textEnEsv: But that same night the word of the Lord came to Nathan,
verses.textEnNkjv: But it happened that night that the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: But that same night the Lord said to Nathan,
verses.textEnNasb: But in the same night, the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,
verses.textEn: But that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying:

verses.textZh: "你去对我的仆人大卫说：耶和华这样说：‘你要建造一座殿宇给我居住吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去对我的仆人大卫说：耶和华这样说：‘你要建造一座殿宇给我居住吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：『你岂可建造殿宇给我居住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: Are you the one to build me a house to dwell in?
verses.textEnEsv: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord : Would you build me a house to dwell in?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and tell My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Would you build a house for Me to dwell in?
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord has declared: Are you the one to build a house for me to live in?
verses.textEnNasb: "Go and say to My servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Should you build Me a house for My dwelling?
verses.textEn: "Go and tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord says: Are you the one to build me a house to dwell in?

verses.textZh: 因为自从我把以色列人从埃及带上来的那天起，直到今日，我都没有住过殿宇。我一直都住在帐棚和会幕里，到处漂泊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为自从我把以色列人从埃及带上来的那天起，直到今日，我都没有住过殿宇。我一直都住在帐棚和会幕里，到处漂泊。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我领以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，常在会幕和帐幕中行走。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt to this day. I have been moving from place to place with a tent as my dwelling.
verses.textEnEsv: I have not lived in a house since the day I brought up the people of Israel from Egypt to this day, but I have been moving about in a tent for my dwelling.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have not dwelt in a house since the time that I brought the children of Israel up from Egypt, even to this day, but have moved about in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: I have never lived in a house, from the day I brought the Israelites out of Egypt until this very day. I have always moved from one place to another with a tent and a Tabernacle as my dwelling.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have not dwelt in a house since the day I brought up the sons of Israel from Egypt, even to this day; rather, I have been moving about in a tent, that is, in a dwelling place.
verses.textEn: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt to this day. I have been moving from place to place with a tent as my dwelling.

verses.textZh: 我与以色列众人一起走过的地方，我可曾对以色列的一个支派的官长，就是我所吩咐要牧养我子民以色列的，说：你们为甚么不给我建造一座香柏木的殿宇呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我与以色列众人一起走过的地方，我可曾对以色列的一个支派的官长，就是我所吩咐要牧养我子民以色列的，说：你们为甚么不给我建造一座香柏木的殿宇呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派的士师，就是我吩咐牧养我民以色列的说：你们为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their rulers whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" ’
verses.textEnEsv: In all places where I have moved with all the people of Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, saying, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?"’
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever I have moved about with all the children of Israel, have I ever spoken a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?’ " ’
verses.textEnNlt: Yet no matter where I have gone with the Israelites, I have never once complained to Israel’s tribal leaders, the shepherds of my people Israel. I have never asked them, "Why haven’t you built me a beautiful cedar house?"’
verses.textEnNasb: Wherever I have gone with all the sons of Israel, did I speak a word with one of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?’ " ’
verses.textEn: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their rulers whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" ’

verses.textZh: 现在你要对我的仆人大卫这样说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我把你从牧场中、从照顾羊群的工作中拣选出来，使你作我子民以色列的领袖，
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要对我的仆人大卫这样说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我把你从牧场中、从照顾羊群的工作中拣选出来，使你作我子民以色列的领袖，
verses.textZhCuv: 「现在，你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：『我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now, therefore, thus you shall say to my servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, that you should be prince over my people Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "I took you from the sheepfold, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people, over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now go and say to my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has declared: I took you from tending sheep in the pasture and selected you to be the leader of my people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, this is what you shall say to My servant David: ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "I Myself took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be leader over My people Israel.
verses.textEn: "Now then, tell my servant David, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture, from tending the flock, and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.

verses.textZh: 你无论到哪里去，我都与你同在；我必在你面前剪除你所有的仇敌。我要使你得享大名，像世上那些伟人的名一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你无论到哪里去，我都与你同在；我必在你面前剪除你所有的仇敌。我要使你得享大名，像世上那些伟人的名一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name great, like the names of the greatest men on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And I have been with you wherever you went and have cut off all your enemies from before you. And I will make for you a great name, like the name of the great ones of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a great name, like the name of the great men who are on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have destroyed all your enemies before your eyes. Now I will make your name as famous as anyone who has ever lived on the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have eliminated all your enemies from you; I will also make a great name for you, like the names of the great men who are on the earth.
verses.textEn: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name great, like the names of the greatest men on earth.

verses.textZh: 我要为我的子民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再受骚扰；恶人也不能再像以前那样苦待他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要为我的子民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再受骚扰；恶人也不能再像以前那样苦待他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，
verses.textEnNiv: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning
verses.textEnEsv: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel and will plant them, so that they may dwell in their own place and be disturbed no more. And violent men shall afflict them no more, as formerly,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own and move no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness oppress them anymore, as previously,
verses.textEnNlt: And I will provide a homeland for my people Israel, planting them in a secure place where they will never be disturbed. Evil nations won’t oppress them as they’ve done in the past,
verses.textEnNasb: And I will establish a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, so that they may live in their own place and not be disturbed again, nor will malicious people oppress them anymore as previously,
verses.textEn: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning

verses.textZh: 像我立了士师治理我的子民以色列的那天以来那样。我要使你安享太平，不受你所有的仇敌侵扰。耶和华向你宣告，耶和华要亲自为你建立一个朝代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 像我立了士师治理我的子民以色列的那天以来那样。我要使你安享太平，不受你所有的仇敌侵扰。耶和华向你宣告，耶和华要亲自为你建立一个朝代。
verses.textZhCuv: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敌扰乱，并且我－耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。
verses.textEnNiv: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also give you rest from all your enemies. " ‘The Lord declares to you that the Lord himself will establish a house for you:
verses.textEnEsv: from the time that I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I will give you rest from all your enemies. Moreover, the Lord declares to you that the Lord will make you a house.
verses.textEnNkjv: since the time that I commanded judges tobe over My people Israel, and have caused you to rest from all your enemies. Also the Lord tells you that He will make you a house.
verses.textEnNlt: starting from the time I appointed judges to rule my people Israel. And I will give you rest from all your enemies. "‘Furthermore, the Lord declares that he will make a house for you—a dynasty of kings!
verses.textEnNasb: even from the day that I appointed judges over My people Israel; and I will give you rest from all your enemies. The Lord also declares to you that the Lord will make a house for you.
verses.textEn: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also give you rest from all your enemies. " ‘The Lord declares to you that the Lord himself will establish a house for you:

verses.textZh: 到了你的寿数满足，你与你的列祖一起长眠的时候，我必兴起你亲生的后裔接替你，并且我要坚固他的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了你的寿数满足，你与你的列祖一起长眠的时候，我必兴起你亲生的后裔接替你，并且我要坚固他的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 你寿数满足、与你列祖同睡的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位；我也必坚定他的国。
verses.textEnNiv: When your days are over and you rest with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, your own flesh and blood, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: When your days are fulfilled and you lie down with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring after you, who shall come from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will set up your seed after you, who will come from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: For when you die and are buried with your ancestors, I will raise up one of your descendants, your own offspring, and I will make his kingdom strong.
verses.textEnNasb: When your days are finished and you lie down with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from you, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.textEn: When your days are over and you rest with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, your own flesh and blood, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.textZh: 他必为我的名建造一座殿宇，我要永远坚固他的国位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必为我的名建造一座殿宇，我要永远坚固他的国位。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必为我的名建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
verses.textEnNlt: He is the one who will build a house—a temple—for my name. And I will secure his royal throne forever.
verses.textEnNasb: He shall build a house for My name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
verses.textEn: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

verses.textZh: 我要作他的父亲，他要作我的儿子，他若是犯了罪，我要用人的刑杖、用世人的鞭子纠正他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要作他的父亲，他要作我的儿子，他若是犯了罪，我要用人的刑杖、用世人的鞭子纠正他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖责打他，用人的鞭责罚他。
verses.textEnNiv: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with a rod wielded by men, with floggings inflicted by human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son. When he commits iniquity, I will discipline him with the rod of men, with the stripes of the sons of men,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will be his Father, and he shall be My son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he sins, I will correct and discipline him with the rod, like any father would do.
verses.textEnNasb: I will be a father to him and he will be a son to Me; when he does wrong, I will discipline him with a rod of men and with strokes of sons of mankind,
verses.textEn: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with a rod wielded by men, with floggings inflicted by human hands.

verses.textZh: 但我的慈爱必不离开他，像离开在你面前的扫罗一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我的慈爱必不离开他，像离开在你面前的扫罗一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我的慈爱仍不离开他，像离开在你面前所废弃的扫罗一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But my love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
verses.textEnEsv: but my steadfast love will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away from before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But My mercy shall not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
verses.textEnNlt: But my favor will not be taken from him as I took it from Saul, whom I removed from your sight.
verses.textEnNasb: but My favor shall not depart from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from you.
verses.textEn: But my love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.

verses.textZh: 你的家和你的王国，也必在我 的面前永远坚定，你的王位也必永远坚立。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的家和你的王国，也必在我 的面前永远坚定，你的王位也必永远坚立。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的家和你的国必在我 面前永远坚立。你的国位也必坚定，直到永远。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me ; your throne will be established forever.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me. Your throne shall be established forever.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And your house and your kingdom shall be established forever before you. Your throne shall be established forever." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Your house and your kingdom will continue before me for all time, and your throne will be secure forever.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Your house and your kingdom shall endure before Me forever; your throne shall be established forever." ’ "
verses.textEn: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me ; your throne will be established forever.’ "

verses.textZh: 拿单按着这一切话，又照着全部的默示，都对大卫说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿单按着这一切话，又照着全部的默示，都对大卫说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示，告诉大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
verses.textEnEsv: In accordance with all these words, and in accordance with all this vision, Nathan spoke to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.textEnNlt: So Nathan went back to David and told him everything the Lord had said in this vision.
verses.textEnNasb: In accordance with all these words and all of this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.textEn: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.

verses.textZh: 于是，大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说："主耶和华啊！我是谁，我的家又算甚么，你竟带领我到这地步？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说："主耶和华啊！我是谁，我的家又算甚么，你竟带领我到这地步？
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：「主耶和华啊，我是谁？我的家算什么？你竟使我到这地步呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, Sovereign Lord , and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
verses.textEnEsv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord and said, "Who am I, O Lord God , and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord; and he said: "Who am I, O Lord God? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
verses.textEnNlt: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord and prayed, "Who am I, O Sovereign Lord , and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?
verses.textEnNasb: Then David the king came in and sat before the Lord, and he said, "Who am I, Lord God, and who are the members of my household, that You have brought me this far?
verses.textEn: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, Sovereign Lord , and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

verses.textZh: 主耶和华啊，这在你眼中还看为小事，你也说到你仆人的家未来的事。主耶和华啊，这岂是人常遇到的事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华啊，这在你眼中还看为小事，你也说到你仆人的家未来的事。主耶和华啊，这岂是人常遇到的事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。主耶和华啊，这岂是人所常遇的事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: And as if this were not enough in your sight, Sovereign Lord , you have also spoken about the future of the house of your servant—and this decree, Sovereign Lord , is for a mere human!
verses.textEnEsv: And yet this was a small thing in your eyes, O Lord God . You have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and this is instruction for mankind, O Lord God !
verses.textEnNkjv: And yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O Lord God; and You have also spoken of Your servant’s house for a great while to come. Is this the manner of man, O Lord God?
verses.textEnNlt: And now, Sovereign Lord , in addition to everything else, you speak of giving your servant a lasting dynasty! Do you deal with everyone this way, O Sovereign Lord ?
verses.textEnNasb: And yet this was insignificant in Your eyes, Lord God, for You have spoken also of the house of Your servant regarding the distant future. And this is the custom of mankind, Lord God.
verses.textEn: And as if this were not enough in your sight, Sovereign Lord , you have also spoken about the future of the house of your servant—and this decree, Sovereign Lord , is for a mere human!

verses.textZh: 主耶和华啊，你认识你的仆人，大卫还有甚么话可以对你说呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华啊，你认识你的仆人，大卫还有甚么话可以对你说呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华啊，我还有何言可以对你说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: "What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And what more can David say to you? For you know your servant, O Lord God !
verses.textEnNkjv: Now what more can David say to You? For You, Lord God, know Your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: "What more can I say to you? You know what your servant is really like, Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Again what more can David say to You? For You know Your servant, Lord God!
verses.textEn: "What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 你因自己应许的缘故，又按照自己的心意，行了这大事，为要使你仆人明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因自己应许的缘故，又按照自己的心意，行了这大事，为要使你仆人明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行这大事使仆人知道，是因你所应许的话，也是照你的心意。
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of your word and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made it known to your servant.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of your promise, and according to your own heart, you have brought about all this greatness, to make your servant know it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your word’s sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all these great things, to make Your servant know them.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of your promise and according to your will, you have done all these great things and have made them known to your servant.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sake of Your word, and according to Your heart, You have done all this greatness, to let Your servant know.
verses.textEn: For the sake of your word and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made it known to your servant.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华啊，因此，你是伟大的！按照我们耳朵所听见的，没有像你的，除了你以外，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华啊，因此，你是伟大的！按照我们耳朵所听见的，没有像你的，除了你以外，再没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华啊，你本为大，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的；除你以外再无神。
verses.textEnNiv: "How great you are, Sovereign Lord ! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you are great, O Lord God . For there is none like you, and there is no God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore You are great, O Lord God. For thereis none like You, nor isthereany God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.textEnNlt: "How great you are, O Sovereign Lord ! There is no one like you. We have never even heard of another God like you!
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason You are great, Lord God; for there is no one like You, and there is no God except You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.textEn: "How great you are, Sovereign Lord ! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

verses.textZh: 世上有哪一个国家像你的子民以色列呢？神曾亲自救赎他们，使他们作自己的子民，又为他自己立名，为他们 作了大事，为你的地作了可畏的事；在你的子民面前，就是你从埃及救赎出来归你自己的子民面前，赶出了列国的人和他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上有哪一个国家像你的子民以色列呢？神曾亲自救赎他们，使他们作自己的子民，又为他自己立名，为他们 作了大事，为你的地作了可畏的事；在你的子民面前，就是你从埃及救赎出来归你自己的子民面前，赶出了列国的人和他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，驱逐列邦人和他们的神，显出你的大名。
verses.textEnNiv: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth that God went out to redeem as a people for himself, and to make a name for himself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?
verses.textEnEsv: And who is like your people Israel, the one nation on earth whom God went to redeem to be his people, making himself a name and doing for them great and awesome things by driving out before your people, whom you redeemed for yourself from Egypt, a nation and its gods?
verses.textEnNkjv: And who is like Your people, like Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people, to make for Himself a name—and to do for Yourself great and awesome deeds for Your land—before Your people whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt, the nations, and their gods?
verses.textEnNlt: What other nation on earth is like your people Israel? What other nation, O God, have you redeemed from slavery to be your own people? You made a great name for yourself when you redeemed your people from Egypt. You performed awesome miracles and drove out the nations and gods that stood in their way.
verses.textEnNasb: And what one nation on the earth is like Your people Israel, whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people, and to make a name for Himself, and to do a great thing for You and awesome things for Your land, because of Your people whom You have redeemed for Yourself from Egypt, from other nations and their gods?
verses.textEn: And who is like your people Israel—the one nation on earth that God went out to redeem as a people for himself, and to make a name for himself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

verses.textZh: 你为自己坚立了你的子民以色列，使他们永远作你的子民；耶和华啊，你也作了他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为自己坚立了你的子民以色列，使他们永远作你的子民；耶和华啊，你也作了他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾坚立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永远；你－耶和华也作了他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You have established your people Israel as your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.
verses.textEnEsv: And you established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever. And you, O Lord , became their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own people forever; and You, Lord, have become their God.
verses.textEnNlt: You made Israel your very own people forever, and you, O Lord , became their God.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have established for Yourself Your people Israel as Your own people forever, and You, Lord, have become their God.
verses.textEn: You have established your people Israel as your very own forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神啊！你所应许关于你仆人和他的家的话，现在求你永远坚守，并且照着你所说的去行吧；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神啊！你所应许关于你仆人和他的家的话，现在求你永远坚守，并且照着你所说的去行吧；
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华神啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远；照你所说的而行。
verses.textEnNiv: "And now, Lord God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house. Do as you promised,
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O Lord God, confirm forever the word that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house, and do as you have spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now, O Lord God, the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house, establish it forever and do as You have said.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, O Lord God, I am your servant; do as you have promised concerning me and my family. Confirm it as a promise that will last forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, Lord God, the word that You have spoken about Your servant and his house, confirm it forever, and do just as You have spoken,
verses.textEn: "And now, Lord God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house. Do as you promised,

verses.textZh: 这样，你的名必永远为大，以致人要说：‘万军之耶和华是以色列的神。’你仆人大卫的家也必在你面前得坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你的名必永远为大，以致人要说：‘万军之耶和华是以色列的神。’你仆人大卫的家也必在你面前得坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿人永远尊你的名为大，说：『万军之耶和华是治理以色列的神。』这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。
verses.textEnNiv: so that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty is God over Israel!’ And the house of your servant David will be established in your sight.
verses.textEnEsv: And your name will be magnified forever, saying, ‘The Lord of hosts is God over Israel,’ and the house of your servant David will be established before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So let Your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The Lord of hosts is the God over Israel.’ And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.
verses.textEnNlt: And may your name be honored forever so that everyone will say, ‘The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is God over Israel!’ And may the house of your servant David continue before you forever.
verses.textEnNasb: so that Your name may be great forever, by saying, ‘The Lord of armies is God over Israel’; and may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
verses.textEn: so that your name will be great forever. Then people will say, ‘The Lord Almighty is God over Israel!’ And the house of your servant David will be established in your sight.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神啊！因为你曾启示你的仆人说：‘我要为你建立家室。’所以你的仆人才敢来向你作这样的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华以色列的神啊！因为你曾启示你的仆人说：‘我要为你建立家室。’所以你的仆人才敢来向你作这样的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神啊，因你启示你的仆人说：『我必为你建立家室』，所以仆人大胆向你如此祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: " Lord Almighty, God of Israel, you have revealed this to your servant, saying, ‘I will build a house for you.’ So your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to you.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, O Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have made this revelation to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, have revealed this to Your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore Your servant has found it in his heart to pray this prayer to You.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, God of Israel, I have been bold enough to pray this prayer to you because you have revealed all this to your servant, saying, ‘I will build a house for you—a dynasty of kings!’
verses.textEnNasb: For You, Lord of armies, God of Israel, have given a revelation to Your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house’; therefore Your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to You.
verses.textEn: " Lord Almighty, God of Israel, you have revealed this to your servant, saying, ‘I will build a house for you.’ So your servant has found courage to pray this prayer to you.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华啊！你是神；你的话是真实可信的。你向你仆人应许了这美好的福分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华啊！你是神；你的话是真实可信的。你向你仆人应许了这美好的福分。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华啊，惟有你是神。你的话是真实的；你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: Sovereign Lord , you are God! Your covenant is trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O Lord God , you are God, and your words are true, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And now, O Lord God, You are God, and Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are God, O Sovereign Lord . Your words are truth, and you have promised these good things to your servant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, Lord God, You are God, and Your words are truth; and You have promised this good thing to Your servant.
verses.textEn: Sovereign Lord , you are God! Your covenant is trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.

verses.textZh: 现在求你乐意赐福给你仆人的家，使它在你面前可以永远存在。主耶和华啊！因为你曾经这样应许，愿你仆人的家因你的赐福永远蒙福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你乐意赐福给你仆人的家，使它在你面前可以永远存在。主耶和华啊！因为你曾经这样应许，愿你仆人的家因你的赐福永远蒙福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求你赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和华啊，这是你所应许的。愿你永远赐福与仆人的家！」
verses.textEnNiv: Now be pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Sovereign Lord , have spoken, and with your blessing the house of your servant will be blessed forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore may it please you to bless the house of your servant, so that it may continue forever before you. For you, O Lord God , have spoken, and with your blessing shall the house of your servant be blessed forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, let it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue before You forever; for You, O Lord God, have spoken it, and with Your blessing let the house of Your servant be blessed forever."
verses.textEnNlt: And now, may it please you to bless the house of your servant, so that it may continue forever before you. For you have spoken, and when you grant a blessing to your servant, O Sovereign Lord , it is an eternal blessing!"
verses.textEnNasb: And now, may it please You to bless the house of Your servant, so that it may continue forever before You. For You, Lord God, have spoken; and with Your blessing may the house of Your servant be blessed forever."
verses.textEn: Now be pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, Sovereign Lord , have spoken, and with your blessing the house of your servant will be blessed forever."

verses.textZh: 这事以后，大卫攻打非利士人，制伏了他们。大卫从非利士人手中取得了京城的控制权。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，大卫攻打非利士人，制伏了他们。大卫从非利士人手中取得了京城的控制权。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了京城的权柄 ；
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Metheg Ammah from the control of the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: After this David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this it came to pass that David attacked the Philistines and subdued them. And David took Metheg Ammah from the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, David defeated and subdued the Philistines by conquering Gath, their largest town.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened afterward that David defeated the Philistines and subdued them; and David took control of the chief city from the hand of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Metheg Ammah from the control of the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 他又击败摩押人，使他们躺在地上，用绳子量他们，把量两绳的杀死，让量一绳的存活。这样，摩押人就臣服大卫，给他进贡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又击败摩押人，使他们躺在地上，用绳子量他们，把量两绳的杀死，让量一绳的存活。这样，摩押人就臣服大卫，给他进贡。
verses.textZhCuv: 又攻打摩押人，使他们躺卧在地上，用绳量一量：量二绳的杀了，量一绳的存留。摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
verses.textEnNiv: David also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground and measured them off with a length of cord. Every two lengths of them were put to death, and the third length was allowed to live. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
verses.textEnEsv: And he defeated Moab and he measured them with a line, making them lie down on the ground. Two lines he measured to be put to death, and one full line to be spared. And the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he defeated Moab. Forcing them down to the ground, he measured them off with a line. With two lines he measured off those to be put to death, and with one full line those to be kept alive. So the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought tribute.
verses.textEnNlt: David also conquered the land of Moab. He made the people lie down on the ground in a row, and he measured them off in groups with a length of rope. He measured off two groups to be executed for every one group to be spared. The Moabites who were spared became David’s subjects and paid him tribute money.
verses.textEnNasb: And he defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and a full line to keep alive. And the Moabites became servants to David, bringing tribute.
verses.textEn: David also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground and measured them off with a length of cord. Every two lengths of them were put to death, and the third length was allowed to live. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.

verses.textZh: 琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢，往幼发拉底河去要夺回他统治这河的势力的时候，大卫就攻打他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢，往幼发拉底河去要夺回他统治这河的势力的时候，大卫就攻打他。
verses.textZhCuv: 琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢往大河去，要夺回他的国权。大卫就攻打他，
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnEsv: David also defeated Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to restore his power at the river Euphrates.
verses.textEnNkjv: David also defeated Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his territory at the River Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: David also destroyed the forces of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when Hadadezer marched out to strengthen his control along the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David defeated Hadadezer, the son of Rehob king of Zobah, as he went to restore his power at the Euphrates River.
verses.textEn: Moreover, David defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to restore his monument at the Euphrates River.

verses.textZh: 大卫从他那里掳获了战车一千辆，骑兵七千 ，步兵二万。大卫把所有战车的马的蹄筋都砍断，只留下一百辆战车的马 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从他那里掳获了战车一千辆，骑兵七千 ，步兵二万。大卫把所有战车的马的蹄筋都砍断，只留下一百辆战车的马 。
verses.textZhCuv: 擒拿了他的马兵一千七百，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。
verses.textEnNiv: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took from him 1,700 horsemen, and 20,000 foot soldiers. And David hamstrung all the chariot horses but left enough for 100 chariots.
verses.textEnNkjv: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Also David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except that he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: David captured 1,000 chariots, 7,000 charioteers, and 20,000 foot soldiers. He crippled all the chariot horses except enough for 100 chariots.
verses.textEnNasb: And David captured from him 1,700 horsemen and twenty thousand foot soldiers; and David hamstrung almost all the chariot horses, but left enough of them for a hundred chariots.
verses.textEn: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

verses.textZh: 大马士革的亚兰人来协助琐巴王哈大底谢，大卫就击杀了亚兰人二万二千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大马士革的亚兰人来协助琐巴王哈大底谢，大卫就击杀了亚兰人二万二千。
verses.textZhCuv: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大底谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down 22,000 men of the Syrians.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand of the Syrians.
verses.textEnNlt: When Arameans from Damascus arrived to help King Hadadezer, David killed 22,000 of them.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand men among the Arameans.
verses.textEn: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地驻军。这样亚兰人就臣服大卫，给他进贡。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地驻军。这样亚兰人就臣服大卫，给他进贡。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地设立防营，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David put garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. And the Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought tribute. So the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he placed several army garrisons in Damascus, the Aramean capital, and the Arameans became David’s subjects and paid him tribute money. So the Lord made David victorious wherever he went.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David put garrisons among the Arameans of Damascus, and the Arameans became servants to David, bringing tribute. And the Lord helped David wherever he went.
verses.textEn: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

verses.textZh: 大卫夺取了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带回耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫夺取了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带回耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 他夺了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带到耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And David took the shields of gold that were carried by the servants of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David took the shields of gold that had belonged to the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: David brought the gold shields of Hadadezer’s officers to Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNasb: David took the shields of gold which were carried by the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 大卫王又从哈大底谢的两座城比他和比罗他夺取了大量的铜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王又从哈大底谢的两座城比他和比罗他夺取了大量的铜。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王又从属哈大底谢的比他和比罗他城中夺取了许多的铜。
verses.textEnNiv: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: And from Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took very much bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also from Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a large amount of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: along with a large amount of bronze from Hadadezer’s towns of Tebah and Berothai.
verses.textEnNasb: And from Betah and Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a very large amount of bronze.
verses.textEn: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

verses.textZh: 哈马王陀以听见大卫打败了哈大底谢的全军，
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈马王陀以听见大卫打败了哈大底谢的全军，
verses.textZhCuv: 哈马王陀以听见大卫杀败哈大底谢的全军，
verses.textEnNiv: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
verses.textEnEsv: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer,
verses.textEnNkjv: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had defeated all the army of Hadadezer,
verses.textEnNlt: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had destroyed the entire army of Hadadezer,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Toi king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of Hadadezer,
verses.textEn: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,

verses.textZh: 就差派他的儿子约兰去见大卫王，向他问安，祝贺他，因为大卫和哈大底谢争战，竟击败了他。原来陀以常常与哈大底谢争战。约兰手里还带着一些银器、金器和铜器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就差派他的儿子约兰去见大卫王，向他问安，祝贺他，因为大卫和哈大底谢争战，竟击败了他。原来陀以常常与哈大底谢争战。约兰手里还带着一些银器、金器和铜器。
verses.textZhCuv: 就打发他儿子约兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大底谢（原来陀以与哈大底谢常常争战）。约兰带了金银铜的器皿来，
verses.textEnNiv: he sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Joram brought with him articles of silver, of gold and of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: Toi sent his son Joram to King David, to ask about his health and to bless him because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him, for Hadadezer had often been at war with Toi. And Joram brought with him articles of silver, of gold, and of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David, to greet him and bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him (for Hadadezer had been at war with Toi); and Joram brought with him articles of silver, articles of gold, and articles of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: he sent his son Joram to congratulate King David for his successful campaign. Hadadezer and Toi had been enemies and were often at war. Joram presented David with many gifts of silver, gold, and bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: Toi sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and bless him, because he had fought Hadadezer and defeated him; for Hadadezer had been at war with Toi. And Joram brought with him articles of silver, gold, and bronze.
verses.textEn: he sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Joram brought with him articles of silver, of gold and of bronze.

verses.textZh: 大卫王也把这些器皿，连同他从他征服的各国得来的金银都一起分别为圣，献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王也把这些器皿，连同他从他征服的各国得来的金银都一起分别为圣，献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王将这些器皿和他治服各国所得来的金银都分别为圣，献给耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold from all the nations he had subdued:
verses.textEnEsv: These also King David dedicated to the Lord , together with the silver and gold that he dedicated from all the nations he subdued,
verses.textEnNkjv: King David also dedicated these to the Lord, along with the silver and gold that he had dedicated from all the nations which he had subdued—
verses.textEnNlt: King David dedicated all these gifts to the Lord , as he did with the silver and gold from the other nations he had defeated—
verses.textEnNasb: King David also consecrated these gifts to the Lord, with the silver and gold that he had consecrated from all the nations which he had subdued:
verses.textEn: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold from all the nations he had subdued:

verses.textZh: 就是从以东、摩押、亚扪人、非利士人、亚玛力人所得来的，以及从琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢获得的战利品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是从以东、摩押、亚扪人、非利士人、亚玛力人所得来的，以及从琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢获得的战利品。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是从亚兰、摩押、亚扪、非利士、亚玛力人所得来的，以及从琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢所掠之物。
verses.textEnNiv: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek. He also dedicated the plunder taken from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.textEnEsv: from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, Amalek, and from the spoil of Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.textEnNkjv: from Syria, from Moab, from the people of Ammon, from the Philistines, from Amalek, and from the spoil of Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.textEnNlt: from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek—and from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.textEnNasb: from Aram, Moab, the sons of Ammon, the Philistines, Amalek, and from the spoils of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.textEn: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek. He also dedicated the plunder taken from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

verses.textZh: 大卫在盐谷击杀了一万八千以东人回来以后，就大有名声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在盐谷击杀了一万八千以东人回来以后，就大有名声。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在盐谷击杀了亚兰 一万八千人回来，就得了大名；
verses.textEnNiv: And David became famous after he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnEsv: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David made himself a name when he returned from killing eighteen thousand Syrians in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnNlt: So David became even more famous when he returned from destroying 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEnNasb: So David made a name for himself when he returned from killing eighteen thousand Arameans in the Valley of Salt.
verses.textEn: And David became famous after he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

verses.textZh: 他又在以东设立防军；他在以东各地都设立防军，所有以东人就都臣服大卫。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在以东设立防军；他在以东各地都设立防军，所有以东人就都臣服大卫。大卫无论到甚么地方去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在以东全地设立防营，以东人就都归服大卫。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: He put garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became David’s servants. And the Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became David’s servants. And the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
verses.textEnNlt: He placed army garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites became David’s subjects. In fact, the Lord made David victorious wherever he went.
verses.textEnNasb: He also put garrisons in Edom. In all Edom he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the Lord helped David wherever he went.
verses.textEn: He put garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

verses.textZh: 大卫作王统治全以色列，以公平和正义对待所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫作王统治全以色列，以公平和正义对待所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。
verses.textEnNiv: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.
verses.textEnEsv: So David reigned over all Israel. And David administered justice and equity to all his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David reigned over all Israel; and David administered judgment and justice to all his people.
verses.textEnNlt: So David reigned over all Israel and did what was just and right for all his people.
verses.textEnNasb: So David reigned over all Israel; and David administered justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.textEn: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作军队的统帅，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作军队的统帅，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
verses.textEnNiv: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnEsv: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
verses.textEnNkjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnNlt: Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the royal historian.
verses.textEnNasb: Joab the son of Zeruiah was commander over the army, and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was secretary.
verses.textEn: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.textZh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长，西莱雅作书记，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长，西莱雅作书记，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长；西莱雅作书记；
verses.textEnNiv: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;
verses.textEnEsv: and Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, and Seraiah was secretary,
verses.textEnNkjv: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests; Seraiah was the scribe;
verses.textEnNlt: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were the priests. Seraiah was the court secretary.
verses.textEnNasb: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, and Seraiah was scribe.
verses.textEn: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统管基利提人和比利提人；大卫的众子都作领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统管基利提人和比利提人；大卫的众子都作领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都作领袖。
verses.textEnNiv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.
verses.textEnEsv: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and David’s sons were priests.
verses.textEnNkjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada wasover both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
verses.textEnNlt: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was captain of the king’s bodyguard. And David’s sons served as priestly leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
verses.textEn: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priests.

verses.textZh: 大卫问："扫罗家还有剩下的人没有？我要因约拿单的缘故，以慈爱待他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问："扫罗家还有剩下的人没有？我要因约拿单的缘故，以慈爱待他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫问说：「扫罗家还有剩下的人没有？我要因约拿单的缘故向他施恩。」
verses.textEnNiv: David asked, "Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said, "Is there still anyone left of the house of Saul, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now David said, "Is there still anyone who is left of the house of Saul, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"
verses.textEnNlt: One day David asked, "Is anyone in Saul’s family still alive—anyone to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul, so that I could show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"
verses.textEn: David asked, "Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan’s sake?"

verses.textZh: 扫罗家有一个仆人，名叫洗巴。有人叫他来见大卫；王问他："你是洗巴吗？"他回答："仆人正是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗家有一个仆人，名叫洗巴。有人叫他来见大卫；王问他："你是洗巴吗？"他回答："仆人正是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗家有一个仆人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他来见大卫，王问他说：「你是洗巴吗？」回答说：「仆人是。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now there was a servant of Saul’s household named Ziba. They summoned him to appear before David, and the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" "At your service," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a servant of the house of Saul whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David. And the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" And he said, "I am your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: And therewas a servant of the house of Saul whose name was Ziba. So when they had called him to David, the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" He said, "At your service!"
verses.textEnNlt: He summoned a man named Ziba, who had been one of Saul’s servants. "Are you Ziba?" the king asked. "Yes sir, I am," Ziba replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a servant of the house of Saul whose name was Ziba, and they summoned him to David; and the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" And he said, "I am your servant."
verses.textEn: Now there was a servant of Saul’s household named Ziba. They summoned him to appear before David, and the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" "At your service," he replied.

verses.textZh: 王又问："扫罗家还有人没有？我要以神的慈爱待他。"洗巴回答王说："还有约拿单的一个儿子，他双脚残废了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又问："扫罗家还有人没有？我要以神的慈爱待他。"洗巴回答王说："还有约拿单的一个儿子，他双脚残废了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「扫罗家还有人没有？我要照神的慈爱恩待他。」洗巴对王说：「还有约拿单的一个儿子，是瘸腿的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king asked, "Is there no one still alive from the house of Saul to whom I can show God’s kindness?" Ziba answered the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan; he is lame in both feet."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said, "Is there not still someone of the house of Saul, that I may show the kindness of God to him?" Ziba said to the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan; he is crippled in his feet."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said, "Is there not still someone of the house of Saul, to whom I may show the kindness of God?" And Ziba said to the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan whois lame in his feet."
verses.textEnNlt: The king then asked him, "Is anyone still alive from Saul’s family? If so, I want to show God’s kindness to them." Ziba replied, "Yes, one of Jonathan’s sons is still alive. He is crippled in both feet."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said, "Is there no one remaining of the house of Saul to whom I could show the kindness of God?" And Ziba said to the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan, one who is disabled in both feet."
verses.textEn: The king asked, "Is there no one still alive from the house of Saul to whom I can show God’s kindness?" Ziba answered the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan; he is lame in both feet."

verses.textZh: 王又问他说："他在哪里？"洗巴回答王说："他在罗．底巴亚米利的儿子玛吉家里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又问他说："他在哪里？"洗巴回答王说："他在罗．底巴亚米利的儿子玛吉家里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「他在哪里？」洗巴对王说：「他在罗‧底巴，亚米利的儿子玛吉家里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Where is he?" the king asked. Ziba answered, "He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar."
verses.textEnEsv: The king said to him, "Where is he?" And Ziba said to the king, "He is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, at Lo-debar."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king said to him, "Where is he?" And Ziba said to the king, "Indeed he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where is he?" the king asked. "In Lo-debar," Ziba told him, "at the home of Makir son of Ammiel."
verses.textEnNasb: So the king said to him, "Where is he?" And Ziba said to the king, "Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar."
verses.textEn: "Where is he?" the king asked. Ziba answered, "He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫王派人去把他从罗．底巴亚米利的儿子玛吉家里接来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫王派人去把他从罗．底巴亚米利的儿子玛吉家里接来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫王打发人去，从罗‧底巴、亚米利的儿子玛吉家里召了他来。
verses.textEnNiv: So King David had him brought from Lo Debar, from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King David sent and brought him from the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, at Lo-debar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
verses.textEnNlt: So David sent for him and brought him from Makir’s home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King David sent messengers who brought him from the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.
verses.textEn: So King David had him brought from Lo Debar, from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.

verses.textZh: 扫罗的孙子，约拿单的儿子米非波设来到大卫面前，俯伏叩拜。大卫说："米非波设！"他回答："仆人在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗的孙子，约拿单的儿子米非波设来到大卫面前，俯伏叩拜。大卫说："米非波设！"他回答："仆人在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的孙子、约拿单的儿子米非波设来见大卫，伏地叩拜。大卫说：「米非波设！」米非波设说：「仆人在此。」
