verses.textEnNiv: When Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he bowed down to pay him honor. David said, "Mephibosheth!" "At your service," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan, son of Saul, came to David and fell on his face and paid homage. And David said, "Mephibosheth!" And he answered, "Behold, I am your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, had come to David, he fell on his face and prostrated himself. Then David said, "Mephibosheth?" And he answered, "Here is your servant!"
verses.textEnNlt: His name was Mephibosheth ; he was Jonathan’s son and Saul’s grandson. When he came to David, he bowed low to the ground in deep respect. David said, "Greetings, Mephibosheth." Mephibosheth replied, "I am your servant."
verses.textEnNasb: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, came to David and fell on his face and prostrated himself. And David said, "Mephibosheth." And he said, "Here is your servant!"
verses.textEn: When Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he bowed down to pay him honor. David said, "Mephibosheth!" "At your service," he replied.

verses.textZh: 大卫对他说："你不要怕，我必因你父亲约拿单的缘故，以慈爱待你，把你祖父扫罗所有的田地都归还给你；你也可以常常与我同席吃饭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对他说："你不要怕，我必因你父亲约拿单的缘故，以慈爱待你，把你祖父扫罗所有的田地都归还给你；你也可以常常与我同席吃饭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「你不要惧怕，我必因你父亲约拿单的缘故施恩与你，将你祖父扫罗的一切田地都归还你；你也可以常与我同席吃饭。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Don’t be afraid," David said to him, "for I will surely show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to him, "Do not fear, for I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan, and I will restore to you all the land of Saul your father, and you shall eat at my table always."
verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to him, "Do not fear, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your grandfather; and you shall eat bread at my table continually."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be afraid!" David said. "I intend to show kindness to you because of my promise to your father, Jonathan. I will give you all the property that once belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will eat here with me at the king’s table!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to him, "Do not be afraid, for I will assuredly show kindness to you for the sake of your father Jonathan, and I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul; and you yourself shall eat at my table regularly."
verses.textEn: "Don’t be afraid," David said to him, "for I will surely show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table."

verses.textZh: 米非波设再叩拜说："仆人算甚么？你竟然眷顾我这个像条死狗的人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米非波设再叩拜说："仆人算甚么？你竟然眷顾我这个像条死狗的人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 米非波设又叩拜，说：「仆人算什么，不过如死狗一般，竟蒙王这样眷顾！」
verses.textEnNiv: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, "What is your servant, that you should notice a dead dog like me?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he paid homage and said, "What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog such as I?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he bowed himself, and said, "What is your servant, that you should look upon such a dead dog as I?"
verses.textEnNlt: Mephibosheth bowed respectfully and exclaimed, "Who is your servant, that you should show such kindness to a dead dog like me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Again he prostrated himself, and said, "What is your servant, that you should be concerned about a dead dog like me?"
verses.textEn: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, "What is your servant, that you should notice a dead dog like me?"

verses.textZh: 王把扫罗的仆人洗巴召来，对他说："我已经把属于扫罗，以及他全家所有的一切，给了你主人的孙子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王把扫罗的仆人洗巴召来，对他说："我已经把属于扫罗，以及他全家所有的一切，给了你主人的孙子。
verses.textZhCuv: 王召了扫罗的仆人洗巴来，对他说：「我已将属扫罗和他的一切家产都赐给你主人的儿子了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king summoned Ziba, Saul’s steward, and said to him, "I have given your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king called Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, "All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s grandson.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, "I have given to your master’s son all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said, "I have given your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, "Everything that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s grandson.
verses.textEn: Then the king summoned Ziba, Saul’s steward, and said to him, "I have given your master’s grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.

verses.textZh: 你和你的儿子，以及你的仆人，都要替他耕种田地；你要把所收获的拿来，供他食用。你主人的孙子米非波设要常常与我同席吃饭。"洗巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的儿子，以及你的仆人，都要替他耕种田地；你要把所收获的拿来，供他食用。你主人的孙子米非波设要常常与我同席吃饭。"洗巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的众子、仆人要为你主人的儿子米非波设耕种田地，把所产的拿来供他食用；他却要常与我同席吃饭。」洗巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: You and your sons and your servants are to farm the land for him and bring in the crops, so that your master’s grandson may be provided for. And Mephibosheth, grandson of your master, will always eat at my table." (Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.)
verses.textEnEsv: And you and your sons and your servants shall till the land for him and shall bring in the produce, that your master’s grandson may have bread to eat. But Mephibosheth your master’s grandson shall always eat at my table." Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: You therefore, and your sons and your servants, shall work the land for him, and you shall bring in theharvest, that your master’s son may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth your master’s son shall eat bread at my table always." Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.textEnNlt: You and your sons and servants are to farm the land for him to produce food for your master’s household. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, will eat here at my table." (Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.)
verses.textEnNasb: You and your sons and your servants shall cultivate the land for him, and you shall bring in the produce so that your master’s grandson will have food to eat; nevertheless Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, shall eat at my table regularly." Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.textEn: You and your sons and your servants are to farm the land for him and bring in the crops, so that your master’s grandson may be provided for. And Mephibosheth, grandson of your master, will always eat at my table." (Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.)

verses.textZh: 洗巴对王说："我主我王吩咐仆人的一切，仆人都必遵行。"于是米非波设与大卫 同桌吃饭，像是王的一个儿子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗巴对王说："我主我王吩咐仆人的一切，仆人都必遵行。"于是米非波设与大卫 同桌吃饭，像是王的一个儿子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗巴对王说：「凡我主我王吩咐仆人的，仆人都必遵行。」王又说：「米非波设必与我同席吃饭，如王的儿子一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ziba said to the king, "Your servant will do whatever my lord the king commands his servant to do." So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s sons.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ziba said to the king, "According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so will your servant do." So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table, like one of the king’s sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ziba said to the king, "According to all that my lord the king has commanded his servant, so will your servant do." "As for Mephibosheth," saidtheking, "he shall eat at my table like one of the king’s sons."
verses.textEnNlt: Ziba replied, "Yes, my lord the king; I am your servant, and I will do all that you have commanded." And from that time on, Mephibosheth ate regularly at David’s table, like one of the king’s own sons.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ziba said to the king, "In accordance with everything that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do." So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table as one of the king’s sons.
verses.textEn: Then Ziba said to the king, "Your servant will do whatever my lord the king commands his servant to do." So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s sons.

verses.textZh: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。住在洗巴家里的人，都作了米非波设的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。住在洗巴家里的人，都作了米非波设的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家里的人都作了米非波设的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mika, and all the members of Ziba’s household were servants of Mephibosheth.
verses.textEnEsv: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. And all who lived in Ziba’s house became Mephibosheth’s servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mephibosheth had a young son whose name was Micha. And all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
verses.textEnNlt: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica. From then on, all the members of Ziba’s household were Mephibosheth’s servants.
verses.textEnNasb: Mephibosheth had a young son whose name was Mica. And all who lived in the house of Ziba were servants to Mephibosheth.
verses.textEn: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mika, and all the members of Ziba’s household were servants of Mephibosheth.

verses.textZh: 这样，米非波设住在耶路撒冷，常常与王同席吃饭。可是他的双腿都是瘸的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，米非波设住在耶路撒冷，常常与王同席吃饭。可是他的双腿都是瘸的。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是米非波设住在耶路撒冷，常与王同席吃饭。他两腿都是瘸的。
verses.textEnNiv: And Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table; he was lame in both feet.
verses.textEnEsv: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate always at the king’s table. Now he was lame in both his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. And he was lame in both his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: And Mephibosheth, who was crippled in both feet, lived in Jerusalem and ate regularly at the king’s table.
verses.textEnNasb: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he ate at the king’s table regularly. And he was disabled in his two feet.
verses.textEn: And Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table; he was lame in both feet.

verses.textZh: 后来，亚扪人的王死了，他的儿子哈嫩继承他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，亚扪人的王死了，他的儿子哈嫩继承他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，亚扪人的王死了，他儿子哈嫩接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: After this the king of the Ammonites died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened after this that the king of the people of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time after this, King Nahash of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun became king.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened afterward that the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun became king in his place.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 大卫说："我要恩待拿辖的儿子哈嫩，像他父亲恩待我一样。"于是大卫差派自己的臣仆，为他丧父的事安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人境内时，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："我要恩待拿辖的儿子哈嫩，像他父亲恩待我一样。"于是大卫差派自己的臣仆，为他丧父的事安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人境内时，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣臣仆，为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内。
verses.textEnNiv: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s men came to the land of the Ammonites,
verses.textEnEsv: And David said, "I will deal loyally with Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father dealt loyally with me." So David sent by his servants to console him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent by the hand of his servants to comfort him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: David said, "I am going to show loyalty to Hanun just as his father, Nahash, was always loyal to me." So David sent ambassadors to express sympathy to Hanun about his father’s death. But when David’s ambassadors arrived in the land of Ammon,
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent some of his servants to console him about his father. But when David’s servants came to the land of the Ammonites,
verses.textEn: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David’s men came to the land of the Ammonites,

verses.textZh: 亚扪人的众领袖对他们的主哈嫩说："大卫差派这些慰问的人到你这里来，你以为他是尊敬你父亲吗？他派遣臣仆到你这里来，不是为了要窥探这城，侦察清楚，然后把城倾覆吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人的众领袖对他们的主哈嫩说："大卫差派这些慰问的人到你这里来，你以为他是尊敬你父亲吗？他派遣臣仆到你这里来，不是为了要窥探这城，侦察清楚，然后把城倾覆吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 但亚扪人的首领对他们的主哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他差臣仆来不是详察窥探、要倾覆这城吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Hasn’t David sent them to you only to explore the city and spy it out and overthrow it?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think, because David has sent comforters to you, that he is honoring your father? Has not David sent his servants to you to search the city and to spy it out and to overthrow it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the princes of the people of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think that David really honors your father because he has sent comforters to you? Has David not rather sent his servants to you to search the city, to spy it out, and to overthrow it?"
verses.textEnNlt: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun, their master, "Do you really think these men are coming here to honor your father? No! David has sent them to spy out the city so they can come in and conquer it!"
verses.textEnNasb: the commanders of the Ammonites said to their lord Hanun, " Do you think that David is simply honoring your father since he has sent you servants to console you? Has David not sent his servants to you in order to explore the city, to spy it out and overthrow it?"
verses.textEn: the Ammonite commanders said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending envoys to you to express sympathy? Hasn’t David sent them to you only to explore the city and spy it out and overthrow it?"

verses.textZh: 于是哈嫩拿住大卫的臣仆，把他们的胡须剃去一半，又把他们的外袍割去半截，露出臀部，然后才放他们走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是哈嫩拿住大卫的臣仆，把他们的胡须剃去一半，又把他们的外袍割去半截，露出臀部，然后才放他们走。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.textEnEsv: So Hanun took David’s servants and shaved off half the beard of each and cut off their garments in the middle, at their hips, and sent them away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off half of their beards, cut off their garments in the middle, at their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hanun seized David’s ambassadors and shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their robes at the buttocks, and sent them back to David in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hanun took David’s servants and shaved off half of their beards, and cut off their robes in the middle as far as their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.textEn: So Hanun seized David’s envoys, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉大卫，他就派人去迎接他们，因为他们非常羞耻。王就说："你们可以住在耶利哥，等到你们的胡须长长了才回来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉大卫，他就派人去迎接他们，因为他们非常羞耻。王就说："你们可以住在耶利哥，等到你们的胡须长长了才回来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，（因为他们甚觉羞耻），告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」
verses.textEnNiv: When David was told about this, he sent messengers to meet the men, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."
verses.textEnEsv: When it was told David, he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, "Remain at Jericho until your beards have grown and then return."
verses.textEnNkjv: When they told David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, "Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard what had happened, he sent messengers to tell the men, "Stay at Jericho until your beards grow out, and then come back." For they felt deep shame because of their appearance.
verses.textEnNasb: When messengers informed David, he sent servants to meet them, because the men were extremely humiliated. And the king said, "Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back, and then you shall return."
verses.textEn: When David was told about this, he sent messengers to meet the men, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."

verses.textZh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就派人去招募伯．利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，玛迦王的人一千，陀伯人一万二千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就派人去招募伯．利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，玛迦王的人一千，陀伯人一万二千。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就打发人去，招募伯‧利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，与玛迦王的人一千、陀伯人一万二千。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth Rehob and Zobah, as well as the king of Maakah with a thousand men, and also twelve thousand men from Tob.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Ammonites saw that they had become a stench to David, the Ammonites sent and hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob, and the Syrians of Zobah, 20,000 foot soldiers, and the king of Maacah with 1,000 men, and the men of Tob, 12,000 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that they had made themselves repulsive to David, the people of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand foot soldiers; and from the king of Maacah one thousand men, and from Ish-Tob twelve thousand men.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people of Ammon realized how seriously they had angered David, they sent and hired 20,000 Aramean foot soldiers from the lands of Beth-rehob and Zobah, 1,000 from the king of Maacah, and 12,000 from the land of Tob.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the sons of Ammon saw that they had become repulsive to David, the sons of Ammon sent messengers and hired the Arameans of Beth-rehob and the Arameans of Zobah, twenty thousand foot soldiers, and the king of Maacah with a thousand men, and the men of Tob with twelve thousand men.
verses.textEn: When the Ammonites realized that they had become obnoxious to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth Rehob and Zobah, as well as the king of Maakah with a thousand men, and also twelve thousand men from Tob.

verses.textZh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押和全体勇士出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫听见了，就差派约押和全体勇士出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when David heard ofit, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard about this, he sent Joab and all his warriors to fight them.
verses.textEnNasb: When David heard about this, he sent Joab and all the army, the warriors.
verses.textEn: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.

verses.textZh: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵，琐巴和利合的亚兰人，陀伯人和玛迦人，也分别在郊野摆阵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵，琐巴和利合的亚兰人，陀伯人和玛迦人，也分别在郊野摆阵。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵；琐巴与利合的亚兰人、陀伯人，并玛迦人，另在郊野摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance of their city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maakah were by themselves in the open country.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Ammonites came out and drew up in battle array at the entrance of the gate, and the Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the open country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people of Ammon came out and put themselves in battle array at the entrance of the gate. And the Syrians of Zoba, Beth Rehob, Ish-Tob, and Maacah were by themselves in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ammonite troops came out and drew up their battle lines at the entrance of the city gate, while the Arameans from Zobah and Rehob and the men from Tob and Maacah positioned themselves to fight in the open fields.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Ammon came out and lined up for battle at the entrance of the city, while the Arameans of Zobah and of Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were stationed by themselves in the field.
verses.textEn: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance of their city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maakah were by themselves in the open country.

verses.textZh: 约押看见自己前后受敌，就从以色列所有的精兵中，挑选一部分出来，使他们摆阵去迎战亚兰人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押看见自己前后受敌，就从以色列所有的精兵中，挑选一部分出来，使他们摆阵去迎战亚兰人，
verses.textZhCuv: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.
verses.textEnEsv: When Joab saw that the battle was set against him both in front and in the rear, he chose some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Syrians.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Joab saw that the battle line was against him before and behind, he chose some of Israel’s best and put them in battle array against the Syrians.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joab saw that he would have to fight on both the front and the rear, he chose some of Israel’s elite troops and placed them under his personal command to fight the Arameans in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him at the front and at the rear, he selected warriors from all the choice men in Israel, and lined them up against the Arameans.
verses.textEn: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

verses.textZh: 他把其余的人交在他兄弟亚比筛手下，使他们摆阵去迎战亚扪人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把其余的人交在他兄弟亚比筛手下，使他们摆阵去迎战亚扪人。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother and deployed them against the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of his men he put in the charge of Abishai his brother, and he arrayed them against the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest of the people he put under the command of Abishai his brother, that he might set them in battle array against the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: He left the rest of the army under the command of his brother Abishai, who was to attack the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: But the remainder of the people he placed under the command of his brother Abishai, and he lined them up against the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother and deployed them against the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 约押对亚比筛说："如果亚兰人比我强，你就来帮助我。如果亚扪人比你强，我就去帮助你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押对亚比筛说："如果亚兰人比我强，你就来帮助我。如果亚扪人比你强，我就去帮助你。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to come to my rescue; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to rescue you.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me, but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the people of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come and help you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then come over and help me," Joab told his brother. "And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I will come and help you.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will come to help you.
verses.textEn: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to come to my rescue; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to rescue you.

verses.textZh: 你要刚强；为了我们的人民和我们神的众城镇，我们要刚强！愿耶和华成全他看为美的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要刚强；为了我们的人民和我们神的众城镇，我们要刚强！愿耶和华成全他看为美的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和神的城邑作大丈夫。愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行！」
verses.textEnNiv: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."
verses.textEnEsv: Be of good courage, and let us be courageous for our people, and for the cities of our God, and may the Lord do what seems good to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Be of good courage, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the Lord do whatis good in His sight."
verses.textEnNlt: Be courageous! Let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. May the Lord ’s will be done."
verses.textEnNasb: Be strong, and let’s show ourselves courageous for the sake of our people and the cities of our God; and may the Lord do what is good in His sight."
verses.textEn: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."

verses.textZh: 于是约押和与他在一起的人前进，攻击亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约押和与他在一起的人前进，攻击亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near to battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near for the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joab and his troops attacked, the Arameans began to run away.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joab and the people who were with him advanced to the battle against the Arameans, and they fled from him.
verses.textEn: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

verses.textZh: 亚扪人看见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑，逃进城里去了。约押就从亚扪人那里回来，回到耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人看见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑，逃进城里去了。约押就从亚扪人那里回来，回到耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就离开亚扪人那里，回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they fled before Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Ammonites saw that the Syrians fled, they likewise fled before Abishai and entered the city. Then Joab returned from fighting against the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the people of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fleeing, they also fled before Abishai, and entered the city. So Joab returned from the people of Ammon and went to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: And when the Ammonites saw the Arameans running, they ran from Abishai and retreated into the city. After the battle was over, Joab returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sons of Ammon saw that the Arameans had fled, they also fled from Abishai and entered the city. Then Joab returned from fighting against the sons of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: When the Ammonites realized that the Arameans were fleeing, they fled before Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人击败，就再聚集起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人击败，就再聚集起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就又聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they gathered themselves together.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they gathered together.
verses.textEnNlt: The Arameans now realized that they were no match for Israel. So when they regrouped,
verses.textEnNasb: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they assembled together.
verses.textEn: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.

verses.textZh: 哈大底谢差遣人把幼发拉底河那边的亚兰人调来。他们来到了希兰，由哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈大底谢差遣人把幼发拉底河那边的亚兰人调来。他们来到了希兰，由哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈大底谢差遣人，将大河那边的亚兰人调来；他们到了希兰，哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Hadadezer had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River; they went to Helam, with Shobak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the Euphrates. They came to Helam, with Shobach the commander of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River, and they came to Helam. And Shobach the commander of Hadadezer’s army went before them.
verses.textEnNlt: they were joined by additional Aramean troops summoned by Hadadezer from the other side of the Euphrates River. These troops arrived at Helam under the command of Shobach, the commander of Hadadezer’s forces.
verses.textEnNasb: And Hadadezer sent word and brought out the Arameans who were beyond the Euphrates River, and they came to Helam; and Shobach the commander of the army of Hadadezer led them.
verses.textEn: Hadadezer had Arameans brought from beyond the Euphrates River; they went to Helam, with Shobak the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉了大卫，他就聚集所有的以色列人，渡过约旦河，来到了希兰。亚兰人摆好了阵迎击大卫，与他交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉了大卫，他就聚集所有的以色列人，渡过约旦河，来到了希兰。亚兰人摆好了阵迎击大卫，与他交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人，过约旦河，来到希兰。亚兰人迎着大卫摆阵，与他打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan and went to Helam. The Arameans formed their battle lines to meet David and fought against him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together and crossed the Jordan and came to Helam. The Syrians arrayed themselves against David and fought with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel, crossed over the Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in battle array against David and fought with him.
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard what was happening, he mobilized all Israel, crossed the Jordan River, and led the army to Helam. The Arameans positioned themselves in battle formation and fought against David.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when it was reported to David, he gathered all Israel together and crossed the Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Arameans lined up against David and fought him.
verses.textEn: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan and went to Helam. The Arameans formed their battle lines to meet David and fought against him.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人却在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七百名驾驶战车的军兵，四万骑兵。又击杀了亚兰军队的将军朔法，他就死在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人却在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七百名驾驶战车的军兵，四万骑兵。又击杀了亚兰军队的将军朔法，他就死在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑；大卫杀了亚兰七百辆战车的人，四万马兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。
verses.textEnNiv: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobak the commander of their army, and he died there.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Syrians fled before Israel, and David killed of the Syrians the men of 700 chariots, and 40,000 horsemen, and wounded Shobach the commander of their army, so that he died there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand horsemen of the Syrians, and struck Shobach the commander of their army, who died there.
verses.textEnNlt: But again the Arameans fled from the Israelites. This time David’s forces killed 700 charioteers and 40,000 foot soldiers, including Shobach, the commander of their army.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Arameans fled from Israel, and David killed seven hundred charioteers of the Arameans and forty thousand horsemen, and struck Shobach the commander of their army, and he died there.
verses.textEn: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobak the commander of their army, and he died there.

verses.textZh: 所有臣服于哈大底谢的王看见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人议和，臣服于他们。于是亚兰人害怕，不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有臣服于哈大底谢的王看见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人议和，臣服于他们。于是亚兰人害怕，不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
verses.textZhCuv: 属哈大底谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人和好，归服他们。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the kings who were vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with the Israelites and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all the kings who were servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with Israel and became subject to them. So the Syrians were afraid to save the Ammonites anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when all the kings whowere servants to Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Syrians were afraid to help the people of Ammon anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the kings allied with Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they surrendered to Israel and became their subjects. After that, the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the kings, servants of Hadadezer, saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with Israel and served them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the sons of Ammon anymore.
verses.textEn: When all the kings who were vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed by Israel, they made peace with the Israelites and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.

verses.textZh: 过了年，在列王出征的时候，大卫派遣约押和自己的臣仆，以及以色列众军一同出征。他们歼灭了亚扪人，并且包围了拉巴。大卫却留在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了年，在列王出征的时候，大卫派遣约押和自己的臣仆，以及以色列众军一同出征。他们歼灭了亚扪人，并且包围了拉巴。大卫却留在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，大卫又差派约押，率领臣仆和以色列众人出战。他们就打败亚扪人，围攻拉巴。大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, David sent Joab out with the king’s men and the whole Israelite army. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: In the spring of the year, the time when kings go out to battle, David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel. And they ravaged the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened in the spring of the year, at the time when kings go out tobattle, that David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the people of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David remained at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: In the spring of the year, when kings normally go out to war, David sent Joab and the Israelite army to fight the Ammonites. They destroyed the Ammonite army and laid siege to the city of Rabbah. However, David stayed behind in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened in the spring, at the time when kings go out to battle, that David sent Joab and his servants with him and all Israel, and they brought destruction on the sons of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, David sent Joab out with the king’s men and the whole Israelite army. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 有一天近黄昏的时候，大卫从床上起来，在王宫的平顶上散步。他从平顶上看见一个妇人在洗澡；这妇人容貌非常美丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天近黄昏的时候，大卫从床上起来，在王宫的平顶上散步。他从平顶上看见一个妇人在洗澡；这妇人容貌非常美丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，太阳平西，大卫从床上起来，在王宫的平顶上游行，看见一个妇人沐浴，容貌甚美，
verses.textEnNiv: One evening David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing. The woman was very beautiful,
verses.textEnEsv: It happened, late one afternoon, when David arose from his couch and was walking on the roof of the king’s house, that he saw from the roof a woman bathing; and the woman was very beautiful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened one evening that David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to behold.
verses.textEnNlt: Late one afternoon, after his midday rest, David got out of bed and was walking on the roof of the palace. As he looked out over the city, he noticed a woman of unusual beauty taking a bath.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at evening time David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of the king’s house, and from the roof he saw a woman bathing; and the woman was very beautiful in appearance.
verses.textEn: One evening David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing. The woman was very beautiful,

verses.textZh: 大卫派人去查问那妇人是谁。有人说："这不是以连的女儿、赫人乌利亚的妻子拔示巴吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫派人去查问那妇人是谁。有人说："这不是以连的女儿、赫人乌利亚的妻子拔示巴吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就差人打听那妇人是谁。有人说：「她是以连的女儿，赫人乌利亚的妻拔示巴。」
verses.textEnNiv: and David sent someone to find out about her. The man said, "She is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite."
verses.textEnEsv: And David sent and inquired about the woman. And one said, "Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So David sent and inquired about the woman. And someone said, "Is this not Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?"
verses.textEnNlt: He sent someone to find out who she was, and he was told, "She is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite."
verses.textEnNasb: So David sent servants and inquired about the woman. And someone said, "Is this not Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?"
verses.textEn: and David sent someone to find out about her. The man said, "She is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫差派使者去把她接来。她来到大卫那里，大卫就与她同房。那时她的月经刚得洁净。事后，她就回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫差派使者去把她接来。她来到大卫那里，大卫就与她同房。那时她的月经刚得洁净。事后，她就回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫差人去，将妇人接来；那时她的月经才得洁净。她来了，大卫与她同房，她就回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David sent messengers to get her. She came to him, and he slept with her. (Now she was purifying herself from her monthly uncleanness.) Then she went back home.
verses.textEnEsv: So David sent messengers and took her, and she came to him, and he lay with her. ( Now she had been purifying herself from her uncleanness.) Then she returned to her house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David sent messengers, and took her; and she came to him, and he lay with her, for she was cleansed from her impurity; and she returned to her house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David sent messengers to get her; and when she came to the palace, he slept with her. She had just completed the purification rites after having her menstrual period. Then she returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David sent messengers and had her brought, and when she came to him, he slept with her; and when she had purified herself from her uncleanness, she returned to her house.
verses.textEn: Then David sent messengers to get her. She came to him, and he slept with her. (Now she was purifying herself from her monthly uncleanness.) Then she went back home.

verses.textZh: 后来那妇人怀了孕，就打发人去告诉大卫，说："我怀孕了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来那妇人怀了孕，就打发人去告诉大卫，说："我怀孕了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是她怀了孕，打发人去告诉大卫说：「我怀了孕。」
verses.textEnNiv: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, "I am pregnant."
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman conceived, and she sent and told David, "I am pregnant."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the woman conceived; so she sent and told David, and said, "I am with child."
verses.textEnNlt: Later, when Bathsheba discovered that she was pregnant, she sent David a message, saying, "I’m pregnant."
verses.textEnNasb: But the woman conceived; so she sent word and informed David, and said, "I am pregnant."
verses.textEn: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, "I am pregnant."

verses.textZh: 大卫派人到约押那里，说："你打发赫人乌利亚到我这里来。"约押就打发乌利亚去见大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫派人到约押那里，说："你打发赫人乌利亚到我这里来。"约押就打发乌利亚去见大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫差人到约押那里，说：「你打发赫人乌利亚到我这里来。」约押就打发乌利亚去见大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: So David sent this word to Joab: "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent him to David.
verses.textEnEsv: So David sent word to Joab, "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David sent to Joab, saying, "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David sent word to Joab: "Send me Uriah the Hittite." So Joab sent him to David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David sent word to Joab: "Send me Uriah the Hittite." So Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.textEn: So David sent this word to Joab: "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent him to David.

verses.textZh: 乌利亚来到大卫那里，大卫就问约押和士兵可好，又问战场上的情形怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌利亚来到大卫那里，大卫就问约押和士兵可好，又问战场上的情形怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌利亚来了，大卫问约押好，也问兵好，又问争战的事怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab was, how the soldiers were and how the war was going.
verses.textEnEsv: When Uriah came to him, David asked how Joab was doing and how the people were doing and how the war was going.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Uriah had come to him, David asked how Joab was doing, and how the people were doing, and how the war prospered.
verses.textEnNlt: When Uriah arrived, David asked him how Joab and the army were getting along and how the war was progressing.
verses.textEnNasb: When Uriah came to him, David asked about Joab’s well-being and that of the people, and the condition of the war.
verses.textEn: When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab was, how the soldiers were and how the war was going.

verses.textZh: 大卫对乌利亚说："你回家去，洗洗脚吧！"乌利亚就离开了王宫。随后王的一份礼物也跟着送去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对乌利亚说："你回家去，洗洗脚吧！"乌利亚就离开了王宫。随后王的一份礼物也跟着送去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对乌利亚说：「你回家去，洗洗脚吧！」乌利亚出了王宫，随后王送他一分食物。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." And Uriah went out of the king’s house, and there followed him a present from the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah departed from the king’s house, and a gift offood from the king followed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he told Uriah, "Go on home and relax. " David even sent a gift to Uriah after he had left the palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house, and wash your feet." So Uriah left the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.
verses.textEn: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

verses.textZh: 乌利亚却和他主人的臣仆一同睡在王宫门外，没有回到自己家里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌利亚却和他主人的臣仆一同睡在王宫门外，没有回到自己家里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌利亚却和他主人的仆人一同睡在宫门外，没有回家去。
verses.textEnNiv: But Uriah slept at the entrance to the palace with all his master’s servants and did not go down to his house.
verses.textEnEsv: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and did not go down to his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and did not go down to his house.
verses.textEnNlt: But Uriah didn’t go home. He slept that night at the palace entrance with the king’s palace guard.
verses.textEnNasb: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and did not go down to his house.
verses.textEn: But Uriah slept at the entrance to the palace with all his master’s servants and did not go down to his house.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉大卫说："乌利亚没有下到自己家里去。"大卫就问乌利亚："你不是从远路回来吗？为甚么不下到自己家里去呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉大卫说："乌利亚没有下到自己家里去。"大卫就问乌利亚："你不是从远路回来吗？为甚么不下到自己家里去呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉大卫说：「乌利亚没有回家去。」大卫就问乌利亚说：「你从远路上来，为什么不回家去呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: David was told, "Uriah did not go home." So he asked Uriah, "Haven’t you just come from a military campaign? Why didn’t you go home?"
verses.textEnEsv: When they told David, "Uriah did not go down to his house," David said to Uriah, "Have you not come from a journey? Why did you not go down to your house?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they told David, saying, "Uriah did not go down to his house," David said to Uriah, "Did you not come from a journey? Why did you not go down to your house?"
verses.textEnNlt: When David heard that Uriah had not gone home, he summoned him and asked, "What’s the matter? Why didn’t you go home last night after being away for so long?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they informed David, saying, "Uriah did not go down to his house," David said to Uriah, "Did you not come from a journey? Why did you not go down to your house?"
verses.textEn: David was told, "Uriah did not go home." So he asked Uriah, "Haven’t you just come from a military campaign? Why didn’t you go home?"

verses.textZh: 乌利亚回答大卫说："约柜、以色列人和犹大人都住在棚里，我主人约押和我主人的臣仆都在野地安营，我怎能回家吃喝，与妻子同睡呢？我指着王和王的生命发誓：我绝不敢作这样的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌利亚回答大卫说："约柜、以色列人和犹大人都住在棚里，我主人约押和我主人的臣仆都在野地安营，我怎能回家吃喝，与妻子同睡呢？我指着王和王的生命发誓：我绝不敢作这样的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 乌利亚对大卫说：「约柜和以色列与犹大兵都住在棚里，我主约押和我主 的仆人都在田野安营，我岂可回家吃喝、与妻子同寝呢？我敢在王面前起誓 ：我决不行这事！」
verses.textEnNiv: Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are staying in tents, and my commander Joab and my lord’s men are camped in the open country. How could I go to my house to eat and drink and make love to my wife? As surely as you live, I will not do such a thing!"
verses.textEnEsv: Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah dwell in booths, and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are camping in the open field. Shall I then go to my house, to eat and to drink and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are dwelling in tents, and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open fields. Shall I then go to my house to eat and drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing."
verses.textEnNlt: Uriah replied, "The Ark and the armies of Israel and Judah are living in tents, and Joab and my master’s men are camping in the open fields. How could I go home to wine and dine and sleep with my wife? I swear that I would never do such a thing."
verses.textEnNasb: And Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are staying in temporary shelters, and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are camping in the open field. Should I then go to my house to eat and drink and to sleep with my wife? By your life and the life of your soul, I will not do this thing."
verses.textEn: Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are staying in tents, and my commander Joab and my lord’s men are camped in the open country. How could I go to my house to eat and drink and make love to my wife? As surely as you live, I will not do such a thing!"

verses.textZh: 大卫对乌利亚说："你今天还留在这里，明天我才打发你去。"那一天，乌利亚就留在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对乌利亚说："你今天还留在这里，明天我才打发你去。"那一天，乌利亚就留在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫吩咐乌利亚说：「你今日仍住在这里，明日我打发你去。」于是乌利亚那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to him, "Stay here one more day, and tomorrow I will send you back." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Uriah, "Remain here today also, and tomorrow I will send you back." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to Uriah, "Wait here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, stay here today," David told him, "and tomorrow you may return to the army." So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Uriah, "Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you go back." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the day after.
verses.textEn: Then David said to him, "Stay here one more day, and tomorrow I will send you back." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.

verses.textZh: 次日，大卫召了乌利亚来，叫乌利亚与他一起吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，乌利亚出去，与他主人的臣仆一同睡在自己的床铺上，还是没有下到自己家里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日，大卫召了乌利亚来，叫乌利亚与他一起吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，乌利亚出去，与他主人的臣仆一同睡在自己的床铺上，还是没有下到自己家里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫召了乌利亚来，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，乌利亚出去与他主的仆人一同住宿，还没有回到家里去。
verses.textEnNiv: At David’s invitation, he ate and drank with him, and David made him drunk. But in the evening Uriah went out to sleep on his mat among his master’s servants; he did not go home.
verses.textEnEsv: And David invited him, and he ate in his presence and drank, so that he made him drunk. And in the evening he went out to lie on his couch with the servants of his lord, but he did not go down to his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when David called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. And at evening he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but he did not go down to his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David invited him to dinner and got him drunk. But even then he couldn’t get Uriah to go home to his wife. Again he slept at the palace entrance with the king’s palace guard.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David summoned Uriah, and he ate and drank in his presence, and he made Uriah drunk; and in the evening Uriah went out to lie on his bed with his lord’s servants, and he still did not go down to his house.
verses.textEn: At David’s invitation, he ate and drank with him, and David made him drunk. But in the evening Uriah went out to sleep on his mat among his master’s servants; he did not go home.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，大卫写了一封给约押的信，交乌利亚亲手带去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，大卫写了一封给约押的信，交乌利亚亲手带去。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日早晨，大卫写信与约押，交乌利亚随手带去。
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the morning it happened that David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
verses.textEnNlt: So the next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and gave it to Uriah to deliver.
verses.textEnNasb: So in the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
verses.textEn: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.

verses.textZh: 他在信里写着说："要把乌利亚派到战斗最猛烈的前线去，然后你们就退到他后边，让他被击杀。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在信里写着说："要把乌利亚派到战斗最猛烈的前线去，然后你们就退到他后边，让他被击杀。"
verses.textZhCuv: 信内写着说：「要派乌利亚前进，到阵势极险之处，你们便退后，使他被杀。」
verses.textEnNiv: In it he wrote, "Put Uriah out in front where the fighting is fiercest. Then withdraw from him so he will be struck down and die."
verses.textEnEsv: In the letter he wrote, "Set Uriah in the forefront of the hardest fighting, and then draw back from him, that he may be struck down, and die."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he wrote in the letter, saying, "Set Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck down and die."
verses.textEnNlt: The letter instructed Joab, "Station Uriah on the front lines where the battle is fiercest. Then pull back so that he will be killed."
verses.textEnNasb: He had written in the letter the following: " Station Uriah on the front line of the fiercest battle and pull back from him, so that he may be struck and killed."
verses.textEn: In it he wrote, "Put Uriah out in front where the fighting is fiercest. Then withdraw from him so he will be struck down and die."

verses.textZh: 那时，约押正在围城，他知道哪里有强悍的守军，就派乌利亚到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约押正在围城，他知道哪里有强悍的守军，就派乌利亚到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押围城的时候，知道敌人那里有勇士，便将乌利亚派在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: So while Joab had the city under siege, he put Uriah at a place where he knew the strongest defenders were.
verses.textEnEsv: And as Joab was besieging the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew there were valiant men.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, while Joab besieged the city, that he assigned Uriah to a place where he knew there were valiant men.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joab assigned Uriah to a spot close to the city wall where he knew the enemy’s strongest men were fighting.
verses.textEnNasb: So it was as Joab kept watch on the city, that he stationed Uriah at the place where he knew there were valiant men.
verses.textEn: So while Joab had the city under siege, he put Uriah at a place where he knew the strongest defenders were.

verses.textZh: 城里的人出来，与约押交战。大卫的仆人中有一些倒毙了，赫人乌利亚也死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里的人出来，与约押交战。大卫的仆人中有一些倒毙了，赫人乌利亚也死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 城里的人出来和约押打仗；大卫的仆人中有几个被杀的，赫人乌利亚也死了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of the men in David’s army fell; moreover, Uriah the Hittite died.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of the city came out and fought with Joab, and some of the servants of David among the people fell. Uriah the Hittite also died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of the city came out and fought with Joab. And some of the people of the servants of David fell; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
verses.textEnNlt: And when the enemy soldiers came out of the city to fight, Uriah the Hittite was killed along with several other Israelite soldiers.
verses.textEnNasb: And the men of the city went out and fought against Joab, and some of the people among David’s servants fell; and Uriah the Hittite also died.
verses.textEn: When the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of the men in David’s army fell; moreover, Uriah the Hittite died.

verses.textZh: 于是，约押派人去把战事的一切情形都报告大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约押派人去把战事的一切情形都报告大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约押差人去将争战的一切事告诉大卫，
verses.textEnNiv: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joab sent and told David all the news about the fighting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joab sent a battle report to David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab sent a messenger and reported to David all the events of the war.
verses.textEn: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.

verses.textEnNkjv: and charged the messenger, saying, "When you have finished telling the matters of the war to the king,

verses.textEn: He instructed the messenger: "When you have finished giving the king this account of the battle,

verses.textZh: 王若是大怒，责问你：‘你们为甚么那样靠近那城争战呢？你们不知道敌人会从城墙上射箭下来吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 王若是大怒，责问你：‘你们为甚么那样靠近那城争战呢？你们不知道敌人会从城墙上射箭下来吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 王若发怒，问你说：『你们打仗为什么挨近城墙呢？岂不知敌人必从城上射箭吗？
verses.textEnNiv: the king’s anger may flare up, and he may ask you, ‘Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn’t you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?
verses.textEnEsv: then, if the king’s anger rises, and if he says to you, ‘Why did you go so near the city to fight? Did you not know that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.textEnNkjv: if it happens that the king’s wrath rises, and he says to you: ‘Why did you approach so near to the city when you fought? Did you not know that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.textEnNlt: But he might get angry and ask, ‘Why did the troops go so close to the city? Didn’t they know there would be shooting from the walls?
verses.textEnNasb: then it shall be that if the king’s wrath rises and he says to you, ‘Why did you move against the city to fight? Did you not know that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.textEn: the king’s anger may flare up, and he may ask you, ‘Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn’t you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?

verses.textZh: 从前击杀了耶路．比设的儿子亚比米勒的是谁呢？不是一个妇人从城墙上把一块磨石丢在他身上，他就死在提备斯吗？你们为甚么靠近城墙呢？’你就回答：‘王的仆人赫人乌利亚也死了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前击杀了耶路．比设的儿子亚比米勒的是谁呢？不是一个妇人从城墙上把一块磨石丢在他身上，他就死在提备斯吗？你们为甚么靠近城墙呢？’你就回答：‘王的仆人赫人乌利亚也死了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前打死耶路‧比设 儿子亚比米勒的是谁呢？岂不是一个妇人从城上抛下一块上磨石来，打在他身上，他就死在提备斯吗？你们为什么挨近城墙呢？』你就说：『王的仆人－赫人乌利亚也死了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Who killed Abimelek son of Jerub-Besheth ? Didn’t a woman drop an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?’ If he asks you this, then say to him, ‘Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Who killed Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Did not a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Was it not a woman who cast a piece of a millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you go near the wall?’—then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Wasn’t Abimelech son of Gideon killed at Thebez by a woman who threw a millstone down on him from the wall? Why would you get so close to the wall?’ Then tell him, ‘Uriah the Hittite was killed, too.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Did a woman not throw an upper millstone on him from the wall so that he died at Thebez? Why did you move against the wall?’—then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite also died.’ "
verses.textEn: Who killed Abimelek son of Jerub-Besheth ? Didn’t a woman drop an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?’ If he asks you this, then say to him, ‘Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是那使者去了；他一来到，就把约押差遣他所要说的一切都报告了大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那使者去了；他一来到，就把约押差遣他所要说的一切都报告了大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 使者起身，来见大卫，照着约押所吩咐他的话奏告大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: The messenger set out, and when he arrived he told David everything Joab had sent him to say.
verses.textEnEsv: So the messenger went and came and told David all that Joab had sent him to tell.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the messenger went, and came and told David all that Joab had sent by him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the messenger went to Jerusalem and gave a complete report to David.
verses.textEnNasb: So the messenger departed and came and reported to David everything that Joab had sent him to tell.
verses.textEn: The messenger set out, and when he arrived he told David everything Joab had sent him to say.

verses.textZh: 那使者又对大卫说："那些人比我们强，他们出到旷野攻打我们，我们把他们赶回城门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那使者又对大卫说："那些人比我们强，他们出到旷野攻打我们，我们把他们赶回城门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 使者对大卫说：「敌人强过我们，出到郊野与我们打仗，我们追杀他们，直到城门口。
verses.textEnNiv: The messenger said to David, "The men overpowered us and came out against us in the open, but we drove them back to the entrance of the city gate.
verses.textEnEsv: The messenger said to David, "The men gained an advantage over us and came out against us in the field, but we drove them back to the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the messenger said to David, "Surely the men prevailed against us and came out to us in the field; then we drove them back as far as the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: "The enemy came out against us in the open fields," he said. "And as we chased them back to the city gate,
verses.textEnNasb: The messenger said to David, "The men prevailed against us and came out against us in the field, but we pressed them as far as the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEn: The messenger said to David, "The men overpowered us and came out against us in the open, but we drove them back to the entrance of the city gate.

verses.textZh: 那时射手从城墙上射王的仆人；王的仆人中有些阵亡了，你的仆人赫人乌利亚也死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时射手从城墙上射王的仆人；王的仆人中有些阵亡了，你的仆人赫人乌利亚也死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 射箭的从城上射王的仆人，射死几个，赫人乌利亚也死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the archers shot arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king’s men died. Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the archers shot at your servants from the wall. Some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also."
verses.textEnNkjv: The archers shot from the wall at your servants; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also."
verses.textEnNlt: the archers on the wall shot arrows at us. Some of the king’s men were killed, including Uriah the Hittite."
verses.textEnNasb: Also, the archers shot at your servants from the wall; so some of the king’s servants died, and your servant Uriah the Hittite also died."
verses.textEn: Then the archers shot arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king’s men died. Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead."

verses.textZh: 大卫对那使者说："你要对约押这样说：‘不要为这件事难过，因为刀剑有时吞灭这人，有时吞灭那人。你只要加紧攻打这城，把城毁灭。’你要这样鼓励他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对那使者说："你要对约押这样说：‘不要为这件事难过，因为刀剑有时吞灭这人，有时吞灭那人。你只要加紧攻打这城，把城毁灭。’你要这样鼓励他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王向使者说：「你告诉约押说：『不要因这事愁闷，刀剑或吞灭这人或吞灭那人，没有一定的；你只管竭力攻城，将城倾覆。』可以用这话勉励约押。」
verses.textEnNiv: David told the messenger, "Say this to Joab: ‘Don’t let this upset you; the sword devours one as well as another. Press the attack against the city and destroy it.’ Say this to encourage Joab."
verses.textEnEsv: David said to the messenger, "Thus shall you say to Joab, ‘Do not let this matter displease you, for the sword devours now one and now another. Strengthen your attack against the city and overthrow it.’ And encourage him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David said to the messenger, "Thus you shall say to Joab: ‘Do not let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Strengthen your attack against the city, and overthrow it.’ So encourage him."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, tell Joab not to be discouraged," David said. "The sword devours this one today and that one tomorrow! Fight harder next time, and conquer the city!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to the messenger, "This is what you shall say to Joab: ‘Do not let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another; fight with determination against the city and overthrow it’; and thereby encourage him."
verses.textEn: David told the messenger, "Say this to Joab: ‘Don’t let this upset you; the sword devours one as well as another. Press the attack against the city and destroy it.’ Say this to encourage Joab."

verses.textZh: 乌利亚的妻子听到丈夫乌利亚死了，就为他哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌利亚的妻子听到丈夫乌利亚死了，就为他哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌利亚的妻听见丈夫乌利亚死了，就为他哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.
verses.textEnEsv: When the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she lamented over her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Uriah’s wife heard that her husband Uriah was dead, she mourned for her husband.
verses.textEn: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.

verses.textZh: 守丧期一过，大卫就派人去把拔示巴接到宫里，她就作了大卫的妻子，给大卫生了一个儿子。大卫所作的这事，耶和华看为恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守丧期一过，大卫就派人去把拔示巴接到宫里，她就作了大卫的妻子，给大卫生了一个儿子。大卫所作的这事，耶和华看为恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 哀哭的日子过了，大卫差人将她接到宫里，她就作了大卫的妻，给大卫生了一个儿子。但大卫所行的这事，耶和华甚不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: After the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing David had done displeased the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And when the mourning was over, David sent and brought her to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And when her mourning was over, David sent and brought her to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When the period of mourning was over, David sent for her and brought her to the palace, and she became one of his wives. Then she gave birth to a son. But the Lord was displeased with what David had done.
verses.textEnNasb: When the time of mourning was over, David sent servants and had her brought to his house and she became his wife; then she bore him a son. But the thing that David had done was evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: After the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing David had done displeased the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华差派拿单去见大卫。于是拿单来到大卫那里，对他说："在一座城里有两个人，一个富有，一个贫穷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华差派拿单去见大卫。于是拿单来到大卫那里，对他说："在一座城里有两个人，一个富有，一个贫穷。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华差遣拿单去见大卫。拿单到了大卫那里，对他说：「在一座城里有两个人：一个是富户，一个是穷人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord sent Nathan to David. When he came to him, he said, "There were two men in a certain town, one rich and the other poor.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord sent Nathan to David. He came to him and said to him, "There were two men in a certain city, the one rich and the other poor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord sent Nathan to David. And he came to him, and said to him: "There were two men in one city, one rich and the other poor.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord sent Nathan the prophet to tell David this story: "There were two men in a certain town. One was rich, and one was poor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord sent Nathan to David. And he came to him and said, "There were two men in a city, the one wealthy and the other poor.
verses.textEn: The Lord sent Nathan to David. When he came to him, he said, "There were two men in a certain town, one rich and the other poor.

verses.textZh: 那贫穷的除了买来养的一只母羊羔以外，甚么也没有。那小羊在他家里和他的儿女一同长大，小羊吃他的食物，喝他杯中的饮料，睡在他的怀里，就像他的女儿一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那贫穷的除了买来养的一只母羊羔以外，甚么也没有。那小羊在他家里和他的儿女一同长大，小羊吃他的食物，喝他杯中的饮料，睡在他的怀里，就像他的女儿一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 穷人除了所买来养活的一只小母羊羔之外，别无所有。羊羔在他家里和他儿女一同长大，吃他所吃的，喝他所喝的，睡在他怀中，在他看来如同女儿一样。
verses.textEnNiv: but the poor man had nothing except one little ewe lamb he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food, drank from his cup and even slept in his arms. It was like a daughter to him.
verses.textEnEsv: but the poor man had nothing but one little ewe lamb, which he had bought. And he brought it up, and it grew up with him and with his children. It used to eat of his morsel and drink from his cup and lie in his arms, and it was like a daughter to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the poor man had nothing, except one little ewe lamb which he had bought and nourished; and it grew up together with him and with his children. It ate of his own food and drank from his own cup and lay in his bosom; and it was like a daughter to him.
verses.textEnNlt: The poor man owned nothing but one little lamb he had bought. He raised that little lamb, and it grew up with his children. It ate from the man’s own plate and drank from his cup. He cuddled it in his arms like a baby daughter.
verses.textEnNasb: "But the poor man had nothing at all except one little ewe lamb Which he bought and nurtured; And it grew up together with him and his children. It would eat scraps from him and drink from his cup and lie in his lap, And was like a daughter to him.
verses.textEn: but the poor man had nothing except one little ewe lamb he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food, drank from his cup and even slept in his arms. It was like a daughter to him.

verses.textZh: 有一个旅客来到富翁那里，他舍不得从自己的牛群羊群中取一头出来，款待到他那里来的旅客，却取了那穷人的母羊羔，款待到他那里来的客人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个旅客来到富翁那里，他舍不得从自己的牛群羊群中取一头出来，款待到他那里来的旅客，却取了那穷人的母羊羔，款待到他那里来的客人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一客人来到这富户家里；富户舍不得从自己的牛群羊群中取一只预备给客人吃，却取了那穷人的羊羔，预备给客人吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Now a traveler came to the rich man, but the rich man refrained from taking one of his own sheep or cattle to prepare a meal for the traveler who had come to him. Instead, he took the ewe lamb that belonged to the poor man and prepared it for the one who had come to him."
verses.textEnEsv: Now there came a traveler to the rich man, and he was unwilling to take one of his own flock or herd to prepare for the guest who had come to him, but he took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a traveler came to the rich man, who refused to take from his own flock and from his own herd to prepare one for the wayfaring man who had come to him; but he took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him."
verses.textEnNlt: One day a guest arrived at the home of the rich man. But instead of killing an animal from his own flock or herd, he took the poor man’s lamb and killed it and prepared it for his guest."
verses.textEnNasb: "Now a visitor came to the wealthy man, And he could not bring himself to take any animal from his own flock or his own herd, To prepare for the traveler who had come to him; So he took the poor man’s ewe lamb and prepared it for the man who had come to him."
verses.textEn: "Now a traveler came to the rich man, but the rich man refrained from taking one of his own sheep or cattle to prepare a meal for the traveler who had come to him. Instead, he took the ewe lamb that belonged to the poor man and prepared it for the one who had come to him."

verses.textZh: 大卫就非常恼怒那人，对拿单说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，作这事的人该死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就非常恼怒那人，对拿单说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，作这事的人该死。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就甚恼怒那人，对拿单说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，行这事的人该死！
verses.textEnNiv: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan, "As surely as the Lord lives, the man who did this must die!
verses.textEnEsv: Then David’s anger was greatly kindled against the man, and he said to Nathan, "As the Lord lives, the man who has done this deserves to die,
verses.textEnNkjv: So David’s anger was greatly aroused against the man, and he said to Nathan, "As the Lord lives, the man who has done this shall surely die!
verses.textEnNlt: David was furious. "As surely as the Lord lives," he vowed, "any man who would do such a thing deserves to die!
verses.textEnNasb: Then David’s anger burned greatly against the man, and he said to Nathan, "As the Lord lives, the man who has done this certainly deserves to die!
verses.textEn: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan, "As surely as the Lord lives, the man who did this must die!

verses.textZh: 他必须四倍赔偿这羊羔，因为他作了这事，又因他没有怜悯的心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必须四倍赔偿这羊羔，因为他作了这事，又因他没有怜悯的心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他必偿还羊羔四倍；因为他行这事，没有怜恤的心。」
verses.textEnNiv: He must pay for that lamb four times over, because he did such a thing and had no pity."
verses.textEnEsv: and he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall restore fourfold for the lamb, because he did this thing and because he had no pity."
verses.textEnNlt: He must repay four lambs to the poor man for the one he stole and for having no pity."
verses.textEnNasb: So he must make restitution for the lamb four times over, since he did this thing and had no compassion."
verses.textEn: He must pay for that lamb four times over, because he did such a thing and had no pity."

verses.textZh: 拿单对大卫说："你就是那人！耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我膏立了你作以色列的王，把你从扫罗的手里救了出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿单对大卫说："你就是那人！耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我膏立了你作以色列的王，把你从扫罗的手里救了出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单对大卫说：「你就是那人！耶和华－以色列的神如此说：『我膏你作以色列的王，救你脱离扫罗的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Nathan said to David, "You are the man! This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: Nathan said to David, "You are the man! Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nathan said to David, "You are the man! Thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nathan said to David, "You are that man! The Lord , the God of Israel, says: I anointed you king of Israel and saved you from the power of Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: Nathan then said to David, "You yourself are the man! This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘It is I who anointed you as king over Israel, and it is I who rescued you from the hand of Saul.
verses.textEn: Then Nathan said to David, "You are the man! This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.

verses.textZh: 把你主人的家赐给你，把你主人的妻妾交在你怀里，又把以色列和犹大家赐给你。如果太少了，我还可以多多加给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把你主人的家赐给你，把你主人的妻妾交在你怀里，又把以色列和犹大家赐给你。如果太少了，我还可以多多加给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将你主人的家业赐给你，将你主人的妻交在你怀里，又将以色列和犹大家赐给你；你若还以为不足，我早就加倍地赐给你。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave your master’s house to you, and your master’s wives into your arms. I gave you all Israel and Judah. And if all this had been too little, I would have given you even more.
verses.textEnEsv: And I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your arms and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah. And if this were too little, I would add to you as much more.
verses.textEnNkjv: I gave you your master’s house and your master’s wives into your keeping, and gave you the house of Israel and Judah. And if thathadbeen too little, I also would have given you much more!
verses.textEnNlt: I gave you your master’s house and his wives and the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. And if that had not been enough, I would have given you much, much more.
verses.textEnNasb: I also gave you your master’s house and put your master’s wives into your care, and I gave you the house of Israel and Judah; and if that had been too little, I would have added to you many more things like these!
verses.textEn: I gave your master’s house to you, and your master’s wives into your arms. I gave you all Israel and Judah. And if all this had been too little, I would have given you even more.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么藐视耶和华的话，行他看为恶的事呢？你用刀击杀了赫人乌利亚，娶了他的妻子作你的妻子，你借着亚扪人的刀杀了乌利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么藐视耶和华的话，行他看为恶的事呢？你用刀击杀了赫人乌利亚，娶了他的妻子作你的妻子，你借着亚扪人的刀杀了乌利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为什么藐视耶和华的命令，行他眼中看为恶的事呢？你借亚扪人的刀杀害赫人乌利亚，又娶了他的妻为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Why did you despise the word of the Lord by doing what is evil in his eyes? You struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and took his wife to be your own. You killed him with the sword of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: Why have you despised the word of the Lord , to do what is evil in his sight? You have struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and have taken his wife to be your wife and have killed him with the sword of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why have you despised the commandment of the Lord, to do evil in His sight? You have killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword; you have taken his wife tobe your wife, and have killed him with the sword of the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: Why, then, have you despised the word of the Lord and done this horrible deed? For you have murdered Uriah the Hittite with the sword of the Ammonites and stolen his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: Why have you despised the word of the Lord, by doing evil in His sight? You have struck and killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, you have taken his wife as your wife, and you have slaughtered him with the sword of the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: Why did you despise the word of the Lord by doing what is evil in his eyes? You struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and took his wife to be your own. You killed him with the sword of the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 所以，从今以后，刀剑必不离开你的家，因为你藐视了我，娶了赫人乌利亚的妻子作你的妻子。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，从今以后，刀剑必不离开你的家，因为你藐视了我，娶了赫人乌利亚的妻子作你的妻子。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你既藐视我，娶了赫人乌利亚的妻为妻，所以刀剑必永不离开你的家。』
verses.textEnNiv: Now, therefore, the sword will never depart from your house, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your own.’
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from your house, because you have despised me and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your wife.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, the sword shall never depart from your house, because you have despised Me, and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your wife.’
verses.textEnNlt: From this time on, your family will live by the sword because you have despised me by taking Uriah’s wife to be your own.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, the sword shall never leave your house, because you have despised Me and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your wife.’
verses.textEn: Now, therefore, the sword will never depart from your house, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your own.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必从你家中兴起祸患攻击你；我要在你的眼前把你的妃嫔拿去赐给你的同伴。他要在光天化日之下与她们同床。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必从你家中兴起祸患攻击你；我要在你的眼前把你的妃嫔拿去赐给你的同伴。他要在光天化日之下与她们同床。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：『我必从你家中兴起祸患攻击你；我必在你眼前把你的妃嫔赐给别人，他在日光之下就与她们同寝。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Out of your own household I am going to bring calamity on you. Before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to one who is close to you, and he will sleep with your wives in broad daylight.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house. And I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he shall lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will raise up adversity against you from your own house; and I will take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he shall lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: Because of what you have done, I will cause your own household to rebel against you. I will give your wives to another man before your very eyes, and he will go to bed with them in public view.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, I am going to raise up evil against you from your own household; I will even take your wives before your eyes and give them to your companion, and he will sleep with your wives in broad daylight.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Out of your own household I am going to bring calamity on you. Before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to one who is close to you, and he will sleep with your wives in broad daylight.

verses.textZh: 你在暗中行了这事，我却要在所有以色列人面前，在光天化日之下行这事报应你。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在暗中行了这事，我却要在所有以色列人面前，在光天化日之下行这事报应你。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你在暗中行这事，我却要在以色列众人面前，日光之下，报应你。』」
verses.textEnNiv: You did it in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For you did it secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel and before the sun.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For you did it secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, before the sun.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You did it secretly, but I will make this happen to you openly in the sight of all Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, you did it secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and in open daylight.’ "
verses.textEn: You did it in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.’ "

verses.textZh: 大卫对拿单说："我得罪了耶和华了。"拿单对大卫说："耶和华已经除去了你的罪，你必不至于死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对拿单说："我得罪了耶和华了。"拿单对大卫说："耶和华已经除去了你的罪，你必不至于死。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对拿单说：「我得罪耶和华了！」拿单说：「耶和华已经除掉你的罪，你必不至于死。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against the Lord ." Nathan replied, "The Lord has taken away your sin. You are not going to die.
verses.textEnEsv: David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against the Lord ." And Nathan said to David, "The Lord also has put away your sin; you shall not die.
