verses.textEnNkjv: So David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against the Lord." And Nathan said to David, "The Lord also has put away your sin; you shall not die.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David confessed to Nathan, "I have sinned against the Lord ." Nathan replied, "Yes, but the Lord has forgiven you, and you won’t die for this sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against the Lord." And Nathan said to David, "The Lord also has allowed your sin to pass; you shall not die.
verses.textEn: Then David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against the Lord ." Nathan replied, "The Lord has taken away your sin. You are not going to die.

verses.textZh: 只是因为你作了这事，使耶和华的仇敌大得亵渎的机会，所以你所生的儿子必定死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是因为你作了这事，使耶和华的仇敌大得亵渎的机会，所以你所生的儿子必定死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你行这事，叫耶和华的仇敌大得亵渎的机会，故此，你所得的孩子必定要死。」
verses.textEnNiv: But because by doing this you have shown utter contempt for the Lord , the son born to you will die."
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, because by this deed you have utterly scorned the Lord , the child who is born to you shall die."
verses.textEnNkjv: However, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the enemies of the Lord to blaspheme, the child also whois born to you shall surely die."
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, because you have shown utter contempt for the word of the Lord by doing this, your child will die."
verses.textEnNasb: However, since by this deed you have shown utter disrespect for the Lord, the child himself who is born to you shall certainly die."
verses.textEn: But because by doing this you have shown utter contempt for the Lord , the son born to you will die."

verses.textZh: 于是拿单回自己的家去了。 耶和华击打乌利亚的妻子给大卫所生的孩子，他就害了重病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拿单回自己的家去了。 耶和华击打乌利亚的妻子给大卫所生的孩子，他就害了重病。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单就回家去了。 耶和华击打乌利亚妻给大卫所生的孩子，使他得重病。
verses.textEnNiv: After Nathan had gone home, the Lord struck the child that Uriah’s wife had borne to David, and he became ill.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Nathan went to his house. And the Lord afflicted the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and he became sick.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nathan departed to his house. And the Lord struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and it became ill.
verses.textEnNlt: After Nathan returned to his home, the Lord sent a deadly illness to the child of David and Uriah’s wife.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nathan went to his house. Later the Lord struck the child that Uriah’s widow bore to David, so that he was very sick.
verses.textEn: After Nathan had gone home, the Lord struck the child that Uriah’s wife had borne to David, and he became ill.

verses.textZh: 大卫为那孩子恳求神，并且禁食。他进房里去，终夜躺在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫为那孩子恳求神，并且禁食。他进房里去，终夜躺在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以大卫为这孩子恳求神，而且禁食，进入内室，终夜躺在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: David pleaded with God for the child. He fasted and spent the nights lying in sackcloth on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: David therefore sought God on behalf of the child. And David fasted and went in and lay all night on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: David therefore pleaded with God for the child, and David fasted and went in and lay all night on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: David begged God to spare the child. He went without food and lay all night on the bare ground.
verses.textEnNasb: David therefore pleaded with God for the child; and David fasted and went and lay all night on the ground.
verses.textEn: David pleaded with God for the child. He fasted and spent the nights lying in sackcloth on the ground.

verses.textZh: 他家中的老侍从站在他旁边，要把他从地上扶起来，他却不肯，也不与他们一起吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他家中的老侍从站在他旁边，要把他从地上扶起来，他却不肯，也不与他们一起吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他家中的老臣来到他旁边，要把他从地上扶起来，他却不肯起来，也不同他们吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: The elders of his household stood beside him to get him up from the ground, but he refused, and he would not eat any food with them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the elders of his house stood beside him, to raise him from the ground, but he would not, nor did he eat food with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the elders of his house arose andwent to him, to raise him up from the ground. But he would not, nor did he eat food with them.
verses.textEnNlt: The elders of his household pleaded with him to get up and eat with them, but he refused.
verses.textEnNasb: The elders of his household stood beside him in order to help him up from the ground, but he was unwilling and would not eat food with them.
verses.textEn: The elders of his household stood beside him to get him up from the ground, but he refused, and he would not eat any food with them.

verses.textZh: 到了第七天，孩子死了。大卫的臣仆不敢告诉他孩子死了，因为他们说："看哪，孩子还活着的时候，我们劝他，他尚且不听我们的话。现在我们怎么能告诉他孩子已经死了呢？他会伤心欲绝的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七天，孩子死了。大卫的臣仆不敢告诉他孩子死了，因为他们说："看哪，孩子还活着的时候，我们劝他，他尚且不听我们的话。现在我们怎么能告诉他孩子已经死了呢？他会伤心欲绝的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到第七日，孩子死了。大卫的臣仆不敢告诉他孩子死了，因他们说：「孩子还活着的时候，我们劝他，他尚且不肯听我们的话，若告诉他孩子死了，岂不更加忧伤吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day the child died. David’s attendants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they thought, "While the child was still living, he wouldn’t listen to us when we spoke to him. How can we now tell him the child is dead? He may do something desperate."
verses.textEnEsv: On the seventh day the child died. And the servants of David were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, "Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him, and he did not listen to us. How then can we say to him the child is dead? He may do himself some harm."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then on the seventh day it came to pass that the child died. And the servants of David were afraid to tell him that the child was dead. For they said, "Indeed, while the child was alive, we spoke to him, and he would not heed our voice. How can we tell him that the child is dead? He may do some harm!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then on the seventh day the child died. David’s advisers were afraid to tell him. "He wouldn’t listen to reason while the child was ill," they said. "What drastic thing will he do when we tell him the child is dead?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened on the seventh day that the child died. And David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, "Behold, while the child was still alive, we spoke to him and he did not listen to us. How then can we tell him that the child is dead, since he might do himself harm?"
verses.textEn: On the seventh day the child died. David’s attendants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they thought, "While the child was still living, he wouldn’t listen to us when we spoke to him. How can we now tell him the child is dead? He may do something desperate."

verses.textZh: 大卫看见他的臣仆彼此低声耳语，就知道孩子已经死了。他问臣仆说："孩子死了吗？"他们回答："死了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫看见他的臣仆彼此低声耳语，就知道孩子已经死了。他问臣仆说："孩子死了吗？"他们回答："死了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫见臣仆彼此低声说话，就知道孩子死了，问臣仆说：「孩子死了吗？」他们说：「死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: David noticed that his attendants were whispering among themselves, and he realized the child was dead. "Is the child dead?" he asked. "Yes," they replied, "he is dead."
verses.textEnEsv: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David understood that the child was dead. And David said to his servants, "Is the child dead?" They said, "He is dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: When David saw that his servants were whispering, David perceived that the child was dead. Therefore David said to his servants, "Is the child dead?" And they said, "He is dead."
verses.textEnNlt: When David saw them whispering, he realized what had happened. "Is the child dead?" he asked. "Yes," they replied, "he is dead."
verses.textEnNasb: But when David saw that his servants were whispering together, David perceived that the child was dead; so David said to his servants, "Is the child dead?" And they said, "He is dead."
verses.textEn: David noticed that his attendants were whispering among themselves, and he realized the child was dead. "Is the child dead?" he asked. "Yes," they replied, "he is dead."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫从地上起来，洗澡，抹膏，更换衣服，进耶和华的殿去敬拜，然后回到自己的宫里去，吩咐人给他摆上饭，他就吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫从地上起来，洗澡，抹膏，更换衣服，进耶和华的殿去敬拜，然后回到自己的宫里去，吩咐人给他摆上饭，他就吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就从地上起来，沐浴，抹膏，换了衣裳，进耶和华的殿敬拜；然后回宫，吩咐人摆饭，他便吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then David got up from the ground. After he had washed, put on lotions and changed his clothes, he went into the house of the Lord and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and at his request they served him food, and he ate.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David arose from the earth and washed and anointed himself and changed his clothes. And he went into the house of the Lord and worshiped. He then went to his own house. And when he asked, they set food before him, and he ate.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David arose from the ground, washed and anointed himself, and changed his clothes; and he went into the house of the Lord and worshiped. Then he went to his own house; and when he requested, they set food before him, and he ate.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David got up from the ground, washed himself, put on lotions, and changed his clothes. He went to the Tabernacle and worshiped the Lord . After that, he returned to the palace and was served food and ate.
verses.textEnNasb: So David got up from the ground, washed, anointed himself, and changed his clothes; and he went into the house of the Lord and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and when he asked, they served him food, and he ate.
verses.textEn: Then David got up from the ground. After he had washed, put on lotions and changed his clothes, he went into the house of the Lord and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and at his request they served him food, and he ate.

verses.textZh: 臣仆问他："你为甚么这样作呢？孩子还活着的时候，你为他禁食哭泣；孩子死了，你倒起来吃饭！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 臣仆问他："你为甚么这样作呢？孩子还活着的时候，你为他禁食哭泣；孩子死了，你倒起来吃饭！"
verses.textZhCuv: 臣仆问他说：「你所行的是什么意思？孩子活着的时候，你禁食哭泣；孩子死了，你倒起来吃饭。」
verses.textEnNiv: His attendants asked him, "Why are you acting this way? While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but now that the child is dead, you get up and eat!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then his servants said to him, "What is this thing that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive; but when the child died, you arose and ate food."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his servants said to him, "What is this that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child whilehewas alive, but when the child died, you arose and ate food."
verses.textEnNlt: His advisers were amazed. "We don’t understand you," they told him. "While the child was still living, you wept and refused to eat. But now that the child is dead, you have stopped your mourning and are eating again."
verses.textEnNasb: Then his servants said to him, "What is this thing that you have done? You fasted and wept for the child while he was alive; but when the child died, you got up and ate food."
verses.textEn: His attendants asked him, "Why are you acting this way? While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but now that the child is dead, you get up and eat!"

verses.textZh: 他回答："孩子还活着的时候，我禁食哭泣，因为我想：‘谁知道呢？也许耶和华怜悯我，让孩子可以活着。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："孩子还活着的时候，我禁食哭泣，因为我想：‘谁知道呢？也许耶和华怜悯我，让孩子可以活着。’
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫说：「孩子还活着，我禁食哭泣；因为我想，或者耶和华怜恤我，使孩子不死也未可知。
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept. I thought, ‘Who knows? The Lord may be gracious to me and let the child live.’
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept, for I said, ‘Who knows whether the Lord will be gracious to me, that the child may live?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "While the child was alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who can tell whether the Lord will be gracious to me, that the child may live?’
verses.textEnNlt: David replied, "I fasted and wept while the child was alive, for I said, ‘Perhaps the Lord will be gracious to me and let the child live.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept; for I said, ‘Who knows, the Lord may be gracious to me, and the child may live.’
verses.textEn: He answered, "While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept. I thought, ‘Who knows? The Lord may be gracious to me and let the child live.’

verses.textZh: 现在他死了，我为甚么还要禁食呢？我还能使他回来吗？我要到他那里去，他却不能回到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在他死了，我为甚么还要禁食呢？我还能使他回来吗？我要到他那里去，他却不能回到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子死了，我何必禁食，我岂能使他返回呢？我必往他那里去，他却不能回我这里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: But now that he is dead, why should I go on fasting? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me."
verses.textEnEsv: But now he is dead. Why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he will not return to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But now he is dead; why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me."
verses.textEnNlt: But why should I fast when he is dead? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him one day, but he cannot return to me."
verses.textEnNasb: But now he has died; why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I am going to him, but he will not return to me."
verses.textEn: But now that he is dead, why should I go on fasting? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me."

verses.textZh: 大卫安慰他的妻子拔示巴，进到她那里去，与她同睡。她生了一个儿子，大卫给他起名叫所罗门；耶和华也喜爱他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫安慰他的妻子拔示巴，进到她那里去，与她同睡。她生了一个儿子，大卫给他起名叫所罗门；耶和华也喜爱他，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫安慰他的妻拔示巴，与她同寝，她就生了儿子，给他起名叫所罗门。耶和华也喜爱他，
verses.textEnNiv: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba, and he went to her and made love to her. She gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. The Lord loved him;
verses.textEnEsv: Then David comforted his wife, Bathsheba, and went in to her and lay with her, and she bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. And the Lord loved him
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her and lay with her. So she bore a son, and he called his name Solomon. Now the Lord loved him,
verses.textEnNlt: Then David comforted Bathsheba, his wife, and slept with her. She became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and David named him Solomon. The Lord loved the child
verses.textEnNasb: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba, and went in to her and slept with her; and she gave birth to a son, and he named him Solomon. Now the Lord loved him,
verses.textEn: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba, and he went to her and made love to her. She gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. The Lord loved him;

verses.textZh: 就差派拿单先知去，照着耶和华的吩咐，给他起名叫耶底底亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就差派拿单先知去，照着耶和华的吩咐，给他起名叫耶底底亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 就藉先知拿单赐他一个名字，叫耶底底亚，因为耶和华爱他。
verses.textEnNiv: and because the Lord loved him, he sent word through Nathan the prophet to name him Jedidiah.
verses.textEnEsv: and sent a message by Nathan the prophet. So he called his name Jedidiah, because of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and He sent word by the hand of Nathan the prophet: So he called his name Jedidiah, because of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: and sent word through Nathan the prophet that they should name him Jedidiah (which means "beloved of the Lord "), as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: and sent word through Nathan the prophet, and he named him Jedidiah for the Lord’s sake.
verses.textEn: and because the Lord loved him, he sent word through Nathan the prophet to name him Jedidiah.

verses.textZh: 那时，约押正在攻打亚扪人的拉巴，攻取了王城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约押正在攻打亚扪人的拉巴，攻取了王城。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押攻取亚扪人的京城拉巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal citadel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and took the royal city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the people of Ammon, and took the royal city.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Joab was fighting against Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and he captured the royal fortifications.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, and captured the royal city.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal citadel.

verses.textZh: 约押派遣使者去见大卫，说："我攻打拉巴，已经攻取了水城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押派遣使者去见大卫，说："我攻打拉巴，已经攻取了水城。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押打发使者去见大卫，说：「我攻打拉巴，取其水城。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, "I have fought against Rabbah and taken its water supply.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab sent messengers to David and said, "I have fought against Rabbah; moreover, I have taken the city of waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, "I have fought against Rabbah, and I have taken the city’s water supply.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab sent messengers to tell David, "I have fought against Rabbah and captured its water supply.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab sent messengers to David and said, "I have fought against Rabbah, I have even captured the city of waters.
verses.textEn: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, "I have fought against Rabbah and taken its water supply.

verses.textZh: 现在，请你聚集其余的人民，安营攻打这城，把城攻取；免得我攻取了这城，人就以我的名字来叫这城。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，请你聚集其余的人民，安营攻打这城，把城攻取；免得我攻取了这城，人就以我的名字来叫这城。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要聚集其余的军兵来，安营围攻这城，恐怕我取了这城，人就以我的名叫这城。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture it. Otherwise I will take the city, and it will be named after me."
verses.textEnEsv: Now then gather the rest of the people together and encamp against the city and take it, lest I take the city and it be called by my name."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, gather the rest of the people together and encamp against the city and take it, lest I take the city and it be called after my name."
verses.textEnNlt: Now bring the rest of the army and capture the city. Otherwise, I will capture it and get credit for the victory."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, gather the rest of the people and camp opposite the city and capture it, or I will capture the city myself and it will be named after me."
verses.textEn: Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture it. Otherwise I will take the city, and it will be named after me."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫聚集所有的人民，向拉巴进军；攻打那城，把它攻取了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫聚集所有的人民，向拉巴进军；攻打那城，把它攻取了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫聚集众军，往拉巴去攻城，就取了这城，
verses.textEnNiv: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.
verses.textEnEsv: So David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah and fought against it and took it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David gathered all the people together and went to Rabbah, fought against it, and took it.
verses.textEnNlt: So David gathered the rest of the army and went to Rabbah, and he fought against it and captured it.
verses.textEnNasb: So David gathered all the people and went to Rabbah, and he fought against it and captured it.
verses.textEn: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.

verses.textZh: 大卫从他们的王的头上夺取了王冠。王冠的金子重三十五公斤，上面嵌有宝石，人把这冠冕戴在大卫的头上。大卫又从这城里带走了许多战利品，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫从他们的王的头上夺取了王冠。王冠的金子重三十五公斤，上面嵌有宝石，人把这冠冕戴在大卫的头上。大卫又从这城里带走了许多战利品，
verses.textZhCuv: 夺了亚扪人之王所戴的金冠冕 ，其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌着宝石。人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，
verses.textEnNiv: David took the crown from their king’s head, and it was placed on his own head. It weighed a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones. David took a great quantity of plunder from the city
verses.textEnEsv: And he took the crown of their king from his head. The weight of it was a talent of gold, and in it was a precious stone, and it was placed on David’s head. And he brought out the spoil of the city, a very great amount.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took their king’s crown from his head. Its weight was a talent of gold, with precious stones. And it was set on David’s head. Also he brought out the spoil of the city in great abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: David removed the crown from the king’s head, and it was placed on his own head. The crown was made of gold and set with gems, and it weighed seventy-five pounds. David took a vast amount of plunder from the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took the crown of their king from his head; and its weight was a talent of gold, and it had a precious stone; and it was placed on David’s head. And he brought out the plunder of the city in great amounts.
verses.textEn: David took the crown from their king’s head, and it was placed on his own head. It weighed a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones. David took a great quantity of plunder from the city

verses.textZh: 又把那城里的人民带出去，使他们用锯子、铁耙、铁斧作工，或使他们在砖窑服役。大卫对待亚扪各城的居民都是这样。后来，大卫和众人都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把那城里的人民带出去，使他们用锯子、铁耙、铁斧作工，或使他们在砖窑服役。大卫对待亚扪各城的居民都是这样。后来，大卫和众人都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或铁斧下，或叫他经过砖窑 ；大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后，大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes, and he made them work at brickmaking. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then he and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought out the people who were in it and set them to labor with saws and iron picks and iron axes and made them toil at the brick kilns. And thus he did to all the cities of the Ammonites. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought out the people who were in it, and put themtowork with saws and iron picks and iron axes, and made them cross over to the brick works. So he did to all the cities of the people of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made slaves of the people of Rabbah and forced them to labor with saws, iron picks, and iron axes, and to work in the brick kilns. That is how he dealt with the people of all the Ammonite towns. Then David and all the army returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: He also brought out the people who were in it, and put some to work at saws, iron picks, and iron axes, and made others serve at the brick works. And he did the same to all the cities of the sons of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes, and he made them work at brickmaking. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then he and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 大卫的儿子押沙龙有一个美丽的妹妹，名叫他玛；大卫的儿子暗嫩爱上了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的儿子押沙龙有一个美丽的妹妹，名叫他玛；大卫的儿子暗嫩爱上了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的儿子押沙龙有一个美貌的妹子，名叫她玛。大卫的儿子暗嫩爱她。
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, Amnon son of David fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of Absalom son of David.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Absalom, David’s son, had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar. And after a time Amnon, David’s son, loved her.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this Absalom the son of David had a lovely sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
verses.textEnNlt: Now David’s son Absalom had a beautiful sister named Tamar. And Amnon, her half brother, fell desperately in love with her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was after this that Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister whose name was Tamar, and Amnon the son of David was in love with her.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, Amnon son of David fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of Absalom son of David.

verses.textZh: 暗嫩为了他妹妹他玛的缘故，因爱成病。因为他玛还是处女，所以暗嫩看来很难对她采取甚么行动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗嫩为了他妹妹他玛的缘故，因爱成病。因为他玛还是处女，所以暗嫩看来很难对她采取甚么行动。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗嫩为他妹子她玛忧急成病。她玛还是处女，暗嫩以为难向她行事。
verses.textEnNiv: Amnon became so obsessed with his sister Tamar that he made himself ill. She was a virgin, and it seemed impossible for him to do anything to her.
verses.textEnEsv: And Amnon was so tormented that he made himself ill because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible to Amnon to do anything to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Amnon was so distressed over his sister Tamar that he became sick; for she was a virgin. And it was improper for Amnon to do anything to her.
verses.textEnNlt: Amnon became so obsessed with Tamar that he became ill. She was a virgin, and Amnon thought he could never have her.
verses.textEnNasb: But Amnon was so frustrated on account of his sister Tamar that he made himself ill, for she was a virgin, and it seemed too difficult to Amnon to do anything to her.
verses.textEn: Amnon became so obsessed with his sister Tamar that he made himself ill. She was a virgin, and it seemed impossible for him to do anything to her.

verses.textZh: 暗嫩有一个朋友，名叫约拿达，是大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子。约拿达是一个非常狡猾的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗嫩有一个朋友，名叫约拿达，是大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子。约拿达是一个非常狡猾的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗嫩有一个朋友，名叫约拿达，是大卫长兄示米亚的儿子。这约拿达为人极其狡猾；
verses.textEnNiv: Now Amnon had an adviser named Jonadab son of Shimeah, David’s brother. Jonadab was a very shrewd man.
verses.textEnEsv: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother. And Jonadab was a very crafty man.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother. Now Jonadab was a very crafty man.
verses.textEnNlt: But Amnon had a very crafty friend—his cousin Jonadab. He was the son of David’s brother Shimea.
verses.textEnNasb: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very clever man.
verses.textEn: Now Amnon had an adviser named Jonadab son of Shimeah, David’s brother. Jonadab was a very shrewd man.

verses.textZh: 他问暗嫩说："王子啊！你为甚么一天比一天瘦弱呢？你可以告诉我吗？"暗嫩说："我爱上了我兄弟押沙龙的妹妹他玛。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他问暗嫩说："王子啊！你为甚么一天比一天瘦弱呢？你可以告诉我吗？"暗嫩说："我爱上了我兄弟押沙龙的妹妹他玛。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他问暗嫩说：「王的儿子啊，为何一天比一天瘦弱呢？请你告诉我。」暗嫩回答说：「我爱我兄弟押沙龙的妹子她玛。」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked Amnon, "Why do you, the king’s son, look so haggard morning after morning? Won’t you tell me?" Amnon said to him, "I’m in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "O son of the king, why are you so haggard morning after morning? Will you not tell me?" Amnon said to him, "I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, "Why are you, the king’s son, becoming thinner day after day? Will you not tell me?" Amnon said to him, "I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jonadab said to Amnon, "What’s the trouble? Why should the son of a king look so dejected morning after morning?" So Amnon told him, "I am in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, "Why are you, the king’s son, so depressed morning after morning? Will you not tell me?" So Amnon said to him, "I am in love with Tamar, the sister of my brother Absalom."
verses.textEn: He asked Amnon, "Why do you, the king’s son, look so haggard morning after morning? Won’t you tell me?" Amnon said to him, "I’m in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister."

verses.textZh: 约拿达对他说："你可以躺在床上装病。你父亲来看你的时候，你就对他说：‘求你叫我的妹妹他玛来，把食物递给我吃；叫她在我眼前预备食物，好使我可以看见，也可以从她的手中取食。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿达对他说："你可以躺在床上装病。你父亲来看你的时候，你就对他说：‘求你叫我的妹妹他玛来，把食物递给我吃；叫她在我眼前预备食物，好使我可以看见，也可以从她的手中取食。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿达说：「你不如躺在床上装病；你父亲来看你，就对他说：『求父叫我妹子她玛来，在我眼前预备食物，递给我吃，使我看见，好从她手里接过来吃。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go to bed and pretend to be ill," Jonadab said. "When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘I would like my sister Tamar to come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare the food in my sight so I may watch her and then eat it from her hand.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Jonadab said to him, "Lie down on your bed and pretend to be ill. And when your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Let my sister Tamar come and give me bread to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonadab said to him, "Lie down on your bed and pretend to be ill. And when your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me food, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see it and eat it from her hand.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," Jonadab said, "I’ll tell you what to do. Go back to bed and pretend you are ill. When your father comes to see you, ask him to let Tamar come and prepare some food for you. Tell him you’ll feel better if she prepares it as you watch and feeds you with her own hands."
verses.textEnNasb: Jonadab then said to him, "Lie down on your bed and pretend to be ill; when your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Please have my sister Tamar come and give me food to eat, and have her prepare the food in my sight, so that I may see it and eat from her hand.’ "
verses.textEn: "Go to bed and pretend to be ill," Jonadab said. "When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘I would like my sister Tamar to come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare the food in my sight so I may watch her and then eat it from her hand.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是暗嫩躺着装病。王来看他，暗嫩对王说："求你叫我的妹妹他玛来，叫她在我眼前给我做两个饼，我可以从她的手里拿过来吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是暗嫩躺着装病。王来看他，暗嫩对王说："求你叫我的妹妹他玛来，叫她在我眼前给我做两个饼，我可以从她的手里拿过来吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是暗嫩躺卧装病。王来看他，他对王说：「求父叫我妹子她玛来，在我眼前为我做两个饼，我好从她手里接过来吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to him, "I would like my sister Tamar to come and make some special bread in my sight, so I may eat from her hand."
verses.textEnEsv: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill. And when the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, "Please let my sister Tamar come and make a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill; and when the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, "Please let Tamar my sister come and make a couple of cakes for me in my sight, that I may eat from her hand."
verses.textEnNlt: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. And when the king came to see him, Amnon asked him, "Please let my sister Tamar come and cook my favorite dish as I watch. Then I can eat it from her own hands."
verses.textEnNasb: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill; when the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, "Please have my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of pastries in my sight, so that I may eat from her hand."
verses.textEn: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to him, "I would like my sister Tamar to come and make some special bread in my sight, so I may eat from her hand."

verses.textZh: 大卫就派人到宫里去对他玛说："你到你哥哥暗嫩的屋里去，为他预备食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就派人到宫里去对他玛说："你到你哥哥暗嫩的屋里去，为他预备食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就打发人到宫里，对她玛说：「你往你哥哥暗嫩的屋里去，为他预备食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: "Go to the house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, "Go to your brother Amnon’s house and prepare food for him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David sent home to Tamar, saying, "Now go to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him."
verses.textEnNlt: So David agreed and sent Tamar to Amnon’s house to prepare some food for him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David sent a messenger to the house for Tamar, saying, "Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him."
verses.textEn: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: "Go to the house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him."

verses.textZh: 他玛就到她哥哥暗嫩的屋里去；暗嫩正躺着。他玛取了点面，把面和好，就在暗嫩面前做饼，并且把饼烤熟了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛就到她哥哥暗嫩的屋里去；暗嫩正躺着。他玛取了点面，把面和好，就在暗嫩面前做饼，并且把饼烤熟了。
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛就到她哥哥暗嫩的屋里；暗嫩正躺卧。她玛抟面，在他眼前做饼，且烤熟了，
verses.textEnNiv: So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was lying down. She took some dough, kneaded it, made the bread in his sight and baked it.
verses.textEnEsv: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house, where he was lying down. And she took dough and kneaded it and made cakes in his sight and baked the cakes.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. Then she took flour and kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.
verses.textEnNlt: When Tamar arrived at Amnon’s house, she went to the place where he was lying down so he could watch her mix some dough. Then she baked his favorite dish for him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house, and he was lying in bed. And she took dough, kneaded it, made pastries in his sight, and baked the pastries.
verses.textEn: So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was lying down. She took some dough, kneaded it, made the bread in his sight and baked it.

verses.textZh: 她拿过锅来，在他面前把饼倒出来，暗嫩却不肯吃，他说："叫众人离开我出去！"众人就都离开他出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她拿过锅来，在他面前把饼倒出来，暗嫩却不肯吃，他说："叫众人离开我出去！"众人就都离开他出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他面前将饼从锅里倒出来，他却不肯吃，便说：「众人离开我出去吧！」众人就都离开他，出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then she took the pan and served him the bread, but he refused to eat. "Send everyone out of here," Amnon said. So everyone left him.
verses.textEnEsv: And she took the pan and emptied it out before him, but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, "Send out everyone from me." So everyone went out from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she took the pan and placed them out before him, but he refused to eat. Then Amnon said, "Have everyone go out from me." And they all went out from him.
verses.textEnNlt: But when she set the serving tray before him, he refused to eat. "Everyone get out of here," Amnon told his servants. So they all left.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she took the tray and served them to him, but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, "Have everyone leave me." So everyone left him.
verses.textEn: Then she took the pan and served him the bread, but he refused to eat. "Send everyone out of here," Amnon said. So everyone left him.

verses.textZh: 暗嫩对他玛说："把食物带到卧房来，我好从你的手里拿过来吃。"他玛拿着她做好的饼，进了卧房，到她哥哥暗嫩那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗嫩对他玛说："把食物带到卧房来，我好从你的手里拿过来吃。"他玛拿着她做好的饼，进了卧房，到她哥哥暗嫩那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗嫩对她玛说：「你把食物拿进卧房，我好从你手里接过来吃。」她玛就把所做的饼拿进卧房，到她哥哥暗嫩那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food here into my bedroom so I may eat from your hand." And Tamar took the bread she had prepared and brought it to her brother Amnon in his bedroom.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food into the chamber, that I may eat from your hand." And Tamar took the cakes she had made and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food into the bedroom, that I may eat from your hand." And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them to Amnon her brother in the bedroom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to Tamar, "Now bring the food into my bedroom and feed it to me here." So Tamar took his favorite dish to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food into the bedroom, so that I may eat from your hand." So Tamar took the pastries which she had made and brought them into the bedroom to her brother Amnon.
verses.textEn: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food here into my bedroom so I may eat from your hand." And Tamar took the bread she had prepared and brought it to her brother Amnon in his bedroom.

verses.textZh: 他玛上到他面前，给他吃的时候，暗嫩却拉住她，对她说："妹妹，来与我同寝吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛上到他面前，给他吃的时候，暗嫩却拉住她，对她说："妹妹，来与我同寝吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿着饼上前给他吃，他便拉住她玛，说：「我妹妹，你来与我同寝。」
verses.textEnNiv: But when she took it to him to eat, he grabbed her and said, "Come to bed with me, my sister."
verses.textEnEsv: But when she brought them near him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, "Come, lie with me, my sister."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when she had brought them to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, "Come, lie with me, my sister."
verses.textEnNlt: But as she was feeding him, he grabbed her and demanded, "Come to bed with me, my darling sister."
verses.textEnNasb: When she brought them to him to eat, he took hold of her and said to her, "Come, sleep with me, my sister."
verses.textEn: But when she took it to him to eat, he grabbed her and said, "Come to bed with me, my sister."

verses.textZh: 他玛对他说："不要！哥哥！不要污辱我！在以色列中不可作这样的事。你不要作这丑事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛对他说："不要！哥哥！不要污辱我！在以色列中不可作这样的事。你不要作这丑事。
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛说：「我哥哥，不要玷辱我。以色列人中不当这样行，你不要做这丑事；
verses.textEnNiv: "No, my brother!" she said to him. "Don’t force me! Such a thing should not be done in Israel! Don’t do this wicked thing.
verses.textEnEsv: She answered him, "No, my brother, do not violate me, for such a thing is not done in Israel; do not do this outrageous thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: But she answered him, "No, my brother, do not force me, for no such thing should be done in Israel. Do not do this disgraceful thing!
verses.textEnNlt: "No, my brother!" she cried. "Don’t be foolish! Don’t do this to me! Such wicked things aren’t done in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But she said to him, "No, my brother, do not violate me, for such a thing is not done in Israel; do not do this disgraceful sin!
verses.textEn: "No, my brother!" she said to him. "Don’t force me! Such a thing should not be done in Israel! Don’t do this wicked thing.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我到哪里除去我的耻辱呢？至于你，你在以色列中也会成了一个愚妄的人。现在请你去对王说，他必不会禁止我归你的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我到哪里除去我的耻辱呢？至于你，你在以色列中也会成了一个愚妄的人。现在请你去对王说，他必不会禁止我归你的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你玷辱了我，我何以掩盖我的羞耻呢？你在以色列中也成了愚妄人。你可以求王，他必不禁止我归你。」
verses.textEnNiv: What about me? Where could I get rid of my disgrace? And what about you? You would be like one of the wicked fools in Israel. Please speak to the king; he will not keep me from being married to you."
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, where could I carry my shame? And as for you, you would be as one of the outrageous fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king, for he will not withhold me from you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, where could I take my shame? And as for you, you would be like one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, please speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you."
verses.textEnNlt: Where could I go in my shame? And you would be called one of the greatest fools in Israel. Please, just speak to the king about it, and he will let you marry me."
verses.textEnNasb: As for me, where could I get rid of my shame? And as for you, you will be like one of the fools in Israel. Now then, please speak to the king, for he will not withhold me from you."
verses.textEn: What about me? Where could I get rid of my disgrace? And what about you? You would be like one of the wicked fools in Israel. Please speak to the king; he will not keep me from being married to you."

verses.textZh: 但暗嫩不肯听她的话，他又比他玛有力，就污辱了她，与她同寝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但暗嫩不肯听她的话，他又比他玛有力，就污辱了她，与她同寝。
verses.textZhCuv: 但暗嫩不肯听她的话，因比她力大，就玷辱她，与她同寝。
verses.textEnNiv: But he refused to listen to her, and since he was stronger than she, he raped her.
verses.textEnEsv: But he would not listen to her, and being stronger than she, he violated her and lay with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, he would not heed her voice; and being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.
verses.textEnNlt: But Amnon wouldn’t listen to her, and since he was stronger than she was, he raped her.
verses.textEnNasb: However, he would not listen to her; since he was stronger than she, he violated her and slept with her.
verses.textEn: But he refused to listen to her, and since he was stronger than she, he raped her.

verses.textZh: 事后，暗嫩非常恨她；他对他玛的恨比以前对她的爱更大，所以暗嫩对她说："你起来！走吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 事后，暗嫩非常恨她；他对他玛的恨比以前对她的爱更大，所以暗嫩对她说："你起来！走吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 随后，暗嫩极其恨她，那恨她的心比先前爱她的心更甚，对她说：「你起来，去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Amnon hated her with intense hatred. In fact, he hated her more than he had loved her. Amnon said to her, "Get up and get out!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Amnon hated her with very great hatred, so that the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. And Amnon said to her, "Get up! Go!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly, so that the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. And Amnon said to her, "Arise, be gone!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then suddenly Amnon’s love turned to hate, and he hated her even more than he had loved her. "Get out of here!" he snarled at her.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Amnon hated her with a very great hatred; indeed, the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. And Amnon said to her, "Get up, go away!"
verses.textEn: Then Amnon hated her with intense hatred. In fact, he hated her more than he had loved her. Amnon said to her, "Get up and get out!"

verses.textZh: 他玛却对他说："我的哥哥啊，不！你赶我出去的这罪比你刚才与我所行的罪更大了。"但是暗嫩不肯听她的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛却对他说："我的哥哥啊，不！你赶我出去的这罪比你刚才与我所行的罪更大了。"但是暗嫩不肯听她的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛说：「不要这样！你赶出我去的这罪比你才行的更重！」但暗嫩不肯听她的话，
verses.textEnNiv: "No!" she said to him. "Sending me away would be a greater wrong than what you have already done to me." But he refused to listen to her.
verses.textEnEsv: But she said to him, "No, my brother, for this wrong in sending me away is greater than the other that you did to me." But he would not listen to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said to him, "No, indeed! This evil of sending me away is worse than the other that you did to me." But he would not listen to her.
verses.textEnNlt: "No, no!" Tamar cried. "Sending me away now is worse than what you’ve already done to me." But Amnon wouldn’t listen to her.
verses.textEnNasb: But she said to him, "No, because this wrong in sending me away is greater than the other that you have done to me!" Yet he would not listen to her.
verses.textEn: "No!" she said to him. "Sending me away would be a greater wrong than what you have already done to me." But he refused to listen to her.

verses.textZh: 就叫了侍候他的仆人来，说："把这女人从我面前赶到外面去，然后把门锁上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就叫了侍候他的仆人来，说："把这女人从我面前赶到外面去，然后把门锁上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就叫伺候自己的仆人来，说：「将这个女子赶出去！她一出去，你就关门，上闩。」
verses.textEnNiv: He called his personal servant and said, "Get this woman out of my sight and bolt the door after her."
verses.textEnEsv: He called the young man who served him and said, "Put this woman out of my presence and bolt the door after her."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he called his servant who attended him, and said, "Here! Put this woman out, away from me, and bolt the door behind her."
verses.textEnNlt: He shouted for his servant and demanded, "Throw this woman out, and lock the door behind her!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he called his young man who attended him and said, "Now throw this woman out of my presence, and lock the door behind her!"
verses.textEn: He called his personal servant and said, "Get this woman out of my sight and bolt the door after her."

verses.textZh: 那时他玛身上穿著长袖彩衣，因为未嫁的公主都是这样穿的。那侍候暗嫩的仆人把她赶到外面去，随后把门锁上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时他玛身上穿著长袖彩衣，因为未嫁的公主都是这样穿的。那侍候暗嫩的仆人把她赶到外面去，随后把门锁上。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时她玛穿着彩衣，因为没有出嫁的公主都是这样穿。暗嫩的仆人就把她赶出去，关门上闩。
verses.textEnNiv: So his servant put her out and bolted the door after her. She was wearing an ornate robe, for this was the kind of garment the virgin daughters of the king wore.
verses.textEnEsv: Now she was wearing a long robe with sleeves, for thus were the virgin daughters of the king dressed. So his servant put her out and bolted the door after her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now she had on a robe of many colors, for the king’s virgin daughters wore such apparel. And his servant put her out and bolted the door behind her.
verses.textEnNlt: So the servant put her out and locked the door behind her. She was wearing a long, beautiful robe, as was the custom in those days for the king’s virgin daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Now she had on a long-sleeved garment; for this is how the virgin daughters of the king dressed themselves in robes. Then his attendant took her out and locked the door behind her.
verses.textEn: So his servant put her out and bolted the door after her. She was wearing an ornate robe, for this was the kind of garment the virgin daughters of the king wore.

verses.textZh: 他玛把尘土撒在自己的头上，撕裂身上的长袖彩衣，又把一只手放在头上，一边行走一边哭叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛把尘土撒在自己的头上，撕裂身上的长袖彩衣，又把一只手放在头上，一边行走一边哭叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛把灰尘撒在头上，撕裂所穿的彩衣，以手抱头，一面行走，一面哭喊。
verses.textEnNiv: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the ornate robe she was wearing. She put her hands on her head and went away, weeping aloud as she went.
verses.textEnEsv: And Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the long robe that she wore. And she laid her hand on her head and went away, crying aloud as she went.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her robe of many colors that was on her, and laid her hand on her head and went away crying bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: But now Tamar tore her robe and put ashes on her head. And then, with her face in her hands, she went away crying.
verses.textEnNasb: Tamar took ashes and put them on her head, and tore her long-sleeved garment which was on her; and she put her hand on her head and went on her way, crying out as she went.
verses.textEn: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the ornate robe she was wearing. She put her hands on her head and went away, weeping aloud as she went.

verses.textZh: 她哥哥押沙龙问她："是不是你哥哥暗嫩与你亲近了？我妹妹啊，你现在不要作声，他是你的哥哥，你不要把这事放在心上。"于是他玛孤单凄凉地住在她哥哥押沙龙的家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她哥哥押沙龙问她："是不是你哥哥暗嫩与你亲近了？我妹妹啊，你现在不要作声，他是你的哥哥，你不要把这事放在心上。"于是他玛孤单凄凉地住在她哥哥押沙龙的家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 她胞兄押沙龙问她说：「莫非你哥哥暗嫩与你亲近了吗？我妹妹，暂且不要作声，他是你的哥哥，不要将这事放在心上。」她玛就孤孤单单地住在她胞兄押沙龙家里。
verses.textEnNiv: Her brother Absalom said to her, "Has that Amnon, your brother, been with you? Be quiet for now, my sister; he is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart." And Tamar lived in her brother Absalom’s house, a desolate woman.
verses.textEnEsv: And her brother Absalom said to her, "Has Amnon your brother been with you? Now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother; do not take this to heart." So Tamar lived, a desolate woman, in her brother Absalom’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Absalom her brother said to her, "Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother; do not take this thing to heart." So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: Her brother Absalom saw her and asked, "Is it true that Amnon has been with you? Well, my sister, keep quiet for now, since he’s your brother. Don’t you worry about it." So Tamar lived as a desolate woman in her brother Absalom’s house.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Absalom her brother said to her, "Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now keep silent, my sister, he is your brother; do not take this matter to heart." So Tamar remained and was isolated in her brother Absalom’s house.
verses.textEn: Her brother Absalom said to her, "Has that Amnon, your brother, been with you? Be quiet for now, my sister; he is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart." And Tamar lived in her brother Absalom’s house, a desolate woman.

verses.textZh: 大卫王听见了这一切事，就非常生气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王听见了这一切事，就非常生气。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王听见这事，就甚发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: When King David heard all this, he was furious.
verses.textEnEsv: When King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.
verses.textEnNlt: When King David heard what had happened, he was very angry.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when King David heard about all these matters, he became very angry.
verses.textEn: When King David heard all this, he was furious.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙甚么话都没有对暗嫩说。押沙龙恨暗嫩，因为暗嫩污辱了他的妹妹他玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙甚么话都没有对暗嫩说。押沙龙恨暗嫩，因为暗嫩污辱了他的妹妹他玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙并不和他哥哥暗嫩说好说歹；因为暗嫩玷辱他妹妹她玛，所以押沙龙恨恶他。
verses.textEnNiv: And Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad; he hated Amnon because he had disgraced his sister Tamar.
verses.textEnEsv: But Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad, for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had violated his sister Tamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Absalom spoke to his brother Amnon neither good nor bad. For Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
verses.textEnNlt: And though Absalom never spoke to Amnon about this, he hated Amnon deeply because of what he had done to his sister.
verses.textEnNasb: But Absalom did not speak with Amnon either good or bad; for Absalom hated Amnon because he had violated his sister Tamar.
verses.textEn: And Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad; he hated Amnon because he had disgraced his sister Tamar.

verses.textZh: 两年以后，在以法莲边界的巴力．夏琐，押沙龙雇了人为他剪羊毛，押沙龙邀请王所有的儿子到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两年以后，在以法莲边界的巴力．夏琐，押沙龙雇了人为他剪羊毛，押沙龙邀请王所有的儿子到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了二年，在靠近以法莲的巴力‧夏琐有人为押沙龙剪羊毛；押沙龙请王的众子与他同去。
verses.textEnNiv: Two years later, when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal Hazor near the border of Ephraim, he invited all the king’s sons to come there.
verses.textEnEsv: After two full years Absalom had sheepshearers at Baal-hazor, which is near Ephraim, and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal Hazor, which is near Ephraim; so Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
verses.textEnNlt: Two years later, when Absalom’s sheep were being sheared at Baal-hazor near Ephraim, Absalom invited all the king’s sons to come to a feast.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after two full years that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal-hazor, which is near Ephraim, and Absalom invited all the king’s sons to celebrate.
verses.textEn: Two years later, when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal Hazor near the border of Ephraim, he invited all the king’s sons to come there.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙去见王说："看哪！现在你的仆人雇了人剪羊毛；请王和王的臣仆与我一同去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙去见王说："看哪！现在你的仆人雇了人剪羊毛；请王和王的臣仆与我一同去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙来见王，说：「现在有人为仆人剪羊毛，请王和王的臣仆与仆人同去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Absalom went to the king and said, "Your servant has had shearers come. Will the king and his attendants please join me?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Absalom came to the king and said, "Behold, your servant has sheepshearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Absalom came to the king and said, "Kindly note, your servant has sheepshearers; please, let the king and his servants go with your servant."
verses.textEnNlt: He went to the king and said, "My sheep-shearers are now at work. Would the king and his servants please come to celebrate the occasion with me?"
verses.textEnNasb: And Absalom came to the king and said, "Behold now, your servant has sheepshearers; may the king and his servants please go with your servant."
verses.textEn: Absalom went to the king and said, "Your servant has had shearers come. Will the king and his attendants please join me?"

verses.textZh: 王对押沙龙说："不！我儿，我们不必都去，免得我们成为你的重担。"押沙龙再三勉强王去，王还是不肯去，只是为他祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对押沙龙说："不！我儿，我们不必都去，免得我们成为你的重担。"押沙龙再三勉强王去，王还是不肯去，只是为他祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 王对押沙龙说：「我儿，我们不必都去，恐怕使你耗费太多。」押沙龙再三请王，王仍是不肯去，只为他祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: "No, my son," the king replied. "All of us should not go; we would only be a burden to you." Although Absalom urged him, he still refused to go but gave him his blessing.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king said to Absalom, "No, my son, let us not all go, lest we be burdensome to you." He pressed him, but he would not go but gave him his blessing.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the king said to Absalom, "No, my son, let us not all go now, lest we be a burden to you." Then he urged him, but he would not go; and he blessed him.
verses.textEnNlt: The king replied, "No, my son. If we all came, we would be too much of a burden on you." Absalom pressed him, but the king would not come, though he gave Absalom his blessing.
verses.textEnNasb: But the king said to Absalom, "No, my son, we should not all go, so that we will not be a burden to you." Though he urged him, he would not go; but he blessed him.
verses.textEn: "No, my son," the king replied. "All of us should not go; we would only be a burden to you." Although Absalom urged him, he still refused to go but gave him his blessing.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙说："王若是不去，求王让我的哥哥暗嫩与我一同去。"王问他："为甚么要他与你一同去呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙说："王若是不去，求王让我的哥哥暗嫩与我一同去。"王问他："为甚么要他与你一同去呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙说：「王若不去，求王许我哥哥暗嫩同去。」王说：「何必要他去呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Absalom said, "If not, please let my brother Amnon come with us." The king asked him, "Why should he go with you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Absalom said, "If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us." And the king said to him, "Why should he go with you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Absalom said, "If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us." And the king said to him, "Why should he go with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, then," Absalom said, "if you can’t come, how about sending my brother Amnon with us?" "Why Amnon?" the king asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Absalom said, "If not, please have my brother Amnon go with us." But the king said to him, "Why should he go with you?"
verses.textEn: Then Absalom said, "If not, please let my brother Amnon come with us." The king asked him, "Why should he go with you?"

verses.textZh: 押沙龙再三求王，王就派暗嫩和王所有的儿子与他一同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙再三求王，王就派暗嫩和王所有的儿子与他一同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙再三求王，王就许暗嫩和王的众子与他同去。
verses.textEnNiv: But Absalom urged him, so he sent with him Amnon and the rest of the king’s sons.
verses.textEnEsv: But Absalom pressed him until he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Absalom urged him; so he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Absalom kept on pressing the king until he finally agreed to let all his sons attend, including Amnon. So Absalom prepared a feast fit for a king.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless Absalom urged him, so he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
verses.textEn: But Absalom urged him, so he sent with him Amnon and the rest of the king’s sons.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙吩咐他的仆人说："你们注意！暗嫩酒酣耳热的时候，我对你们说：‘击杀暗嫩！’你们就把他杀死。不要惧怕，这不是我吩咐你们的吗？你们要坚强，作勇敢的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙吩咐他的仆人说："你们注意！暗嫩酒酣耳热的时候，我对你们说：‘击杀暗嫩！’你们就把他杀死。不要惧怕，这不是我吩咐你们的吗？你们要坚强，作勇敢的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙吩咐仆人说：「你们注意，看暗嫩饮酒畅快的时候，我对你们说杀暗嫩，你们便杀他，不要惧怕。这不是我吩咐你们的吗？你们只管壮胆奋勇！」
verses.textEnNiv: Absalom ordered his men, "Listen! When Amnon is in high spirits from drinking wine and I say to you, ‘Strike Amnon down,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I given you this order? Be strong and brave."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Absalom commanded his servants, "Mark when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine, and when I say to you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Do not fear; have I not commanded you? Be courageous and be valiant."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, "Watch now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine, and when I say to you, ‘Strike Amnon!’ then kill him. Do not be afraid. Have I not commanded you? Be courageous and valiant."
verses.textEnNlt: Absalom told his men, "Wait until Amnon gets drunk; then at my signal, kill him! Don’t be afraid. I’m the one who has given the command. Take courage and do it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Absalom commanded his servants, saying, "See now, when Amnon’s heart is cheerful with wine, and I say to you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then put him to death. Do not fear; have I not commanded you myself? Be courageous and be valiant."
verses.textEn: Absalom ordered his men, "Listen! When Amnon is in high spirits from drinking wine and I say to you, ‘Strike Amnon down,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I given you this order? Be strong and brave."

verses.textZh: 押沙龙的仆人就照押沙龙所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王所有的儿子就起来，各人骑上自己的骡子逃跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙的仆人就照押沙龙所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王所有的儿子就起来，各人骑上自己的骡子逃跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙的仆人就照押沙龙所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王的众子都起来，各人骑上骡子，逃跑了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Absalom’s men did to Amnon what Absalom had ordered. Then all the king’s sons got up, mounted their mules and fled.
verses.textEnEsv: So the servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and each mounted his mule and fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and each one got on his mule and fled.
verses.textEnNlt: So at Absalom’s signal they murdered Amnon. Then the other sons of the king jumped on their mules and fled.
verses.textEnNasb: And the servants of Absalom did to Amnon just as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons got up and each mounted his mule and fled.
verses.textEn: So Absalom’s men did to Amnon what Absalom had ordered. Then all the king’s sons got up, mounted their mules and fled.

verses.textZh: 他们还在路上的时候，有消息传到大卫那里，说："押沙龙杀了王所有的儿子，没有剩下一个。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们还在路上的时候，有消息传到大卫那里，说："押沙龙杀了王所有的儿子，没有剩下一个。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们还在路上，有风声传到大卫那里，说：「押沙龙将王的众子都杀了，没有留下一个。」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were on their way, the report came to David: "Absalom has struck down all the king’s sons; not one of them is left."
verses.textEnEsv: While they were on the way, news came to David, "Absalom has struck down all the king’s sons, and not one of them is left."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, while they were on the way, that news came to David, saying, "Absalom has killed all the king’s sons, and not one of them is left!"
verses.textEnNlt: As they were on the way back to Jerusalem, this report reached David: "Absalom has killed all the king’s sons; not one is left alive!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was while they were on the way that the report came to David, saying, "Absalom has struck and killed all the king’s sons, and not one of them is left."
verses.textEn: While they were on their way, the report came to David: "Absalom has struck down all the king’s sons; not one of them is left."

verses.textZh: 王就起来，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。侍立在他身旁的所有臣仆，也都撕裂衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就起来，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。侍立在他身旁的所有臣仆，也都撕裂衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就起来，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。王的臣仆也都撕裂衣服，站在旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: The king stood up, tore his clothes and lay down on the ground; and all his attendants stood by with their clothes torn.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king arose and tore his garments and lay on the earth. And all his servants who were standing by tore their garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king arose and tore his garments and lay on the ground, and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
verses.textEnNlt: The king got up, tore his robe, and threw himself on the ground. His advisers also tore their clothes in horror and sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king stood up, tore his clothes, and lay on the ground; and all his servants were standing by with clothes torn.
verses.textEn: The king stood up, tore his clothes and lay down on the ground; and all his attendants stood by with their clothes torn.

verses.textZh: 大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿达说："我主不要以为所有的年轻人、王的儿子都被杀死了。其实死的只有暗嫩一人；自从暗嫩污辱了押沙龙的妹妹他玛那一天起，押沙龙就定意要杀死他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿达说："我主不要以为所有的年轻人、王的儿子都被杀死了。其实死的只有暗嫩一人；自从暗嫩污辱了押沙龙的妹妹他玛那一天起，押沙龙就定意要杀死他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的长兄，示米亚的儿子约拿达说：「我主，不要以为王的众子－少年人都杀了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。自从暗嫩玷辱押沙龙妹子她玛的那日，押沙龙就定意杀暗嫩了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jonadab son of Shimeah, David’s brother, said, "My lord should not think that they killed all the princes; only Amnon is dead. This has been Absalom’s express intention ever since the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, said, "Let not my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon alone is dead. For by the command of Absalom this has been determined from the day he violated his sister Tamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered and said, "Let not my lord suppose they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for only Amnon is dead. For by the command of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
verses.textEnNlt: But just then Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimea, arrived and said, "No, don’t believe that all the king’s sons have been killed! It was only Amnon! Absalom has been plotting this ever since Amnon raped his sister Tamar.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, responded, "Let my lord not assume that they have put to death all the young men, the king’s sons, for only Amnon is dead; because this has been set up by the intent of Absalom since the day that he violated his sister Tamar.
verses.textEn: But Jonadab son of Shimeah, David’s brother, said, "My lord should not think that they killed all the princes; only Amnon is dead. This has been Absalom’s express intention ever since the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.

verses.textZh: 现在我主我王不要把这事放在心上，以为王所有的儿子都死了。其实死的只有暗嫩一人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我主我王不要把这事放在心上，以为王所有的儿子都死了。其实死的只有暗嫩一人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在，我主我王，不要把这事放在心上，以为王的众子都死了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: My lord the king should not be concerned about the report that all the king’s sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore let not my lord the king so take it to heart as to suppose that all the king’s sons are dead, for Amnon alone is dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead. For only Amnon is dead."
verses.textEnNlt: No, my lord the king, your sons aren’t all dead! It was only Amnon."
verses.textEnNasb: So now, may my lord the king not take the report to heart, claiming, ‘all the king’s sons are dead’; but only Amnon is dead."
verses.textEn: My lord the king should not be concerned about the report that all the king’s sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead."

verses.textZh: 押沙龙逃走了。守望的年轻人举目观看，看见许多人从后面山坡旁边的路而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙逃走了。守望的年轻人举目观看，看见许多人从后面山坡旁边的路而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙逃跑了。 守望的少年人举目观看，见有许多人从山坡的路上来。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Absalom had fled. Now the man standing watch looked up and saw many people on the road west of him, coming down the side of the hill. The watchman went and told the king, "I see men in the direction of Horonaim, on the side of the hill."
verses.textEnEsv: But Absalom fled. And the young man who kept the watch lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming from the road behind him by the side of the mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Absalom fled. And the young man who was keeping watch lifted his eyes and looked, and there, many people were coming from the road on the hillside behind him.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile Absalom escaped. Then the watchman on the Jerusalem wall saw a great crowd coming down the hill on the road from the west. He ran to tell the king, "I see a crowd of people coming from the Horonaim road along the side of the hill."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Absalom had fled. And the young man who was the watchman raised his eyes and looked, and behold, many people were coming from the road behind him by the side of the mountain.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Absalom had fled. Now the man standing watch looked up and saw many people on the road west of him, coming down the side of the hill. The watchman went and told the king, "I see men in the direction of Horonaim, on the side of the hill."

verses.textZh: 约拿达对王说："看哪！王的儿子都回来了。正如你仆人所说的，事情果然是这样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿达对王说："看哪！王的儿子都回来了。正如你仆人所说的，事情果然是这样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿达对王说：「看哪，王的众子都来了，果然与你仆人所说的相合。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jonadab said to the king, "See, the king’s sons have come; it has happened just as your servant said."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jonadab said to the king, "Behold, the king’s sons have come; as your servant said, so it has come about."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonadab said to the king, "Look, the king’s sons are coming; as your servant said, so it is."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look!" Jonadab told the king. "There they are now! The king’s sons are coming, just as I said."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jonadab said to the king, "Behold, the king’s sons have come; so it has happened according to your servant’s word."
verses.textEn: Jonadab said to the king, "See, the king’s sons have come; it has happened just as your servant said."

verses.textZh: 他刚说完了，王的众子就都来到了，他们都放声大哭；王和他所有的臣仆也都号咷痛哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他刚说完了，王的众子就都来到了，他们都放声大哭；王和他所有的臣仆也都号咷痛哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 话才说完，王的众子都到了，放声大哭；王和臣仆也都哭得甚恸。
verses.textEnNiv: As he finished speaking, the king’s sons came in, wailing loudly. The king, too, and all his attendants wept very bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came and lifted up their voice and wept. And the king also and all his servants wept very bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as soon as he had finished speaking, that the king’s sons indeed came, and they lifted up their voice and wept. Also the king and all his servants wept very bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: They soon arrived, weeping and sobbing, and the king and all his servants wept bitterly with them.
verses.textEnNasb: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came and raised their voices and wept; and the king and all his servants also wept very profusely.
verses.textEn: As he finished speaking, the king’s sons came in, wailing loudly. The king, too, and all his attendants wept very bitterly.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙逃亡，走到基述王亚米忽的儿子达买那里去了。大卫天天为他的儿子哀伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙逃亡，走到基述王亚米忽的儿子达买那里去了。大卫天天为他的儿子哀伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙逃到基述王亚米忽的儿子达买那里去了。大卫天天为他儿子悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. But King David mourned many days for his son.
verses.textEnEsv: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son day after day.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.
verses.textEnNlt: And David mourned many days for his son Amnon. Absalom fled to his grandfather, Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Absalom had fled and gone to Talmai the son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.
verses.textEn: Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. But King David mourned many days for his son.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙逃亡，逃到基述那里去，在那里住了三年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙逃亡，逃到基述那里去，在那里住了三年。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙逃到基述，在那里住了三年。
verses.textEnNiv: After Absalom fled and went to Geshur, he stayed there three years.
verses.textEnEsv: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Absalom fled and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.textEnNlt: He stayed there in Geshur for three years.
verses.textEnNasb: So Absalom had fled and gone to Geshur, and was there for three years.
verses.textEn: After Absalom fled and went to Geshur, he stayed there three years.

verses.textZh: 大卫的心不再怀恨押沙龙，对暗嫩的死也不再那么难过了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的心不再怀恨押沙龙，对暗嫩的死也不再那么难过了。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗嫩死了以后，大卫王得了安慰，心里切切想念押沙龙。
verses.textEnNiv: And King David longed to go to Absalom, for he was consoled concerning Amnon’s death.
verses.textEnEsv: And the spirit of the king longed to go out to Absalom, because he was comforted about Amnon, since he was dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And King David longed to go to Absalom. For he had been comforted concerning Amnon, because he was dead.
verses.textEnNlt: And King David, now reconciled to Amnon’s death, longed to be reunited with his son Absalom.
verses.textEnNasb: And the heart of King David longed to go out to Absalom; for he was comforted regarding Amnon, since he was dead.
verses.textEn: And King David longed to go to Absalom, for he was consoled concerning Amnon’s death.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押知道王的心想念押沙龙，
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押知道王的心想念押沙龙，
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押，知道王心里想念押沙龙，
verses.textEnNiv: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that the king’s heart longed for Absalom.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah knew that the king’s heart went out to Absalom.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was concerned about Absalom.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab realized how much the king longed to see Absalom.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was drawn toward Absalom.
verses.textEn: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that the king’s heart longed for Absalom.

verses.textZh: 就派人到提哥亚去，从那里带了一位聪明的妇人来，对她说："你要假装居丧的，穿上丧服，不要用油膏抹身体。要装成一个为死者居丧很久的妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就派人到提哥亚去，从那里带了一位聪明的妇人来，对她说："你要假装居丧的，穿上丧服，不要用油膏抹身体。要装成一个为死者居丧很久的妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就打发人往提哥亚去，从那里叫了一个聪明的妇人来，对她说：「请你假装居丧的，穿上孝衣，不要用膏抹身，要装作为死者许久悲哀的妇人；
verses.textEnNiv: So Joab sent someone to Tekoa and had a wise woman brought from there. He said to her, "Pretend you are in mourning. Dress in mourning clothes, and don’t use any cosmetic lotions. Act like a woman who has spent many days grieving for the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab sent to Tekoa and brought from there a wise woman and said to her, "Pretend to be a mourner and put on mourning garments. Do not anoint yourself with oil, but behave like a woman who has been mourning many days for the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab sent to Tekoa and brought from there a wise woman, and said to her, "Please pretend to be a mourner, and put on mourning apparel; do not anoint yourself with oil, but act like a woman who has been mourning a long time for the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: So he sent for a woman from Tekoa who had a reputation for great wisdom. He said to her, "Pretend you are in mourning; wear mourning clothes and don’t put on lotions. Act like a woman who has been mourning for the dead for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joab sent a messenger to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, "Please follow mourning rites, and put on mourning garments now, and do not anoint yourself with oil but be like a woman who has been mourning for the dead for many days.
verses.textEn: So Joab sent someone to Tekoa and had a wise woman brought from there. He said to her, "Pretend you are in mourning. Dress in mourning clothes, and don’t use any cosmetic lotions. Act like a woman who has spent many days grieving for the dead.

verses.textZh: 然后进去见王，对他这样这样说。"于是约押把要说的话教了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后进去见王，对他这样这样说。"于是约押把要说的话教了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 进去见王，对王如此如此说。」于是约押将当说的话教导了妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then go to the king and speak these words to him." And Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: Go to the king and speak thus to him." So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go to the king and speak to him in this manner." So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then go to the king and tell him the story I am about to tell you." Then Joab told her what to say.
verses.textEnNasb: Then go to the king and speak to him in this way." So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.textEn: Then go to the king and speak these words to him." And Joab put the words in her mouth.

verses.textZh: 提哥亚妇人进去见王，俯伏在地，叩拜他，说："王啊！求你帮助我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 提哥亚妇人进去见王，俯伏在地，叩拜他，说："王啊！求你帮助我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 提哥亚妇人到王面前，伏地叩拜，说：「王啊，求你拯救！」
verses.textEnNiv: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell with her face to the ground to pay him honor, and she said, "Help me, Your Majesty!"
verses.textEnEsv: When the woman of Tekoa came to the king, she fell on her face to the ground and paid homage and said, "Save me, O king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground and prostrated herself, and said, "Help, O king!"
verses.textEnNlt: When the woman from Tekoa approached the king, she bowed with her face to the ground in deep respect and cried out, "O king! Help me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground and prostrated herself, and said, "Help, O king!"
verses.textEn: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell with her face to the ground to pay him honor, and she said, "Help me, Your Majesty!"

verses.textZh: 王问她："你有甚么事呢？"她回答："我实在是个寡妇，我的丈夫死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王问她："你有甚么事呢？"她回答："我实在是个寡妇，我的丈夫死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 王问她说：「你有什么事呢？」回答说：「婢女实在是寡妇，我丈夫死了。
verses.textEnNiv: The king asked her, "What is troubling you?" She said, "I am a widow; my husband is dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to her, "What is your trouble?" She answered, "Alas, I am a widow; my husband is dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to her, "What troubles you?" And she answered, "Indeed I am a widow, my husband is dead.
verses.textEnNlt: "What’s the trouble?" the king asked. "Alas, I am a widow!" she replied. "My husband is dead.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king said to her, "What is troubling you?" And she answered, "Truly I am a widow, for my husband is dead.
verses.textEn: The king asked her, "What is troubling you?" She said, "I am a widow; my husband is dead.

verses.textZh: 婢女有两个儿子；有一天，他们两人在田里打架，当时没有人劝开他们，这个就击打那个，竟把他打死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 婢女有两个儿子；有一天，他们两人在田里打架，当时没有人劝开他们，这个就击打那个，竟把他打死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我有两个儿子，一日在田间争斗，没有人解劝，这个就打死那个。
verses.textEnNiv: I your servant had two sons. They got into a fight with each other in the field, and no one was there to separate them. One struck the other and killed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And your servant had two sons, and they quarreled with one another in the field. There was no one to separate them, and one struck the other and killed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now your maidservant had two sons; and the two fought with each other in the field, and therewas no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: My two sons had a fight out in the field. And since no one was there to stop it, one of them was killed.
verses.textEnNasb: And your servant had two sons, but the two of them fought in the field, and there was no one to save them from each other, so one struck the other and killed him.
verses.textEn: I your servant had two sons. They got into a fight with each other in the field, and no one was there to separate them. One struck the other and killed him.

verses.textZh: 看哪！现在全家族的人都起来攻击婢女，说：‘你要把那击杀他兄弟的凶手交出来，好让我们把他处死，以偿他兄弟的命，也可以灭绝那继承产业的。’这样他们要使我所剩下的炭火也都熄灭了，不让我丈夫在这世上留下名字，或留下后代。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！现在全家族的人都起来攻击婢女，说：‘你要把那击杀他兄弟的凶手交出来，好让我们把他处死，以偿他兄弟的命，也可以灭绝那继承产业的。’这样他们要使我所剩下的炭火也都熄灭了，不让我丈夫在这世上留下名字，或留下后代。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在全家的人都起来攻击婢女，说：『你将那打死兄弟的交出来，我们好治死他，偿他打死兄弟的命，灭绝那承受家业的。』这样，他们要将我剩下的炭火灭尽，不与我丈夫留名留后在世上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the whole clan has risen up against your servant; they say, ‘Hand over the one who struck his brother down, so that we may put him to death for the life of his brother whom he killed; then we will get rid of the heir as well.’ They would put out the only burning coal I have left, leaving my husband neither name nor descendant on the face of the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: And now the whole clan has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Give up the man who struck his brother, that we may put him to death for the life of his brother whom he killed.’ And so they would destroy the heir also. Thus they would quench my coal that is left and leave to my husband neither name nor remnant on the face of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And now the whole family has risen up against your maidservant, and they said, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may execute him for the life of his brother whom he killed; and we will destroy the heir also.’ So they would extinguish my ember that is left, and leave to my husband neither name nor remnant on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Now the rest of the family is demanding, ‘Let us have your son. We will execute him for murdering his brother. He doesn’t deserve to inherit his family’s property.’ They want to extinguish the only coal I have left, and my husband’s name and family will disappear from the face of the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, the entire family has risen against your servant, and they have said, ‘Hand over the one who struck his brother, so that we may put him to death for the life of his brother whom he killed, and eliminate the heir as well.’ So they will extinguish my coal which is left, so as to leave my husband neither name nor remnant on the face of the earth."
verses.textEn: Now the whole clan has risen up against your servant; they say, ‘Hand over the one who struck his brother down, so that we may put him to death for the life of his brother whom he killed; then we will get rid of the heir as well.’ They would put out the only burning coal I have left, leaving my husband neither name nor descendant on the face of the earth."

verses.textZh: 王对那妇人说："你回家去吧！我必为你下令办这件事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对那妇人说："你回家去吧！我必为你下令办这件事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对妇人说：「你回家去吧！我必为你下令。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king said to the woman, "Go home, and I will issue an order in your behalf."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king said to the woman, "Go to your house, and I will give orders concerning you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to the woman, "Go to your house, and I will give orders concerning you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Leave it to me," the king told her. "Go home, and I’ll see to it that no one touches him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to the woman, "Go to your home, and I will issue orders concerning you."
verses.textEn: The king said to the woman, "Go home, and I will issue an order in your behalf."

verses.textZh: 提哥亚妇人又对王说："我主我王，愿这罪归于我和我父的家；愿王和王的王位与这罪无关。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 提哥亚妇人又对王说："我主我王，愿这罪归于我和我父的家；愿王和王的王位与这罪无关。"
verses.textZhCuv: 提哥亚妇人又对王说：「我主我王，愿这罪归我和我父家，与王和王的位无干。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the woman from Tekoa said to him, "Let my lord the king pardon me and my family, and let the king and his throne be without guilt."
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman of Tekoa said to the king, "On me be the guilt, my lord the king, and on my father’s house; let the king and his throne be guiltless."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the woman of Tekoa said to the king, "My lord, O king, let the iniquity be on me and on my father’s house, and the king and his throne be guiltless."
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, thank you, my lord the king," the woman from Tekoa replied. "If you are criticized for helping me, let the blame fall on me and on my father’s house, and let the king and his throne be innocent."
verses.textEnNasb: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, "My lord, the king, the guilt is on me and my father’s house, but the king and his throne are guiltless."
verses.textEn: But the woman from Tekoa said to him, "Let my lord the king pardon me and my family, and let the king and his throne be without guilt."

verses.textZh: 王说："对你说这事的，你就把他带到我这里来，他必不会再打扰你了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："对你说这事的，你就把他带到我这里来，他必不会再打扰你了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「凡难为你的，你就带他到我这里来，他必不再搅扰你。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king replied, "If anyone says anything to you, bring them to me, and they will not bother you again."
verses.textEnEsv: The king said, "If anyone says anything to you, bring him to me, and he shall never touch you again."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king said, "Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he shall not touch you anymore."
verses.textEnNlt: "If anyone objects," the king said, "bring him to me. I can assure you he will never harm you again!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the king said, "Whoever speaks to you, bring him to me, and he will not touch you anymore."
verses.textEn: The king replied, "If anyone says anything to you, bring them to me, and they will not bother you again."

verses.textZh: 妇人说："愿王记念耶和华你的神，不许报血仇的人多行杀戮，免得他们灭绝我的儿子。"王说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你的儿子连一根头发也不会落在地上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人说："愿王记念耶和华你的神，不许报血仇的人多行杀戮，免得他们灭绝我的儿子。"王说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，你的儿子连一根头发也不会落在地上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「愿王记念耶和华－你的神，不许报血仇的人施行灭绝，恐怕他们灭绝我的儿子。」王说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓：你的儿子连一根头发也不致落在地上。」
verses.textEnNiv: She said, "Then let the king invoke the Lord his God to prevent the avenger of blood from adding to the destruction, so that my son will not be destroyed." "As surely as the Lord lives," he said, "not one hair of your son’s head will fall to the ground."
verses.textEnEsv: Then she said, "Please let the king invoke the Lord your God, that the avenger of blood kill no more, and my son be not destroyed." He said, "As the Lord lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the ground."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said, "Please let the king remember the Lord your God, and do not permit the avenger of blood to destroy anymore, lest they destroy my son." And he said, "As the Lord lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the ground."
