verses.textEnNasb: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man was coming out from there from the family of the house of Saul, and his name was Shimei, the son of Gera; he was coming out, cursing as he came.
verses.textEn: As King David approached Bahurim, a man from the same clan as Saul’s family came out from there. His name was Shimei son of Gera, and he cursed as he came out.

verses.textZh: 又拿石头投掷大卫和大卫王所有的臣仆，那时众人和众勇士都在王的左右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又拿石头投掷大卫和大卫王所有的臣仆，那时众人和众勇士都在王的左右。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拿石头砍大卫王和王的臣仆；众民和勇士都在王的左右。
verses.textEnNiv: He pelted David and all the king’s officials with stones, though all the troops and the special guard were on David’s right and left.
verses.textEnEsv: And he threw stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he threw stones at David and at all the servants of King David. And all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
verses.textEnNlt: He threw stones at the king and the king’s officers and all the mighty warriors who surrounded him.
verses.textEnNasb: He also threw stones at David and all the servants of King David; and all the people and all the warriors were on his right and on his left.
verses.textEn: He pelted David and all the king’s officials with stones, though all the troops and the special guard were on David’s right and left.

verses.textZh: 示每咒骂的时候，这样说："你这流人血的人啊，滚开！你这无赖啊，滚开！
verses.textZhCnvs: 示每咒骂的时候，这样说："你这流人血的人啊，滚开！你这无赖啊，滚开！
verses.textZhCuv: 示每咒骂说：「你这流人血的坏人哪，去吧去吧！
verses.textEnNiv: As he cursed, Shimei said, "Get out, get out, you murderer, you scoundrel!
verses.textEnEsv: And Shimei said as he cursed, "Get out, get out, you man of blood, you worthless man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Shimei said thus when he cursed: "Come out! Come out! You bloodthirsty man, you rogue!
verses.textEnNlt: "Get out of here, you murderer, you scoundrel!" he shouted at David.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what Shimei said when he cursed: "Go away, go away, you man of bloodshed and worthless man!
verses.textEn: As he cursed, Shimei said, "Get out, get out, you murderer, you scoundrel!

verses.textZh: 你流了扫罗全家的血，接替扫罗作王，耶和华已经把这罪报应在你身上；耶和华已经把这国交在你儿子押沙龙的手里。看哪！你现在自取其祸了，因为你是个流人血的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你流了扫罗全家的血，接替扫罗作王，耶和华已经把这罪报应在你身上；耶和华已经把这国交在你儿子押沙龙的手里。看哪！你现在自取其祸了，因为你是个流人血的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你流扫罗全家的血，接续他作王；耶和华把这罪归在你身上，将这国交给你儿子押沙龙。现在你自取其祸，因为你是流人血的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has repaid you for all the blood you shed in the household of Saul, in whose place you have reigned. The Lord has given the kingdom into the hands of your son Absalom. You have come to ruin because you are a murderer!"
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has avenged on you all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose place you have reigned, and the Lord has given the kingdom into the hand of your son Absalom. See, your evil is on you, for you are a man of blood."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has brought upon you all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose place you have reigned; and the Lord has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son. So now you arecaught in your own evil, because you are a bloodthirsty man!"
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord is paying you back for all the bloodshed in Saul’s clan. You stole his throne, and now the Lord has given it to your son Absalom. At last you will taste some of your own medicine, for you are a murderer!"
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has brought back upon you all the bloodshed of the house of Saul, in whose place you have become king; and the Lord has handed the kingdom over to your son Absalom. And behold, you are caught in your own evil, for you are a man of bloodshed!"
verses.textEn: The Lord has repaid you for all the blood you shed in the household of Saul, in whose place you have reigned. The Lord has given the kingdom into the hands of your son Absalom. You have come to ruin because you are a murderer!"

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛对王说："为甚么让这条死狗咒骂我主我王呢？让我过去，把他的头砍下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛对王说："为甚么让这条死狗咒骂我主我王呢？让我过去，把他的头砍下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛对王说：「这死狗岂可咒骂我主我王呢？求你容我过去，割下他的头来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and take off his head."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please, let me go over and take off his head!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king?" Abishai son of Zeruiah demanded. "Let me go over and cut off his head!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Now let me go over and cut off his head."
verses.textEn: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head."

verses.textZh: 王说："洗鲁雅的儿子啊，我与你们有甚么关系呢？如果他咒骂是因为耶和华对他说：‘你要咒骂大卫！’那么谁敢说：‘你为甚么这样作呢？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："洗鲁雅的儿子啊，我与你们有甚么关系呢？如果他咒骂是因为耶和华对他说：‘你要咒骂大卫！’那么谁敢说：‘你为甚么这样作呢？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「洗鲁雅的儿子，我与你们有何关涉呢？他咒骂是因耶和华吩咐他说：『你要咒骂大卫。』如此，谁敢说你为什么这样行呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the king said, "What does this have to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? If he is cursing because the Lord said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who can ask, ‘Why do you do this?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But the king said, "What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? If he is cursing because the Lord has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But the king said, "What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? So let him curse, because the Lord has said to him, ‘Curse David.’ Who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "No!" the king said. "Who asked your opinion, you sons of Zeruiah! If the Lord has told him to curse me, who are you to stop him?"
verses.textEnNasb: But the king said, " What business of mine is yours, you sons of Zeruiah? If he curses, and if the Lord has told him, ‘Curse David,’ then who should say, ‘Why have you done so?’ "
verses.textEn: But the king said, "What does this have to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? If he is cursing because the Lord said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who can ask, ‘Why do you do this?’ "

verses.textZh: 大卫又对亚比筛和他所有的臣仆说："看哪！连我亲生的儿子尚且寻索我的命，何况这便雅悯人呢？由他去吧，由他咒骂吧！因为这是耶和华吩咐他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫又对亚比筛和他所有的臣仆说："看哪！连我亲生的儿子尚且寻索我的命，何况这便雅悯人呢？由他去吧，由他咒骂吧！因为这是耶和华吩咐他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫又对亚比筛和众臣仆说：「我亲生的儿子尚且寻索我的性命，何况这便雅悯人呢？由他咒骂吧！因为这是耶和华吩咐他的。
verses.textEnNiv: David then said to Abishai and all his officials, "My son, my own flesh and blood, is trying to kill me. How much more, then, this Benjamite! Leave him alone; let him curse, for the Lord has told him to.
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Abishai and to all his servants, "Behold, my own son seeks my life; how much more now may this Benjaminite! Leave him alone, and let him curse, for the Lord has told him to.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Abishai and all his servants, "See how my son who came from my own body seeks my life. How much more now maythis Benjamite? Let him alone, and let him curse; for so the Lord has ordered him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said to Abishai and to all his servants, "My own son is trying to kill me. Doesn’t this relative of Saul have even more reason to do so? Leave him alone and let him curse, for the Lord has told him to do it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Abishai and to all his servants, "Behold, my son who came out of my own body seeks my life; how much more now this Benjaminite? Leave him alone and let him curse, for the Lord has told him.
verses.textEn: David then said to Abishai and all his officials, "My son, my own flesh and blood, is trying to kill me. How much more, then, this Benjamite! Leave him alone; let him curse, for the Lord has told him to.

verses.textZh: 也许耶和华看见我的苦难，就施恩与我，以取代今天这人对我的咒骂。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也许耶和华看见我的苦难，就施恩与我，以取代今天这人对我的咒骂。"
verses.textZhCuv: 或者耶和华见我遭难，为我今日被这人咒骂，就施恩与我。」
verses.textEnNiv: It may be that the Lord will look upon my misery and restore to me his covenant blessing instead of his curse today."
verses.textEnEsv: It may be that the Lord will look on the wrong done to me, and that the Lord will repay me with good for his cursing today."
verses.textEnNkjv: It may be that the Lord will look on my affliction, and that the Lord will repay me with good for his cursing this day."
verses.textEnNlt: And perhaps the Lord will see that I am being wronged and will bless me because of these curses today."
verses.textEnNasb: Perhaps the Lord will look on my misery and return good to me instead of his cursing this day."
verses.textEn: It may be that the Lord will look upon my misery and restore to me his covenant blessing instead of his curse today."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫和跟从他的人继续在大路上往前去。示每也沿着山坡，与大卫并排而行，一边走，一边咒骂，又用石头投掷他，拿尘土扬他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫和跟从他的人继续在大路上往前去。示每也沿着山坡，与大卫并排而行，一边走，一边咒骂，又用石头投掷他，拿尘土扬他。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫和跟随他的人往前行走。示每在大卫对面山坡，一面行走一面咒骂，又拿石头砍他，拿土扬他。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and his men continued along the road while Shimei was going along the hillside opposite him, cursing as he went and throwing stones at him and showering him with dirt.
verses.textEnEsv: So David and his men went on the road, while Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went and threw stones at him and flung dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as David and his men went along the road, Shimei went along the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him and kicked up dust.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and his men continued down the road, and Shimei kept pace with them on a nearby hillside, cursing and throwing stones and dirt at David.
verses.textEnNasb: So David and his men went on the road; and Shimei kept going on the hillside close beside him, and as he went he cursed and threw stones and dirt at him.
verses.textEn: So David and his men continued along the road while Shimei was going along the hillside opposite him, cursing as he went and throwing stones at him and showering him with dirt.

verses.textZh: 王和所有与他在一起的人到了一个地方，都觉得累了，就在那里舒展一下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和所有与他在一起的人到了一个地方，都觉得累了，就在那里舒展一下。
verses.textZhCuv: 王和跟随他的众人疲疲乏乏地到了一个地方，就在那里歇息歇息。
verses.textEnNiv: The king and all the people with him arrived at their destination exhausted. And there he refreshed himself.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king, and all the people who were with him, arrived weary at the Jordan. And there he refreshed himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king and all the people who were with him became weary; so they refreshed themselves there.
verses.textEnNlt: The king and all who were with him grew weary along the way, so they rested when they reached the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king and all the people who were with him arrived exhausted, and he refreshed himself there.
verses.textEn: The king and all the people with him arrived at their destination exhausted. And there he refreshed himself.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙和以色列众人进了耶路撒冷，亚希多弗也与押沙龙在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙和以色列众人进了耶路撒冷，亚希多弗也与押沙龙在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙和以色列众人来到耶路撒冷；亚希多弗也与他同来。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Meanwhile Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem; and Ahithophel was with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Absalom and all the army of Israel arrived at Jerusalem, accompanied by Ahithophel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, entered Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.

verses.textZh: 大卫的朋友亚基人户筛去见押沙龙，对他说："愿王万岁！愿王万岁！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的朋友亚基人户筛去见押沙龙，对他说："愿王万岁！愿王万岁！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫的朋友亚基人户筛去见押沙龙，对他说：「愿王万岁！愿王万岁！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Hushai the Arkite, David’s confidant, went to Absalom and said to him, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, came to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, came to Absalom, that Hushai said to Absalom, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNlt: When David’s friend Hushai the Arkite arrived, he went immediately to see Absalom. "Long live the king!" he exclaimed. "Long live the king!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, came to Absalom, that Hushai said to Absalom, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"
verses.textEn: Then Hushai the Arkite, David’s confidant, went to Absalom and said to him, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"

verses.textZh: 押沙龙问户筛："你就以这样的‘慈爱’待你的朋友吗？你为甚么没有与你的朋友一同走呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙问户筛："你就以这样的‘慈爱’待你的朋友吗？你为甚么没有与你的朋友一同走呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙问户筛说：「这是你恩待朋友吗？为什么不与你的朋友同去呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Absalom said to Hushai, "So this is the love you show your friend? If he’s your friend, why didn’t you go with him?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Absalom said to Hushai, "Is this your loyalty to your friend? Why did you not go with your friend?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Absalom said to Hushai, "Is this your loyalty to your friend? Why did you not go with your friend?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Is this the way you treat your friend David?" Absalom asked him. "Why aren’t you with him?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Absalom said to Hushai, "Is this your loyalty to your friend? Why did you not go with your friend?"
verses.textEn: Absalom said to Hushai, "So this is the love you show your friend? If he’s your friend, why didn’t you go with him?"

verses.textZh: 户筛回答押沙龙："不！耶和华和这民，以及以色列众人所拣选的，我应该归属他，与他在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户筛回答押沙龙："不！耶和华和这民，以及以色列众人所拣选的，我应该归属他，与他在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 户筛对押沙龙说：「不然，耶和华和这民，并以色列众人所拣选的，我必归顺他，与他同住。
verses.textEnNiv: Hushai said to Absalom, "No, the one chosen by the Lord , by these people, and by all the men of Israel—his I will be, and I will remain with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hushai said to Absalom, "No, for whom the Lord and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, his I will be, and with him I will remain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hushai said to Absalom, "No, but whom the Lord and this people and all the men of Israel choose, his I will be, and with him I will remain.
verses.textEnNlt: "I’m here because I belong to the man who is chosen by the Lord and by all the men of Israel," Hushai replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hushai said to Absalom, "No! For whomever the Lord, this people, and all the men of Israel have chosen, his I shall be, and with him I shall remain.
verses.textEn: Hushai said to Absalom, "No, the one chosen by the Lord , by these people, and by all the men of Israel—his I will be, and I will remain with him.

verses.textZh: 再者，我要事奉谁呢？不是前王的儿子吗？我以前怎样事奉你的父亲，我现在也必怎样事奉你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 再者，我要事奉谁呢？不是前王的儿子吗？我以前怎样事奉你的父亲，我现在也必怎样事奉你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，我当服事谁呢？岂不是前王的儿子吗？我怎样服事你父亲，也必照样服事你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, whom should I serve? Should I not serve the son? Just as I served your father, so I will serve you."
verses.textEnEsv: And again, whom should I serve? Should it not be his son? As I have served your father, so I will serve you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore, whom should I serve? ShouldI not serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so will I be in your presence."
verses.textEnNlt: "And anyway, why shouldn’t I serve you? Just as I was your father’s adviser, now I will be your adviser!"
verses.textEnNasb: Besides, whom should I serve? Should I not serve in the presence of his son? Just as I have served in your father’s presence, so I shall be in your presence."
verses.textEn: Furthermore, whom should I serve? Should I not serve the son? Just as I served your father, so I will serve you."

verses.textZh: 押沙龙对亚希多弗说："你们出个主意，我们应该怎样行才好？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙对亚希多弗说："你们出个主意，我们应该怎样行才好？"
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙对亚希多弗说：「你们出个主意，我们怎样行才好？」
verses.textEnNiv: Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give us your advice. What should we do?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give your counsel. What shall we do?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give advice as to what we should do."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Absalom turned to Ahithophel and asked him, "What should I do next?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give your advice. What should we do?"
verses.textEn: Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give us your advice. What should we do?"

verses.textZh: 亚希多弗对押沙龙说："你去与你父亲留下来看守王宫的那些妃嫔亲近，这样以色列众人听见你与你父亲已经完全决裂，所有跟随你的人的手就都更坚强了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希多弗对押沙龙说："你去与你父亲留下来看守王宫的那些妃嫔亲近，这样以色列众人听见你与你父亲已经完全决裂，所有跟随你的人的手就都更坚强了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希多弗对押沙龙说：「你父所留下看守宫殿的妃嫔，你可以与她们亲近。以色列众人听见你父亲憎恶你，凡归顺你人的手就更坚强。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ahithophel answered, "Sleep with your father’s concubines whom he left to take care of the palace. Then all Israel will hear that you have made yourself obnoxious to your father, and the hands of everyone with you will be more resolute."
verses.textEnEsv: Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Go in to your father’s concubines, whom he has left to keep the house, and all Israel will hear that you have made yourself a stench to your father, and the hands of all who are with you will be strengthened."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Go in to your father’s concubines, whom he has left to keep the house; and all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong."
verses.textEnNlt: Ahithophel told him, "Go and sleep with your father’s concubines, for he has left them here to look after the palace. Then all Israel will know that you have insulted your father beyond hope of reconciliation, and they will throw their support to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Have relations with your father’s concubines, whom he has left behind to take care of the house; then all Israel will hear that you have made yourself repulsive to your father. The hands of all who are with you will also be strengthened."
verses.textEn: Ahithophel answered, "Sleep with your father’s concubines whom he left to take care of the palace. Then all Israel will hear that you have made yourself obnoxious to your father, and the hands of everyone with you will be more resolute."

verses.textZh: 于是有人为押沙龙在王宫的平顶上搭了一座帐棚，押沙龙就在以色列众人眼前与他父亲的妃嫔亲近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有人为押沙龙在王宫的平顶上搭了一座帐棚，押沙龙就在以色列众人眼前与他父亲的妃嫔亲近。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是人为押沙龙在宫殿的平顶上支搭帐棚；押沙龙在以色列众人眼前，与他父的妃嫔亲近。
verses.textEnNiv: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof. And Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So they set up a tent on the palace roof where everyone could see it, and Absalom went in and had sex with his father’s concubines.
verses.textEnNasb: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and Absalom had relations with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
verses.textEn: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

verses.textZh: 那时，亚希多弗所出的策略，好象是人求问神得来的话一样。亚希多弗为大卫，或为押沙龙所出的策略都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，亚希多弗所出的策略，好象是人求问神得来的话一样。亚希多弗为大卫，或为押沙龙所出的策略都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时亚希多弗所出的主意好像人问神的话一样；他昔日给大卫，今日给押沙龙所出的主意，都是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Now in those days the advice Ahithophel gave was like that of one who inquires of God. That was how both David and Absalom regarded all of Ahithophel’s advice.
verses.textEnEsv: Now in those days the counsel that Ahithophel gave was as if one consulted the word of God; so was all the counsel of Ahithophel esteemed, both by David and by Absalom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the advice of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if one had inquired at the oracle of God. So was all the advice of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.
verses.textEnNlt: Absalom followed Ahithophel’s advice, just as David had done. For every word Ahithophel spoke seemed as wise as though it had come directly from the mouth of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the advice of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was taken as though one inquired of the word of God; so was all the advice of Ahithophel regarded by both David and Absalom.
verses.textEn: Now in those days the advice Ahithophel gave was like that of one who inquires of God. That was how both David and Absalom regarded all of Ahithophel’s advice.

verses.textZh: 亚希多弗又对押沙龙说："求你准我挑选一万二千人，今晚我要动身去追赶大卫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希多弗又对押沙龙说："求你准我挑选一万二千人，今晚我要动身去追赶大卫，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希多弗又对押沙龙说：「求你准我挑选一万二千人，今夜我就起身追赶大卫，
verses.textEnNiv: Ahithophel said to Absalom, "I would choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Let me choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue David tonight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Now let me choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue David tonight.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Ahithophel urged Absalom, "Let me choose 12,000 men to start out after David tonight.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, Ahithophel said to Absalom, "Please let me choose twelve thousand men and let me set out and pursue David tonight.
verses.textEn: Ahithophel said to Absalom, "I would choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.

verses.textZh: 趁他疲乏手软的时候，忽然追上他，使他惊惶失措，与他在一起的人就必逃跑；我只要单单击杀王一人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 趁他疲乏手软的时候，忽然追上他，使他惊惶失措，与他在一起的人就必逃跑；我只要单单击杀王一人，
verses.textZhCuv: 趁他疲乏手软，我忽然追上他，使他惊惶；跟随他的民必都逃跑，我就单杀王一人，
verses.textEnNiv: I would attack him while he is weary and weak. I would strike him with terror, and then all the people with him will flee. I would strike down only the king
verses.textEnEsv: I will come upon him while he is weary and discouraged and throw him into a panic, and all the people who are with him will flee. I will strike down only the king,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will come upon him while he is weary and weak, and make him afraid. And all the people who are with him will flee, and I will strike only the king.
verses.textEnNlt: I will catch up with him while he is weary and discouraged. He and his troops will panic, and everyone will run away. Then I will kill only the king,
verses.textEnNasb: And I will attack him while he is weary and exhausted and startle him, so that all the people who are with him will flee. Then I will strike and kill the king when he is alone,
verses.textEn: I would attack him while he is weary and weak. I would strike him with terror, and then all the people with him will flee. I would strike down only the king

verses.textZh: 使众人都来归你，好象新娘归回丈夫那里一样。你所寻索的不过是一个人的性命，众人会平安无事 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 使众人都来归你，好象新娘归回丈夫那里一样。你所寻索的不过是一个人的性命，众人会平安无事 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使众民都归顺你。你所寻找的人既然死了，众民就如已经归顺你；这样，也都平安无事了。」
verses.textEnNiv: and bring all the people back to you. The death of the man you seek will mean the return of all; all the people will be unharmed."
verses.textEnEsv: and I will bring all the people back to you as a bride comes home to her husband. You seek the life of only one man, and all the people will be at peace."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will bring back all the people to you. When all return except the man whom you seek, all the people will be at peace."
verses.textEnNlt: and I will bring all the people back to you as a bride returns to her husband. After all, it is only one man’s life that you seek. Then you will be at peace with all the people."
verses.textEnNasb: and I will bring all the people back to you. The return of everyone depends on the man whom you are seeking; then all the people will be at peace."
verses.textEn: and bring all the people back to you. The death of the man you seek will mean the return of all; all the people will be unharmed."

verses.textZh: 押沙龙和以色列的众长老都看这事为美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙和以色列的众长老都看这事为美。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙和以色列的长老都以这话为美。
verses.textEnNiv: This plan seemed good to Absalom and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the advice seemed right in the eyes of Absalom and all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the saying pleased Absalom and all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: This plan seemed good to Absalom and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the plan pleased Absalom and all the elders of Israel.
verses.textEn: This plan seemed good to Absalom and to all the elders of Israel.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙说："把亚基人户筛召来，我们也听听他怎么说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙说："把亚基人户筛召来，我们也听听他怎么说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙说：「要召亚基人户筛来，我们也要听他怎样说。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Absalom said, "Summon also Hushai the Arkite, so we can hear what he has to say as well."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Absalom said, "Call Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear what he has to say."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Absalom said, "Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear what he says too."
verses.textEnNlt: But then Absalom said, "Bring in Hushai the Arkite. Let’s see what he thinks about this."
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, Absalom said, "Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear what he has to say."
verses.textEn: But Absalom said, "Summon also Hushai the Arkite, so we can hear what he has to say as well."

verses.textZh: 于是户筛来见押沙龙，押沙龙问他说："亚希多弗说了这样的话，我们可以照着他的话去行吗？如果不可以，请你提议吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是户筛来见押沙龙，押沙龙问他说："亚希多弗说了这样的话，我们可以照着他的话去行吗？如果不可以，请你提议吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 户筛到了押沙龙面前，押沙龙向他说：「亚希多弗是如此如此说的，我们照着他的话行可以不可以？若不可，你就说吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: When Hushai came to him, Absalom said, "Ahithophel has given this advice. Should we do what he says? If not, give us your opinion."
verses.textEnEsv: And when Hushai came to Absalom, Absalom said to him, "Thus has Ahithophel spoken; shall we do as he says? If not, you speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Hushai came to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, "Ahithophel has spoken in this manner. Shall we do as he says? If not, speak up."
verses.textEnNlt: When Hushai arrived, Absalom told him what Ahithophel had said. Then he asked, "What is your opinion? Should we follow Ahithophel’s advice? If not, what do you suggest?"
verses.textEnNasb: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom said to him, "Ahithophel has proposed this plan. Should we carry out his plan? If not, say so yourself."
verses.textEn: When Hushai came to him, Absalom said, "Ahithophel has given this advice. Should we do what he says? If not, give us your opinion."

verses.textZh: 户筛回答押沙龙："亚希多弗这次计划的谋略不好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 户筛回答押沙龙："亚希多弗这次计划的谋略不好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 户筛对押沙龙说：「亚希多弗这次所定的谋不善。」
verses.textEnNiv: Hushai replied to Absalom, "The advice Ahithophel has given is not good this time.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hushai said to Absalom, "This time the counsel that Ahithophel has given is not good."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hushai said to Absalom: "The advice that Ahithophel has given is not good at this time.
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," Hushai replied to Absalom, "this time Ahithophel has made a mistake.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hushai said to Absalom, "This time the advice that Ahithophel has given is not good."
verses.textEn: Hushai replied to Absalom, "The advice Ahithophel has given is not good this time.

verses.textZh: 户筛又说："你知道你父亲和那些跟随他的人都是勇士；他们心里正在恼怒，好象野地里丧子的母熊一样；并且你父亲是个战士，必不会与众人在一起住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户筛又说："你知道你父亲和那些跟随他的人都是勇士；他们心里正在恼怒，好象野地里丧子的母熊一样；并且你父亲是个战士，必不会与众人在一起住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 户筛又说：「你知道，你父亲和跟随他的人都是勇士，现在他们心里恼怒，如同田野丢崽子的母熊一般，而且你父亲是个战士，必不和民一同住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: You know your father and his men; they are fighters, and as fierce as a wild bear robbed of her cubs. Besides, your father is an experienced fighter; he will not spend the night with the troops.
verses.textEnEsv: Hushai said, "You know that your father and his men are mighty men, and that they are enraged, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Besides, your father is expert in war; he will not spend the night with the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For," said Hushai, "you know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are enraged in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field; and your father is a man of war, and will not camp with the people.
verses.textEnNlt: You know your father and his men; they are mighty warriors. Right now they are as enraged as a mother bear who has been robbed of her cubs. And remember that your father is an experienced man of war. He won’t be spending the night among the troops.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hushai said, "You yourself know your father and his men, that they are warriors and they are fierce, like a bear deprived of her cubs in the field. And your father is an expert in warfare, and he will not spend the night with the people.
verses.textEn: You know your father and his men; they are fighters, and as fierce as a wild bear robbed of her cubs. Besides, your father is an experienced fighter; he will not spend the night with the troops.

verses.textZh: 现在他或躺在一个坑中，或在另一个地方，如果他首先攻击你的手下，听见的人就必说：‘跟从押沙龙的人被杀了！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在他或躺在一个坑中，或在另一个地方，如果他首先攻击你的手下，听见的人就必说：‘跟从押沙龙的人被杀了！’
verses.textZhCuv: 他现今或藏在坑中或在别处，若有人首先被杀，凡听见的必说：『跟随押沙龙的民被杀了。』
verses.textEnNiv: Even now, he is hidden in a cave or some other place. If he should attack your troops first, whoever hears about it will say, ‘There has been a slaughter among the troops who follow Absalom.’
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, even now he has hidden himself in one of the pits or in some other place. And as soon as some of the people fall at the first attack, whoever hears it will say, ‘There has been a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely by now he is hidden in some pit, or in some other place. And it will be, when some of them are overthrown at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom.’
verses.textEnNlt: He has probably already hidden in some pit or cave. And when he comes out and attacks and a few of your men fall, there will be panic among your troops, and the word will spread that Absalom’s men are being slaughtered.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, he has now hidden himself in one of the ravines, or in another place; and it will be that when he falls on them at the first attack, whoever hears it will say, ‘There has been a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’
verses.textEn: Even now, he is hidden in a cave or some other place. If he should attack your troops first, whoever hears about it will say, ‘There has been a slaughter among the troops who follow Absalom.’

verses.textZh: 那时，纵使有人像狮子一般勇敢，心里也必惊慌，因为全以色列都知道你父亲是个勇士，跟随他的人都是英勇的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，纵使有人像狮子一般勇敢，心里也必惊慌，因为全以色列都知道你父亲是个勇士，跟随他的人都是英勇的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有人胆大如狮子，他的心也必消化；因为以色列人都知道你父亲是英雄，跟随他的人也都是勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: Then even the bravest soldier, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will melt with fear, for all Israel knows that your father is a fighter and that those with him are brave.
verses.textEnEsv: Then even the valiant man, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will utterly melt with fear, for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and that those who are with him are valiant men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And even he whois valiant, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will melt completely. For all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.
verses.textEnNlt: Then even the bravest soldiers, though they have the heart of a lion, will be paralyzed with fear. For all Israel knows what a mighty warrior your father is and how courageous his men are.
verses.textEnNasb: And even the one who is valiant, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will completely despair; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.
verses.textEn: Then even the bravest soldier, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will melt with fear, for all Israel knows that your father is a fighter and that those with him are brave.

verses.textZh: 因此，我建议把以色列众人，从但到别是巴，都聚集到你这里来，好象海边的沙那样多，然后你亲自率领他们上战场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我建议把以色列众人，从但到别是巴，都聚集到你这里来，好象海边的沙那样多，然后你亲自率领他们上战场。
verses.textZhCuv: 依我之计，不如将以色列众人－从但直到别是巴，如同海边的沙那样多－聚集到你这里来，你也亲自率领他们出战。
verses.textEnNiv: "So I advise you: Let all Israel, from Dan to Beersheba—as numerous as the sand on the seashore—be gathered to you, with you yourself leading them into battle.
verses.textEnEsv: But my counsel is that all Israel be gathered to you, from Dan to Beersheba, as the sand by the sea for multitude, and that you go to battle in person.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I advise that all Israel be fully gathered to you, from Dan to Beersheba, like the sand that is by the sea for multitude, and that you go to battle in person.
verses.textEnNlt: "I recommend that you mobilize the entire army of Israel, bringing them from as far away as Dan in the north and Beersheba in the south. That way you will have an army as numerous as the sand on the seashore. And I advise that you personally lead the troops.
verses.textEnNasb: But I advise that all Israel be fully gathered to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, like the sand that is by the sea in abundance; and that you personally go into battle.
verses.textEn: "So I advise you: Let all Israel, from Dan to Beersheba—as numerous as the sand on the seashore—be gathered to you, with you yourself leading them into battle.

verses.textZh: 无论我们在哪一个地方找到大卫，就攻击他；我们临到他，像露水降在地上一样。这样，他和跟随他的人，就一个也不会留下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论我们在哪一个地方找到大卫，就攻击他；我们临到他，像露水降在地上一样。这样，他和跟随他的人，就一个也不会留下。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们在何处遇见他，就下到他那里，如同露水下在地上一般，连他带跟随他的人，一个也不留下。
verses.textEnNiv: Then we will attack him wherever he may be found, and we will fall on him as dew settles on the ground. Neither he nor any of his men will be left alive.
verses.textEnEsv: So we shall come upon him in some place where he is to be found, and we shall light upon him as the dew falls on the ground, and of him and all the men with him not one will be left.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we will come upon him in some place where he may be found, and we will fall on him as the dew falls on the ground. And of him and all the men who are with him there shall not be left so much as one.
verses.textEnNlt: When we find David, we’ll fall on him like dew that falls on the ground. Then neither he nor any of his men will be left alive.
verses.textEnNasb: Then we will come to him in one of the places where he can be found, and we will fall on him just as the dew falls on the ground; and of him and of all the men who are with him, not even one will be left.
verses.textEn: Then we will attack him wherever he may be found, and we will fall on him as dew settles on the ground. Neither he nor any of his men will be left alive.

verses.textZh: 如果他退入城里去，以色列众人就要带绳子到那城去，我们要把那城拉到河里去，使那里连一块小石头也找不到。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他退入城里去，以色列众人就要带绳子到那城去，我们要把那城拉到河里去，使那里连一块小石头也找不到。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他若进了哪一座城，以色列众人必带绳子去，将那城拉到河里，甚至连一块小石头都不剩下。」
verses.textEnNiv: If he withdraws into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it down to the valley until not so much as a pebble is left."
verses.textEnEsv: If he withdraws into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we shall drag it into the valley, until not even a pebble is to be found there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, if he has withdrawn into a city, then all Israel shall bring ropes to that city; and we will pull it into the river, until there is not one small stone found there."
verses.textEnNlt: And if David were to escape into some town, you will have all Israel there at your command. Then we can take ropes and drag the walls of the town into the nearest valley until every stone is torn down."
verses.textEnNasb: And if he withdraws into a city, then all Israel shall bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it into the valley until not even a pebble is found there."
verses.textEn: If he withdraws into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it down to the valley until not so much as a pebble is left."

verses.textZh: 押沙龙和以色列众人都说："亚基人户筛的谋略比亚希多弗的好。"因为耶和华定意要破坏亚希多弗的好计谋，为要降灾祸给押沙龙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙和以色列众人都说："亚基人户筛的谋略比亚希多弗的好。"因为耶和华定意要破坏亚希多弗的好计谋，为要降灾祸给押沙龙。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙和以色列众人说：「亚基人户筛的计谋比亚希多弗的计谋更好！」这是因耶和华定意破坏亚希多弗的良谋，为要降祸与押沙龙。
verses.textEnNiv: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The advice of Hushai the Arkite is better than that of Ahithophel." For the Lord had determined to frustrate the good advice of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom.
verses.textEnEsv: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel." For the Lord had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, so that the Lord might bring harm upon Absalom.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than the advice of Ahithophel." For the Lord had purposed to defeat the good advice of Ahithophel, to the intent that the Lord might bring disaster on Absalom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "Hushai’s advice is better than Ahithophel’s." For the Lord had determined to defeat the counsel of Ahithophel, which really was the better plan, so that he could bring disaster on Absalom!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than the advice of Ahithophel." For the Lord had ordained to foil the good advice of Ahithophel, in order for the Lord to bring disaster on Absalom.
verses.textEn: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The advice of Hushai the Arkite is better than that of Ahithophel." For the Lord had determined to frustrate the good advice of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom.

verses.textZh: 于是户筛对撒督祭司和亚比亚他说："亚希多弗为押沙龙和以色列的众长老所策定的谋略是这样这样的，我所策定的谋略又是这样这样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是户筛对撒督祭司和亚比亚他说："亚希多弗为押沙龙和以色列的众长老所策定的谋略是这样这样的，我所策定的谋略又是这样这样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 户筛对祭司撒督和亚比亚他说： 「亚希多弗为押沙龙和以色列的长老所定的计谋是如此如此，我所定的计谋是如此如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, "Ahithophel has advised Absalom and the elders of Israel to do such and such, but I have advised them to do so and so.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Hushai said to Zadok and Abiathar the priests, "Thus and so did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel, and thus and so have I counseled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hushai said to Zadok and Abiathar the priests, "Thus and so Ahithophel advised Absalom and the elders of Israel, and thus and so I have advised.
verses.textEnNlt: Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, what Ahithophel had said to Absalom and the elders of Israel and what he himself had advised instead.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, " This is what Ahithophel advised Absalom and the elders of Israel to do, and this is what I have advised.
verses.textEn: Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, "Ahithophel has advised Absalom and the elders of Israel to do such and such, but I have advised them to do so and so.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要赶快派人去告诉大卫：‘今天晚上你不可在旷野的渡口住宿，务要过河，免得王和跟随他的众人都被吞灭。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要赶快派人去告诉大卫：‘今天晚上你不可在旷野的渡口住宿，务要过河，免得王和跟随他的众人都被吞灭。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们要急速打发人去，告诉大卫说：『今夜不可住在旷野的渡口，务要过河，免得王和跟随他的人都被吞灭。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Now send a message at once and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the fords in the wilderness; cross over without fail, or the king and all the people with him will be swallowed up.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore send quickly and tell David, ‘Do not stay tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king and all the people who are with him be swallowed up.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, send quickly and tell David, saying, ‘Do not spend this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily cross over, lest the king and all the people who are with him be swallowed up.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Quick!" he told them. "Find David and urge him not to stay at the shallows of the Jordan River tonight. He must go across at once into the wilderness beyond. Otherwise he will die and his entire army with him."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, send a messenger quickly and tell David, saying, ‘Do not spend the night at the river crossing places of the wilderness, but by all means cross over, or else the king and all the people who are with him will be destroyed.’ "
verses.textEn: Now send a message at once and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the fords in the wilderness; cross over without fail, or the king and all the people with him will be swallowed up.’ "

verses.textZh: 那时，约拿单和亚希玛斯停留在隐．罗结，他们不敢进城，怕被人看见。有一个婢女经常出来，把话告诉他们，然后他们再去告诉大卫王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约拿单和亚希玛斯停留在隐．罗结，他们不敢进城，怕被人看见。有一个婢女经常出来，把话告诉他们，然后他们再去告诉大卫王。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，约拿单和亚希玛斯在隐‧罗结那里等候，不敢进城，恐怕被人看见。有一个使女出来，将这话告诉他们，他们就去报信给大卫王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En Rogel. A female servant was to go and inform them, and they were to go and tell King David, for they could not risk being seen entering the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were waiting at En-rogel. A female servant was to go and tell them, and they were to go and tell King David, for they were not to be seen entering the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed at En Rogel, for they dared not be seen coming into the city; so a female servant would come and tell them, and they would go and tell King David.
verses.textEnNlt: Jonathan and Ahimaaz had been staying at En-rogel so as not to be seen entering and leaving the city. Arrangements had been made for a servant girl to bring them the message they were to take to King David.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En-rogel, and a female servant would go and inform them, and they would go and inform King David, for they could not allow themselves to be seen entering the city.
verses.textEn: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En Rogel. A female servant was to go and inform them, and they were to go and tell King David, for they could not risk being seen entering the city.

verses.textZh: 但有一个仆人看见他们，就去告诉押沙龙。因此，他们两人急忙离开那里，来到巴户琳某人的家里；那人的院子里有一口井，他们就下到井里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有一个仆人看见他们，就去告诉押沙龙。因此，他们两人急忙离开那里，来到巴户琳某人的家里；那人的院子里有一口井，他们就下到井里。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而有一个童子看见他们，就去告诉押沙龙。他们急忙跑到巴户琳某人的家里；那人院中有一口井，他们就下到井里。
verses.textEnNiv: But a young man saw them and told Absalom. So the two of them left at once and went to the house of a man in Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.
verses.textEnEsv: But a young man saw them and told Absalom. So both of them went away quickly and came to the house of a man at Bahurim, who had a well in his courtyard. And they went down into it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom. But both of them went away quickly and came to a man’s house in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down into it.
verses.textEnNlt: But a boy spotted them at En-rogel, and he told Absalom about it. So they quickly escaped to Bahurim, where a man hid them down inside a well in his courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: But a boy did see them, and he told Absalom; so the two of them left quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his courtyard, and they went down into it.
verses.textEn: But a young man saw them and told Absalom. So the two of them left at once and went to the house of a man in Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.

verses.textZh: 那家的主妇拿了一块大布，盖在井口上，又在上面铺了一些麦子，所以没有人知道这件事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那家的主妇拿了一块大布，盖在井口上，又在上面铺了一些麦子，所以没有人知道这件事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那家的妇人用盖盖上井口，又在上头铺上碎麦，事就没有泄漏。
verses.textEnNiv: His wife took a covering and spread it out over the opening of the well and scattered grain over it. No one knew anything about it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth and scattered grain on it, and nothing was known of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground grain on it; and the thing was not known.
verses.textEnNlt: The man’s wife put a cloth over the top of the well and scattered grain on it to dry in the sun; so no one suspected they were there.
verses.textEnNasb: And the woman took a cover and spread it over the well’s mouth and scattered barley meal on it, so that nothing was known.
verses.textEn: His wife took a covering and spread it out over the opening of the well and scattered grain over it. No one knew anything about it.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙的臣仆到这家来见那妇人，问她："亚希玛斯和约拿单在哪里？"那妇人回答他们说："他们已经过了河了。"于是臣仆搜索他们，却没有找着，就都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙的臣仆到这家来见那妇人，问她："亚希玛斯和约拿单在哪里？"那妇人回答他们说："他们已经过了河了。"于是臣仆搜索他们，却没有找着，就都回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙的仆人来到那家，问妇人说：「亚希玛斯和约拿单在哪里？」妇人说：「他们过了河了。」仆人找他们，找不着，就回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Absalom’s men came to the woman at the house, they asked, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" The woman answered them, "They crossed over the brook." The men searched but found no one, so they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house, they said, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" And the woman said to them, "They have gone over the brook of water." And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house, they said, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" So the woman said to them, "They have gone over the water brook." And when they had searched and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: When Absalom’s men arrived, they asked her, "Have you seen Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" The woman replied, "They were here, but they crossed over the brook." Absalom’s men looked for them without success and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house and said, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" And the woman said to them, "They have crossed the brook of water." And when they searched and did not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: When Absalom’s men came to the woman at the house, they asked, "Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?" The woman answered them, "They crossed over the brook." The men searched but found no one, so they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们走了以后，两人从井里上来，去告诉大卫王，对大卫说："你们要起来，赶快过河，因为亚希多弗已经定了这样这样的谋略攻击你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走了以后，两人从井里上来，去告诉大卫王，对大卫说："你们要起来，赶快过河，因为亚希多弗已经定了这样这样的谋略攻击你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们走后，二人从井里上来，去告诉大卫王说：「亚希多弗如此如此定计害你，你们务要起来，快快过河。」
verses.textEnNiv: After they had gone, the two climbed out of the well and went to inform King David. They said to him, "Set out and cross the river at once; Ahithophel has advised such and such against you."
verses.textEnEsv: After they had gone, the men came up out of the well, and went and told King David. They said to David, "Arise, and go quickly over the water, for thus and so has Ahithophel counseled against you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, after they had departed, that they came up out of the well and went and told King David, and said to David, "Arise and cross over the water quickly. For thus has Ahithophel advised against you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the two men crawled out of the well and hurried on to King David. "Quick!" they told him, "cross the Jordan tonight!" And they told him how Ahithophel had advised that he be captured and killed.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about after they had departed, that they came up out of the well and went and reported to King David; and they said to David, "Set out and cross over the water quickly, because this is what Ahithophel has advised against you."
verses.textEn: After they had gone, the two climbed out of the well and went to inform King David. They said to him, "Set out and cross the river at once; Ahithophel has advised such and such against you."

verses.textZh: 于是大卫和跟随他的众人都起来，渡过约旦河；到了天亮，没有一人还没有渡过约旦河的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫和跟随他的众人都起来，渡过约旦河；到了天亮，没有一人还没有渡过约旦河的。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大卫和跟随他的人都起来，过约旦河。到了天亮，无一人不过约旦河的。
verses.textEnNiv: So David and all the people with him set out and crossed the Jordan. By daybreak, no one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they crossed the Jordan. By daybreak not one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David and all the people who were with him arose and crossed over the Jordan. By morning light not one of them was left who had not gone over the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: So David and all the people with him went across the Jordan River during the night, and they were all on the other bank before dawn.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David and all the people who were with him set out and crossed the Jordan; by dawn not even one remained who had not crossed the Jordan.
verses.textEn: So David and all the people with him set out and crossed the Jordan. By daybreak, no one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 亚希多弗见自己的谋略不被采纳，就预备了驴子，起程往本城自己的家去。他安排好了家里的事，就上吊死了，埋葬在他父亲的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希多弗见自己的谋略不被采纳，就预备了驴子，起程往本城自己的家去。他安排好了家里的事，就上吊死了，埋葬在他父亲的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希多弗见不依从他的计谋，就备上驴，归回本城；到了家，留下遗言，便吊死了，葬在他父亲的坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he saddled his donkey and set out for his house in his hometown. He put his house in order and then hanged himself. So he died and was buried in his father’s tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey and went off home to his own city. He set his house in order and hanged himself, and he died and was buried in the tomb of his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Ahithophel saw that his advice was not followed, he saddled a donkey, and arose and went home to his house, to his city. Then he put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died; and he was buried in his father’s tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ahithophel realized that his advice had not been followed, he saddled his donkey, went to his hometown, set his affairs in order, and hanged himself. He died there and was buried in the family tomb.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he saddled his donkey and set out and went to his home, to his city, and set his house in order, and hanged himself; so he died and was buried in his father’s grave.
verses.textEn: When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he saddled his donkey and set out for his house in his hometown. He put his house in order and then hanged himself. So he died and was buried in his father’s tomb.

verses.textZh: 大卫到了玛哈念，押沙龙和跟随他的以色列众人也都过了约旦河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫到了玛哈念，押沙龙和跟随他的以色列众人也都过了约旦河。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫到了玛哈念，押沙龙和跟随他的以色列人也都过了约旦河。
verses.textEnNiv: David went to Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David went to Mahanaim. And Absalom crossed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
verses.textEnNlt: David soon arrived at Mahanaim. By now, Absalom had mobilized the entire army of Israel and was leading his troops across the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom crossed the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
verses.textEn: David went to Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙派亚玛撒统率军队，取代约押。亚玛撒是以实玛利人 以特拉的儿子。以特拉曾经与拿辖的女儿亚比该亲近过；亚比该和约押的母亲洗鲁雅是姊妹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙派亚玛撒统率军队，取代约押。亚玛撒是以实玛利人 以特拉的儿子。以特拉曾经与拿辖的女儿亚比该亲近过；亚比该和约押的母亲洗鲁雅是姊妹。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙立亚玛撒作元帅，代替约押。亚玛撒是以实玛利人 以特拉的儿子。以特拉曾与拿辖的女儿亚比该亲近；这亚比该与约押的母亲洗鲁雅是姊妹。
verses.textEnNiv: Absalom had appointed Amasa over the army in place of Joab. Amasa was the son of Jether, an Ishmaelite who had married Abigail, the daughter of Nahash and sister of Zeruiah the mother of Joab.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Absalom had set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Amasa was the son of a man named Ithra the Ishmaelite, who had married Abigal the daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the army instead of Joab. This Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Jithra, an Israelite, who had gone in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
verses.textEnNlt: Absalom had appointed Amasa as commander of his army, replacing Joab, who had been commander under David. (Amasa was Joab’s cousin. His father was Jether, an Ishmaelite. His mother, Abigail daughter of Nahash, was the sister of Joab’s mother, Zeruiah.)
verses.textEnNasb: Absalom put Amasa in command of the army in place of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who had relations with Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
verses.textEn: Absalom had appointed Amasa over the army in place of Joab. Amasa was the son of Jether, an Ishmaelite who had married Abigail, the daughter of Nahash and sister of Zeruiah the mother of Joab.

verses.textZh: 以色列人和押沙龙都在基列地安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人和押沙龙都在基列地安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙和以色列人都安营在基列地。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: Absalom and the Israelite army set up camp in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: And Israel and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEn: The Israelites and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 大卫到了玛哈念的时候，亚扪族的拉巴人拿辖的儿子朔比、罗．底巴人亚米利的儿子玛吉、基列的罗基琳人巴西莱，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫到了玛哈念的时候，亚扪族的拉巴人拿辖的儿子朔比、罗．底巴人亚米利的儿子玛吉、基列的罗基琳人巴西莱，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫到了玛哈念，亚扪族的拉巴人拿辖的儿子朔比，罗‧底巴人亚米利的儿子玛吉，基列的罗基琳人巴西莱，
verses.textEnNiv: When David came to Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, and Makir son of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim
verses.textEnEsv: When David came to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, and Machir the son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when David had come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash from Rabbah of the people of Ammon, Machir the son of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim,
verses.textEnNlt: When David arrived at Mahanaim, he was warmly greeted by Shobi son of Nahash, who came from Rabbah of the Ammonites, and by Makir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and by Barzillai of Gilead from Rogelim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash from Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, Machir the son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim,
verses.textEn: When David came to Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, and Makir son of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim

verses.textZh: 带来寝具、碗盆、瓦器、小麦、大麦、面粉、炒麦、豆子、红豆、炒豆、
verses.textZhCnvs: 带来寝具、碗盆、瓦器、小麦、大麦、面粉、炒麦、豆子、红豆、炒豆、
verses.textZhCuv: 带着被、褥、盆、碗、瓦器、小麦、大麦、麦面、炒谷、豆子、红豆、炒豆、
verses.textEnNiv: brought bedding and bowls and articles of pottery. They also brought wheat and barley, flour and roasted grain, beans and lentils,
verses.textEnEsv: brought beds, basins, and earthen vessels, wheat, barley, flour, parched grain, beans and lentils,
verses.textEnNkjv: brought beds and basins, earthen vessels and wheat, barley and flour, parched grain and beans, lentils and parched seeds,
verses.textEnNlt: They brought sleeping mats, cooking pots, serving bowls, wheat and barley, flour and roasted grain, beans, lentils,
verses.textEnNasb: brought beds, basins, pottery, wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils, roasted seeds,
verses.textEn: brought bedding and bowls and articles of pottery. They also brought wheat and barley, flour and roasted grain, beans and lentils,

verses.textZh: 蜂蜜、奶油、绵羊和乳酪送给大卫和跟随他的人吃，因为他们说："这些人在旷野一定又饥饿，又疲倦，又口渴了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 蜂蜜、奶油、绵羊和乳酪送给大卫和跟随他的人吃，因为他们说："这些人在旷野一定又饥饿，又疲倦，又口渴了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 蜂蜜、奶油、绵羊、奶饼，供给大卫和跟随他的人吃；他们说：「民在旷野，必饥渴困乏了。」
verses.textEnNiv: honey and curds, sheep, and cheese from cows’ milk for David and his people to eat. For they said, "The people have become exhausted and hungry and thirsty in the wilderness."
verses.textEnEsv: honey and curds and sheep and cheese from the herd, for David and the people with him to eat, for they said, "The people are hungry and weary and thirsty in the wilderness."
verses.textEnNkjv: honey and curds, sheep and cheese of the herd, for David and the people who were with him to eat. For they said, "The people are hungry and weary and thirsty in the wilderness."
verses.textEnNlt: honey, butter, sheep, goats, and cheese for David and those who were with him. For they said, "You must all be very hungry and tired and thirsty after your long march through the wilderness."
verses.textEnNasb: honey, curds, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and the people who were with him, to eat. For they said, "The people are hungry and exhausted and thirsty in the wilderness."
verses.textEn: honey and curds, sheep, and cheese from cows’ milk for David and his people to eat. For they said, "The people have become exhausted and hungry and thirsty in the wilderness."

verses.textZh: 大卫数点了跟随他的人，亦立千夫长、百夫长率领他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫数点了跟随他的人，亦立千夫长、百夫长率领他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫数点跟随他的人，立千夫长、百夫长率领他们。
verses.textEnNiv: David mustered the men who were with him and appointed over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David mustered the men who were with him and set over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David numbered the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
verses.textEnNlt: David now mustered the men who were with him and appointed generals and captains to lead them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David took a count of the people who were with him and appointed over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
verses.textEn: David mustered the men who were with him and appointed over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

verses.textZh: 大卫派遣众人出战：三分之一在约押手下，三分之一在约押的兄弟、洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛手下，三分之一在迦特人以太手下。大卫对众人说："我也必与你们一同出战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫派遣众人出战：三分之一在约押手下，三分之一在约押的兄弟、洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛手下，三分之一在迦特人以太手下。大卫对众人说："我也必与你们一同出战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫打发军兵出战，分为三队：一队在约押手下，一队在洗鲁雅的儿子、约押兄弟亚比筛手下，一队在迦特人以太手下。大卫对军兵说：「我必与你们一同出战。」
verses.textEnNiv: David sent out his troops, a third under the command of Joab, a third under Joab’s brother Abishai son of Zeruiah, and a third under Ittai the Gittite. The king told the troops, "I myself will surely march out with you."
verses.textEnEsv: And David sent out the army, one third under the command of Joab, one third under the command of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and one third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said to the men, "I myself will also go out with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David sent out one third of the people under the hand of Joab, one third under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and one third under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said to the people, "I also will surely go out with you myself."
verses.textEnNlt: He sent the troops out in three groups, placing one group under Joab, one under Joab’s brother Abishai son of Zeruiah, and one under Ittai, the man from Gath. The king told his troops, "I am going out with you."
verses.textEnNasb: And David sent the people out, a third under the command of Joab, a third under the command of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said to the people, "I myself will certainly go out with you also."
verses.textEn: David sent out his troops, a third under the command of Joab, a third under Joab’s brother Abishai son of Zeruiah, and a third under Ittai the Gittite. The king told the troops, "I myself will surely march out with you."

verses.textZh: 众人却说："你不可以出战。因为如果我们逃跑，他们不会把我们放在心上，即使我们死了一半，他们也不会把我们放在心上。因为你一个人抵得上我们一万人；所以你最好还是留在城里，随时支援我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人却说："你不可以出战。因为如果我们逃跑，他们不会把我们放在心上，即使我们死了一半，他们也不会把我们放在心上。因为你一个人抵得上我们一万人；所以你最好还是留在城里，随时支援我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 军兵却说：「你不可出战。若是我们逃跑，敌人必不介意；我们阵亡一半，敌人也不介意。因为你一人强似我们万人，你不如在城里预备帮助我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the men said, "You must not go out; if we are forced to flee, they won’t care about us. Even if half of us die, they won’t care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It would be better now for you to give us support from the city."
verses.textEnEsv: But the men said, "You shall not go out. For if we flee, they will not care about us. If half of us die, they will not care about us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore it is better that you send us help from the city."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the people answered, "You shall not go out! For if we flee away, they will not care about us; nor if half of us die, will they care about us. But youare worth ten thousand of us now. For you are now more help to us in the city."
verses.textEnNlt: But his men objected strongly. "You must not go," they urged. "If we have to turn and run—and even if half of us die—it will make no difference to Absalom’s troops; they will be looking only for you. You are worth 10,000 of us, and it is better that you stay here in the town and send help if we need it."
verses.textEnNasb: But the people said, "You should not go out; for if in fact we flee, they will not care about us; and if half of us die, they will not care about us. But you are worth ten thousand of us; so now it is better that you will be ready to help us from the city."
verses.textEn: But the men said, "You must not go out; if we are forced to flee, they won’t care about us. Even if half of us die, they won’t care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It would be better now for you to give us support from the city."

verses.textZh: 王对他们说："你们看怎么好，我就怎样作吧！"于是王站在城门旁边，众人组成百人一队或千人一队出发了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对他们说："你们看怎么好，我就怎样作吧！"于是王站在城门旁边，众人组成百人一队或千人一队出发了。
verses.textZhCuv: 王向他们说：「你们以为怎样好，我就怎样行。」于是王站在城门旁，军兵或百或千地挨次出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The king answered, "I will do whatever seems best to you." So the king stood beside the gate while all his men marched out in units of hundreds and of thousands.
verses.textEnEsv: The king said to them, "Whatever seems best to you I will do." So the king stood at the side of the gate, while all the army marched out by hundreds and by thousands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to them, "Whatever seems best to you I will do." So the king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you think that’s the best plan, I’ll do it," the king answered. So he stood alongside the gate of the town as all the troops marched out in groups of hundreds and of thousands.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to them, "Whatever seems best to you I will do." So the king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and thousands.
verses.textEn: The king answered, "I will do whatever seems best to you." So the king stood beside the gate while all his men marched out in units of hundreds and of thousands.

verses.textZh: 王吩咐约押、亚比筛和以太说："为我的缘故，你们要宽待那年轻人押沙龙。"王为押沙龙吩咐众将领的话，众人都听到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王吩咐约押、亚比筛和以太说："为我的缘故，你们要宽待那年轻人押沙龙。"王为押沙龙吩咐众将领的话，众人都听到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 王嘱咐约押、亚比筛、以太说：「你们要为我的缘故宽待那少年人押沙龙。」王为押沙龙嘱咐众将的话，兵都听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: The king commanded Joab, Abishai and Ittai, "Be gentle with the young man Absalom for my sake." And all the troops heard the king giving orders concerning Absalom to each of the commanders.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king ordered Joab and Abishai and Ittai, "Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom." And all the people heard when the king gave orders to all the commanders about Absalom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king had commanded Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, saying, "Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom." And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains orders concerning Absalom.
verses.textEnNlt: And the king gave this command to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai: "For my sake, deal gently with young Absalom." And all the troops heard the king give this order to his commanders.
verses.textEnNasb: But the king commanded Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, saying, "Deal gently with the young man Absalom for my sake." And all the people heard when the king commanded all the commanders regarding Absalom.
verses.textEn: The king commanded Joab, Abishai and Ittai, "Be gentle with the young man Absalom for my sake." And all the troops heard the king giving orders concerning Absalom to each of the commanders.

verses.textZh: 众人出到田野迎战以色列人；战争发生在以法莲的树林里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人出到田野迎战以色列人；战争发生在以法莲的树林里。
verses.textZhCuv: 兵就出到田野迎着以色列人，在以法莲树林里交战。
verses.textEnNiv: David’s army marched out of the city to fight Israel, and the battle took place in the forest of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: So the army went out into the field against Israel, and the battle was fought in the forest of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people went out into the field of battle against Israel. And the battle was in the woods of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: So the battle began in the forest of Ephraim,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people went out to the field against Israel, and the battle took place in the forest of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: David’s army marched out of the city to fight Israel, and the battle took place in the forest of Ephraim.

verses.textZh: 在那里，以色列人在大卫的臣仆面前被打败了；那天被杀的人很多，共有二万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里，以色列人在大卫的臣仆面前被打败了；那天被杀的人很多，共有二万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人败在大卫的仆人面前；那日阵亡的甚多，共有二万人。
verses.textEnNiv: There Israel’s troops were routed by David’s men, and the casualties that day were great—twenty thousand men.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel were defeated there by the servants of David, and the loss there was great on that day, twenty thousand men.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people of Israel were overthrown there before the servants of David, and a great slaughter of twenty thousand took place there that day.
verses.textEnNlt: and the Israelite troops were beaten back by David’s men. There was a great slaughter that day, and 20,000 men laid down their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: The people of Israel were defeated there by the servants of David, and the slaughter there that day was great, twenty thousand men.
verses.textEn: There Israel’s troops were routed by David’s men, and the casualties that day were great—twenty thousand men.

verses.textZh: 战事在那里蔓延到全地；那一天，树林所吞灭的比刀剑所吞灭的更多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 战事在那里蔓延到全地；那一天，树林所吞灭的比刀剑所吞灭的更多。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为在那里四面打仗，死于树林的比死于刀剑的更多。
verses.textEnNiv: The battle spread out over the whole countryside, and the forest swallowed up more men that day than the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: The battle spread over the face of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the battle there was scattered over the face of the whole countryside, and the woods devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
verses.textEnNlt: The battle raged all across the countryside, and more men died because of the forest than were killed by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: For the battle there was spread over the whole countryside, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
verses.textEn: The battle spread out over the whole countryside, and the forest swallowed up more men that day than the sword.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙偶然遇上了大卫的臣仆。那时押沙龙骑着骡子，骡子从一棵大橡树茂密的树枝下经过，押沙龙的头发被橡树枝紧紧勾住，他就吊在空中，他所骑的骡子却跑开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙偶然遇上了大卫的臣仆。那时押沙龙骑着骡子，骡子从一棵大橡树茂密的树枝下经过，押沙龙的头发被橡树枝紧紧勾住，他就吊在空中，他所骑的骡子却跑开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙偶然遇见大卫的仆人。押沙龙骑着骡子，从大橡树密枝底下经过，他的头发被树枝绕住，就悬挂起来，所骑的骡子便离他去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Absalom happened to meet David’s men. He was riding his mule, and as the mule went under the thick branches of a large oak, Absalom’s hair got caught in the tree. He was left hanging in midair, while the mule he was riding kept on going.
verses.textEnEsv: And Absalom happened to meet the servants of David. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick branches of a great oak, and his head caught fast in the oak, and he was suspended between heaven and earth, while the mule that was under him went on.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Absalom met the servants of David. Absalom rode on a mule. The mule went under the thick boughs of a great terebinth tree, and his head caught in the terebinth; so he was left hanging between heaven and earth. And the mule which was under him went on.
verses.textEnNlt: During the battle, Absalom happened to come upon some of David’s men. He tried to escape on his mule, but as he rode beneath the thick branches of a great tree, his hair got caught in the tree. His mule kept going and left him dangling in the air.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Absalom encountered the servants of David. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the branches of a massive oak. Then his head caught firmly in the oak, and he was left hanging between the sky and earth, while the mule that was under him kept going.
verses.textEn: Now Absalom happened to meet David’s men. He was riding his mule, and as the mule went under the thick branches of a large oak, Absalom’s hair got caught in the tree. He was left hanging in midair, while the mule he was riding kept on going.

verses.textZh: 有一个人看见了，就告诉约押说："看哪！我看见押沙龙悬在一棵橡树上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人看见了，就告诉约押说："看哪！我看见押沙龙悬在一棵橡树上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有个人看见，就告诉约押说：「我看见押沙龙挂在橡树上了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When one of the men saw what had happened, he told Joab, "I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree."
verses.textEnEsv: And a certain man saw it and told Joab, "Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man saw it and told Joab, and said, "I just saw Absalom hanging in a terebinth tree!"
verses.textEnNlt: One of David’s men saw what had happened and told Joab, "I saw Absalom dangling from a great tree."
verses.textEnNasb: When a certain man saw him, he informed Joab and said, "Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak."
verses.textEn: When one of the men saw what had happened, he told Joab, "I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree."

verses.textZh: 约押对那向他报告的人说："你既然看见了，为甚么不当场把他击杀，落在地上呢？那样，我就赏赐你一百一十四克银子和一条腰带。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押对那向他报告的人说："你既然看见了，为甚么不当场把他击杀，落在地上呢？那样，我就赏赐你一百一十四克银子和一条腰带。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约押对报信的人说：「你既看见他，为什么不将他打死落在地上呢？你若打死他，我就赏你十舍客勒银子，一条带子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joab said to the man who had told him this, "What! You saw him? Why didn’t you strike him to the ground right there? Then I would have had to give you ten shekels of silver and a warrior’s belt."
verses.textEnEsv: Joab said to the man who told him, "What, you saw him! Why then did you not strike him there to the ground? I would have been glad to give you ten pieces of silver and a belt."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab said to the man who told him, "You just saw him! And why did you not strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten shekels of silver and a belt."
verses.textEnNlt: "What?" Joab demanded. "You saw him there and didn’t kill him? I would have rewarded you with ten pieces of silver and a hero’s belt!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab said to the man who had informed him, "So behold, you saw him! Why then did you not strike him there to the ground? And it would have been my duty to give you ten pieces of silver and a belt."
verses.textEn: Joab said to the man who had told him this, "What! You saw him? Why didn’t you strike him to the ground right there? Then I would have had to give you ten shekels of silver and a warrior’s belt."

verses.textZh: 那人回答约押："就是量十一公斤银子放在我手中，我也不敢伸手伤害王的儿子，因为我们亲耳听见王吩咐你、亚比筛和以太说：‘你们要为我的缘故，照顾那年轻人押沙龙。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人回答约押："就是量十一公斤银子放在我手中，我也不敢伸手伤害王的儿子，因为我们亲耳听见王吩咐你、亚比筛和以太说：‘你们要为我的缘故，照顾那年轻人押沙龙。’
verses.textZhCuv: 那人对约押说：「我就是得你一千舍客勒银子，我也不敢伸手害王的儿子；因为我们听见王嘱咐你和亚比筛并以太说：『你们要谨慎，不可害那少年人押沙龙。』
verses.textEnNiv: But the man replied, "Even if a thousand shekels were weighed out into my hands, I would not lay a hand on the king’s son. In our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘Protect the young man Absalom for my sake. ’
verses.textEnEsv: But the man said to Joab, "Even if I felt in my hand the weight of a thousand pieces of silver, I would not reach out my hand against the king’s son, for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘For my sake protect the young man Absalom.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the man said to Joab, "Though I were to receive a thousand shekels of silver in my hand, I would not raise my hand against the king’s son. For in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware lest anyone touch the young man Absalom!’
verses.textEnNlt: "I would not kill the king’s son for even a thousand pieces of silver, " the man replied to Joab. "We all heard the king say to you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘For my sake, please spare young Absalom.’
verses.textEnNasb: But the man said to Joab, "Even if I were to receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I would not put out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you, Abishai, and Ittai, saying, ‘ Protect the young man Absalom for me!’
verses.textEn: But the man replied, "Even if a thousand shekels were weighed out into my hands, I would not lay a hand on the king’s son. In our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘Protect the young man Absalom for my sake. ’

verses.textZh: 我若是胆大妄为伤害了他的性命，甚么事情都瞒不过王的，那时你也不会维护我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若是胆大妄为伤害了他的性命，甚么事情都瞒不过王的，那时你也不会维护我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我若妄为害了他的性命，就是你自己也必与我为敌（原来，无论何事都瞒不过王。）」
verses.textEnNiv: And if I had put my life in jeopardy —and nothing is hidden from the king—you would have kept your distance from me."
verses.textEnEsv: On the other hand, if I had dealt treacherously against his life (and there is nothing hidden from the king), then you yourself would have stood aloof."
verses.textEnNkjv: Otherwise I would have dealt falsely against my own life. For there is nothing hidden from the king, and you yourself would have set yourself against me."
verses.textEnNlt: And if I had betrayed the king by killing his son—and the king would certainly find out who did it—you yourself would be the first to abandon me."
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, if I had dealt treacherously against his life (and there is nothing hidden from the king), then you yourself would have avoided me."
verses.textEn: And if I had put my life in jeopardy —and nothing is hidden from the king—you would have kept your distance from me."

verses.textZh: 约押说："我不能与你这样耽误时间。"于是约押手里拿起三根短矛，趁押沙龙还悬挂在橡树上活着的时候，就刺透了他的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押说："我不能与你这样耽误时间。"于是约押手里拿起三根短矛，趁押沙龙还悬挂在橡树上活着的时候，就刺透了他的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押说：「我不能与你留连。」约押手拿三杆短枪，趁押沙龙在橡树上还活着，就刺透他的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab said, "I’m not going to wait like this for you." So he took three javelins in his hand and plunged them into Absalom’s heart while Absalom was still alive in the oak tree.
verses.textEnEsv: Joab said, "I will not waste time like this with you." And he took three javelins in his hand and thrust them into the heart of Absalom while he was still alive in the oak.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joab said, "I cannot linger with you." And he took three spears in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart, while he was still alive in the midst of the terebinth tree.
verses.textEnNlt: "Enough of this nonsense," Joab said. Then he took three daggers and plunged them into Absalom’s heart as he dangled, still alive, in the great tree.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab said, "I will not waste time here with you." So he took three spears in his hand and thrust them through the heart of Absalom while he was still alive in the midst of the oak.
verses.textEn: Joab said, "I’m not going to wait like this for you." So he took three javelins in his hand and plunged them into Absalom’s heart while Absalom was still alive in the oak tree.

verses.textZh: 给约押拿武器的十个年轻人围着押沙龙，攻击他，把他杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 给约押拿武器的十个年轻人围着押沙龙，攻击他，把他杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 给约押拿兵器的十个少年人围绕押沙龙，将他杀死。
verses.textEnNiv: And ten of Joab’s armor-bearers surrounded Absalom, struck him and killed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And ten young men, Joab’s armor-bearers, surrounded Absalom and struck him and killed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded Absalom, and struck and killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Ten of Joab’s young armor bearers then surrounded Absalom and killed him.
verses.textEnNasb: And ten young men who carried Joab’s armor gathered around and struck Absalom and killed him.
verses.textEn: And ten of Joab’s armor-bearers surrounded Absalom, struck him and killed him.

verses.textZh: 约押吹响号角，众人就回来，不再追赶以色列人；因为约押拦阻众人继续追赶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押吹响号角，众人就回来，不再追赶以色列人；因为约押拦阻众人继续追赶。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押吹角，拦阻众人，他们就回来，不再追赶以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops stopped pursuing Israel, for Joab halted them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joab blew the trumpet, and the troops came back from pursuing Israel, for Joab restrained them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing Israel. For Joab held back the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joab blew the ram’s horn, and his men returned from chasing the army of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing Israel, for Joab restrained the people.
verses.textEn: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops stopped pursuing Israel, for Joab halted them.

verses.textZh: 他们把押沙龙的尸体抬起来，丢在树林中的一个大坑里，又在上面堆起一大堆石头。以色列众人都逃跑，各回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把押沙龙的尸体抬起来，丢在树林中的一个大坑里，又在上面堆起一大堆石头。以色列众人都逃跑，各回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将押沙龙丢在林中一个大坑里，上头堆起一大堆石头。以色列众人都逃跑，各回各家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: They took Absalom, threw him into a big pit in the forest and piled up a large heap of rocks over him. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled to their homes.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took Absalom and threw him into a great pit in the forest and raised over him a very great heap of stones. And all Israel fled every one to his own home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took Absalom and cast him into a large pit in the woods, and laid a very large heap of stones over him. Then all Israel fled, everyone to his tent.
verses.textEnNlt: They threw Absalom’s body into a deep pit in the forest and piled a great heap of stones over it. And all Israel fled to their homes.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took Absalom and threw him into a deep pit in the forest, and erected over him a very large pile of stones. And all Israel fled, each to his own tent.
verses.textEn: They took Absalom, threw him into a big pit in the forest and piled up a large heap of rocks over him. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled to their homes.

verses.textZh: 押沙龙生前曾在王谷为自己立了一根石柱，因为他想："我没有儿子记念我的名字。"他就以自己的名字称那石柱。因此人称那石柱为押沙龙柱，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 押沙龙生前曾在王谷为自己立了一根石柱，因为他想："我没有儿子记念我的名字。"他就以自己的名字称那石柱。因此人称那石柱为押沙龙柱，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 押沙龙活着的时候，在王谷立了一根石柱，因他说：「我没有儿子为我留名。」他就以自己的名称那石柱叫押沙龙柱，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: During his lifetime Absalom had taken a pillar and erected it in the King’s Valley as a monument to himself, for he thought, "I have no son to carry on the memory of my name." He named the pillar after himself, and it is called Absalom’s Monument to this day.
