verses.textEnNkjv: Now David came to his house at Jerusalem. And the king took the ten women, his concubines whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in seclusion and supported them, but did not go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.textEnNlt: When David came to his palace in Jerusalem, he took the ten concubines he had left to look after the palace and placed them in seclusion. Their needs were provided for, but he no longer slept with them. So each of them lived like a widow until she died.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David came to his house in Jerusalem, and the king took the ten women, the concubines whom he had left behind to take care of the house, and put them in custody and provided them with food, but did not have relations with them. So they were locked up until the day of their death, living as widows.
verses.textEn: When David returned to his palace in Jerusalem, he took the ten concubines he had left to take care of the palace and put them in a house under guard. He provided for them but had no sexual relations with them. They were kept in confinement till the day of their death, living as widows.

verses.textZh: 王对亚玛撒说："你要在三天之内把犹大人召集到我这里来。你自己也要在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对亚玛撒说："你要在三天之内把犹大人召集到我这里来。你自己也要在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对亚玛撒说：「你要在三日之内将犹大人招聚了来，你也回到这里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king said to Amasa, "Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king said to Amasa, "Call the men of Judah together to me within three days, and be here yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said to Amasa, "Assemble the men of Judah for me within three days, and be present here yourself."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king told Amasa, "Mobilize the army of Judah within three days, and report back at that time."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king said to Amasa, "Summon the men of Judah for me within three days, and be present here yourself."
verses.textEn: Then the king said to Amasa, "Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself."

verses.textZh: 亚玛撒就去召集犹大人。他却耽延，超过了王限定的日期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛撒就去召集犹大人。他却耽延，超过了王限定的日期。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛撒就去招聚犹大人，却耽延过了王所限的日期。
verses.textEnNiv: But when Amasa went to summon Judah, he took longer than the time the king had set for him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Amasa went to summon Judah, but he delayed beyond the set time that had been appointed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Amasa went to assemble themenof Judah. But he delayed longer than the set time which David had appointed him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Amasa went out to notify Judah, but it took him longer than the time he had been given.
verses.textEnNasb: So Amasa went to summon the men of Judah, but he was delayed longer than the set time which he had designated for him.
verses.textEn: But when Amasa went to summon Judah, he took longer than the time the king had set for him.

verses.textZh: 大卫对亚比筛说："现在比基利的儿子示巴要加害我们，比押沙龙更甚。你要带着你主人的仆人去追赶他，免得他找到了设防的城镇，就避过我们的眼目，从我们的手中逃脱了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对亚比筛说："现在比基利的儿子示巴要加害我们，比押沙龙更甚。你要带着你主人的仆人去追赶他，免得他找到了设防的城镇，就避过我们的眼目，从我们的手中逃脱了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对亚比筛说：「现在恐怕比基利的儿子示巴加害于我们比押沙龙更甚。你要带领你主的仆人追赶他，免得他得了坚固城，躲避我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba son of Bikri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your master’s men and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and escape from us."
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. Take your lord’s servants and pursue him, lest he get himself to fortified cities and escape from us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. Take your lord’s servants and pursue him, lest he find for himself fortified cities, and escape us."
verses.textEnNlt: Then David said to Abishai, "Sheba son of Bicri is going to hurt us more than Absalom did. Quick, take my troops and chase after him before he gets into a fortified town where we can’t reach him."
verses.textEnNasb: And David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom; take your lord’s servants and pursue him, so that he does not find for himself fortified cities and escape from our sight."
verses.textEn: David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba son of Bikri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your master’s men and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and escape from us."

verses.textZh: 于是约押的人，基利提人、比利提人和所有的勇士，都跟随亚比筛出去。他们从耶路撒冷出去，追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约押的人，基利提人、比利提人和所有的勇士，都跟随亚比筛出去。他们从耶路撒冷出去，追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押的人和基利提人、比利提人，并所有的勇士，都跟着亚比筛，从耶路撒冷出去追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joab’s men and the Kerethites and Pelethites and all the mighty warriors went out under the command of Abishai. They marched out from Jerusalem to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.
verses.textEnEsv: And there went out after him Joab’s men and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men. They went out from Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joab’s men, with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men, went out after him. And they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abishai and Joab, together with the king’s bodyguard and all the mighty warriors, set out from Jerusalem to go after Sheba.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joab’s men went out after him, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the warriors; and they left Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEn: So Joab’s men and the Kerethites and Pelethites and all the mighty warriors went out under the command of Abishai. They marched out from Jerusalem to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.

verses.textZh: 他们到了基遍的大盘石那里，亚玛撒来与他们会合。那时约押穿著战衣，腰间束着佩刀的带子，刀在鞘里。他往前走的时候，刀掉了下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了基遍的大盘石那里，亚玛撒来与他们会合。那时约押穿著战衣，腰间束着佩刀的带子，刀在鞘里。他往前走的时候，刀掉了下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了基遍的大磐石那里，亚玛撒来迎接他们。那时约押穿着战衣，腰束佩刀的带子，刀在鞘内；约押前行，刀从鞘内掉出来。
verses.textEnNiv: While they were at the great rock in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was wearing his military tunic, and strapped over it at his waist was a belt with a dagger in its sheath. As he stepped forward, it dropped out of its sheath.
verses.textEnEsv: When they were at the great stone that is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Now Joab was wearing a soldier’s garment, and over it was a belt with a sword in its sheath fastened on his thigh, and as he went forward it fell out.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they were at the large stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came before them. Now Joab was dressed in battle armor; on it was a belt with a sword fastened in its sheath at his hips; and as he was going forward, it fell out.
verses.textEnNlt: As they arrived at the great stone in Gibeon, Amasa met them. Joab was wearing his military tunic with a dagger strapped to his belt. As he stepped forward to greet Amasa, he slipped the dagger from its sheath.
verses.textEnNasb: When they were at the large stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Now Joab was dressed in his military attire, and over it he had a belt with a sword in its sheath strapped on at his waist; and as he went forward, it fell out.
verses.textEn: While they were at the great rock in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was wearing his military tunic, and strapped over it at his waist was a belt with a dagger in its sheath. As he stepped forward, it dropped out of its sheath.

verses.textZh: 约押对亚玛撒说："我的兄弟，你好吗？"约押用右手握住亚玛撒的胡子，要与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押对亚玛撒说："我的兄弟，你好吗？"约押用右手握住亚玛撒的胡子，要与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押左手拾起刀来，对亚玛撒说：「我兄弟，你好啊！」就用右手抓住亚玛撒的胡子，要与他亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab said to Amasa, "How are you, my brother?" Then Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab said to Amasa, "Is it well with you, my brother?" And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joab said to Amasa, "Are you in health, my brother?" And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
verses.textEnNlt: "How are you, my cousin?" Joab said and took him by the beard with his right hand as though to kiss him.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joab said to Amasa, "Is it going well for you, my brother?" And Joab took hold of Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
verses.textEn: Joab said to Amasa, "How are you, my brother?" Then Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

verses.textZh: 亚玛撒没有防备约押手中的刀，约押用这刀刺进他的肚子，他的内脏就流在地上。不用再刺第二刀，亚玛撒就死了。约押和他的兄弟亚比筛继续追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛撒没有防备约押手中的刀，约押用这刀刺进他的肚子，他的内脏就流在地上。不用再刺第二刀，亚玛撒就死了。约押和他的兄弟亚比筛继续追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛撒没有防备约押手里所拿的刀；约押用刀刺入他的肚腹，他的肠子流在地上，没有再刺他，就死了。 约押和他兄弟亚比筛往前追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Amasa was not on his guard against the dagger in Joab’s hand, and Joab plunged it into his belly, and his intestines spilled out on the ground. Without being stabbed again, Amasa died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bikri.
verses.textEnEsv: But Amasa did not observe the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So Joab struck him with it in the stomach and spilled his entrails to the ground without striking a second blow, and he died. Then Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Amasa did not notice the sword that was in Joab’s hand. And he struck him with it in the stomach, and his entrails poured out on the ground; and he did not strike him again. Thus he died. Then Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEnNlt: Amasa didn’t notice the dagger in his left hand, and Joab stabbed him in the stomach with it so that his insides gushed out onto the ground. Joab did not need to strike again, and Amasa soon died. Joab and his brother Abishai left him lying there and continued after Sheba.
verses.textEnNasb: But Amasa was not on guard against the sword which was in Joab’s hand, so he struck him in the belly with it and spilled out his intestines on the ground, and did not strike him again, and he died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEn: Amasa was not on his guard against the dagger in Joab’s hand, and Joab plunged it into his belly, and his intestines spilled out on the ground. Without being stabbed again, Amasa died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bikri.

verses.textZh: 约押的仆从之中，有一个人站在亚玛撒的尸体旁边，说："谁喜欢约押，谁归顺大卫，就当跟随约押去！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押的仆从之中，有一个人站在亚玛撒的尸体旁边，说："谁喜欢约押，谁归顺大卫，就当跟随约押去！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有约押的一个少年人站在亚玛撒尸身旁边，对众人说：「谁喜悦约押，谁归顺大卫，就当跟随约押去。」
verses.textEnNiv: One of Joab’s men stood beside Amasa and said, "Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!"
verses.textEnEsv: And one of Joab’s young men took his stand by Amasa and said, "Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab."
verses.textEnNkjv: Meanwhile one of Joab’s men stood near Amasa, and said, "Whoever favors Joab and whoever is for David—follow Joab!"
verses.textEnNlt: One of Joab’s young men shouted to Amasa’s troops, "If you are for Joab and David, come and follow Joab."
verses.textEnNasb: Now one of Joab’s young men stood by him and said, "Whoever favors Joab and whoever is for David, follow Joab!"
verses.textEn: One of Joab’s men stood beside Amasa and said, "Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!"

verses.textZh: 亚玛撒在大道当中，辊在自己的血里。那人看见经过的众人都站住，就把亚玛撒的尸体从大道上拖到田里，又扔一件衣服把他盖住，因为他看见众人来到亚玛撒的尸体旁边都站住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚玛撒在大道当中，辊在自己的血里。那人看见经过的众人都站住，就把亚玛撒的尸体从大道上拖到田里，又扔一件衣服把他盖住，因为他看见众人来到亚玛撒的尸体旁边都站住。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚玛撒在道路上滚在自己的血里。那人见众民经过都站住，就把亚玛撒的尸身从路上挪到田间，用衣服遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the road, and the man saw that all the troops came to a halt there. When he realized that everyone who came up to Amasa stopped, he dragged him from the road into a field and threw a garment over him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the highway. And anyone who came by, seeing him, stopped. And when the man saw that all the people stopped, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field and threw a garment over him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Amasa wallowed in his blood in the middle of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he moved Amasa from the highway to the field and threw a garment over him, when he saw that everyone who came upon him halted.
verses.textEnNlt: But Amasa lay in his blood in the middle of the road, and Joab’s man saw that everyone was stopping to stare at him. So he pulled him off the road into a field and threw a cloak over him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Amasa was wallowing in his own blood in the middle of the road. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa from the road to the field and threw a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.
verses.textEn: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the road, and the man saw that all the troops came to a halt there. When he realized that everyone who came up to Amasa stopped, he dragged him from the road into a field and threw a garment over him.

verses.textZh: 尸体从大道上挪去以后，众人就都过去，跟随约押去追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尸体从大道上挪去以后，众人就都过去，跟随约押去追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 尸身从路上挪移之后，众民就都跟随约押去追赶比基利的儿子示巴。
verses.textEnNiv: After Amasa had been removed from the road, everyone went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.
verses.textEnEsv: When he was taken out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he was removed from the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEnNlt: With Amasa’s body out of the way, everyone went on with Joab to capture Sheba son of Bicri.
verses.textEnNasb: As soon as he was removed from the road, all the men went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.textEn: After Amasa had been removed from the road, everyone went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bikri.

verses.textZh: 示巴走遍以色列各支派，直到伯．玛迦的亚比拉和比利人的全境，他们聚集起来跟随他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴走遍以色列各支派，直到伯．玛迦的亚比拉和比利人的全境，他们聚集起来跟随他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他走遍以色列各支派，直到伯‧玛迦的亚比拉，并比利人的全地；那些地方的人也都聚集跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel Beth Maakah and through the entire region of the Bikrites, who gathered together and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel of Beth-maacah, and all the Bichrites assembled and followed him in.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel and Beth Maachah and all the Berites. So they were gathered together and also went after Sheba.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Sheba traveled through all the tribes of Israel and eventually came to the town of Abel-beth-maacah. All the members of his own clan, the Bicrites, assembled for battle and followed him into the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he went on through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, that is, Beth-maacah, and all the Berites; and they assembled and went after him as well.
verses.textEn: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel Beth Maakah and through the entire region of the Bikrites, who gathered together and followed him.

verses.textZh: 所有跟随约押的人都来了，把示巴围困在伯．玛迦的亚比拉。他们对着城筑起攻城的土垒，高度与城的外墙一样。他们撞击城墙，要把城墙撞倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有跟随约押的人都来了，把示巴围困在伯．玛迦的亚比拉。他们对着城筑起攻城的土垒，高度与城的外墙一样。他们撞击城墙，要把城墙撞倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押和跟随的人到了伯‧玛迦的亚比拉，围困示巴，就对着城筑垒；跟随约押的众民用锤撞城，要使城塌陷。
verses.textEnNiv: All the troops with Joab came and besieged Sheba in Abel Beth Maakah. They built a siege ramp up to the city, and it stood against the outer fortifications. While they were battering the wall to bring it down,
verses.textEnEsv: And all the men who were with Joab came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah. They cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart, and they were battering the wall to throw it down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maachah; and they cast up a siege mound against the city, and it stood by the rampart. And all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joab’s forces arrived, they attacked Abel-beth-maacah. They built a siege ramp against the town’s fortifications and began battering down the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: And they came and besieged him in Abel Beth-maacah, and they built up an assault ramp against the city, and it stood against the outer rampart; and all the people who were with Joab were wreaking destruction in order to topple the wall.
verses.textEn: All the troops with Joab came and besieged Sheba in Abel Beth Maakah. They built a siege ramp up to the city, and it stood against the outer fortifications. While they were battering the wall to bring it down,

verses.textZh: 有一个聪明的妇人在城墙上呼叫："请听！请听！请你们对约押说：‘请你走近这里，我有话对你说。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个聪明的妇人在城墙上呼叫："请听！请听！请你们对约押说：‘请你走近这里，我有话对你说。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个聪明妇人从城上呼叫说：「听啊，听啊，请约押近前来，我好与他说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: a wise woman called from the city, "Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come here so I can speak to him."
verses.textEnEsv: Then a wise woman called from the city, "Listen! Listen! Tell Joab, ‘Come here, that I may speak to you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a wise woman cried out from the city, "Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come nearby, that I may speak with you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But a wise woman in the town called out to Joab, "Listen to me, Joab. Come over here so I can talk to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then a wise woman called out from the city, "Listen, listen! Please tell Joab, ‘Come here that I may speak with you.’ "
verses.textEn: a wise woman called from the city, "Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come here so I can speak to him."

verses.textZh: 约押走近妇人那里，妇人问："你是约押吗？"他回答："我是。"妇人对他说："请听婢女的话！"他说："我正在听！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押走近妇人那里，妇人问："你是约押吗？"他回答："我是。"妇人对他说："请听婢女的话！"他说："我正在听！"
verses.textZhCuv: 约押就近前来，妇人问他说：「你是约押不是？」他说：「我是。」妇人说：「求你听婢女的话。」约押说：「我听。」
verses.textEnNiv: He went toward her, and she asked, "Are you Joab?" "I am," he answered. She said, "Listen to what your servant has to say." "I’m listening," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And he came near her, and the woman said, "Are you Joab?" He answered, "I am." Then she said to him, "Listen to the words of your servant." And he answered, "I am listening."
verses.textEnNkjv: When he had come near to her, the woman said, "Are you Joab?" He answered, "I am." Then she said to him, "Hear the words of your maidservant." And he answered, "I am listening."
verses.textEnNlt: As he approached, the woman asked, "Are you Joab?" "I am," he replied. So she said, "Listen carefully to your servant." "I’m listening," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: So he approached her, and the woman said, "Are you Joab?" And he answered, "I am." Then she said to him, "Listen to the words of your slave." And he said, "I am listening."
verses.textEn: He went toward her, and she asked, "Are you Joab?" "I am," he answered. She said, "Listen to what your servant has to say." "I’m listening," he said.

verses.textZh: 妇人说："古时人常说：‘只要在亚比拉求问，事就必成全。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人说："古时人常说：‘只要在亚比拉求问，事就必成全。’
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人说：「古时有话说，当先在亚比拉求问，然后事就定妥。
verses.textEnNiv: She continued, "Long ago they used to say, ‘Get your answer at Abel,’ and that settled it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she said, "They used to say in former times, ‘Let them but ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she spoke, saying, "They used to talk in former times, saying, ‘They shall surely seek guidance at Abel,’ and so they would end disputes.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she continued, "There used to be a saying, ‘If you want to settle an argument, ask advice at the town of Abel.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then she spoke, saying, "In the past they used to say, ‘They will undoubtedly ask advice at Abel,’ and that is how they ended a dispute.
verses.textEn: She continued, "Long ago they used to say, ‘Get your answer at Abel,’ and that settled it.

verses.textZh: 我在以色列中是和平信实的人，你却设法毁灭这座以色列的母城。你为甚么要吞灭耶和华的产业呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在以色列中是和平信实的人，你却设法毁灭这座以色列的母城。你为甚么要吞灭耶和华的产业呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们这城的人在以色列人中是和平、忠厚的。你为何要毁坏以色列中的大城，吞灭耶和华的产业呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: We are the peaceful and faithful in Israel. You are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why do you want to swallow up the Lord ’s inheritance?"
verses.textEnEsv: I am one of those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up the heritage of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: I amamongthe peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the inheritance of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: I am one who is peace loving and faithful in Israel. But you are destroying an important town in Israel. Why do you want to devour what belongs to the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNasb: I am one of those who are ready for peace and faithful in Israel. You are trying to destroy a city, even a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the inheritance of the Lord?"
verses.textEn: We are the peaceful and faithful in Israel. You are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why do you want to swallow up the Lord ’s inheritance?"

verses.textZh: 约押回答："绝对不会！我绝对不会吞灭，也不会毁坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押回答："绝对不会！我绝对不会吞灭，也不会毁坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押回答说：「我决不吞灭毁坏，
verses.textEnNiv: "Far be it from me!" Joab replied, "Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!
verses.textEnEsv: Joab answered, "Far be it from me, far be it, that I should swallow up or destroy!
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab answered and said, "Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy!
verses.textEnNlt: And Joab replied, "Believe me, I don’t want to devour or destroy your town!
verses.textEnNasb: Joab replied, "Far be it, far be it from me that I would consume or destroy!
verses.textEn: "Far be it from me!" Joab replied, "Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!

verses.textZh: 事情不是这样的；只因以法莲山地有一个人名叫示巴，是比基利的儿子，他举手攻击大卫王。你们只要把他一人交出来，我就离开这城。"妇人对约押说："看哪！那人的头必从这城墙上丢给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 事情不是这样的；只因以法莲山地有一个人名叫示巴，是比基利的儿子，他举手攻击大卫王。你们只要把他一人交出来，我就离开这城。"妇人对约押说："看哪！那人的头必从这城墙上丢给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 乃因以法莲山地的一个人－比基利的儿子示巴－举手攻击大卫王，你们若将他一人交出来，我便离城而去。」妇人对约押说：「那人的首级必从城墙上丢给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: That is not the case. A man named Sheba son of Bikri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Hand over this one man, and I’ll withdraw from the city." The woman said to Joab, "His head will be thrown to you from the wall."
verses.textEnEsv: That is not true. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, called Sheba the son of Bichri, has lifted up his hand against King David. Give up him alone, and I will withdraw from the city." And the woman said to Joab, "Behold, his head shall be thrown to you over the wall."
verses.textEnNkjv: That is not so. But a man from the mountains of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has raised his hand against the king, against David. Deliver him only, and I will depart from the city." So the woman said to Joab, "Watch, his head will be thrown to you over the wall."
verses.textEnNlt: That’s not my purpose. All I want is a man named Sheba son of Bicri from the hill country of Ephraim, who has revolted against King David. If you hand over this one man to me, I will leave the town in peace." "All right," the woman replied, "we will throw his head over the wall to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Such is not the case. But a man from the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has raised his hand against King David. Only turn him over, and I will depart from the city." And the woman said to Joab, "Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall."
verses.textEn: That is not the case. A man named Sheba son of Bikri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Hand over this one man, and I’ll withdraw from the city." The woman said to Joab, "His head will be thrown to you from the wall."

verses.textZh: 妇人就凭她的智慧去见众人，他们就把比基利的儿子示巴的头砍下来，丢给约押；约押吹号角，众人就离城散开，各回自己的家去了。约押也回耶路撒冷去见王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人就凭她的智慧去见众人，他们就把比基利的儿子示巴的头砍下来，丢给约押；约押吹号角，众人就离城散开，各回自己的家去了。约押也回耶路撒冷去见王。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人就凭她的智慧去劝众人。他们便割下比基利的儿子示巴的首级，丢给约押。约押吹角，众人就离城而散，各归各家去了。约押回耶路撒冷，到王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise advice, and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bikri and threw it to Joab. So he sounded the trumpet, and his men dispersed from the city, each returning to his home. And Joab went back to the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri and threw it out to Joab. So he blew the trumpet, and they dispersed from the city, every man to his home. And Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman in her wisdom went to all the people. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. Then he blew a trumpet, and they withdrew from the city, every man to his tent. So Joab returned to the king at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise advice, and they cut off Sheba’s head and threw it out to Joab. So he blew the ram’s horn and called his troops back from the attack. They all returned to their homes, and Joab returned to the king at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the woman wisely came to all the people. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri and threw it to Joab. So he blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, each to his tent. Joab also returned to the king at Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise advice, and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bikri and threw it to Joab. So he sounded the trumpet, and his men dispersed from the city, each returning to his home. And Joab went back to the king in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 约押作以色列所有军队的统帅。耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押作以色列所有军队的统帅。耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人；
verses.textZhCuv: 约押作以色列全军的元帅；耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人；
verses.textEnNiv: Joab was over Israel’s entire army; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites;
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joab was in command of all the army of Israel; and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was in command of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab was over all the army of Israel; Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites;
verses.textEnNlt: Now Joab was the commander of the army of Israel. Benaiah son of Jehoiada was captain of the king’s bodyguard.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joab was in command of the entire army of Israel, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites;
verses.textEn: Joab was over Israel’s entire army; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites;

verses.textZh: 亚多兰管理作苦工的人。亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚多兰管理作苦工的人。亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多兰掌管服苦的人；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
verses.textEnNiv: Adoniram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnEsv: and Adoram was in charge of the forced labor; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder;
verses.textEnNkjv: Adoram was in charge of revenue; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnNlt: Adoniram was in charge of forced labor. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the royal historian.
verses.textEnNasb: and Adoram was over the forced labor, and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the secretary;
verses.textEn: Adoniram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.textZh: 示法作书记。撒督和亚比亚他作祭司长；
verses.textZhCnvs: 示法作书记。撒督和亚比亚他作祭司长；
verses.textZhCuv: 示法作书记；撒督和亚比亚他作祭司长；
verses.textEnNiv: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.textEnEsv: and Sheva was secretary; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.textEnNkjv: Sheva was scribe; Zadok and Abiathar were the priests;
verses.textEnNlt: Sheva was the court secretary. Zadok and Abiathar were the priests.
verses.textEnNasb: and Sheva was scribe, and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.textEn: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

verses.textZh: 睚珥人以拉也作大卫的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 睚珥人以拉也作大卫的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 睚珥人以拉作大卫的宰相。
verses.textEnNiv: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest.
verses.textEnEsv: and Ira the Jairite was also David’s priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Ira the Jairite was a chief minister under David.
verses.textEnNlt: And Ira, a descendant of Jair, was David’s personal priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Ira the Jairite also was a priest to David.
verses.textEn: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest.

verses.textZh: 大卫在位的日子，有连续三年的饥荒；大卫就寻求耶和华的面。耶和华说："这是因为扫罗和扫罗家流人血的罪，因为他曾经杀死了基遍人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在位的日子，有连续三年的饥荒；大卫就寻求耶和华的面。耶和华说："这是因为扫罗和扫罗家流人血的罪，因为他曾经杀死了基遍人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫年间有饥荒，一连三年，大卫就求问耶和华。耶和华说：「这饥荒是因扫罗和他流人血之家杀死基遍人。」
verses.textEnNiv: During the reign of David, there was a famine for three successive years; so David sought the face of the Lord . The Lord said, "It is on account of Saul and his blood-stained house; it is because he put the Gibeonites to death."
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year. And David sought the face of the Lord . And the Lord said, "There is bloodguilt on Saul and on his house, because he put the Gibeonites to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David inquired of the Lord. And the Lord answered, "Itis because of Saul and his bloodthirsty house, because he killed the Gibeonites."
verses.textEnNlt: There was a famine during David’s reign that lasted for three years, so David asked the Lord about it. And the Lord said, "The famine has come because Saul and his family are guilty of murdering the Gibeonites."
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the presence of the Lord. And the Lord said, "It is because of Saul and his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death."
verses.textEn: During the reign of David, there was a famine for three successive years; so David sought the face of the Lord . The Lord said, "It is on account of Saul and his blood-stained house; it is because he put the Gibeonites to death."

verses.textZh: 原来基遍人不是以色列人，而是亚摩利人中余剩的后人。以色列人曾经起誓与他们立约，但扫罗却为以色列人和犹大人发热心，设法要击杀他们。王把基遍人召了来，对他们说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来基遍人不是以色列人，而是亚摩利人中余剩的后人。以色列人曾经起誓与他们立约，但扫罗却为以色列人和犹大人发热心，设法要击杀他们。王把基遍人召了来，对他们说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来这基遍人不是以色列人，乃是亚摩利人中所剩的；以色列人曾向他们起誓，不杀灭他们，扫罗却为以色列人和犹大人发热心，想要杀灭他们。大卫王召了他们来，
verses.textEnNiv: The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them. (Now the Gibeonites were not a part of Israel but were survivors of the Amorites; the Israelites had sworn to spare them, but Saul in his zeal for Israel and Judah had tried to annihilate them.)
verses.textEnEsv: So the king called the Gibeonites and spoke to them. Now the Gibeonites were not of the people of Israel but of the remnant of the Amorites. Although the people of Israel had sworn to spare them, Saul had sought to strike them down in his zeal for the people of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king called the Gibeonites and spoke to them. Now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; the children of Israel had sworn protection to them, but Saul had sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king summoned the Gibeonites. They were not part of Israel but were all that was left of the nation of the Amorites. The people of Israel had sworn not to kill them, but Saul, in his zeal for Israel and Judah, had tried to wipe them out.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king called the Gibeonites and spoke to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the sons of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the sons of Israel had made a covenant with them, but Saul had sought to kill them in his zeal for the sons of Israel and Judah).
verses.textEn: The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them. (Now the Gibeonites were not a part of Israel but were survivors of the Amorites; the Israelites had sworn to spare them, but Saul in his zeal for Israel and Judah had tried to annihilate them.)

verses.textZh: 大卫问基遍人："我能为你们作甚么？我该用甚么来赎罪，使你们为耶和华的产业祝福呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫问基遍人："我能为你们作甚么？我该用甚么来赎罪，使你们为耶和华的产业祝福呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 问他们说：「我当为你们怎样行呢？可用什么赎这罪，使你们为耶和华的产业祝福呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: David asked the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? How shall I make atonement so that you will bless the Lord ’s inheritance?"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said to the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? And how shall I make atonement, that you may bless the heritage of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore David said to the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? And with what shall I make atonement, that you may bless the inheritance of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: David asked them, "What can I do for you? How can I make amends so that you will bless the Lord ’s people again?"
verses.textEnNasb: David said to the Gibeonites, "What should I do for you? And how can I make amends, so that you will bless the inheritance of the Lord?"
verses.textEn: David asked the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? How shall I make atonement so that you will bless the Lord ’s inheritance?"

verses.textZh: 基遍人回答大卫："我们与扫罗和他家的事，都与金子银子没有关系；我们也不愿以色列中有一个人被杀。"大卫问："那么，你们说，我当为你们作甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基遍人回答大卫："我们与扫罗和他家的事，都与金子银子没有关系；我们也不愿以色列中有一个人被杀。"大卫问："那么，你们说，我当为你们作甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 基遍人回答说：「我们和扫罗与他家的事并不关乎金银，也不要因我们的缘故杀一个以色列人。」大卫说：「你们怎样说，我就为你们怎样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Gibeonites answered him, "We have no right to demand silver or gold from Saul or his family, nor do we have the right to put anyone in Israel to death." "What do you want me to do for you?" David asked.
verses.textEnEsv: The Gibeonites said to him, "It is not a matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel." And he said, "What do you say that I shall do for you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Gibeonites said to him, "We will have no silver or gold from Saul or from his house, nor shall you kill any man in Israel for us." So he said, "Whatever you say, I will do for you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well, money can’t settle this matter between us and the family of Saul," the Gibeonites replied. "Neither can we demand the life of anyone in Israel." "What can I do then?" David asked. "Just tell me and I will do it for you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Gibeonites said to him, "For us it is not a matter of silver or gold with Saul or his house, nor is it for us to put anyone to death in Israel." Nevertheless David said, "I will do for you whatever you say."
verses.textEn: The Gibeonites answered him, "We have no right to demand silver or gold from Saul or his family, nor do we have the right to put anyone in Israel to death." "What do you want me to do for you?" David asked.

verses.textZh: 他们回答王："从前破坏我们，谋害我们，要消灭我们，使我们不能在以色列境内立足的那人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答王："从前破坏我们，谋害我们，要消灭我们，使我们不能在以色列境内立足的那人，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对王说：「那从前谋害我们、要灭我们、使我们不得再住以色列境内的人，
verses.textEnNiv: They answered the king, "As for the man who destroyed us and plotted against us so that we have been decimated and have no place anywhere in Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: They said to the king, "The man who consumed us and planned to destroy us, so that we should have no place in all the territory of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they answered the king, "As for the man who consumed us and plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the territories of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: Then they replied, "It was Saul who planned to destroy us, to keep us from having any place at all in the territory of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to the king, "The man who destroyed us and who planned to eliminate us so that we would not exist within any border of Israel—
verses.textEn: They answered the king, "As for the man who destroyed us and plotted against us so that we have been decimated and have no place anywhere in Israel,

verses.textZh: 现在请你把他子孙中的七个男丁交给我们，我们可以在基遍耶和华的山上，在耶和华面前把他们处决。"王说："我必交给你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在请你把他子孙中的七个男丁交给我们，我们可以在基遍耶和华的山上，在耶和华面前把他们处决。"王说："我必交给你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在愿将他的子孙七人交给我们，我们好在耶和华面前，将他们悬挂在耶和华拣选扫罗的基比亚。」王说：「我必交给你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: let seven of his male descendants be given to us to be killed and their bodies exposed before the Lord at Gibeah of Saul—the Lord ’s chosen one." So the king said, "I will give them to you."
verses.textEnEsv: let seven of his sons be given to us, so that we may hang them before the Lord at Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the Lord ." And the king said, "I will give them."
verses.textEnNkjv: let seven men of his descendants be delivered to us, and we will hang them before the Lord in Gibeah of Saul, whom the Lord chose." And the king said, "I will give them."
verses.textEnNlt: So let seven of Saul’s sons be handed over to us, and we will execute them before the Lord at Gibeon, on the mountain of the Lord . " "All right," the king said, "I will do it."
verses.textEnNasb: let seven men from his sons be given to us, and we will hang them before the Lord in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the Lord." And the king said, "I will give them."
verses.textEn: let seven of his male descendants be given to us to be killed and their bodies exposed before the Lord at Gibeah of Saul—the Lord ’s chosen one." So the king said, "I will give them to you."

verses.textZh: 王顾惜扫罗的孙子、约拿单的儿子米非波设，因为大卫与扫罗的儿子约拿单，曾经在耶和华面前有过誓约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王顾惜扫罗的孙子、约拿单的儿子米非波设，因为大卫与扫罗的儿子约拿单，曾经在耶和华面前有过誓约。
verses.textZhCuv: 王因为曾与扫罗的儿子约拿单指着耶和华起誓结盟，就爱惜扫罗的孙子、约拿单的儿子米非波设，不交出来，
verses.textEnNiv: The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath before the Lord between David and Jonathan son of Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Saul’s son Jonathan, because of the oath of the Lord that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the Lord’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: The king spared Jonathan’s son Mephibosheth, who was Saul’s grandson, because of the oath David and Jonathan had sworn before the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath of the Lord which was between them, between David and Saul’s son Jonathan.
verses.textEn: The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath before the Lord between David and Jonathan son of Saul.

verses.textZh: 于是王逮捕了爱雅的女儿利斯巴为扫罗所生的两个儿子：亚摩尼和米非波设，和扫罗的女儿米拉 为米何拉人巴西莱的儿子亚得列所生的五个儿子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王逮捕了爱雅的女儿利斯巴为扫罗所生的两个儿子：亚摩尼和米非波设，和扫罗的女儿米拉 为米何拉人巴西莱的儿子亚得列所生的五个儿子，
verses.textZhCuv: 却把爱雅的女儿利斯巴给扫罗所生的两个儿子亚摩尼、米非波设，和扫罗女儿米甲的姊姊给米何拉人巴西莱儿子亚得列所生的五个儿子
verses.textEnNiv: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons of Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, whom she had borne to Saul, together with the five sons of Saul’s daughter Merab, whom she had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
verses.textEnEsv: The king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite;
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite;
verses.textEnNlt: But he gave them Saul’s two sons Armoni and Mephibosheth, whose mother was Rizpah daughter of Aiah. He also gave them the five sons of Saul’s daughter Merab, the wife of Adriel son of Barzillai from Meholah.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, Armoni and Mephibosheth whom she had borne to Saul, and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she had borne to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
verses.textEn: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons of Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, whom she had borne to Saul, together with the five sons of Saul’s daughter Merab, whom she had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

verses.textZh: 把他们交在基遍人的手里。基遍人就在山上耶和华面前把他们处决，这七人就一同倒毙了。他们被处死的时候，正是收获季节之初，就是开始收割大麦的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他们交在基遍人的手里。基遍人就在山上耶和华面前把他们处决，这七人就一同倒毙了。他们被处死的时候，正是收获季节之初，就是开始收割大麦的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 交在基遍人的手里。基遍人就把他们，在耶和华面前，悬挂在山上，这七人就一同死亡。被杀的时候正是收割的日子，就是动手割大麦的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: He handed them over to the Gibeonites, who killed them and exposed their bodies on a hill before the Lord . All seven of them fell together; they were put to death during the first days of the harvest, just as the barley harvest was beginning.
verses.textEnEsv: and he gave them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the mountain before the Lord , and the seven of them perished together. They were put to death in the first days of harvest, at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill before the Lord. So they fell, all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Gibeon executed them on the mountain before the Lord . So all seven of them died together at the beginning of the barley harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he handed them over to the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the mountain before the Lord, so that the seven of them fell together; and they were put to death in the first days of harvest at the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.textEn: He handed them over to the Gibeonites, who killed them and exposed their bodies on a hill before the Lord . All seven of them fell together; they were put to death during the first days of the harvest, just as the barley harvest was beginning.

verses.textZh: 爱雅的女儿利斯巴拿了一块麻布，为自己铺在盘石上。从开始收割的时候，直到雨水从天上倾倒在他们的尸身上的时候，白天她不让空中的飞鸟落在尸身上，夜间不让田间的走兽来糟践他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱雅的女儿利斯巴拿了一块麻布，为自己铺在盘石上。从开始收割的时候，直到雨水从天上倾倒在他们的尸身上的时候，白天她不让空中的飞鸟落在尸身上，夜间不让田间的走兽来糟践他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱雅的女儿利斯巴用麻布在磐石上搭棚，从动手收割的时候直到天降雨在尸身上的时候，日间不容空中的雀鸟落在尸身上，夜间不让田野的走兽前来糟践。
verses.textEnNiv: Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on a rock. From the beginning of the harvest till the rain poured down from the heavens on the bodies, she did not let the birds touch them by day or the wild animals by night.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until rain fell upon them from the heavens. And she did not allow the birds of the air to come upon them by day, or the beasts of the field by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until the late rains poured on them from heaven. And she did not allow the birds of the air to rest on them by day nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Rizpah daughter of Aiah, the mother of two of the men, spread burlap on a rock and stayed there the entire harvest season. She prevented the scavenger birds from tearing at their bodies during the day and stopped wild animals from eating them at night.
verses.textEnNasb: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until it rained on them from the sky; and she allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day nor the wild animals by night.
verses.textEn: Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on a rock. From the beginning of the harvest till the rain poured down from the heavens on the bodies, she did not let the birds touch them by day or the wild animals by night.

verses.textZh: 有人把扫罗的妃子，爱雅的女儿利斯巴所作的这事告诉了大卫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人把扫罗的妃子，爱雅的女儿利斯巴所作的这事告诉了大卫，
verses.textZhCuv: 有人将扫罗的妃嫔爱雅女儿利斯巴所行的这事告诉大卫。
verses.textEnNiv: When David was told what Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, Saul’s concubine, had done,
verses.textEnEsv: When David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done,
verses.textEnNkjv: And David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.textEnNlt: When David learned what Rizpah, Saul’s concubine, had done,
verses.textEnNasb: When it was reported to David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done,
verses.textEn: When David was told what Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, Saul’s concubine, had done,

verses.textZh: 大卫就去把扫罗的骸骨和他儿子约拿单的骸骨，从基列．雅比人那里搬回来。原来非利士人从前在基利波山击杀扫罗那一天，就把他们二人的尸体挂在伯．珊的广场上，基列．雅比人却把他们偷了去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就去把扫罗的骸骨和他儿子约拿单的骸骨，从基列．雅比人那里搬回来。原来非利士人从前在基利波山击杀扫罗那一天，就把他们二人的尸体挂在伯．珊的广场上，基列．雅比人却把他们偷了去。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就去，从基列‧雅比人那里将扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨搬了来（是因非利士人从前在基利波杀扫罗，将尸身悬挂在伯‧珊的街市上，基列‧雅比人把尸身偷了去。）
verses.textEnNiv: he went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh Gilead. (They had stolen their bodies from the public square at Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hung them after they struck Saul down on Gilboa.)
verses.textEnEsv: David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of his son Jonathan from the men of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, on the day the Philistines killed Saul on Gilboa.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David went and took the bones of Saul, and the bones of Jonathan his son, from the men of Jabesh Gilead who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hung them up, after the Philistines had struck down Saul in Gilboa.
verses.textEnNlt: he went to the people of Jabesh-gilead and retrieved the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan. (When the Philistines had killed Saul and Jonathan on Mount Gilboa, the people of Jabesh-gilead stole their bodies from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hung them.)
verses.textEnNasb: then David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the public square of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them on the day the Philistines struck and killed Saul in Gilboa.
verses.textEn: he went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh Gilead. (They had stolen their bodies from the public square at Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hung them after they struck Saul down on Gilboa.)

verses.textZh: 大卫把扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨从那里搬上来；又有人收殓了那些被处决者的骸骨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫把扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨从那里搬上来；又有人收殓了那些被处决者的骸骨。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫将扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨从那里搬了来，又收殓被悬挂七人的骸骨，
verses.textEnNiv: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there, and the bones of those who had been killed and exposed were gathered up.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of his son Jonathan; and they gathered the bones of those who were hanged.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he brought up the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from there; and they gathered the bones of those who had been hanged.
verses.textEnNlt: So David obtained the bones of Saul and Jonathan, as well as the bones of the men the Gibeonites had executed.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of his son Jonathan, and they gathered the bones of those who had been hanged.
verses.textEn: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there, and the bones of those who had been killed and exposed were gathered up.

verses.textZh: 他们把扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨埋葬在便雅悯地的洗拉，在扫罗父亲基士的坟墓里。王所吩咐的一切，众人都行了。这事以后，神垂听了人们为那地的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨埋葬在便雅悯地的洗拉，在扫罗父亲基士的坟墓里。王所吩咐的一切，众人都行了。这事以后，神垂听了人们为那地的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 将扫罗和他儿子约拿单的骸骨葬在便雅悯的洗拉，在扫罗父亲基士的坟墓里；众人行了王所吩咐的。此后神垂听国民所求的。
verses.textEnNiv: They buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish, at Zela in Benjamin, and did everything the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer in behalf of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the land of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father. And they did all that the king commanded. And after that God responded to the plea for the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the tomb of Kish his father. So they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God heeded the prayer for the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king ordered that they bury the bones in the tomb of Kish, Saul’s father, at the town of Zela in the land of Benjamin. After that, God ended the famine in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the grave of his father Kish; so they did everything that the king commanded, and after that God responded to prayer for the land.
verses.textEn: They buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish, at Zela in Benjamin, and did everything the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer in behalf of the land.

verses.textZh: 非利士人与以色列人又有了战事。大卫和跟随他的臣仆一同下去，要与非利士人争战；大卫疲倦了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人与以色列人又有了战事。大卫和跟随他的臣仆一同下去，要与非利士人争战；大卫疲倦了。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人与以色列人打仗；大卫带领仆人下去，与非利士人接战，大卫就疲乏了。
verses.textEnNiv: Once again there was a battle between the Philistines and Israel. David went down with his men to fight against the Philistines, and he became exhausted.
verses.textEnEsv: There was war again between the Philistines and Israel, and David went down together with his servants, and they fought against the Philistines. And David grew weary.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Philistines were at war again with Israel, David and his servants with him went down and fought against the Philistines; and David grew faint.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again the Philistines were at war with Israel. And when David and his men were in the thick of battle, David became weak and exhausted.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the Philistines were at war with Israel again, David went down, and his servants with him; and when they fought against the Philistines, David became weary.
verses.textEn: Once again there was a battle between the Philistines and Israel. David went down with his men to fight against the Philistines, and he became exhausted.

verses.textZh: 他们住在歌伯。有一个人，是巨人的儿子，他的铜矛有三公斤半重，又佩带着新刀；他想要击杀大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们住在歌伯。有一个人，是巨人的儿子，他的铜矛有三公斤半重，又佩带着新刀；他想要击杀大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 伟人的一个儿子以实‧比诺要杀大卫；他的铜枪重三百舍客勒，又佩着新刀。
verses.textEnNiv: And Ishbi-Benob, one of the descendants of Rapha, whose bronze spearhead weighed three hundred shekels and who was armed with a new sword, said he would kill David.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ishbi-benob, one of the descendants of the giants, whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of bronze, and who was armed with a new sword, thought to kill David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ishbi-Benob, who was one of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose bronze spear was three hundred shekels, who was bearing a new sword, thought he could kill David.
verses.textEnNlt: Ishbi-benob was a descendant of the giants ; his bronze spearhead weighed more than seven pounds, and he was armed with a new sword. He had cornered David and was about to kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ishbi-benob, who was among the descendants of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, had strapped on a new sword, and he intended to kill David.
verses.textEn: And Ishbi-Benob, one of the descendants of Rapha, whose bronze spearhead weighed three hundred shekels and who was armed with a new sword, said he would kill David.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛帮助了大卫；亚比筛击打那非利士人，把他杀死了。那时，跟随大卫的人向他起誓说："以后你不可再与我们一同出去打仗，免得以色列的灯熄灭了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛帮助了大卫；亚比筛击打那非利士人，把他杀死了。那时，跟随大卫的人向他起誓说："以后你不可再与我们一同出去打仗，免得以色列的灯熄灭了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛帮助大卫，攻打非利士人，将他杀死。当日，跟随大卫的人向大卫起誓说：「以后你不可再与我们一同出战，恐怕熄灭以色列的灯。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, saying, "Never again will you go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel will not be extinguished."
verses.textEnEsv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah came to his aid and attacked the Philistine and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, "You shall no longer go out with us to battle, lest you quench the lamp of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah came to his aid, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, "You shall go out no more with us to battle, lest you quench the lamp of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue and killed the Philistine. Then David’s men declared, "You are not going out to battle with us again! Why risk snuffing out the light of Israel?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, saying, "You shall not go out again with us to battle, so that you do not extinguish the lamp of Israel."
verses.textEn: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, saying, "Never again will you go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel will not be extinguished."

verses.textZh: 后来，以色列人又在歌伯与非利士人争战。那时，户沙人西比该击杀了巨人的一个儿子撒弗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，以色列人又在歌伯与非利士人争战。那时，户沙人西比该击杀了巨人的一个儿子撒弗。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，以色列人在歌伯与非利士人打仗，户沙人西比该杀了伟人的一个儿子撒弗。
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time, there was another battle with the Philistines, at Gob. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.
verses.textEnEsv: After this there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Saph, who was one of the descendants of the giants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened afterward that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was one of the sons of the giant.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, there was another battle against the Philistines at Gob. As they fought, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Saph, another descendant of the giants.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after this that there was war again with the Philistines at Gob; then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck and killed Saph, who was among the descendants of the giant.
verses.textEn: In the course of time, there was another battle with the Philistines, at Gob. At that time Sibbekai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.

verses.textZh: 在歌伯又再与非利士人争战。伯利恒人雅雷俄珥金的儿子伊勒哈难击杀了迦特人歌利亚。这人的矛杆好象织布的机轴那么粗大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在歌伯又再与非利士人争战。伯利恒人雅雷俄珥金的儿子伊勒哈难击杀了迦特人歌利亚。这人的矛杆好象织布的机轴那么粗大。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在歌伯与非利士人打仗，伯利恒人雅雷俄珥金的儿子伊勒哈难杀了迦特人歌利亚。这人的枪杆粗如织布的机轴。
verses.textEnNiv: In another battle with the Philistines at Gob, Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, the Bethlehemite, struck down Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again there was war at Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed thebrotherof Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.textEnNlt: During another battle at Gob, Elhanan son of Jair from Bethlehem killed the brother of Goliath of Gath. The handle of his spear was as thick as a weaver’s beam!
verses.textEnNasb: And there was war with the Philistines again at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.textEn: In another battle with the Philistines at Gob, Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.

verses.textZh: 在迦特又有一场战事，那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都各有六个指头，总数是二十四个；这人也是巨人所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在迦特又有一场战事，那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都各有六个指头，总数是二十四个；这人也是巨人所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在迦特打仗，那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都是六指，共有二十四个指头；他也是伟人的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on each hand, and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was descended from the giants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.textEnNlt: In another battle with the Philistines at Gath, they encountered a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in all, who was also a descendant of the giants.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was war at Gath again, where there was a man of great stature who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number; and he also had been born to the giant.
verses.textEn: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

verses.textZh: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单把他击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单把他击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就杀了他。
verses.textEnNiv: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David’s brother, killed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, struck him down.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: But when he defied and taunted Israel, he was killed by Jonathan, the son of David’s brother Shimea.
verses.textEnNasb: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, struck and killed him.
verses.textEn: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David’s brother, killed him.

verses.textZh: 以上这四个人都是迦特城里那个巨人所生的，都死在大卫和大卫臣仆的手下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这四个人都是迦特城里那个巨人所生的，都死在大卫和大卫臣仆的手下。
verses.textZhCuv: 这四个人是迦特伟人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。
verses.textEnNiv: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.
verses.textEnEsv: These four were descended from the giants in Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: These four Philistines were descendants of the giants of Gath, but David and his warriors killed them.
verses.textEnNasb: These four were born to the giant at Gath, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.textEn: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华拯救大卫脱离所有仇敌和扫罗的手的日子，他向耶和华唱出这首歌的歌词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华拯救大卫脱离所有仇敌和扫罗的手的日子，他向耶和华唱出这首歌的歌词。
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华救大卫脱离一切仇敌和扫罗之手的日子，他向耶和华念这诗，
verses.textEnNiv: David sang to the Lord the words of this song when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: And David spoke to the Lord the words of this song on the day when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David spoke to the Lord the words of this song, on the day when the Lord had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: David sang this song to the Lord on the day the Lord rescued him from all his enemies and from Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: Now David spoke the words of this song to the Lord on the day that the Lord had saved him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
verses.textEn: David sang to the Lord the words of this song when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

verses.textZh: 他说： "耶和华是我的岩石、我的山寨、我的救主、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说： "耶和华是我的岩石、我的山寨、我的救主、
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 耶和华是我的岩石， 我的山寨，我的救主，
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer;
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "The Lordis my rock and my fortress and my deliverer;
verses.textEnNlt: He sang: "The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my savior;
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer;
verses.textEn: He said: "The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer;

verses.textZh: 我的神、我的盘石、我所投靠的、 我的盾牌、我救恩的角、我的高台、我的避难所、 我的救主；你是救我脱离强暴的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神、我的盘石、我所投靠的、 我的盾牌、我救恩的角、我的高台、我的避难所、 我的救主；你是救我脱离强暴的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角， 是我的高台，是我的避难所。 我的救主啊，你是救我脱离强暴的。
verses.textEnNiv: my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation. He is my stronghold, my refuge and my savior— from violent people you save me.
verses.textEnEsv: my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold and my refuge, my savior; you save me from violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: The God of my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, My stronghold and my refuge; My Savior, You save me from violence.
verses.textEnNlt: my God is my rock, in whom I find protection. He is my shield, the power that saves me, and my place of safety. He is my refuge, my savior, the one who saves me from violence.
verses.textEnNasb: My God, my rock, in whom I take refuge, My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold and my refuge; My savior, You save me from violence.
verses.textEn: my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation. He is my stronghold, my refuge and my savior— from violent people you save me.

verses.textZh: 我向那当受赞美的耶和华呼求， 就得到拯救，脱离我的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向那当受赞美的耶和华呼求， 就得到拯救，脱离我的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华， 这样，我必从仇敌手中被救出来。
verses.textEnNiv: "I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and have been saved from my enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: I call upon the Lord , who is worthy to be praised, and I am saved from my enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will call upon the Lord, whoisworthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: I called on the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and he saved me from my enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "I call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised, And I am saved from my enemies.
verses.textEn: "I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and have been saved from my enemies.

verses.textZh: 死亡的波浪环绕我， 毁灭的急流淹没了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死亡的波浪环绕我， 毁灭的急流淹没了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 曾有死亡的波浪环绕我， 匪类的急流使我惊惧，
verses.textEnNiv: The waves of death swirled about me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.
verses.textEnEsv: "For the waves of death encompassed me, the torrents of destruction assailed me;
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the waves of death surrounded me, The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: "The waves of death overwhelmed me; floods of destruction swept over me.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the waves of death encompassed me; The floods of destruction terrified me;
verses.textEn: The waves of death swirled about me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

verses.textZh: 阴间的绳索围绕着我； 死亡的网罗迎面而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阴间的绳索围绕着我； 死亡的网罗迎面而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 阴间的绳索缠绕我， 死亡的网罗临到我。
verses.textEnNiv: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEnEsv: the cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sorrows of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEnNlt: The grave wrapped its ropes around me; death laid a trap in my path.
verses.textEnNasb: The ropes of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEn: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

verses.textZh: 急难临到我的时候，我求告耶和华， 我向我的神呼求； 他从殿中听了我的声音， 我的呼求进了他的耳中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 急难临到我的时候，我求告耶和华， 我向我的神呼求； 他从殿中听了我的声音， 我的呼求进了他的耳中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 向我的神呼求。 他从殿中听了我的声音； 我的呼求入了他的耳中。
verses.textEnNiv: "In my distress I called to the Lord ; I called out to my God. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came to his ears.
verses.textEnEsv: "In my distress I called upon the Lord ; to my God I called. From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry came to his ears.
verses.textEnNkjv: In my distress I called upon the Lord, And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry entered His ears.
verses.textEnNlt: But in my distress I cried out to the Lord ; yes, I cried to my God for help. He heard me from his sanctuary; my cry reached his ears.
verses.textEnNasb: "In my distress I called upon the Lord, Yes, I called out to my God; And from His temple He heard my voice, And my cry for help came into His ears.
verses.textEn: "In my distress I called to the Lord ; I called out to my God. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came to his ears.

verses.textZh: 那时大地摇撼震动， 天的根基也都摇动； 它们摇撼，是因为耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时大地摇撼震动， 天的根基也都摇动； 它们摇撼，是因为耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖； 天的根基也震动摇撼。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then the earth reeled and rocked; the foundations of the heavens trembled and quaked, because he was angry.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the earth quaked and trembled. The foundations of the heavens shook; they quaked because of his anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the earth shook and quaked, The foundations of heaven were trembling And were shaken, because He was angry.
verses.textEn: The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.

verses.textZh: 浓烟从他的鼻孔往上冒， 烈火从他的口中喷出来， 连炭也烧着了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 浓烟从他的鼻孔往上冒， 烈火从他的口中喷出来， 连炭也烧着了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾； 从他口中发火焚烧，连炭也着了。
verses.textEnNiv: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.
verses.textEnEsv: Smoke went up from his nostrils, and devouring fire from his mouth; glowing coals flamed forth from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it.
verses.textEnNlt: Smoke poured from his nostrils; fierce flames leaped from his mouth. Glowing coals blazed forth from him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Smoke went up out of His nostrils, And fire from His mouth was devouring; Coals were kindled by it.
verses.textEn: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

verses.textZh: 他使天下垂，亲自降临； 在他的脚下黑云密布。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使天下垂，亲自降临； 在他的脚下黑云密布。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临； 有黑云在他脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: He bowed the heavens and came down; thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet.
verses.textEnNlt: He opened the heavens and came down; dark storm clouds were beneath his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: "He also bowed the heavens down low, and came down With thick darkness under His feet.
verses.textEn: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

verses.textZh: 他乘着基路伯飞行， 借着风的翅膀急飞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他乘着基路伯飞行， 借着风的翅膀急飞。
verses.textZhCuv: 他坐着基路伯飞行， 在风的翅膀上显现。
verses.textEnNiv: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnEsv: He rode on a cherub and flew; he was seen on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnNkjv: He rode upon a cherub, and flew; And He was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnNlt: Mounted on a mighty angelic being, he flew, soaring on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: "He rode on a cherub and flew; He appeared on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEn: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

verses.textZh: 他以黑暗作他的隐密处， 他以浓黑的水气，就是天空的密云，作他四周的帷帐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以黑暗作他的隐密处， 他以浓黑的水气，就是天空的密云，作他四周的帷帐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以黑暗和聚集的水、 天空的厚云为他四围的行宫。
verses.textEnNiv: He made darkness his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: He made darkness around him his canopy, thick clouds, a gathering of water.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made darkness canopies around Him, Dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.textEnNlt: He shrouded himself in darkness, veiling his approach with dense rain clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: "He made darkness canopies around Him, A mass of waters, thick clouds of the sky.
verses.textEn: He made darkness his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.

verses.textZh: 从他面前发出的光辉， 火炭都烧起来！
verses.textZhCnvs: 从他面前发出的光辉， 火炭都烧起来！
verses.textZhCuv: 因他面前的光辉炭都着了。
verses.textEnNiv: Out of the brightness of his presence bolts of lightning blazed forth.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of the brightness before him coals of fire flamed forth.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the brightness before Him Coals of fire were kindled.
verses.textEnNlt: A great brightness shone around him, and burning coals blazed forth.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the brightness before Him Coals of fire were kindled.
verses.textEn: Out of the brightness of his presence bolts of lightning blazed forth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华从天上打雷， 至高者发出声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华从天上打雷， 至高者发出声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华从天上打雷； 至高者发出声音。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High uttered his voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice.
verses.textEn: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

verses.textZh: 他射出箭来，使它们四散； 他发出闪电，使它们混乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他射出箭来，使它们四散； 他发出闪电，使它们混乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散， 发出闪电，使他们扰乱。
verses.textEnNiv: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent out arrows and scattered them; lightning, and routed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent out arrows and scattered them; Lightning bolts, and He vanquished them.
verses.textEnNlt: He shot arrows and scattered his enemies; his lightning flashed, and they were confused.
verses.textEnNasb: "And He shot arrows and scattered them, Lightning, and routed them.
verses.textEn: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的斥责一发， 他鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现， 大地的根基也显露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的斥责一发， 他鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现， 大地的根基也显露。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的斥责一发，鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现，大地的根基也显露。
verses.textEnNiv: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of breath from his nostrils.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the channels of the sea were seen; the foundations of the world were laid bare, at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered, At the rebuke of the Lord, At the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at the command of the Lord , at the blast of his breath, the bottom of the sea could be seen, and the foundations of the earth were laid bare.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the channels of the sea appeared, The foundations of the world were exposed By the rebuke of the Lord, From the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
verses.textEn: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of breath from his nostrils.

verses.textZh: 他从高处伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从高处伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从高天伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
verses.textEnNiv: "He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.
verses.textEnEsv: "He sent from on high, he took me; he drew me out of many waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He sent from above, He took me, He drew me out of many waters.
verses.textEnNlt: "He reached down from heaven and rescued me; he drew me out of deep waters.
verses.textEnNasb: "He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.
verses.textEn: "He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

verses.textZh: 他救我脱离我的强敌， 脱离那些恨我的人，因为他们比我强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我脱离我的强敌， 脱离那些恨我的人，因为他们比我强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人， 因为他们比我强盛。
verses.textEnNiv: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.
verses.textEnEsv: He rescued me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me; For they were too strong for me.
verses.textEnNlt: He rescued me from my powerful enemies, from those who hated me and were too strong for me.
verses.textEnNasb: "He rescued me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me, for they were too strong for me.
verses.textEn: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

verses.textZh: 在我遭难的日子，他们来攻击我； 但耶和华是我的支持。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我遭难的日子，他们来攻击我； 但耶和华是我的支持。
verses.textZhCuv: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我； 但耶和华是我的倚靠。
verses.textEnNiv: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.
verses.textEnEsv: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, but the Lord was my support.
verses.textEnNkjv: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But the Lord was my support.
verses.textEnNlt: They attacked me at a moment when I was in distress, but the Lord supported me.
verses.textEnNasb: "They confronted me on the day of my disaster, But the Lord was my support.
verses.textEn: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.

verses.textZh: 他又领我出去，到那宽阔之地； 他搭救我，因为他喜悦我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又领我出去，到那宽阔之地； 他搭救我，因为他喜悦我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又领我到宽阔之处； 他救拔我，因他喜悦我。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.
verses.textEnEsv: He brought me out into a broad place; he rescued me, because he delighted in me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.
verses.textEnNlt: He led me to a place of safety; he rescued me because he delights in me.
verses.textEnNasb: "He also brought me out into an open place; He rescued me, because He delighted in me.
verses.textEn: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 照着我手中的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 照着我手中的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 按着我手中的清洁赏赐我。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he rewarded me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord rewarded me for doing right; he restored me because of my innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord has treated me in accordance with my righteousness; In accordance with the cleanliness of my hands He has repaid me.
verses.textEn: "The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

verses.textZh: 因为我谨守了耶和华的道； 未曾作恶离开我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我谨守了耶和华的道； 未曾作恶离开我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道， 未曾作恶离开我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.
verses.textEnEsv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.textEnNlt: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I have not turned from my God to follow evil.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I have kept the ways of the Lord, And have not acted wickedly against my God.
verses.textEn: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.

verses.textZh: 因为他的一切典章常摆在我面前， 他的律例，我未曾丢弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的一切典章常摆在我面前， 他的律例，我未曾丢弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例，我也未曾离弃。
verses.textEnNiv: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: For all his rules were before me, and from his statutes I did not turn aside.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all His judgments were before me; And asfor His statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.textEnNlt: I have followed all his regulations; I have never abandoned his decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: "For all His ordinances were before me, And as for His statutes, I did not deviate from them.
verses.textEn: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

verses.textZh: 我在他面前作完全的人， 我也谨守自己，脱离我的罪孽；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在他面前作完全的人， 我也谨守自己，脱离我的罪孽；
verses.textZhCuv: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.
verses.textEnEsv: I was blameless before him, and I kept myself from guilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was also blameless before Him, And I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: I am blameless before God; I have kept myself from sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "I was also blameless toward Him, And I have kept myself from my wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华按着我的公义， 照着我在他眼前的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华按着我的公义， 照着我在他眼前的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华按我的公义， 按我在他眼前的清洁赏赐我。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in His eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord rewarded me for doing right. He has seen my innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: "So the Lord has repaid me in accordance with my righteousness, In accordance with my cleanliness before His eyes.
verses.textEn: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.

verses.textZh: 对慈爱的人，你显出你的慈爱； 对完全的人，你显出你的完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对慈爱的人，你显出你的慈爱； 对完全的人，你显出你的完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他；
verses.textEnNiv: "To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,
verses.textEnEsv: "With the merciful you show yourself merciful; with the blameless man you show yourself blameless;
verses.textEnNkjv: "With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;
