verses.textEnNlt: "To the faithful you show yourself faithful; to those with integrity you show integrity.
verses.textEnNasb: "With the one who is faithful You show Yourself faithful, With the blameless one You prove Yourself blameless;
verses.textEn: "To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

verses.textZh: 对清洁的人，你显出你的清洁； 对狡诈的人，你显出你的机巧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对清洁的人，你显出你的清洁； 对狡诈的人，你显出你的机巧。
verses.textZhCuv: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他； 乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。
verses.textEnNiv: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.
verses.textEnEsv: with the purified you deal purely, and with the crooked you make yourself seem tortuous.
verses.textEnNkjv: With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.
verses.textEnNlt: To the pure you show yourself pure, but to the crooked you show yourself shrewd.
verses.textEnNasb: With the one who is pure You show Yourself pure, And with the crooked You show Yourself astute.
verses.textEn: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.

verses.textZh: 谦卑的人，你要拯救； 你的眼睛察看高傲的人，要使他们降卑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谦卑的人，你要拯救； 你的眼睛察看高傲的人，要使他们降卑。
verses.textZhCuv: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 但你的眼目察看高傲的人，使他降卑。
verses.textEnNiv: You save the humble, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them low.
verses.textEnEsv: You save a humble people, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will save the humble people; But Your eyes are on the haughty, that You may bring them down.
verses.textEnNlt: You rescue the humble, but your eyes watch the proud and humiliate them.
verses.textEnNasb: "And You save an afflicted people; But Your eyes are on the haughty whom You humiliate.
verses.textEn: You save the humble, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them low.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你是我的灯； 耶和华照明了我的黑暗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你是我的灯； 耶和华照明了我的黑暗。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是我的灯； 耶和华必照明我的黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are my lamp, O Lord , and my God lightens my darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For You are my lamp, O Lord; The Lord shall enlighten my darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , you are my lamp. The Lord lights up my darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: "For You are my lamp, Lord; And the Lord illuminates my darkness.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.

verses.textZh: 借着你，我攻破敌军； 靠着我的神，我跳过墙垣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 借着你，我攻破敌军； 靠着我的神，我跳过墙垣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我藉着你冲入敌军， 藉着我的神跳过墙垣。
verses.textEnNiv: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.
verses.textEnEsv: For by you I can run against a troop, and by my God I can leap over a wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by You I can run against a troop; By my God I can leap over a wall.
verses.textEnNlt: In your strength I can crush an army; with my God I can scale any wall.
verses.textEnNasb: "For by You I can run at a troop of warriors; By my God I can leap over a wall.
verses.textEn: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.

verses.textZh: 这位神，他的道路是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的； 凡是投靠他的，他都作他们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这位神，他的道路是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的； 凡是投靠他的，他都作他们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于神，他的道是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: "As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnEsv: This God— his way is perfect; the word of the Lord proves true; he is a shield for all those who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor God, His way is perfect; The word of the Lordis proven; He is a shield to all who trust in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "God’s way is perfect. All the Lord ’s promises prove true. He is a shield for all who look to him for protection.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for God, His way is blameless; The word of the Lord is refined; He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
verses.textEn: "As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.

verses.textZh: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？ 除了我们的神，谁是盘石呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？ 除了我们的神，谁是盘石呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？ 除了我们的神，谁是磐石呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?
verses.textEnEsv: "For who is God, but the Lord ? And who is a rock, except our God?
verses.textEnNkjv: "For who is God, except the Lord? And who is a rock, except our God?
verses.textEnNlt: For who is God except the Lord ? Who but our God is a solid rock?
verses.textEnNasb: "For who is God, except the Lord? And who is a rock, except our God?
verses.textEn: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?

verses.textZh: 这位神是我坚固的避难所， 他使我的道路完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这位神是我坚固的避难所， 他使我的道路完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是我坚固的保障； 他引导完全人行他的路。
verses.textEnNiv: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
verses.textEnEsv: This God is my strong refuge and has made my way blameless.
verses.textEnNkjv: God is my strength and power, And He makes my way perfect.
verses.textEnNlt: God is my strong fortress, and he makes my way perfect.
verses.textEnNasb: "God is my strong fortress; And He sets the blameless on His way.
verses.textEn: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

verses.textZh: 他使我的脚像母鹿的蹄， 又使我站稳在高处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我的脚像母鹿的蹄， 又使我站稳在高处。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄， 又使我在高处安稳。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.
verses.textEnEsv: He made my feet like the feet of a deer and set me secure on the heights.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes my feet like the feet of deer, And sets me on my high places.
verses.textEnNlt: He makes me as surefooted as a deer, enabling me to stand on mountain heights.
verses.textEnNasb: "He makes my feet like deer’s feet, And sets me on my high places.
verses.textEn: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.

verses.textZh: 他教导我的手怎样作战， 又使我的手臂可以拉开铜弓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他教导我的手怎样作战， 又使我的手臂可以拉开铜弓。
verses.textZhCuv: 他教导我的手能以争战， 甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。
verses.textEnNiv: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: He trains my hands for battle; he strengthens my arm to draw a bronze bow.
verses.textEnNasb: "He trains my hands for battle, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEn: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

verses.textZh: 你把你救恩的盾牌赐给我； 你的回答使我昌大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把你救恩的盾牌赐给我； 你的回答使我昌大。
verses.textZhCuv: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌； 你的温和使我为大。
verses.textEnNiv: You make your saving help my shield; your help has made me great.
verses.textEnEsv: You have given me the shield of your salvation, and your gentleness made me great.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.textEnNlt: You have given me your shield of victory; your help has made me great.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have also given me the shield of Your salvation, And Your help makes me great.
verses.textEn: You make your saving help my shield; your help has made me great.

verses.textZh: 你使我脚底下的路径宽阔， 我的两膝不会动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我脚底下的路径宽阔， 我的两膝不会动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔； 我的脚未曾滑跌。
verses.textEnNiv: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.
verses.textEnEsv: You gave a wide place for my steps under me, and my feet did not slip;
verses.textEnNkjv: You enlarged my path under me; So my feet did not slip.
verses.textEnNlt: You have made a wide path for my feet to keep them from slipping.
verses.textEnNasb: "You enlarge my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.
verses.textEn: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.

verses.textZh: 我追赶仇敌，把他们追上， 不消灭他们，我必不归回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我追赶仇敌，把他们追上， 不消灭他们，我必不归回。
verses.textZhCuv: 我追赶我的仇敌，灭绝了他们， 未灭以先，我没有归回。
verses.textEnNiv: "I pursued my enemies and crushed them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them, and did not turn back until they were consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: "I chased my enemies and destroyed them; I did not stop until they were conquered.
verses.textEnNasb: "I pursued my enemies and eliminated them, And I did not turn back until they were finished off.
verses.textEn: "I pursued my enemies and crushed them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

verses.textZh: 我吞灭他们，重创他们，使他们不能起来； 他们都倒在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我吞灭他们，重创他们，使他们不能起来； 他们都倒在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 我灭绝了他们， 打伤了他们，使他们不能起来； 他们都倒在我的脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: I crushed them completely, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
verses.textEnEsv: I consumed them; I thrust them through, so that they did not rise; they fell under my feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have destroyed them and wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.
verses.textEnNlt: I consumed them; I struck them down so they did not get up; they fell beneath my feet.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I have devoured them and smashed them, so that they would not rise; And they fell under my feet.
verses.textEn: I crushed them completely, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

verses.textZh: 你以能力给我束腰，使我能够作战； 你又使那些起来攻击我的人都屈服在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以能力给我束腰，使我能够作战； 你又使那些起来攻击我的人都屈服在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战； 你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。
verses.textEnNiv: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.
verses.textEnEsv: For you equipped me with strength for the battle; you made those who rise against me sink under me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have armed me with strength for the battle; You have subdued under me those who rose against me.
verses.textEnNlt: You have armed me with strength for the battle; you have subdued my enemies under my feet.
verses.textEnNasb: "For You have encircled me with strength for battle; You have forced those who rose up against me to bow down under me.
verses.textEn: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.

verses.textZh: 你使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 使我可以歼灭恨我的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 使我可以歼灭恨我的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
verses.textEnNiv: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.
verses.textEnEsv: You made my enemies turn their backs to me, those who hated me, and I destroyed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.
verses.textEnNlt: You placed my foot on their necks. I have destroyed all who hated me.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, And I destroyed those who hated me.
verses.textEn: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

verses.textZh: 他们呼叫，却没有人拯救； 就算向耶和华呼求，他也不答应他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们呼叫，却没有人拯救； 就算向耶和华呼求，他也不答应他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们仰望，却无人拯救； 就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。
verses.textEnNiv: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.
verses.textEnEsv: They looked, but there was none to save; they cried to the Lord , but he did not answer them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They looked, but therewas none to save; Even to the Lord, but He did not answer them.
verses.textEnNlt: They looked for help, but no one came to their rescue. They even cried to the Lord , but he refused to answer.
verses.textEnNasb: "They looked, but there was no one to save them; Even to the Lord, but He did not answer them.
verses.textEn: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.

verses.textZh: 我捣碎他们，像地上的尘土； 我打碎他们，践踏他们， 像街上的烂泥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我捣碎他们，像地上的尘土； 我打碎他们，践踏他们， 像街上的烂泥。
verses.textZhCuv: 我捣碎他们，如同地上的灰尘， 践踏他们，四散在地，如同街上的泥土。
verses.textEnNiv: I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I pounded and trampled them like mud in the streets.
verses.textEnEsv: I beat them fine as the dust of the earth; I crushed them and stamped them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I trod them like dirt in the streets, And I spread them out.
verses.textEnNlt: I ground them as fine as the dust of the earth; I trampled them in the gutter like dirt.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I pulverized them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like the mud of the streets.
verses.textEn: I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I pounded and trampled them like mud in the streets.

verses.textZh: 你救我脱离了我民的争竞， 你立我作列国的元首； 我不认识的人民要服事我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你救我脱离了我民的争竞， 你立我作列国的元首； 我不认识的人民要服事我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你救我脱离我百姓的争竞， 保护我作列国的元首； 我素不认识的民必事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: "You have delivered me from the attacks of the peoples; you have preserved me as the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,
verses.textEnEsv: "You delivered me from strife with my people; you kept me as the head of the nations; people whom I had not known served me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have also delivered me from the strivings of my people; You have kept me as the head of the nations. A people I have not known shall serve me.
verses.textEnNlt: "You gave me victory over my accusers. You preserved me as the ruler over nations; people I don’t even know now serve me.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have also saved me from the contentions of my people; You have kept me as head of the nations; A people I have not known serve me.
verses.textEn: "You have delivered me from the attacks of the peoples; you have preserved me as the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,

verses.textZh: 外族人都向我假意归顺； 他们一听见，就服从我；
verses.textZhCnvs: 外族人都向我假意归顺； 他们一听见，就服从我；
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人要投降我， 一听见我的名声就必顺从我。
verses.textEnNiv: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.
verses.textEnEsv: Foreigners came cringing to me; as soon as they heard of me, they obeyed me.
verses.textEnNkjv: The foreigners submit to me; As soon as they hear, they obey me.
verses.textEnNlt: Foreign nations cringe before me; as soon as they hear of me, they submit.
verses.textEnNasb: "Foreigners pretend to obey me; As soon as they hear, they obey me.
verses.textEn: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

verses.textZh: 外族人大势已去， 战战兢兢地从他们的要塞走出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外族人大势已去， 战战兢兢地从他们的要塞走出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人要衰残， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。
verses.textEnNiv: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.
verses.textEnEsv: Foreigners lost heart and came trembling out of their fortresses.
verses.textEnNkjv: The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.
verses.textEnNlt: They all lose their courage and come trembling from their strongholds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Foreigners lose heart, And come trembling out of their fortresses.
verses.textEn: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是永活的，我的盘石是应当称颂的； 拯救我的神，我的盘石，是应当被尊为至高的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是永活的，我的盘石是应当称颂的； 拯救我的神，我的盘石，是应当被尊为至高的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是活神，愿我的磐石被人称颂！ 愿神－那拯救我的磐石被人尊崇！
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be my God, the Rock, my Savior!
verses.textEnEsv: "The Lord lives, and blessed be my rock, and exalted be my God, the rock of my salvation,
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord lives! Blessed be my Rock! Let God be exalted, The Rock of my salvation!
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord lives! Praise to my Rock! May God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted!
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord lives, and blessed be my Rock; And exalted be my God, the rock of my salvation,
verses.textEn: "The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be my God, the Rock, my Savior!

verses.textZh: 他是那位为我伸冤的神， 他使万民服在我的脚下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是那位为我伸冤的神， 他使万民服在我的脚下，
verses.textZhCuv: 这位神就是那为我伸冤、 使众民服在我以下的。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the God who avenges me, who puts the nations under me,
verses.textEnEsv: the God who gave me vengeance and brought down peoples under me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis God who avenges me, And subdues the peoples under me;
verses.textEnNlt: He is the God who pays back those who harm me; he brings down the nations under me
verses.textEnNasb: The God who executes vengeance for me, And brings down peoples under me,
verses.textEn: He is the God who avenges me, who puts the nations under me,

verses.textZh: 他救我脱离我的仇敌。 你还把我高举起来，高过那些起来攻击我的人， 又救我脱离了强暴的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我脱离我的仇敌。 你还把我高举起来，高过那些起来攻击我的人， 又救我脱离了强暴的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你救我脱离仇敌， 又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的； 你救我脱离强暴的人。
verses.textEnNiv: who sets me free from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.
verses.textEnEsv: who brought me out from my enemies; you exalted me above those who rose against me; you delivered me from men of violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: He delivers me from my enemies. You also lift me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.
verses.textEnNlt: and delivers me from my enemies. You hold me safe beyond the reach of my enemies; you save me from violent opponents.
verses.textEnNasb: Who also brings me out from my enemies; You also raise me above those who rise up against me; You rescue me from the violent person.
verses.textEn: who sets me free from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华啊，我要在列国中称赞你，歌颂你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华啊，我要在列国中称赞你，歌颂你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你， 歌颂你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.
verses.textEnEsv: "For this I will praise you, O Lord , among the nations, and sing praises to your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will give thanks to You, O Lord, among the Gentiles, And sing praises to Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: For this, O Lord , I will praise you among the nations; I will sing praises to your name.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I will give thanks to You, Lord, among the nations, And I will sing praises to Your name.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.

verses.textZh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王， 又向他的受膏者施慈爱， 就是向大卫和他的后裔施慈爱，直到永远。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王， 又向他的受膏者施慈爱， 就是向大卫和他的后裔施慈爱，直到永远。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王， 施慈爱给他的受膏者， 就是给大卫和他的后裔， 直到永远！
verses.textEnNiv: "He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Great salvation he brings to his king, and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David and his offspring forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: "He is the tower of salvation to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forevermore."
verses.textEnNlt: You give great victories to your king; you show unfailing love to your anointed, to David and all his descendants forever."
verses.textEnNasb: "He is a tower of salvation to His king, And shows favor to His anointed, To David and his descendants forever."
verses.textEn: "He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever."

verses.textZh: 以下是大卫末了的话： "耶西的儿子大卫的宣告， 被高举的人的宣告。 大卫是雅各的神所膏立的， 是以色列美妙的诗人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是大卫末了的话： "耶西的儿子大卫的宣告， 被高举的人的宣告。 大卫是雅各的神所膏立的， 是以色列美妙的诗人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以下是大卫末了的话。耶西的儿子大卫得居高位，是雅各神所膏的，作以色列的美歌者，说：
verses.textEnNiv: These are the last words of David: "The inspired utterance of David son of Jesse, the utterance of the man exalted by the Most High, the man anointed by the God of Jacob, the hero of Israel’s songs:
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the last words of David: The oracle of David, the son of Jesse, the oracle of the man who was raised on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the last words of David. Thus says David the son of Jesse; Thus says the man raised up on high, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: These are the last words of David: "David, the son of Jesse, speaks— David, the man who was raised up so high, David, the man anointed by the God of Jacob, David, the sweet psalmist of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse declares, The man who was raised on high, The anointed of the God of Jacob And the sweet psalmist of Israel, declares,
verses.textEn: These are the last words of David: "The inspired utterance of David son of Jesse, the utterance of the man exalted by the Most High, the man anointed by the God of Jacob, the hero of Israel’s songs:

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵借着我说话， 他的话在我的舌头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵借着我说话， 他的话在我的舌头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵藉着我说： 他的话在我口中。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: "The Spirit of the Lord speaks by me; his word is on my tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Spirit of the Lord spoke by me, And His word was on my tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Spirit of the Lord speaks through me; his words are upon my tongue.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me, And His word was on my tongue.
verses.textEn: "The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

verses.textZh: 以色列的神说， 以色列的盘石告诉我： 那以公义统治人的， 那存敬畏神的心施行统治的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的神说， 以色列的盘石告诉我： 那以公义统治人的， 那存敬畏神的心施行统治的，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的神、 以色列的磐石晓谕我说： 那以公义治理人民的， 敬畏神执掌权柄，
verses.textEnNiv: The God of Israel spoke, the Rock of Israel said to me: ‘When one rules over people in righteousness, when he rules in the fear of God,
verses.textEnEsv: The God of Israel has spoken; the Rock of Israel has said to me: When one rules justly over men, ruling in the fear of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spoke to me: ‘He who rules over men mustbe just, Ruling in the fear of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The God of Israel spoke. The Rock of Israel said to me: ‘The one who rules righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
verses.textEnNasb: "The God of Israel said it; The Rock of Israel spoke to me: ‘He who rules over mankind righteously, Who rules in the fear of God,
verses.textEn: The God of Israel spoke, the Rock of Israel said to me: ‘When one rules over people in righteousness, when he rules in the fear of God,

verses.textZh: 他必像旭日升起的光芒， 像无云的早晨， 像雨后的晴朗， 使地长出绿草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必像旭日升起的光芒， 像无云的早晨， 像雨后的晴朗， 使地长出绿草。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必像日出的晨光， 如无云的清晨， 雨后的晴光， 使地发生嫩草。
verses.textEnNiv: he is like the light of morning at sunrise on a cloudless morning, like the brightness after rain that brings grass from the earth.’
verses.textEnEsv: he dawns on them like the morning light, like the sun shining forth on a cloudless morning, like rain that makes grass to sprout from the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And heshallbe like the light of the morning when the sun rises, A morning without clouds, Like the tender grass springing out of the earth, By clear shining after rain.’
verses.textEnNlt: is like the light of morning at sunrise, like a morning without clouds, like the gleaming of the sun on new grass after rain.’
verses.textEnNasb: Is like the light of the morning when the sun rises, A morning without clouds, When the fresh grass springs out of the earth From sunshine after rain.’
verses.textEn: he is like the light of morning at sunrise on a cloudless morning, like the brightness after rain that brings grass from the earth.’

verses.textZh: 我的家在神面前不是这样吗？ 他与我立了永远的约； 这约安排了一切，稳固妥当。 我的一切救恩、一切愿望， 他不都成全吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的家在神面前不是这样吗？ 他与我立了永远的约； 这约安排了一切，稳固妥当。 我的一切救恩、一切愿望， 他不都成全吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我家在神面前并非如此；神却与我立永远的约。 这约凡事坚稳， 关乎我的一切救恩和我一切所想望的， 他岂不为我成就吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "If my house were not right with God, surely he would not have made with me an everlasting covenant, arranged and secured in every part; surely he would not bring to fruition my salvation and grant me my every desire.
verses.textEnEsv: "For does not my house stand so with God? For he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things and secure. For will he not cause to prosper all my help and my desire?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Although my house is not so with God, Yet He has made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in all things and secure. For thisis all my salvation and all my desire; Will He not make it increase?
verses.textEnNlt: "Is it not my family God has chosen? Yes, he has made an everlasting covenant with me. His agreement is arranged and guaranteed in every detail. He will ensure my safety and success.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is my house not indeed so with God? For He has made an everlasting covenant with me, Properly ordered in all things, and secured; For will He not indeed make All my salvation and all my delight grow?
verses.textEn: "If my house were not right with God, surely he would not have made with me an everlasting covenant, arranged and secured in every part; surely he would not bring to fruition my salvation and grant me my every desire.

verses.textZh: 流氓却像荆棘被丢弃， 人不敢用手拿它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流氓却像荆棘被丢弃， 人不敢用手拿它。
verses.textZhCuv: 但匪类都必像荆棘被丢弃； 人不敢用手拿它；
verses.textEnNiv: But evil men are all to be cast aside like thorns, which are not gathered with the hand.
verses.textEnEsv: But worthless men are all like thorns that are thrown away, for they cannot be taken with the hand;
verses.textEnNkjv: But thesons of rebellion shall all be as thorns thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with hands.
verses.textEnNlt: But the godless are like thorns to be thrown away, for they tear the hand that touches them.
verses.textEnNasb: "But the worthless, every one of them, are like scattered thorns, Because they cannot be taken in hand;
verses.textEn: But evil men are all to be cast aside like thorns, which are not gathered with the hand.

verses.textZh: 人要碰它， 必须带备铁器和枪杆， 他们要在原地被火彻底烧毁。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要碰它， 必须带备铁器和枪杆， 他们要在原地被火彻底烧毁。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿它的人必带铁器和枪杆， 终久它必被火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever touches thorns uses a tool of iron or the shaft of a spear; they are burned up where they lie."
verses.textEnEsv: but the man who touches them arms himself with iron and the shaft of a spear, and they are utterly consumed with fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the man who touches them Must be armed with iron and the shaft of a spear, And they shall be utterly burned with fire in their place."
verses.textEnNlt: One must use iron tools to chop them down; they will be totally consumed by fire."
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, the man who touches them Must be armed with iron and the shaft of a spear, And they will be completely burned with fire in their place."
verses.textEn: Whoever touches thorns uses a tool of iron or the shaft of a spear; they are burned up where they lie."

verses.textZh: 以下是大卫勇士的名字：他革扪人约设．巴设，是军官 的首领，又称为伊斯尼人亚底挪。他曾在一次战役中杀死了八百人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是大卫勇士的名字：他革扪人约设．巴设，是军官 的首领，又称为伊斯尼人亚底挪。他曾在一次战役中杀死了八百人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫勇士的名字记在下面：他革扪人约设‧巴设，又称伊斯尼人亚底挪，他是军长的统领，一时击杀了八百人。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of David’s mighty warriors: Josheb-Basshebeth, a Tahkemonite, was chief of the Three; he raised his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite; he was chief of the three. He wielded his spear against eight hundred whom he killed at one time.
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-Basshebeth the Tachmonite, chief among the captains. He was called Adino the Eznite, because he had killed eight hundred men at one time.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of David’s mightiest warriors. The first was Jashobeam the Hacmonite, who was leader of the Three —the three mightiest warriors among David’s men. He once used his spear to kill 800 enemy warriors in a single battle.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite because of eight hundred who were killed by him at one time.
verses.textEn: These are the names of David’s mighty warriors: Josheb-Basshebeth, a Tahkemonite, was chief of the Three; he raised his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.

verses.textZh: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒。从前非利士人在巴斯达闵聚集要争战，与大卫一同去向他们骂阵的三个勇士，其中之一就是以利亚撒；那时以色列人向上撤退，
verses.textZhCnvs: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒。从前非利士人在巴斯达闵聚集要争战，与大卫一同去向他们骂阵的三个勇士，其中之一就是以利亚撒；那时以色列人向上撤退，
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒。从前非利士人聚集要打仗，以色列人迎着上去，有跟随大卫的三个勇士向非利士人骂阵，其中有以利亚撒。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty warriors, he was with David when they taunted the Philistines gathered at Pas Dammim for battle. Then the Israelites retreated,
verses.textEnEsv: And next to him among the three mighty men was Eleazar the son of Dodo, son of Ahohi. He was with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel withdrew.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there for battle, and the men of Israel had retreated.
verses.textEnNlt: Next in rank among the Three was Eleazar son of Dodai, a descendant of Ahoah. Once Eleazar and David stood together against the Philistines when the entire Israelite army had fled.
verses.textEnNasb: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there to battle and the men of Israel had withdrawn.
verses.textEn: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty warriors, he was with David when they taunted the Philistines gathered at Pas Dammim for battle. Then the Israelites retreated,

verses.textZh: 他却起来，击杀非利士人，直到他的手疲乏无力，紧贴在刀把上。那一天耶和华使以色列人获得了大胜利。众人转到以利亚撒后面，只顾剥夺死者的财物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却起来，击杀非利士人，直到他的手疲乏无力，紧贴在刀把上。那一天耶和华使以色列人获得了大胜利。众人转到以利亚撒后面，只顾剥夺死者的财物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他起来击杀非利士人，直到手臂疲乏，手黏住刀把。那日耶和华使以色列人大获全胜；众民在以利亚撒后头专夺财物。
verses.textEnNiv: but Eleazar stood his ground and struck down the Philistines till his hand grew tired and froze to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day. The troops returned to Eleazar, but only to strip the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: He rose and struck down the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clung to the sword. And the Lord brought about a great victory that day, and the men returned after him only to strip the slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: He arose and attacked the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand stuck to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to plunder.
verses.textEnNlt: He killed Philistines until his hand was too tired to lift his sword, and the Lord gave him a great victory that day. The rest of the army did not return until it was time to collect the plunder!
verses.textEnNasb: He rose up and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary and it clung to the sword, and the Lord brought about a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to plunder the dead.
verses.textEn: but Eleazar stood his ground and struck down the Philistines till his hand grew tired and froze to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day. The troops returned to Eleazar, but only to strip the dead.

verses.textZh: 再其次是哈拉人亚基的儿子沙玛。非利士人聚集在利希，那里有一块田地长满了红豆，众人都从非利士人面前逃走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再其次是哈拉人亚基的儿子沙玛。非利士人聚集在利希，那里有一块田地长满了红豆，众人都从非利士人面前逃走。
verses.textZhCuv: 其次是哈拉人亚基的儿子沙玛。一日，非利士人聚集成群，在一块长满红豆的田里，众民就在非利士人面前逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: Next to him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines banded together at a place where there was a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.
verses.textEnEsv: And next to him was Shammah, the son of Agee the Hararite. The Philistines gathered together at Lehi, where there was a plot of ground full of lentils, and the men fled from the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a piece of ground full of lentils. So the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: Next in rank was Shammah son of Agee from Harar. One time the Philistines gathered at Lehi and attacked the Israelites in a field full of lentils. The Israelite army fled,
verses.textEnNasb: Now after him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered into an army where there was a plot of land full of lentils, and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.textEn: Next to him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines banded together at a place where there was a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.

verses.textZh: 沙玛却在那块田中间站稳脚步，保护了那块田，又击杀了非利士人。耶和华又使以色列人获得了大胜利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙玛却在那块田中间站稳脚步，保护了那块田，又击杀了非利士人。耶和华又使以色列人获得了大胜利。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙玛却站在那田间击杀非利士人，救护了那田。耶和华使以色列人大获全胜。
verses.textEnNiv: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field. He defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.
verses.textEnEsv: But he took his stand in the midst of the plot and defended it and struck down the Philistines, and the Lord worked a great victory.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he stationed himself in the middle of the field, defended it, and killed the Philistines. So the Lord brought about a great victory.
verses.textEnNlt: but Shammah held his ground in the middle of the field and beat back the Philistines. So the Lord brought about a great victory.
verses.textEnNasb: But he took his stand in the midst of the plot, defended it, and struck the Philistines; and the Lord brought about a great victory.
verses.textEn: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field. He defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the Lord brought about a great victory.

verses.textZh: 收割的时候，三十个首领中有三个人下到亚杜兰洞那里去见大卫；有一队非利士人在利乏音谷安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 收割的时候，三十个首领中有三个人下到亚杜兰洞那里去见大卫；有一队非利士人在利乏音谷安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 收割的时候，有三十个勇士中的三个人下到亚杜兰洞见大卫。非利士的军兵在利乏音谷安营。
verses.textEnNiv: During harvest time, three of the thirty chief warriors came down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnEsv: And three of the thirty chief men went down and came about harvest time to David at the cave of Adullam, when a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then three of the thirty chief men went down at harvest time and came to David at the cave of Adullam. And the troop of Philistines encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNlt: Once during the harvest, when David was at the cave of Adullam, the Philistine army was camped in the valley of Rephaim. The Three (who were among the Thirty—an elite group among David’s fighting men) went down to meet him there.
verses.textEnNasb: Then three of the thirty chief men went down and came to David at harvest time to the cave of Adullam, while the army of the Philistines was camping in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEn: During harvest time, three of the thirty chief warriors came down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.textZh: 那时大卫在山寨中，非利士人的驻军却在伯利恒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时大卫在山寨中，非利士人的驻军却在伯利恒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时大卫在山寨，非利士人的防营在伯利恒。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnEsv: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNkjv: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNlt: David was staying in the stronghold at the time, and a Philistine detachment had occupied the town of Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNasb: David was then in the stronghold, while the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.textEn: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.

verses.textZh: 大卫渴望说："但愿有人把伯利恒城门旁边井里的水拿来给我喝！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫渴望说："但愿有人把伯利恒城门旁边井里的水拿来给我喝！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫渴想，说：「甚愿有人将伯利恒城门旁、井里的水打来给我喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: David longed for water and said, "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"
verses.textEnEsv: And David said longingly, "Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem that is by the gate!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said with longing, "Oh, that someone would give me a drink of the water from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!"
verses.textEnNlt: David remarked longingly to his men, "Oh, how I would love some of that good water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem."
verses.textEnNasb: And David had a craving and said, "Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem which is by the gate!"
verses.textEn: David longed for water and said, "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"

verses.textZh: 那三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营地，从伯利恒城门旁边的井里打水，把水取上来，带到大卫那里。大卫不肯喝，却把水浇奠在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营地，从伯利恒城门旁边的井里打水，把水取上来，带到大卫那里。大卫不肯喝，却把水浇奠在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 这三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营盘，从伯利恒城门旁的井里打水，拿来奉给大卫。他却不肯喝，将水奠在耶和华面前，
verses.textEnNiv: So the three mighty warriors broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then the three mighty men broke through the camp of the Philistines and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and carried and brought it to David. But he would not drink of it. He poured it out to the Lord
verses.textEnNkjv: So the three mighty men broke through the camp of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, and took it and brought it to David. Nevertheless he would not drink it, but poured it out to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew some water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it. Instead, he poured it out as an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So the three mighty men forced their way into the camp of the Philistines, and drew water from the well of Bethlehem which was by the gate, and carried it and brought it to David. Yet he would not drink it, but poured it out as an offering to the Lord;
verses.textEn: So the three mighty warriors broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫说："耶和华啊！我绝对不可作这事。这三个人冒着生命危险去打水，这水不是他们的血吗？"因此大卫不肯喝那水。这些是那三个勇士所作的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫说："耶和华啊！我绝对不可作这事。这三个人冒着生命危险去打水，这水不是他们的血吗？"因此大卫不肯喝那水。这些是那三个勇士所作的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「耶和华啊，这三个人冒死去打水；这水好像他们的血一般，我断不敢喝。」如此，大卫不肯喝。这是三个勇士所做的事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Far be it from me, Lord , to do this!" he said. "Is it not the blood of men who went at the risk of their lives?" And David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Far be it from me, O Lord , that I should do this. Shall I drink the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?" Therefore he would not drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Far be it from me, O Lord, that I should do this! Is thisnot the blood of the men who went in jeopardyof their lives?" Therefore he would not drink it. These things were done by the three mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord forbid that I should drink this!" he exclaimed. "This water is as precious as the blood of these men who risked their lives to bring it to me." So David did not drink it. These are examples of the exploits of the Three.
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "Far be it from me, Lord, that I would do this! Should I drink the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?" So he would not drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
verses.textEn: "Far be it from me, Lord , to do this!" he said. "Is it not the blood of men who went at the risk of their lives?" And David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty warriors.

verses.textZh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押的兄弟亚比筛是三十勇士 的首领。他曾挥舞矛枪杀死了三百人，因此他与"三勇士"齐名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押的兄弟亚比筛是三十勇士 的首领。他曾挥舞矛枪杀死了三百人，因此他与"三勇士"齐名。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗鲁雅的儿子、约押的兄弟亚比筛是这三个勇士的首领；他举枪杀了三百人，就在三个勇士里得了名。
verses.textEnNiv: Abishai the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the thirty. And he wielded his spear against three hundred men and killed them and won a name beside the three.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abishai the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of another three. He lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name among these three.
verses.textEnNlt: Abishai son of Zeruiah, the brother of Joab, was the leader of the Thirty. He once used his spear to kill 300 enemy warriors in a single battle. It was by such feats that he became as famous as the Three.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the thirty. And he swung his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name as well as the three.
verses.textEn: Abishai the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.

verses.textZh: 他的荣誉比那"三十勇士"高 ，所以成为他们的领袖；不过，却不及"三勇士"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的荣誉比那"三十勇士"高 ，所以成为他们的领袖；不过，却不及"三勇士"。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在这三个勇士里是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领，只是不及前三个勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: Was he not held in greater honor than the Three? He became their commander, even though he was not included among them.
verses.textEnEsv: He was the most renowned of the thirty and became their commander, but he did not attain to the three.
verses.textEnNkjv: Was he not the most honored of three? Therefore he became their captain. However, he did not attain to the first three.
verses.textEnNlt: Abishai was the most famous of the Thirty and was their commander, though he was not one of the Three.
verses.textEnNasb: He was the most honored among the thirty, so he became their commander; however, he did not attain to the reputation of the three.
verses.textEn: Was he not held in greater honor than the Three? He became their commander, even though he was not included among them.

verses.textZh: 甲薛人耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，是一个力气很大的人，作过许多大事。他曾经击杀了摩押人的两个勇将；又在下雪的时候，下到坑里去击杀了一只狮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甲薛人耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，是一个力气很大的人，作过许多大事。他曾经击杀了摩押人的两个勇将；又在下雪的时候，下到坑里去击杀了一只狮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅行过大能的事；他杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个儿子，又在下雪的时候下坑里去，杀了一个狮子，
verses.textEnNiv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.
verses.textEnEsv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a valiant man of Kabzeel, a doer of great deeds. He struck down two ariels of Moab. He also went down and struck down a lion in a pit on a day when snow had fallen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man from Kabzeel, who had done many deeds. He had killed two lion-like heroes of Moab. He also had gone down and killed a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.
verses.textEnNlt: There was also Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant warrior from Kabzeel. He did many heroic deeds, which included killing two champions of Moab. Another time, on a snowy day, he chased a lion down into a pit and killed it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done great deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
verses.textEn: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, performed great exploits. He struck down Moab’s two mightiest warriors. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

verses.textZh: 他还击杀了一个体格高大的埃及人。这埃及人手里有矛，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去与他对抗；结果他把埃及人手中的矛枪夺了过来，用那矛枪杀死他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还击杀了一个体格高大的埃及人。这埃及人手里有矛，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去与他对抗；结果他把埃及人手中的矛枪夺了过来，用那矛枪杀死他。
verses.textZhCuv: 又杀了一个强壮的埃及人；埃及人手里拿着枪，比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，从埃及人手里夺过枪来，用那枪将他杀死。
verses.textEnNiv: And he struck down a huge Egyptian. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEnEsv: And he struck down an Egyptian, a handsome man. The Egyptian had a spear in his hand, but Benaiah went down to him with a staff and snatched the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he killed an Egyptian, a spectacular man. The Egyptian had a spear in his hand; so he went down to him with a staff, wrested the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEnNlt: Once, armed only with a club, he killed an imposing Egyptian warrior who was armed with a spear. Benaiah wrenched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with it.
verses.textEnNasb: And he killed an Egyptian, an impressive man. Now the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, but he went down to him with a club and snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.textEn: And he struck down a huge Egyptian. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.

verses.textZh: 这些是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所作的事。他与"三勇士"齐名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所作的事。他与"三勇士"齐名。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，就在三个勇士里得了名。
verses.textEnNiv: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.
verses.textEnEsv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and won a name beside the three mighty men.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and won a name among three mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: Deeds like these made Benaiah as famous as the Three mightiest warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and had a name as well as the three mighty men.
verses.textEn: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.

verses.textZh: 他的荣誉比那"三十勇士"高，不过，却不及"三勇士"。大卫立他作侍卫长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的荣誉比那"三十勇士"高，不过，却不及"三勇士"。大卫立他作侍卫长。
verses.textZhCuv: 他比那三十个勇士都尊贵，只是不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作护卫长。
verses.textEnNiv: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
verses.textEnEsv: He was renowned among the thirty, but he did not attain to the three. And David set him over his bodyguard.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was more honored than the thirty, but he did not attain to the first three. And David appointed him over his guard.
verses.textEnNlt: He was more honored than the other members of the Thirty, though he was not one of the Three. And David made him captain of his bodyguard.
verses.textEnNasb: He was honored among the thirty, but he did not attain the reputation of the three. And David appointed him over his bodyguard.
verses.textEn: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
