verses.textZh: 耶和华又向以色列人发怒，就激动大卫，使他们受害，说："你去数点一下以色列和犹大的人数吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又向以色列人发怒，就激动大卫，使他们受害，说："你去数点一下以色列和犹大的人数吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又向以色列人发怒，就激动大卫，使他吩咐人去数点以色列人和犹大人。
verses.textEnNiv: Again the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, "Go and take a census of Israel and Judah."
verses.textEnEsv: Again the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, "Go, number Israel and Judah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the anger of the Lord was aroused against Israel, and He moved David against them to say, "Go, number Israel and Judah."
verses.textEnNlt: Once again the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he caused David to harm them by taking a census. "Go and count the people of Israel and Judah," the Lord told him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the anger of the Lord burned against Israel again, and He incited David against them to say, "Go, count Israel and Judah."
verses.textEn: Again the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, "Go and take a census of Israel and Judah."

verses.textZh: 王就对约押和跟随他的军官说："你们走遍以色列各支派，从但到别是巴，数点人民，我好知道人民的数目。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就对约押和跟随他的军官说："你们走遍以色列各支派，从但到别是巴，数点人民，我好知道人民的数目。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就吩咐跟随他的元帅约押说：「你去走遍以色列众支派，从但直到别是巴，数点百姓，我好知道他们的数目。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the king said to Joab and the army commanders with him, "Go throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and enroll the fighting men, so that I may know how many there are."
verses.textEnEsv: So the king said to Joab, the commander of the army, who was with him, "Go through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, and number the people, that I may know the number of the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king said to Joab the commander of the army who was with him, "Now go throughout all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the number of the people."
verses.textEnNlt: So the king said to Joab and the commanders of the army, "Take a census of all the tribes of Israel—from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south—so I may know how many people there are."
verses.textEnNasb: So the king said to Joab the commander of the army, who was with him, "Roam about now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, and conduct a census of the people, so that I may know the number of the people."
verses.textEn: So the king said to Joab and the army commanders with him, "Go throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and enroll the fighting men, so that I may know how many there are."

verses.textZh: 约押回答王："无论人民有多少，愿耶和华你的神再增加一百倍，又愿我主我王亲眼看见。不过，我主我王为甚么喜欢这事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押回答王："无论人民有多少，愿耶和华你的神再增加一百倍，又愿我主我王亲眼看见。不过，我主我王为甚么喜欢这事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约押对王说：「无论百姓多少，愿耶和华－你的神再加增百倍，使我主我王亲眼得见。我主我王何必喜悦行这事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Joab replied to the king, "May the Lord your God multiply the troops a hundred times over, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Joab said to the king, "May the Lord your God add to the people a hundred times as many as they are, while the eyes of my lord the king still see it, but why does my lord the king delight in this thing?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joab said to the king, "Now may the Lord your God add to the people a hundred times more than there are, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king desire this thing?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Joab replied to the king, "May the Lord your God let you live to see a hundred times as many people as there are now! But why, my lord the king, do you want to do this?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Joab said to the king, "May the Lord your God add to the people a hundred times as many as they are, while the eyes of my lord the king can still see; but why does my lord the king delight in this thing?"
verses.textEn: But Joab replied to the king, "May the Lord your God multiply the troops a hundred times over, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing?"

verses.textZh: 但是王的命令约押和众军官不敢不从。于是约押和众军官从王面前出去，数点以色列的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是王的命令约押和众军官不敢不从。于是约押和众军官从王面前出去，数点以色列的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 但王的命令胜过约押和众军长。约押和众军长就从王面前出去，数点以色列的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab and the army commanders; so they left the presence of the king to enroll the fighting men of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king’s word prevailed against Joab and the commanders of the army. So Joab and the commanders of the army went out from the presence of the king to number the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Therefore Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king insisted that they take the census, so Joab and the commanders of the army went out to count the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, the king’s order prevailed against Joab and against the commanders of the army. So Joab and the commanders of the army left the presence of the king to conduct a census of the people of Israel.
verses.textEn: The king’s word, however, overruled Joab and the army commanders; so they left the presence of the king to enroll the fighting men of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们过了约旦河，就在谷中那座亚罗珥城的右边安营。后来他们经过迦得，直到雅谢，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们过了约旦河，就在谷中那座亚罗珥城的右边安营。后来他们经过迦得，直到雅谢，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们过了约旦河，在迦得谷中、城的右边亚罗珥安营，与雅谢相对，
verses.textEnNiv: After crossing the Jordan, they camped near Aroer, south of the town in the gorge, and then went through Gad and on to Jazer.
verses.textEnEsv: They crossed the Jordan and began from Aroer, and from the city that is in the middle of the valley, toward Gad and on to Jazer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they crossed over the Jordan and camped in Aroer, on the right side of the town which is in the midst of the ravine of Gad, and toward Jazer.
verses.textEnNlt: First they crossed the Jordan and camped at Aroer, south of the town in the valley, in the direction of Gad. Then they went on to Jazer,
verses.textEnNasb: They crossed the Jordan and camped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the Valley of Gad and toward Jazer.
verses.textEn: After crossing the Jordan, they camped near Aroer, south of the town in the gorge, and then went through Gad and on to Jazer.

verses.textZh: 然后又到了基列和他停．合示地，再到了但．雅安，并绕过了西顿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后又到了基列和他停．合示地，再到了但．雅安，并绕过了西顿，
verses.textZhCuv: 又到了基列和他停‧合示地，又到了但‧雅安，绕到西顿，
verses.textEnNiv: They went to Gilead and the region of Tahtim Hodshi, and on to Dan Jaan and around toward Sidon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they came to Gilead, and to Kadesh in the land of the Hittites; and they came to Dan, and from Dan they went around to Sidon,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon;
verses.textEnNlt: then to Gilead in the land of Tahtim-hodshi and to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi, and they came to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon,
verses.textEn: They went to Gilead and the region of Tahtim Hodshi, and on to Dan Jaan and around toward Sidon.

verses.textZh: 来到推罗的堡垒，以及希未人和迦南人所有的城市。最后，他们出到犹大的南端别是巴去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 来到推罗的堡垒，以及希未人和迦南人所有的城市。最后，他们出到犹大的南端别是巴去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 来到泰尔的保障，并希未人和迦南人的各城，又到犹大南方的别是巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the towns of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went on to Beersheba in the Negev of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: and came to the fortress of Tyre and to all the cities of the Hivites and Canaanites; and they went out to the Negeb of Judah at Beersheba.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they came to the stronghold of Tyre and to all the cities of the Hivites and the Canaanites. Then they went out to South Judah asfaras Beersheba.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they came to the fortress of Tyre, and all the towns of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went south to Judah as far as Beersheba.
verses.textEnNasb: then they came to the fortress of Tyre and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites, and they went out to the south of Judah, to Beersheba.
verses.textEn: Then they went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the towns of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went on to Beersheba in the Negev of Judah.

verses.textZh: 以后，他们走遍了全地，过了九个月又二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，他们走遍了全地，过了九个月又二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们走遍全地，过了九个月零二十天，就回到耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: After they had gone through the entire land, they came back to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.textEnEsv: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.textEnNlt: Having gone through the entire land for nine months and twenty days, they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: So when they had roamed about through the whole land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.textEn: After they had gone through the entire land, they came back to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

verses.textZh: 约押把数点人民的数目向王呈报：在以色列中能拔刀的勇士共有八十万人；犹大共有五十万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押把数点人民的数目向王呈报：在以色列中能拔刀的勇士共有八十万人；犹大共有五十万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押将百姓的总数奏告于王：以色列拿刀的勇士有八十万；犹大有五十万。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to the king: In Israel there were eight hundred thousand able-bodied men who could handle a sword, and in Judah five hundred thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joab gave the sum of the numbering of the people to the king: in Israel there were 800,000 valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were 500,000.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to the king. And there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab reported the number of people to the king. There were 800,000 capable warriors in Israel who could handle a sword, and 500,000 in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joab gave the number of the census of the people to the king: in Israel there were eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
verses.textEn: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to the king: In Israel there were eight hundred thousand able-bodied men who could handle a sword, and in Judah five hundred thousand.

verses.textZh: 大卫数点了人民以后，良心一直不安，于是对耶和华说："我作了这事，犯了大罪。耶和华啊！现在求你除去你仆人的罪孽，因为我作了非常糊涂的事！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫数点了人民以后，良心一直不安，于是对耶和华说："我作了这事，犯了大罪。耶和华啊！现在求你除去你仆人的罪孽，因为我作了非常糊涂的事！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫数点百姓以后，就心中自责，祷告耶和华说：「我行这事大有罪了。耶和华啊，求你除掉仆人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
verses.textEnNiv: David was conscience-stricken after he had counted the fighting men, and he said to the Lord , "I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, Lord , I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."
verses.textEnEsv: But David’s heart struck him after he had numbered the people. And David said to the Lord , "I have sinned greatly in what I have done. But now, O Lord , please take away the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David’s heart condemned him after he had numbered the people. So David said to the Lord, "I have sinned greatly in what I have done; but now, I pray, O Lord, take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have done very foolishly."
verses.textEnNlt: But after he had taken the census, David’s conscience began to bother him. And he said to the Lord , "I have sinned greatly by taking this census. Please forgive my guilt, Lord , for doing this foolish thing."
verses.textEnNasb: Now David’s heart troubled him after he had counted the people. So David said to the Lord, "I have sinned greatly in what I have done. But now, Lord, please overlook the guilt of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly."
verses.textEn: David was conscience-stricken after he had counted the fighting men, and he said to the Lord , "I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, Lord , I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."

verses.textZh: 大卫早晨起来；耶和华的话临到迦得先知，就是大卫的先见，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫早晨起来；耶和华的话临到迦得先知，就是大卫的先见，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫早晨起来，耶和华的话临到先知迦得，就是大卫的先见，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Before David got up the next morning, the word of the Lord had come to Gad the prophet, David’s seer:
verses.textEnEsv: And when David arose in the morning, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when David arose in the morning, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning the word of the Lord came to the prophet Gad, who was David’s seer. This was the message:
verses.textEnNasb: When David got up in the morning, the word of the Lord came to Gad the prophet, David’s seer, saying,
verses.textEn: Before David got up the next morning, the word of the Lord had come to Gad the prophet, David’s seer:

verses.textZh: "你去告诉大卫说：‘耶和华这样说：我给你三个选择，你要选择一个，我好向你施行。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去告诉大卫说：‘耶和华这样说：我给你三个选择，你要选择一个，我好向你施行。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉大卫，说耶和华如此说：『我有三样灾，随你选择一样，我好降与你。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Go and say to David, ‘Thus says the Lord , Three things I offer you. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and tell David, ‘Thus says the Lord: "I offer you three things; choose one of them for yourself, that I may do it to you." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and say to David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I will give you three choices. Choose one of these punishments, and I will inflict it on you.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Go and speak to David, ‘This is what the Lord says: "I am imposing upon you three choices; choose for yourself one of them, and I will do it to you." ’ "
verses.textEn: "Go and tell David, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是迦得来见大卫，问他说："你要国中三年 的饥荒呢？或是要在你敌人面前逃跑，被追赶三个月呢？或是要国中有三天的瘟疫呢？现在你要想想，决定我该用甚么话回复那差我来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是迦得来见大卫，问他说："你要国中三年 的饥荒呢？或是要在你敌人面前逃跑，被追赶三个月呢？或是要国中有三天的瘟疫呢？现在你要想想，决定我该用甚么话回复那差我来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是迦得来见大卫，对他说：「你愿意国中有七年的饥荒呢？是在你敌人面前逃跑，被追赶三个月呢？是在你国中有三日的瘟疫呢？现在你要揣摩思想，我好回复那差我来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Gad went to David and said to him, "Shall there come on you three years of famine in your land? Or three months of fleeing from your enemies while they pursue you? Or three days of plague in your land? Now then, think it over and decide how I should answer the one who sent me."
verses.textEnEsv: So Gad came to David and told him, and said to him, "Shall three years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now consider, and decide what answer I shall return to him who sent me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Gad came to David and told him; and he said to him, "Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or shall you flee three months before your enemies, while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ plague in your land? Now consider and see what answer I should take back to Him who sent me."
verses.textEnNlt: So Gad came to David and asked him, "Will you choose three years of famine throughout your land, three months of fleeing from your enemies, or three days of severe plague throughout your land? Think this over and decide what answer I should give the Lord who sent me."
verses.textEnNasb: So Gad came to David and told him, and said to him, "Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee for three months before your enemies while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days of plague in your land? Now consider and see what answer I shall return to Him who sent me."
verses.textEn: So Gad went to David and said to him, "Shall there come on you three years of famine in your land? Or three months of fleeing from your enemies while they pursue you? Or three days of plague in your land? Now then, think it over and decide how I should answer the one who sent me."

verses.textZh: 大卫对迦得说："我非常为难，我们情愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯。不要让我落在人的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫对迦得说："我非常为难，我们情愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯。不要让我落在人的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫对迦得说：「我甚为难！我愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯。我不愿落在人的手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let us fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is great; but do not let me fall into human hands."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Let us fall into the hand of the Lord , for his mercy is great; but let me not fall into the hand of man."
verses.textEnNkjv: And David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Please let us fall into the hand of the Lord, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into the hand of man."
verses.textEnNlt: "I’m in a desperate situation!" David replied to Gad. "But let us fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is great. Do not let me fall into human hands."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David said to Gad, "I am in great distress. Let us now fall into the hand of the Lord, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into human hands."
verses.textEn: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let us fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is great; but do not let me fall into human hands."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华降瘟疫在以色列地，从早晨直到所定的时间；从但到别是巴，众民中死了七万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华降瘟疫在以色列地，从早晨直到所定的时间；从但到别是巴，众民中死了七万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶和华降瘟疫与以色列人，自早晨到所定的时候；从但直到别是巴，民间死了七万人。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel from that morning until the end of the time designated, and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to Beersheba died.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning until the appointed time. And there died of the people from Dan to Beersheba 70,000 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel from the morning till the appointed time. From Dan to Beersheba seventy thousand men of the people died.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel that morning, and it lasted for three days. A total of 70,000 people died throughout the nation, from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord sent a plague upon Israel from the morning until the appointed time, and seventy thousand men of the people from Dan to Beersheba died.
verses.textEn: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel from that morning until the end of the time designated, and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to Beersheba died.

verses.textZh: 当天使向耶路撒冷伸手，要毁灭耶路撒冷的时候，耶和华就后悔降这灾祸，就对那毁灭众民的天使说："够了，现在住手吧！"那时，耶和华的天使在耶布斯人亚劳拿的打禾场那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当天使向耶路撒冷伸手，要毁灭耶路撒冷的时候，耶和华就后悔降这灾祸，就对那毁灭众民的天使说："够了，现在住手吧！"那时，耶和华的天使在耶布斯人亚劳拿的打禾场那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使向耶路撒冷伸手要灭城的时候，耶和华后悔，就不降这灾了，吩咐灭民的天使说：「够了！住手吧！」那时耶和华的使者在耶布斯人亚劳拿的禾场那里。
verses.textEnNiv: When the angel stretched out his hand to destroy Jerusalem, the Lord relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was afflicting the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the Lord was then at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord relented from the calamity and said to the angel who was working destruction among the people, "It is enough; now stay your hand." And the angel of the Lord was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the angel stretched out His hand over Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord relented from the destruction, and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "It is enough; now restrain your hand." And the angel of the Lord was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNlt: But as the angel was preparing to destroy Jerusalem, the Lord relented and said to the death angel, "Stop! That is enough!" At that moment the angel of the Lord was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEnNasb: When the angel extended his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord relented of the disaster and said to the angel who destroyed the people, "It is enough! Now drop your hand!" And the angel of the Lord was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.textEn: When the angel stretched out his hand to destroy Jerusalem, the Lord relented concerning the disaster and said to the angel who was afflicting the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the Lord was then at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.textZh: 大卫看见那击杀人民的天使，就对耶和华说："犯了罪的是我，行了恶的是我，这群羊又作了甚么呢？求你的手攻击我和我的父家吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫看见那击杀人民的天使，就对耶和华说："犯了罪的是我，行了恶的是我，这群羊又作了甚么呢？求你的手攻击我和我的父家吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫看见灭民的天使，就祷告耶和华说：「我犯了罪，行了恶；但这群羊做了什么呢？愿你的手攻击我和我的父家。」
verses.textEnNiv: When David saw the angel who was striking down the people, he said to the Lord , "I have sinned; I, the shepherd, have done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Let your hand fall on me and my family."
verses.textEnEsv: Then David spoke to the Lord when he saw the angel who was striking the people, and said, "Behold, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me and against my father’s house."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then David spoke to the Lord when he saw the angel who was striking the people, and said, "Surely I have sinned, and I have done wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Let Your hand, I pray, be against me and against my father’s house."
verses.textEnNlt: When David saw the angel, he said to the Lord , "I am the one who has sinned and done wrong! But these people are as innocent as sheep—what have they done? Let your anger fall against me and my family."
verses.textEnNasb: Then David spoke to the Lord when he saw the angel who was striking down the people, and said, "Behold, it is I who have sinned, and it is I who have done wrong; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let Your hand be against me and against my father’s house!"
verses.textEn: When David saw the angel who was striking down the people, he said to the Lord , "I have sinned; I, the shepherd, have done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Let your hand fall on me and my family."

verses.textZh: 那一天，迦得来见大卫，对他说："你上去，在耶布斯人亚劳拿的打禾场那里，为耶和华立一座祭坛。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，迦得来见大卫，对他说："你上去，在耶布斯人亚劳拿的打禾场那里，为耶和华立一座祭坛。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，迦得来见大卫，对他说：「你上去，在耶布斯人亚劳拿的禾场上为耶和华筑一座坛。」
verses.textEnNiv: On that day Gad went to David and said to him, "Go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."
verses.textEnEsv: And Gad came that day to David and said to him, "Go up, raise an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Gad came that day to David and said to him, "Go up, erect an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."
verses.textEnNlt: That day Gad came to David and said to him, "Go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."
verses.textEnNasb: So Gad came to David that day and said to him, "Go up, erect an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."
verses.textEn: On that day Gad went to David and said to him, "Go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."

verses.textZh: 大卫就照着迦得的话，正如耶和华所吩咐的，上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫就照着迦得的话，正如耶和华所吩咐的，上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华名所说的话上去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So David went up, as the Lord had commanded through Gad.
verses.textEnEsv: So David went up at Gad’s word, as the Lord commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David, according to the word of Gad, went up as the Lord commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: So David went up to do what the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David went up in accordance with the word of Gad, just as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEn: So David went up, as the Lord had commanded through Gad.

verses.textZh: 亚劳拿往下观看，看见王和他的臣仆正朝着他这边走过来，就出去迎接，脸伏于地向王叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚劳拿往下观看，看见王和他的臣仆正朝着他这边走过来，就出去迎接，脸伏于地向王叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚劳拿观看，见王和他臣仆前来，就迎接出去，脸伏于地，向王下拜，
verses.textEnNiv: When Araunah looked and saw the king and his officials coming toward him, he went out and bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Araunah looked down, he saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. And Araunah went out and paid homage to the king with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming toward him. So Araunah went out and bowed before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: When Araunah saw the king and his men coming toward him, he came and bowed before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: And Araunah looked down and saw the king and his servants crossing over toward him; so Araunah went out and bowed his face to the ground before the king.
verses.textEn: When Araunah looked and saw the king and his officials coming toward him, he went out and bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.

verses.textZh: 亚劳拿问："我主我王为甚么来到你仆人这里呢？"大卫回答："是要向你买这打禾场，好为耶和华筑一座祭坛，使民间的瘟疫可以止住。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚劳拿问："我主我王为甚么来到你仆人这里呢？"大卫回答："是要向你买这打禾场，好为耶和华筑一座祭坛，使民间的瘟疫可以止住。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我主我王为何来到仆人这里呢？」大卫说：「我要买你这禾场，为耶和华筑一座坛，使民间的瘟疫止住。」
verses.textEnNiv: Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" "To buy your threshing floor," David answered, "so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped."
verses.textEnEsv: And Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" David said, "To buy the threshing floor from you, in order to build an altar to the Lord , that the plague may be averted from the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" And David said, "To buy the threshing floor from you, to build an altar to the Lord, that the plague may be withdrawn from the people."
verses.textEnNlt: "Why have you come, my lord the king?" Araunah asked. David replied, "I have come to buy your threshing floor and to build an altar to the Lord there, so that he will stop the plague."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" And David said, "To buy the threshing floor from you, in order to build an altar to the Lord, so that the plague may be withdrawn from the people."
verses.textEn: Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" "To buy your threshing floor," David answered, "so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped."

verses.textZh: 亚劳拿对大卫说："我主我王看甚么好，就拿去献上吧！看哪，这里有牛可以作燔祭，打禾的器具和套牛的轭可以当柴烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚劳拿对大卫说："我主我王看甚么好，就拿去献上吧！看哪，这里有牛可以作燔祭，打禾的器具和套牛的轭可以当柴烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚劳拿对大卫说：「我主我王，你喜悦用什么，就拿去献祭。看哪，这里有牛可以作燔祭，有打粮的器具和套牛的轭可以当柴烧。
verses.textEnNiv: Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take whatever he wishes and offer it up. Here are oxen for the burnt offering, and here are threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Here are the oxen for the burnt offering and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take and offer up whatever seems good to him. Look, hereare oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing implements and the yokes of the oxen for wood.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take it, my lord the king, and use it as you wish," Araunah said to David. "Here are oxen for the burnt offering, and you can use the threshing boards and ox yokes for wood to build a fire on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Araunah then said to David, "Let my lord the king take and offer up what is good in his sight. Look, here are the oxen for the burnt offering, the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.
verses.textEn: Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take whatever he wishes and offer it up. Here are oxen for the burnt offering, and here are threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood.

verses.textZh: 王啊，这一切亚劳拿都奉给你。"亚劳拿又对王说："愿耶和华你的神悦纳你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王啊，这一切亚劳拿都奉给你。"亚劳拿又对王说："愿耶和华你的神悦纳你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 王啊，这一切，我亚劳拿都奉给你」；又对王说：「愿耶和华－你的神悦纳你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Your Majesty, Araunah gives all this to the king." Araunah also said to him, "May the Lord your God accept you."
verses.textEnEsv: All this, O king, Araunah gives to the king." And Araunah said to the king, "May the Lord your God accept you."
verses.textEnNkjv: All these, O king, Araunah has given to the king." And Araunah said to the king, "May the Lord your God accept you."
verses.textEnNlt: I will give it all to you, Your Majesty, and may the Lord your God accept your sacrifice."
verses.textEnNasb: Everything, O king, Araunah gives to the king." And Araunah said to the king, "May the Lord your God be favorable to you."
verses.textEn: Your Majesty, Araunah gives all this to the king." Araunah also said to him, "May the Lord your God accept you."

verses.textZh: 王回答亚劳拿："不！我一定要按价钱向你买，我不要用白白得来的作燔祭献给耶和华我的神。"于是大卫用五百七十克银子，买下了那打禾场和牛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王回答亚劳拿："不！我一定要按价钱向你买，我不要用白白得来的作燔祭献给耶和华我的神。"于是大卫用五百七十克银子，买下了那打禾场和牛。
verses.textZhCuv: 王对亚劳拿说：「不然。我必要按着价值向你买；我不肯用白得之物作燔祭献给耶和华－我的神。」大卫就用五十舍客勒银子买了那禾场与牛。
verses.textEnNiv: But the king replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying you for it. I will not sacrifice to the Lord my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen and paid fifty shekels of silver for them.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king said to Araunah, "No, but I will buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the Lord my God that cost me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to Araunah, "No, but I will surely buy it from you for a price; nor will I offer burnt offerings to the Lord my God with that which costs me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on buying it, for I will not present burnt offerings to the Lord my God that have cost me nothing." So David paid him fifty pieces of silver for the threshing floor and the oxen.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the king said to Araunah, "No, but I will certainly buy it from you for a price; for I will not offer burnt offerings to the Lord my God that cost me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.textEn: But the king replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying you for it. I will not sacrifice to the Lord my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen and paid fifty shekels of silver for them.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献上燔祭和平安祭。这样耶和华垂听了人们为那地的祷告，瘟疫就在以色列人中止住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献上燔祭和平安祭。这样耶和华垂听了人们为那地的祷告，瘟疫就在以色列人中止住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭。如此，耶和华垂听国民所求的，瘟疫在以色列人中就止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then the Lord answered his prayer in behalf of the land, and the plague on Israel was stopped.
verses.textEnEsv: And David built there an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the Lord responded to the plea for the land, and the plague was averted from Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And David built there an altar to the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the Lord heeded the prayers for the land, and the plague was withdrawn from Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: David built an altar there to the Lord and sacrificed burnt offerings and peace offerings. And the Lord answered his prayer for the land, and the plague on Israel was stopped.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David built there an altar to the Lord, and he offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. And the Lord responded to prayer for the land, and the plague was withdrawn from Israel.
verses.textEn: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then the Lord answered his prayer in behalf of the land, and the plague on Israel was stopped.
